### 31. Inorder Traversal
**Problem**: Binary tree inorder traversal  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
class TreeNode {
    int val;
    TreeNode left;
    TreeNode right;
    TreeNode() {}
    TreeNode(int val) { this.val = val; }
    TreeNode(int val, TreeNode left, TreeNode right) {
        this.val = val;
        this.left = left;
        this.right = right;
    }
}

// Recursive approach
public List<Integer> inorderTraversal(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    inorderHelper(root, result);
    return result;
}

private void inorderHelper(TreeNode node, List<Integer> result) {
    if (node != null) {
        inorderHelper(node.left, result);
        result.add(node.val);
        inorderHelper(node.right, result);
    }
}

// Iterative approach using stack
public List<Integer> inorderTraversalIterative(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (current != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        // Reach the leftmost node
        while (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        }
        
        // Current must be null at this point
        current = stack.pop();
        result.add(current.val);
        
        // Visit the right subtree
        current = current.right;
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Morris Traversal - O(1) space
public List<Integer> inorderTraversalMorris(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (current != null) {
        if (current.left == null) {
            result.add(current.val);
            current = current.right;
        } else {
            // Find inorder predecessor
            TreeNode predecessor = current.left;
            while (predecessor.right != null && predecessor.right != current) {
                predecessor = predecessor.right;
            }
            
            if (predecessor.right == null) {
                // Make current as right child of its inorder predecessor
                predecessor.right = current;
                current = current.left;
            } else {
                // Revert the changes
                predecessor.right = null;
                result.add(current.val);
                current = current.right;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Preorder traversal
public List<Integer> preorderTraversal(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return result;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    stack.push(root);
    
    while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
        TreeNode node = stack.pop();
        result.add(node.val);
        
        if (node.right != null) stack.push(node.right);
        if (node.left != null) stack.push(node.left);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Postorder traversal
public List<Integer> postorderTraversal(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return result;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode lastVisited = null;
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (!stack.isEmpty() || current != null) {
        if (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        } else {
            TreeNode peekNode = stack.peek();
            if (peekNode.right != null && lastVisited != peekNode.right) {
                current = peekNode.right;
            } else {
                result.add(peekNode.val);
                lastVisited = stack.pop();
            }
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h) recursive/iterative, O(1) Morris

### 32. Preorder Traversal
**Problem**: Binary tree preorder traversal  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
// Recursive approach
public List<Integer> preorderTraversal(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    preorderHelper(root, result);
    return result;
}

private void preorderHelper(TreeNode node, List<Integer> result) {
    if (node != null) {
        result.add(node.val);
        preorderHelper(node.left, result);
        preorderHelper(node.right, result);
    }
}

// Iterative approach
public List<Integer> preorderTraversalIterative(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return result;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    stack.push(root);
    
    while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
        TreeNode node = stack.pop();
        result.add(node.val);
        
        // Push right first, then left
        if (node.right != null) stack.push(node.right);
        if (node.left != null) stack.push(node.left);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Morris preorder traversal
public List<Integer> preorderTraversalMorris(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (current != null) {
        if (current.left == null) {
            result.add(current.val);
            current = current.right;
        } else {
            TreeNode predecessor = current.left;
            while (predecessor.right != null && predecessor.right != current) {
                predecessor = predecessor.right;
            }
            
            if (predecessor.right == null) {
                result.add(current.val); // Process before going left
                predecessor.right = current;
                current = current.left;
            } else {
                predecessor.right = null;
                current = current.right;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h) recursive, O(1) Morris

// Recursive approach

    return result;

// Iterative approach using two stacks
public List<Integer> postorderTraversalTwoStacks(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return result;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack1 = new Stack<>();
    Stack<TreeNode> stack2 = new Stack<>();
    
    stack1.push(root);
    
    while (!stack1.isEmpty()) {
        TreeNode node = stack1.pop();
        stack2.push(node);
        
        if (node.left != null) stack1.push(node.left);
        if (node.right != null) stack1.push(node.right);
    }
    
    while (!stack2.isEmpty()) {
        result.add(stack2.pop().val);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Iterative approach using one stack
public List<Integer> postorderTraversalOneStack(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return result;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    TreeNode lastVisited = null;
    
    while (!stack.isEmpty() || current != null) {
        if (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        } else {
            TreeNode peekNode = stack.peek();
            if (peekNode.right != null && lastVisited != peekNode.right) {
                current = peekNode.right;
            } else {
                result.add(peekNode.val);
                lastVisited = stack.pop();
            }
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

### 34. Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
**Problem**: Find maximum depth of binary tree  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
// Recursive approach
public int maxDepth(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return 0;
    
    int leftDepth = maxDepth(root.left);
    int rightDepth = maxDepth(root.right);
    
    return Math.max(leftDepth, rightDepth) + 1;
}

// Iterative BFS approach
public int maxDepthBFS(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return 0;
    
    Queue<TreeNode> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.offer(root);
    int depth = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int size = queue.size();
        depth++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            TreeNode node = queue.poll();
            
            if (node.left != null) queue.offer(node.left);
            if (node.right != null) queue.offer(node.right);
        }
    }
    
    return depth;
}

// Iterative DFS approach
public int maxDepthDFS(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return 0;
    
    Stack<Pair<TreeNode, Integer>> stack = new Stack<>();
    stack.push(new Pair<>(root, 1));
    int maxDepth = 0;
    
    while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
        Pair<TreeNode, Integer> current = stack.pop();
        TreeNode node = current.getKey();
        int depth = current.getValue();
        
        maxDepth = Math.max(maxDepth, depth);
        
        if (node.left != null) {
            stack.push(new Pair<>(node.left, depth + 1));
        }
        if (node.right != null) {
            stack.push(new Pair<>(node.right, depth + 1));
        }
    }
    
    return maxDepth;
}

// Minimum depth
public int minDepth(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return 0;
    
    Queue<TreeNode> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    queue.offer(root);
    int depth = 1;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int size = queue.size();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            TreeNode node = queue.poll();
            
            // If leaf node found, return current depth
            if (node.left == null && node.right == null) {
                return depth;
            }
            
            if (node.left != null) queue.offer(node.left);
            if (node.right != null) queue.offer(node.right);
        }
        
        depth++;
    }
    
    return depth;
}

// Helper class for iterative DFS
class Pair<K, V> {
    private K key;
    private V value;
    
    public Pair(K key, V value) {
        this.key = key;
        this.value = value;
    }
    
    public K getKey() { return key; }
    public V getValue() { return value; }
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h) recursive, O(n) iterative

### 35. Balanced Binary Tree
**Problem**: Check if binary tree is height-balanced  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
// Top-down approach (inefficient)
public boolean isBalanced(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return true;
    
    int leftHeight = height(root.left);
    int rightHeight = height(root.right);
    
    return Math.abs(leftHeight - rightHeight) <= 1 && 
           isBalanced(root.left) && 
           isBalanced(root.right);
}

private int height(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) return 0;
    return Math.max(height(node.left), height(node.right)) + 1;
}

// Bottom-up approach (efficient)
public boolean isBalancedOptimal(TreeNode root) {
    return checkBalance(root) != -1;
}

private int checkBalance(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) return 0;
    
    int leftHeight = checkBalance(node.left);
    if (leftHeight == -1) return -1;
    
    int rightHeight = checkBalance(node.right);
    if (rightHeight == -1) return -1;
    
    if (Math.abs(leftHeight - rightHeight) > 1) return -1;
    
    return Math.max(leftHeight, rightHeight) + 1;
}

// Using custom result class
class BalanceResult {
    boolean isBalanced;
    int height;
    
    BalanceResult(boolean isBalanced, int height) {
        this.isBalanced = isBalanced;
        this.height = height;
    }
}

public boolean isBalancedWithResult(TreeNode root) {
    return checkBalanceWithResult(root).isBalanced;
}

private BalanceResult checkBalanceWithResult(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) {
        return new BalanceResult(true, 0);
    }
    
    BalanceResult left = checkBalanceWithResult(node.left);
    BalanceResult right = checkBalanceWithResult(node.right);
    
    boolean balanced = left.isBalanced && right.isBalanced && 
                      Math.abs(left.height - right.height) <= 1;
    int height = Math.max(left.height, right.height) + 1;
    
    return new BalanceResult(balanced, height);
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h)

### 36. Diameter of Binary Tree
**Problem**: Find diameter (longest path between any two nodes)  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
private int maxDiameter = 0;

public int diameterOfBinaryTree(TreeNode root) {
    maxDiameter = 0;
    height(root);
    return maxDiameter;
}

private int height(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) return 0;
    
    int leftHeight = height(node.left);
    int rightHeight = height(node.right);
    
    // Update diameter at current node
    maxDiameter = Math.max(maxDiameter, leftHeight + rightHeight);
    
    return Math.max(leftHeight, rightHeight) + 1;
}

// Using result class to avoid global variable
class DiameterResult {
    int diameter;
    int height;
    
    DiameterResult(int diameter, int height) {
        this.diameter = diameter;
        this.height = height;
    }
}

public int diameterOfBinaryTreeClean(TreeNode root) {
    return calculateDiameter(root).diameter;
}

private DiameterResult calculateDiameter(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) {
        return new DiameterResult(0, 0);
    }
    
    DiameterResult left = calculateDiameter(node.left);
    DiameterResult right = calculateDiameter(node.right);
    
    int currentDiameter = left.height + right.height;
    int maxDiameter = Math.max(currentDiameter, Math.max(left.diameter, right.diameter));
    int height = Math.max(left.height, right.height) + 1;
    
    return new DiameterResult(maxDiameter, height);
}

// Find diameter path
public List<TreeNode> diameterPath(TreeNode root) {
    List<TreeNode> path = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return path;
    
    findDiameterPath(root);
    return diameterPathNodes;
}

private List<TreeNode> diameterPathNodes = new ArrayList<>();
private int maxDiam = 0;

private int findDiameterPath(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) return 0;
    
    int leftDepth = findDiameterPath(node.left);
    int rightDepth = findDiameterPath(node.right);
    
    if (leftDepth + rightDepth > maxDiam) {
        maxDiam = leftDepth + rightDepth;
        diameterPathNodes.clear();
        
        // Add path from left subtree
        addPath(node.left, leftDepth, diameterPathNodes, true);
        // Add current node
        diameterPathNodes.add(node);
        // Add path from right subtree
        addPath(node.right, rightDepth, diameterPathNodes, false);
    }
    
    return Math.max(leftDepth, rightDepth) + 1;
}

private void addPath(TreeNode node, int depth, List<TreeNode> path, boolean reverse) {
    if (node == null || depth == 0) return;
    
    List<TreeNode> tempPath = new ArrayList<>();
    findNodeAtDepth(node, depth - 1, tempPath);
    
    if (reverse) {
        Collections.reverse(tempPath);
        path.addAll(0, tempPath);
    } else {
        path.addAll(tempPath);
    }
}

private boolean findNodeAtDepth(TreeNode node, int depth, List<TreeNode> path) {
    if (node == null) return false;
    
    path.add(node);
    
    if (depth == 0) return true;
    
    if (findNodeAtDepth(node.left, depth - 1, path) || 
        findNodeAtDepth(node.right, depth - 1, path)) {
        return true;
    }
    
    path.remove(path.size() - 1);
    return false;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h)

### 37. Validate Binary Search Tree
**Problem**: Check if binary tree is valid BST  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public boolean isValidBST(TreeNode root) {
    return validate(root, null, null);
}

private boolean validate(TreeNode node, Integer minVal, Integer maxVal) {
    if (node == null) return true;
    
    if ((minVal != null && node.val <= minVal) || 
        (maxVal != null && node.val >= maxVal)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    return validate(node.left, minVal, node.val) && 
           validate(node.right, node.val, maxVal);
}

// Using inorder traversal
public boolean isValidBSTInorder(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> inorder = new ArrayList<>();
    inorderTraversal(root, inorder);
    
    for (int i = 1; i < inorder.size(); i++) {
        if (inorder.get(i) <= inorder.get(i - 1)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

private void inorderTraversal(TreeNode node, List<Integer> inorder) {
    if (node != null) {
        inorderTraversal(node.left, inorder);
        inorder.add(node.val);
        inorderTraversal(node.right, inorder);
    }
}

// Optimized inorder with early termination
private Integer prevValue = null;

public boolean isValidBSTOptimized(TreeNode root) {
    prevValue = null;
    return inorderCheck(root);
}

private boolean inorderCheck(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) return true;
    
    if (!inorderCheck(node.left)) return false;
    
    if (prevValue != null && node.val <= prevValue) return false;
    prevValue = node.val;
    
    return inorderCheck(node.right);
}

// Iterative inorder approach
public boolean isValidBSTIterative(TreeNode root) {
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    Integer prevValue = null;
    
    while (current != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        while (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        }
        
        current = stack.pop();
        
        if (prevValue != null && current.val <= prevValue) {
            return false;
        }
        prevValue = current.val;
        
        current = current.right;
    }
    
    return true;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h)

### 38. Lowest Common Ancestor in BST
**Problem**: Find LCA of two nodes in BST  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public TreeNode lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    if (root == null) return null;
    
    // Both nodes are in left subtree
    if (p.val < root.val && q.val < root.val) {
        return lowestCommonAncestor(root.left, p, q);
    }
    
    // Both nodes are in right subtree
    if (p.val > root.val && q.val > root.val) {
        return lowestCommonAncestor(root.right, p, q);
    }
    
    // Nodes are on different sides or one is root
    return root;
}

// Iterative approach
public TreeNode lowestCommonAncestorIterative(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (current != null) {
        if (p.val < current.val && q.val < current.val) {
            current = current.left;
        } else if (p.val > current.val && q.val > current.val) {
            current = current.right;
        } else {
            return current;
        }
    }
    
    return null;
}

// Find path to node
public List<TreeNode> findPath(TreeNode root, TreeNode target) {
    List<TreeNode> path = new ArrayList<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    
    while (current != null) {
        path.add(current);
        
        if (target.val == current.val) {
            break;
        } else if (target.val < current.val) {
            current = current.left;
        } else {
            current = current.right;
        }
    }
    
    return path;
}

// LCA using paths
public TreeNode lowestCommonAncestorPaths(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    List<TreeNode> pathP = findPath(root, p);
    List<TreeNode> pathQ = findPath(root, q);
    
    TreeNode lca = null;
    int i = 0;
    
    while (i < pathP.size() && i < pathQ.size() && pathP.get(i) == pathQ.get(i)) {
        lca = pathP.get(i);
        i++;
    }
    
    return lca;
}

// Distance between two nodes
public int distanceBetweenNodes(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    TreeNode lca = lowestCommonAncestor(root, p, q);
    return distanceFromAncestor(lca, p) + distanceFromAncestor(lca, q);
}

private int distanceFromAncestor(TreeNode ancestor, TreeNode node) {
    if (ancestor == null) return -1;
    
    int distance = 0;
    TreeNode current = ancestor;
    
    while (current != null && current.val != node.val) {
        if (node.val < current.val) {
            current = current.left;
        } else {
            current = current.right;
        }
        distance++;
    }
    
    return current != null ? distance : -1;
}
```
**Time**: O(h), **Space**: O(h) recursive, O(1) iterative

### 39. Construct BST from Preorder
**Problem**: Construct BST from preorder traversal  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public TreeNode bstFromPreorder(int[] preorder) {
    return buildBST(preorder, 0, preorder.length - 1);
}

private TreeNode buildBST(int[] preorder, int start, int end) {
    if (start > end) return null;
    
    TreeNode root = new TreeNode(preorder[start]);
    
    // Find the first element greater than root
    int i = start + 1;
    while (i <= end && preorder[i] < preorder[start]) {
        i++;
    }
    
    root.left = buildBST(preorder, start + 1, i - 1);
    root.right = buildBST(preorder, i, end);
    
    return root;
}

// Optimized approach using bounds
private int preorderIndex = 0;

public TreeNode bstFromPreorderOptimal(int[] preorder) {
    preorderIndex = 0;
    return buildBSTWithBounds(preorder, Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
}

private TreeNode buildBSTWithBounds(int[] preorder, int minVal, int maxVal) {
    if (preorderIndex >= preorder.length) return null;
    
    int val = preorder[preorderIndex];
    if (val < minVal || val > maxVal) return null;
    
    preorderIndex++;
    TreeNode root = new TreeNode(val);
    
    root.left = buildBSTWithBounds(preorder, minVal, val);
    root.right = buildBSTWithBounds(preorder, val, maxVal);
    
    return root;
}

// Using stack approach
public TreeNode bstFromPreorderStack(int[] preorder) {
    if (preorder.length == 0) return null;
    
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode root = new TreeNode(preorder[0]);
    stack.push(root);
    
    for (int i = 1; i < preorder.length; i++) {
        TreeNode current = new TreeNode(preorder[i]);
        TreeNode parent = null;
        
        // Find the correct parent
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && stack.peek().val < current.val) {
            parent = stack.pop();
        }
        
        if (parent != null) {
            parent.right = current;
        } else {
            stack.peek().left = current;
        }
        
        stack.push(current);
    }
    
    return root;
}

// Construct from inorder and preorder
public TreeNode buildTree(int[] preorder, int[] inorder) {
    Map<Integer, Integer> inorderMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < inorder.length; i++) {
        inorderMap.put(inorder[i], i);
    }
    
    return buildTreeHelper(preorder, 0, preorder.length - 1, 
                          inorder, 0, inorder.length - 1, inorderMap);
}

private TreeNode buildTreeHelper(int[] preorder, int preStart, int preEnd,
                                int[] inorder, int inStart, int inEnd,
                                Map<Integer, Integer> inorderMap) {
    if (preStart > preEnd || inStart > inEnd) return null;
    
    TreeNode root = new TreeNode(preorder[preStart]);
    int inorderIndex = inorderMap.get(root.val);
    int leftSubtreeSize = inorderIndex - inStart;
    
    root.left = buildTreeHelper(preorder, preStart + 1, preStart + leftSubtreeSize,
                               inorder, inStart, inorderIndex - 1, inorderMap);
    root.right = buildTreeHelper(preorder, preStart + leftSubtreeSize + 1, preEnd,
                                inorder, inorderIndex + 1, inEnd, inorderMap);
    
    return root;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h)

### 40. Successor/Predecessor in BST
**Problem**: Find inorder successor and predecessor in BST  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Find inorder successor
public TreeNode inorderSuccessor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p) {
    TreeNode successor = null;
    
    while (root != null) {
        if (p.val < root.val) {
            successor = root;
            root = root.left;
        } else {
            root = root.right;
        }
    }
    
    return successor;
}

// Find inorder predecessor
public TreeNode inorderPredecessor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p) {
    TreeNode predecessor = null;
    
    while (root != null) {
        if (p.val > root.val) {
            predecessor = root;
            root = root.right;
        } else {
            root = root.left;
        }
    }
    
    return predecessor;
}

// Find both successor and predecessor
public TreeNode[] findSuccessorPredecessor(TreeNode root, int key) {
    TreeNode successor = null;
    TreeNode predecessor = null;
    
    // Find key and update successor/predecessor
    while (root != null) {
        if (key == root.val) {
            // If left subtree exists, predecessor is rightmost node in left subtree
            if (root.left != null) {
                predecessor = findMax(root.left);
            }
            
            // If right subtree exists, successor is leftmost node in right subtree
            if (root.right != null) {
                successor = findMin(root.right);
            }
            break;
        } else if (key < root.val) {
            successor = root;
            root = root.left;
        } else {
            predecessor = root;
            root = root.right;
        }
    }
    
    return new TreeNode[]{predecessor, successor};
}

private TreeNode findMin(TreeNode node) {
    while (node.left != null) {
        node = node.left;
    }
    return node;
}

private TreeNode findMax(TreeNode node) {
    while (node.right != null) {
        node = node.right;
    }
    return node;
}

// Morris traversal approach for successor
public TreeNode inorderSuccessorMorris(TreeNode root, TreeNode p) {
    TreeNode current = root;
    TreeNode successor = null;
    boolean found = false;
    
    while (current != null) {
        if (current.left == null) {
            if (found) return current;
            if (current == p) found = true;
            current = current.right;
        } else {
            TreeNode predecessor = current.left;
            while (predecessor.right != null && predecessor.right != current) {
                predecessor = predecessor.right;
            }
            
            if (predecessor.right == null) {
                predecessor.right = current;
                current = current.left;
            } else {
                predecessor.right = null;
                if (found) return current;
                if (current == p) found = true;
                current = current.right;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return null;
}

// Find kth smallest element (successor variation)
public int kthSmallest(TreeNode root, int k) {
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    int count = 0;
    
    while (current != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        while (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        }
        
        current = stack.pop();
        count++;
        
        if (count == k) {
            return current.val;
        }
        
        current = current.right;
    }
    
    return -1; // k is out of range
}

// Find kth largest element (predecessor variation)
public int kthLargest(TreeNode root, int k) {
    Stack<TreeNode> stack = new Stack<>();
    TreeNode current = root;
    int count = 0;
    
    while (current != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        while (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.right;
        }
        
        current = stack.pop();
        count++;
        
        if (count == k) {
            return current.val;
        }
        
        current = current.left;
    }
    
    return -1; // k is out of range
}
```
**Time**: O(h), **Space**: O(1) for iterative, O(h) for Morris

### 41. BST Iterator
**Problem**: Implement BST iterator for inorder traversal  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class BSTIterator {
    private Stack<TreeNode> stack;
    
    public BSTIterator(TreeNode root) {
        stack = new Stack<>();
        pushLeft(root);
    }
    
    private void pushLeft(TreeNode node) {
        while (node != null) {
            stack.push(node);
            node = node.left;
        }
    }
    
    public int next() {
        TreeNode node = stack.pop();
        if (node.right != null) {
            pushLeft(node.right);
        }
        return node.val;
    }
    
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return !stack.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Two-way iterator (with previous)
class BSTIteratorTwoWay {
    private Stack<TreeNode> nextStack;
    private Stack<TreeNode> prevStack;
    
    public BSTIteratorTwoWay(TreeNode root) {
        nextStack = new Stack<>();
        prevStack = new Stack<>();
        pushLeft(root, nextStack);
    }
    
    private void pushLeft(TreeNode node, Stack<TreeNode> stack) {
        while (node != null) {
            stack.push(node);
            node = node.left;
        }
    }
    
    private void pushRight(TreeNode node, Stack<TreeNode> stack) {
        while (node != null) {
            stack.push(node);
            node = node.right;
        }
    }
    
    public int next() {
        TreeNode node = nextStack.pop();
        prevStack.push(node);
        
        if (node.right != null) {
            pushLeft(node.right, nextStack);
        }
        
        return node.val;
    }
    
    public int previous() {
        TreeNode node = prevStack.pop();
        nextStack.push(node);
        
        if (node.left != null) {
            pushRight(node.left, prevStack);
        }
        
        return node.val;
    }
    
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return !nextStack.isEmpty();
    }
    
    public boolean hasPrevious() {
        return !prevStack.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Iterator with O(1) average time using Morris-like approach
class BSTIteratorMorris {
    private TreeNode current;
    private Stack<TreeNode> stack;
    
    public BSTIteratorMorris(TreeNode root) {
        current = root;
        stack = new Stack<>();
    }
    
    public int next() {
        while (current != null) {
            stack.push(current);
            current = current.left;
        }
        
        TreeNode node = stack.pop();
        current = node.right;
        
        return node.val;
    }
    
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return current != null || !stack.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Range iterator (within a range)
class BSTRangeIterator {
    private Stack<TreeNode> stack;
    private int low, high;
    
    public BSTRangeIterator(TreeNode root, int low, int high) {
        this.low = low;
        this.high = high;
        stack = new Stack<>();
        pushLeft(root);
    }
    
    private void pushLeft(TreeNode node) {
        while (node != null) {
            if (node.val >= low) {
                stack.push(node);
                node = node.left;
            } else {
                node = node.right;
            }
        }
    }
    
    public int next() {
        TreeNode node = stack.pop();
        
        if (node.right != null) {
            pushLeft(node.right);
        }
        
        return node.val;
    }
    
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && stack.peek().val <= high;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(1) amortized for next(), **Space**: O(h)

### 42. Size of Largest BST in Binary Tree
**Problem**: Find size of largest BST subtree in binary tree  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class BSTInfo {
    boolean isBST;
    int size;
    int min;
    int max;
    
    BSTInfo(boolean isBST, int size, int min, int max) {
        this.isBST = isBST;
        this.size = size;
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
    }
}

private int maxBSTSize = 0;

public int largestBSTSubtree(TreeNode root) {
    maxBSTSize = 0;
    getBSTInfo(root);
    return maxBSTSize;
}

private BSTInfo getBSTInfo(TreeNode node) {
    if (node == null) {
        return new BSTInfo(true, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    }
    
    BSTInfo left = getBSTInfo(node.left);
    BSTInfo right = getBSTInfo(node.right);
    
    if (left.isBST && right.isBST && 
        node.val > left.max && node.val < right.min) {
        
        int size = left.size + right.size + 1;
        maxBSTSize = Math.max(maxBSTSize, size);
        
        int min = left.size == 0 ? node.val : left.min;
        int max = right.size == 0 ? node.val : right.max;
        
        return new BSTInfo(true, size, min, max);
    }
    
    return new BSTInfo(false, 0, 0, 0);
}

// Alternative approach with cleaner structure
class BSTResult {
    int maxBSTSize;
    boolean isBST;
    int size;
    int minVal;
    int maxVal;
    
    BSTResult() {
        this.maxBSTSize = 0;
        this.isBST = true;
        this.size = 0;
        this.minVal = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        this.maxVal = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    }
}

public int largestBSTSubtreeAlternative(TreeNode root) {
    return largestBSTHelper(root).maxBSTSize;
}

private BSTResult largestBSTHelper(TreeNode node) {
    BSTResult result = new BSTResult();
    
    if (node == null) {
        return result;
    }
    
    BSTResult left = largestBSTHelper(node.left);
    BSTResult right = largestBSTHelper(node.right);
    
    // Check if current subtree is BST
    if (left.isBST && right.isBST &&
        (node.left == null || left.maxVal < node.val) &&
        (node.right == null || right.minVal > node.val)) {
        
        result.isBST = true;
        result.size = left.size + right.size + 1;
        result.minVal = node.left == null ? node.val : left.minVal;
        result.maxVal = node.right == null ? node.val : right.maxVal;
        result.maxBSTSize = result.size;
    } else {
        result.isBST = false;
        result.maxBSTSize = Math.max(left.maxBSTSize, right.maxBSTSize);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Find the actual largest BST subtree root
public TreeNode largestBSTSubtreeRoot(TreeNode root) {
    BSTNodeResult result = findLargestBSTRoot(root);
    return result.largestBSTRoot;
}

class BSTNodeResult {
    TreeNode largestBSTRoot;
    int maxBSTSize;
    boolean isBST;
    int size;
    int minVal;
    int maxVal;
    
    BSTNodeResult() {
        this.largestBSTRoot = null;
        this.maxBSTSize = 0;
        this.isBST = true;
        this.size = 0;
        this.minVal = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        this.maxVal = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    }
}

private BSTNodeResult findLargestBSTRoot(TreeNode node) {
    BSTNodeResult result = new BSTNodeResult();
    
    if (node == null) {
        return result;
    }
    
    BSTNodeResult left = findLargestBSTRoot(node.left);
    BSTNodeResult right = findLargestBSTRoot(node.right);
    
    if (left.isBST && right.isBST &&
        (node.left == null || left.maxVal < node.val) &&
        (node.right == null || right.minVal > node.val)) {
        
        result.isBST = true;
        result.size = left.size + right.size + 1;
        result.minVal = node.left == null ? node.val : left.minVal;
        result.maxVal = node.right == null ? node.val : right.maxVal;
        result.maxBSTSize = result.size;
        result.largestBSTRoot = node;
    } else {
        result.isBST = false;
        if (left.maxBSTSize >= right.maxBSTSize) {
            result.maxBSTSize = left.maxBSTSize;
            result.largestBSTRoot = left.largestBSTRoot;
        } else {
            result.maxBSTSize = right.maxBSTSize;
            result.largestBSTRoot = right.largestBSTRoot;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(h)

### **Day 8: Dynamic Programming Part-I (6 Questions)** ✅

### 43. Maximum Subarray Sum (Kadane's Algorithm)
**Problem**: Find maximum sum of contiguous subarray  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public int maxSubArray(int[] nums) {
    int maxSoFar = nums[0];
    int maxEndingHere = nums[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        maxEndingHere = Math.max(nums[i], maxEndingHere + nums[i]);
        maxSoFar = Math.max(maxSoFar, maxEndingHere);
    }
    
    return maxSoFar;
}

// Return the actual subarray
public int[] maxSubArrayWithIndices(int[] nums) {
    int maxSum = nums[0];
    int currentSum = nums[0];
    int start = 0, end = 0, tempStart = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (currentSum < 0) {
            currentSum = nums[i];
            tempStart = i;
        } else {
            currentSum += nums[i];
        }
        
        if (currentSum > maxSum) {
            maxSum = currentSum;
            start = tempStart;
            end = i;
        }
    }
    
    return new int[]{start, end, maxSum};
}

// 2D Maximum subarray (Kadane's extension)
public int maxSubArraySum2D(int[][] matrix) {
    int m = matrix.length, n = matrix[0].length;
    int maxSum = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    for (int top = 0; top < m; top++) {
        int[] temp = new int[n];
        
        for (int bottom = top; bottom < m; bottom++) {
            // Add current row to temp
            for (int col = 0; col < n; col++) {
                temp[col] += matrix[bottom][col];
            }
            
            // Apply Kadane's algorithm
            int currentMax = maxSubArray(temp);
            maxSum = Math.max(maxSum, currentMax);
        }
    }
    
    return maxSum;
}

// Maximum subarray with at most k elements
public int maxSubArrayK(int[] nums, int k) {
    if (k <= 0 || k > nums.length) return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    int maxSum = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= nums.length - k; i++) {
        int currentSum = 0;
        for (int j = i; j < i + k && j < nums.length; j++) {
            currentSum += nums[j];
            if (j - i + 1 >= 1) { // At least 1 element
                maxSum = Math.max(maxSum, currentSum);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return maxSum;
}

// Circular array maximum subarray
public int maxSubarraySumCircular(int[] nums) {
    // Case 1: Maximum subarray is not circular (normal Kadane's)
    int normalMax = kadane(nums);
    
    // Case 2: Maximum subarray is circular
    int totalSum = 0;
    for (int num : nums) {
        totalSum += num;
    }
    
    // Invert array and find minimum subarray
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        nums[i] = -nums[i];
    }
    
    int minSubarray = kadane(nums);
    int circularMax = totalSum + minSubarray; // totalSum - (-minSubarray)
    
    // Restore original array
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        nums[i] = -nums[i];
    }
    
    // Handle edge case: all elements are negative
    return circularMax == 0 ? normalMax : Math.max(normalMax, circularMax);
}

private int kadane(int[] nums) {
    int maxSoFar = nums[0];
    int maxEndingHere = nums[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        maxEndingHere = Math.max(nums[i], maxEndingHere + nums[i]);
        maxSoFar = Math.max(maxSoFar, maxEndingHere);
    }
    
    return maxSoFar;
}
```
**Time**: O(n) for 1D, O(n³) for 2D, **Space**: O(1) for 1D, O(n) for 2D

### 44. Maximum Product Subarray
**Problem**: Find maximum product of contiguous subarray  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int maxProduct(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return 0;
    
    int maxSoFar = nums[0];
    int maxEndingHere = nums[0];
    int minEndingHere = nums[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        int temp = maxEndingHere;
        
        maxEndingHere = Math.max(nums[i], 
                        Math.max(maxEndingHere * nums[i], 
                                minEndingHere * nums[i]));
        
        minEndingHere = Math.min(nums[i], 
                        Math.min(temp * nums[i], 
                                minEndingHere * nums[i]));
        
        maxSoFar = Math.max(maxSoFar, maxEndingHere);
    }
    
    return maxSoFar;
}

// Alternative approach handling zeros
public int maxProductAlternative(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int maxProduct = nums[0];
    int currentMax = nums[0];
    int currentMin = nums[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (nums[i] == 0) {
            currentMax = currentMin = 1;
            maxProduct = Math.max(maxProduct, 0);
        } else {
            int tempMax = currentMax;
            currentMax = Math.max(nums[i], Math.max(currentMax * nums[i], currentMin * nums[i]));
            currentMin = Math.min(nums[i], Math.min(tempMax * nums[i], currentMin * nums[i]));
            maxProduct = Math.max(maxProduct, currentMax);
        }
    }
    
    return maxProduct;
}

// Find actual subarray with maximum product
public int[] maxProductSubarray(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return new int[]{};
    
    int maxProduct = nums[0];
    int maxEndingHere = nums[0];
    int minEndingHere = nums[0];
    int start = 0, end = 0, tempStart = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (nums[i] == 0) {
            maxEndingHere = minEndingHere = 1;
            tempStart = i + 1;
            if (maxProduct < 0) {
                maxProduct = 0;
                start = end = i;
            }
            continue;
        }
        
        int temp = maxEndingHere;
        int prevMax = maxEndingHere;
        
        maxEndingHere = Math.max(nums[i], 
                        Math.max(maxEndingHere * nums[i], 
                                minEndingHere * nums[i]));
        
        minEndingHere = Math.min(nums[i], 
                        Math.min(temp * nums[i], 
                                minEndingHere * nums[i]));
        
        if (maxEndingHere == nums[i]) {
            tempStart = i;
        }
        
        if (maxEndingHere > maxProduct) {
            maxProduct = maxEndingHere;
            start = tempStart;
            end = i;
        }
    }
    
    return Arrays.copyOfRange(nums, start, end + 1);
}

// Left-right scan approach
public int maxProductLeftRight(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int maxProduct = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    // Left to right scan
    int product = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        product *= nums[i];
        maxProduct = Math.max(maxProduct, product);
        if (product == 0) product = 1;
    }
    
    // Right to left scan
    product = 1;
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        product *= nums[i];
        maxProduct = Math.max(maxProduct, product);
        if (product == 0) product = 1;
    }
    
    return maxProduct;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(1)

### 45. Coin Change
**Problem**: Find minimum coins needed to make target amount  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int coinChange(int[] coins, int amount) {
    int[] dp = new int[amount + 1];
    Arrays.fill(dp, amount + 1);
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= amount; i++) {
        for (int coin : coins) {
            if (coin <= i) {
                dp[i] = Math.min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[amount] > amount ? -1 : dp[amount];
}

// Space optimized using BFS
public int coinChangeBFS(int[] coins, int amount) {
    if (amount == 0) return 0;
    
    Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
    
    queue.offer(0);
    visited.add(0);
    int level = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int size = queue.size();
        level++;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int current = queue.poll();
            
            for (int coin : coins) {
                int next = current + coin;
                
                if (next == amount) {
                    return level;
                }
                
                if (next < amount && !visited.contains(next)) {
                    visited.add(next);
                    queue.offer(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return -1;
}

// Count number of ways to make change
public int change(int amount, int[] coins) {
    int[] dp = new int[amount + 1];
    dp[0] = 1;
    
    for (int coin : coins) {
        for (int i = coin; i <= amount; i++) {
            dp[i] += dp[i - coin];
        }
    }
    
    return dp[amount];
}

// Find actual coin combination
public List<Integer> coinChangeActual(int[] coins, int amount) {
    int[] dp = new int[amount + 1];
    int[] parent = new int[amount + 1];
    Arrays.fill(dp, amount + 1);
    Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= amount; i++) {
        for (int coin : coins) {
            if (coin <= i && dp[i - coin] + 1 < dp[i]) {
                dp[i] = dp[i - coin] + 1;
                parent[i] = coin;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (dp[amount] > amount) return new ArrayList<>();
    
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int current = amount;
    while (current > 0) {
        result.add(parent[current]);
        current -= parent[current];
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Unbounded knapsack variant
public int coinChangeUnbounded(int[] coins, int amount) {
    int[][] dp = new int[coins.length + 1][amount + 1];
    
    // Initialize first row (no coins available)
    for (int i = 1; i <= amount; i++) {
        dp[0][i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= coins.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= amount; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]; // Don't take current coin
            
            if (coins[i - 1] <= j && dp[i][j - coins[i - 1]] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i][j - coins[i - 1]] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[coins.length][amount] == Integer.MAX_VALUE ? -1 : dp[coins.length][amount];
}
```
**Time**: O(n × amount), **Space**: O(amount)

### 46. Longest Increasing Subsequence
**Problem**: Find length of longest increasing subsequence  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Dynamic Programming O(n²)
public int lengthOfLIS(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return 0;
    
    int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
    Arrays.fill(dp, 1);
    int maxLength = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[j] < nums[i]) {
                dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            }
        }
        maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, dp[i]);
    }
    
    return maxLength;
}

// Binary Search O(n log n)
public int lengthOfLISOptimal(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return 0;
    
    List<Integer> tails = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        int pos = binarySearch(tails, num);
        
        if (pos == tails.size()) {
            tails.add(num);
        } else {
            tails.set(pos, num);
        }
    }
    
    return tails.size();
}

private int binarySearch(List<Integer> tails, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = tails.size();
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        if (tails.get(mid) < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Find actual LIS
public List<Integer> findLIS(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return new ArrayList<>();
    
    int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
    int[] parent = new int[nums.length];
    Arrays.fill(dp, 1);
    Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
    
    int maxLength = 1;
    int maxIndex = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[j] < nums[i] && dp[j] + 1 > dp[i]) {
                dp[i] = dp[j] + 1;
                parent[i] = j;
            }
        }
        
        if (dp[i] > maxLength) {
            maxLength = dp[i];
            maxIndex = i;
        }
    }
    
    // Reconstruct LIS
    List<Integer> lis = new ArrayList<>();
    int current = maxIndex;
    while (current != -1) {
        lis.add(0, nums[current]);
        current = parent[current];
    }
    
    return lis;
}

// Longest Decreasing Subsequence
public int lengthOfLDS(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return 0;
    
    int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
    Arrays.fill(dp, 1);
    int maxLength = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[j] > nums[i]) {
                dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            }
        }
        maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, dp[i]);
    }
    
    return maxLength;
}

// Number of LIS
public int findNumberOfLIS(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length == 0) return 0;
    
    int[] dp = new int[nums.length];
    int[] count = new int[nums.length];
    Arrays.fill(dp, 1);
    Arrays.fill(count, 1);
    
    int maxLength = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[j] < nums[i]) {
                if (dp[j] + 1 > dp[i]) {
                    dp[i] = dp[j] + 1;
                    count[i] = count[j];
                } else if (dp[j] + 1 == dp[i]) {
                    count[i] += count[j];
                }
            }
        }
        maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, dp[i]);
    }
    
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (dp[i] == maxLength) {
            result += count[i];
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n²) DP, O(n log n) Binary Search, **Space**: O(n)

### 47. Longest Common Subsequence
**Problem**: Find length of longest common subsequence  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int longestCommonSubsequence(String text1, String text2) {
    int m = text1.length(), n = text2.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}

// Space optimized
public int longestCommonSubsequenceOptimized(String text1, String text2) {
    int m = text1.length(), n = text2.length();
    int[] prev = new int[n + 1];
    int[] curr = new int[n + 1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                curr[j] = prev[j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                curr[j] = Math.max(prev[j], curr[j - 1]);
            }
        }
        int[] temp = prev;
        prev = curr;
        curr = temp;
    }
    
    return prev[n];
}

// Find actual LCS
public String findLCS(String text1, String text2) {
    int m = text1.length(), n = text2.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Reconstruct LCS
    StringBuilder lcs = new StringBuilder();
    int i = m, j = n;
    
    while (i > 0 && j > 0) {
        if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
            lcs.append(text1.charAt(i - 1));
            i--;
            j--;
        } else if (dp[i - 1][j] > dp[i][j - 1]) {
            i--;
        } else {
            j--;
        }
    }
    
    return lcs.reverse().toString();
}

// Print all LCS
public Set<String> findAllLCS(String text1, String text2) {
    int m = text1.length(), n = text2.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    Set<String> allLCS = new HashSet<>();
    findAllLCSHelper(text1, text2, dp, m, n, "", allLCS);
    return allLCS;
}

private void findAllLCSHelper(String text1, String text2, int[][] dp, 
                             int i, int j, String current, Set<String> allLCS) {
    if (i == 0 || j == 0) {
        allLCS.add(new StringBuilder(current).reverse().toString());
        return;
    }
    
    if (text1.charAt(i - 1) == text2.charAt(j - 1)) {
        findAllLCSHelper(text1, text2, dp, i - 1, j - 1, 
                        current + text1.charAt(i - 1), allLCS);
    } else {
        if (dp[i - 1][j] == dp[i][j]) {
            findAllLCSHelper(text1, text2, dp, i - 1, j, current, allLCS);
        }
        if (dp[i][j - 1] == dp[i][j]) {
            findAllLCSHelper(text1, text2, dp, i, j - 1, current, allLCS);
        }
    }
}

// Shortest common supersequence
public String shortestCommonSupersequence(String str1, String str2) {
    String lcs = findLCS(str1, str2);
    
    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
    int i = 0, j = 0, k = 0;
    
    while (k < lcs.length()) {
        while (i < str1.length() && str1.charAt(i) != lcs.charAt(k)) {
            result.append(str1.charAt(i++));
        }
        while (j < str2.length() && str2.charAt(j) != lcs.charAt(k)) {
            result.append(str2.charAt(j++));
        }
        result.append(lcs.charAt(k++));
        i++;
        j++;
    }
    
    // Append remaining characters
    while (i < str1.length()) {
        result.append(str1.charAt(i++));
    }
    while (j < str2.length()) {
        result.append(str2.charAt(j++));
    }
    
    return result.toString();
}
```
**Time**: O(m × n), **Space**: O(m × n) full DP, O(n) space optimized

### 48. 0/1 Knapsack Problem
**Problem**: Maximum value with weight constraint  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int knapsack(int W, int[] wt, int[] val, int n) {
    int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][W + 1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 1; w <= W; w++) {
            if (wt[i - 1] <= w) {
                dp[i][w] = Math.max(val[i - 1] + dp[i - 1][w - wt[i - 1]], 
                                   dp[i - 1][w]);
            } else {
                dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n][W];
}

// Space optimized
public int knapsackOptimized(int W, int[] wt, int[] val, int n) {
    int[] dp = new int[W + 1];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int w = W; w >= wt[i]; w--) {
            dp[w] = Math.max(dp[w], dp[w - wt[i]] + val[i]);
        }
    }
    
    return dp[W];
}

// Find items included in knapsack
public List<Integer> knapsackItems(int W, int[] wt, int[] val, int n) {
    int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][W + 1];
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 1; w <= W; w++) {
            if (wt[i - 1] <= w) {
                dp[i][w] = Math.max(val[i - 1] + dp[i - 1][w - wt[i - 1]], 
                                   dp[i - 1][w]);
            } else {
                dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w];
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Backtrack to find items
    List<Integer> items = new ArrayList<>();
    int w = W;
    for (int i = n; i > 0 && w > 0; i--) {
        if (dp[i][w] != dp[i - 1][w]) {
            items.add(i - 1); // Item index
            w -= wt[i - 1];
        }
    }
    
    Collections.reverse(items);
    return items;
}

// Count number of ways to achieve exact weight
public int knapsackCount(int W, int[] wt, int n) {
    int[] dp = new int[W + 1];
    dp[0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int w = W; w >= wt[i]; w--) {
            dp[w] += dp[w - wt[i]];
        }
    }
    
    return dp[W];
}

// Unbounded knapsack (unlimited items)
public int unboundedKnapsack(int W, int[] wt, int[] val, int n) {
    int[] dp = new int[W + 1];
    
    for (int w = 1; w <= W; w++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (wt[i] <= w) {
                dp[w] = Math.max(dp[w], dp[w - wt[i]] + val[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[W];
}

// Fractional knapsack (greedy approach)
public double fractionalKnapsack(int W, int[] wt, int[] val, int n) {
    // Create array of items with value-to-weight ratio
    Item[] items = new Item[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        items[i] = new Item(val[i], wt[i], (double) val[i] / wt[i]);
    }
    
    // Sort by ratio in descending order
    Arrays.sort(items, (a, b) -> Double.compare(b.ratio, a.ratio));
    
    double totalValue = 0.0;
    int currentWeight = 0;
    
    for (Item item : items) {
        if (currentWeight + item.weight <= W) {
            totalValue += item.value;
            currentWeight += item.weight;
        } else {
            double remainingWeight = W - currentWeight;
            totalValue += item.ratio * remainingWeight;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return totalValue;
}

class Item {
    int value, weight;
    double ratio;
    
    Item(int value, int weight, double ratio) {
        this.value = value;
        this.weight = weight;
        this.ratio = ratio;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n × W), **Space**: O(W) optimized

### 49. Edit Distance (Levenshtein Distance)
**Problem**: Minimum operations to convert string1 to string2  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int minDistance(String word1, String word2) {
    int m = word1.length(), n = word2.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    // Initialize base cases
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = i; // Delete all characters
    }
    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
        dp[0][j] = j; // Insert all characters
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (word1.charAt(i - 1) == word2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1]; // No operation needed
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = 1 + Math.min(
                    Math.min(dp[i - 1][j],     // Delete
                            dp[i][j - 1]),     // Insert
                    dp[i - 1][j - 1]          // Replace
                );
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}

// Space optimized
public int minDistanceOptimized(String word1, String word2) {
    int m = word1.length(), n = word2.length();
    int[] prev = new int[n + 1];
    int[] curr = new int[n + 1];
    
    // Initialize first row
    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
        prev[j] = j;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        curr[0] = i;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (word1.charAt(i - 1) == word2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                curr[j] = prev[j - 1];
            } else {
                curr[j] = 1 + Math.min(Math.min(prev[j], curr[j - 1]), prev[j - 1]);
            }
        }
        int[] temp = prev;
        prev = curr;
        curr = temp;
    }
    
    return prev[n];
}

// Find actual sequence of operations
public List<String> minDistanceOperations(String word1, String word2) {
    int m = word1.length(), n = word2.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    // Fill DP table
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) dp[0][j] = j;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (word1.charAt(i - 1) == word2.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = 1 + Math.min(Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]), dp[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Backtrack to find operations
    List<String> operations = new ArrayList<>();
    int i = m, j = n;
    
    while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
        if (i > 0 && j > 0 && word1.charAt(i - 1) == word2.charAt(j - 1)) {
            i--;
            j--;
        } else if (i > 0 && j > 0 && dp[i][j] == dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1) {
            operations.add("Replace " + word1.charAt(i - 1) + " with " + word2.charAt(j - 1));
            i--;
            j--;
        } else if (i > 0 && dp[i][j] == dp[i - 1][j] + 1) {
            operations.add("Delete " + word1.charAt(i - 1));
            i--;
        } else if (j > 0 && dp[i][j] == dp[i][j - 1] + 1) {
            operations.add("Insert " + word2.charAt(j - 1));
            j--;
        }
    }
    
    Collections.reverse(operations);
    return operations;
}

// One edit distance
public boolean isOneEditDistance(String s, String t) {
    int m = s.length(), n = t.length();
    
    if (Math.abs(m - n) > 1) return false;
    if (s.equals(t)) return false;
    
    if (m > n) return isOneEditDistance(t, s);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        if (s.charAt(i) != t.charAt(i)) {
            if (m == n) {
                return s.substring(i + 1).equals(t.substring(i + 1));
            } else {
                return s.substring(i).equals(t.substring(i + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    return m + 1 == n;
}
```
**Time**: O(m × n), **Space**: O(n) optimized

### 50. Distinct Subsequences
**Problem**: Number of distinct subsequences of s which equals t  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int numDistinct(String s, String t) {
    int m = s.length(), n = t.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    // Empty string t can be formed by any string s in 1 way
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = 1;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]; // Don't use current character
            
            if (s.charAt(i - 1) == t.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1]; // Use current character
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}

// Space optimized
public int numDistinctOptimized(String s, String t) {
    int m = s.length(), n = t.length();
    int[] prev = new int[n + 1];
    int[] curr = new int[n + 1];
    
    prev[0] = curr[0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            curr[j] = prev[j];
            if (s.charAt(i - 1) == t.charAt(j - 1)) {
                curr[j] += prev[j - 1];
            }
        }
        int[] temp = prev;
        prev = curr;
        curr = temp;
    }
    
    return prev[n];
}

// 1D space optimization
public int numDistinct1D(String s, String t) {
    int m = s.length(), n = t.length();
    int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
    dp[0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = n; j >= 1; j--) {
            if (s.charAt(i - 1) == t.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[j] += dp[j - 1];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n];
}

// Handle overflow with modulo
public int numDistinctMod(String s, String t) {
    int MOD = 1000000007;
    int m = s.length(), n = t.length();
    long[] dp = new long[n + 1];
    dp[0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = n; j >= 1; j--) {
            if (s.charAt(i - 1) == t.charAt(j - 1)) {
                dp[j] = (dp[j] + dp[j - 1]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return (int) dp[n];
}
```
**Time**: O(m × n), **Space**: O(n)

### 51. Regular Expression Matching
**Problem**: Check if string matches pattern with '.' and '*'  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public boolean isMatch(String s, String p) {
    int m = s.length(), n = p.length();
    boolean[][] dp = new boolean[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    dp[0][0] = true; // Empty string matches empty pattern
    
    // Handle patterns like a*, a*b*, a*b*c*
    for (int j = 2; j <= n; j += 2) {
        if (p.charAt(j - 1) == '*') {
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 2];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            char sc = s.charAt(i - 1);
            char pc = p.charAt(j - 1);
            
            if (pc == '*') {
                // Check pattern before '*'
                char prevPattern = p.charAt(j - 2);
                
                // Zero occurrences
                dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 2];
                
                // One or more occurrences
                if (prevPattern == '.' || prevPattern == sc) {
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j] || dp[i - 1][j];
                }
            } else if (pc == '.' || pc == sc) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}

// Recursive with memoization
public boolean isMatchRecursive(String s, String p) {
    Boolean[][] memo = new Boolean[s.length() + 1][p.length() + 1];
    return helper(s, p, 0, 0, memo);
}

private boolean helper(String s, String p, int i, int j, Boolean[][] memo) {
    if (memo[i][j] != null) return memo[i][j];
    
    if (j == p.length()) {
        return memo[i][j] = (i == s.length());
    }
    
    boolean firstMatch = i < s.length() && 
                        (p.charAt(j) == s.charAt(i) || p.charAt(j) == '.');
    
    boolean result;
    if (j + 1 < p.length() && p.charAt(j + 1) == '*') {
        result = helper(s, p, i, j + 2, memo) || 
                (firstMatch && helper(s, p, i + 1, j, memo));
    } else {
        result = firstMatch && helper(s, p, i + 1, j + 1, memo);
    }
    
    return memo[i][j] = result;
}

// Wildcard pattern matching (with ? and *)
public boolean isMatchWildcard(String s, String p) {
    int m = s.length(), n = p.length();
    boolean[][] dp = new boolean[m + 1][n + 1];
    
    dp[0][0] = true;
    
    // Handle patterns starting with *
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        if (p.charAt(j - 1) == '*') {
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            char pc = p.charAt(j - 1);
            char sc = s.charAt(i - 1);
            
            if (pc == '*') {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] || dp[i][j - 1];
            } else if (pc == '?' || pc == sc) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}
```
**Time**: O(m × n), **Space**: O(m × n)

### 52. Interleaving String
**Problem**: Check if s3 is interleaving of s1 and s2  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public boolean isInterleave(String s1, String s2, String s3) {
    int m = s1.length(), n = s2.length();
    
    if (m + n != s3.length()) return false;
    
    boolean[][] dp = new boolean[m + 1][n + 1];
    dp[0][0] = true;
    
    // Fill first row (only s2 characters)
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1] && s2.charAt(j - 1) == s3.charAt(j - 1);
    }
    
    // Fill first column (only s1 characters)
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] && s1.charAt(i - 1) == s3.charAt(i - 1);
    }
    
    // Fill the rest of the table
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j] && s1.charAt(i - 1) == s3.charAt(i + j - 1)) ||
                       (dp[i][j - 1] && s2.charAt(j - 1) == s3.charAt(i + j - 1));
        }
    }
    
    return dp[m][n];
}

// Space optimized
public boolean isInterleaveOptimized(String s1, String s2, String s3) {
    int m = s1.length(), n = s2.length();
    
    if (m + n != s3.length()) return false;
    
    boolean[] dp = new boolean[n + 1];
    dp[0] = true;
    
    // Fill first row
    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        dp[j] = dp[j - 1] && s2.charAt(j - 1) == s3.charAt(j - 1);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        dp[0] = dp[0] && s1.charAt(i - 1) == s3.charAt(i - 1);
        
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            dp[j] = (dp[j] && s1.charAt(i - 1) == s3.charAt(i + j - 1)) ||
                    (dp[j - 1] && s2.charAt(j - 1) == s3.charAt(i + j - 1));
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n];
}

// DFS with memoization
public boolean isInterleaveDFS(String s1, String s2, String s3) {
    if (s1.length() + s2.length() != s3.length()) return false;
    
    Boolean[][] memo = new Boolean[s1.length() + 1][s2.length() + 1];
    return dfs(s1, s2, s3, 0, 0, 0, memo);
}

private boolean dfs(String s1, String s2, String s3, int i, int j, int k, Boolean[][] memo) {
    if (k == s3.length()) return i == s1.length() && j == s2.length();
    
    if (memo[i][j] != null) return memo[i][j];
    
    boolean result = false;
    
    if (i < s1.length() && s1.charAt(i) == s3.charAt(k)) {
        result = dfs(s1, s2, s3, i + 1, j, k + 1, memo);
    }
    
    if (!result && j < s2.length() && s2.charAt(j) == s3.charAt(k)) {
        result = dfs(s1, s2, s3, i, j + 1, k + 1, memo);
    }
    
    return memo[i][j] = result;
}
```
**Time**: O(m × n), **Space**: O(n) optimized

### 53. Palindromic Substrings
**Problem**: Count all palindromic substrings  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int countSubstrings(String s) {
    int count = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        // Count odd length palindromes
        count += expandAroundCenter(s, i, i);
        // Count even length palindromes
        count += expandAroundCenter(s, i, i + 1);
    }
    
    return count;
}

private int expandAroundCenter(String s, int left, int right) {
    int count = 0;
    while (left >= 0 && right < s.length() && s.charAt(left) == s.charAt(right)) {
        count++;
        left--;
        right++;
    }
    return count;
}

// Dynamic Programming approach
public int countSubstringsDP(String s) {
    int n = s.length();
    boolean[][] dp = new boolean[n][n];
    int count = 0;
    
    // Single characters are palindromes
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        dp[i][i] = true;
        count++;
    }
    
    // Check for 2-character palindromes
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i + 1)) {
            dp[i][i + 1] = true;
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    // Check for palindromes of length 3 and more
    for (int len = 3; len <= n; len++) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
            int j = i + len - 1;
            
            if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j) && dp[i + 1][j - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = true;
                count++;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return count;
}

// Manacher's algorithm for counting
public int countSubstringsManacher(String s) {
    String processed = preprocessString(s);
    int n = processed.length();
    int[] P = new int[n];
    int center = 0, right = 0;
    int totalCount = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < right) {
            P[i] = Math.min(right - i, P[2 * center - i]);
        }
        
        try {
            while (processed.charAt(i + P[i] + 1) == processed.charAt(i - P[i] - 1)) {
                P[i]++;
            }
        } catch (StringIndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
            // Reached boundary
        }
        
        if (i + P[i] > right) {
            center = i;
            right = i + P[i];
        }
        
        totalCount += (P[i] + 1) / 2;
    }
    
    return totalCount;
}

private String preprocessString(String s) {
    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
    for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
        sb.append('#').append(c);
    }
    sb.append('#');
    return sb.toString();
}

// Find all palindromic substrings
public List<String> getAllPalindromes(String s) {
    List<String> palindromes = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        // Find odd length palindromes
        findPalindromes(s, i, i, palindromes);
        // Find even length palindromes
        findPalindromes(s, i, i + 1, palindromes);
    }
    
    return palindromes;
}

private void findPalindromes(String s, int left, int right, List<String> palindromes) {
    while (left >= 0 && right < s.length() && s.charAt(left) == s.charAt(right)) {
        palindromes.add(s.substring(left, right + 1));
        left--;
        right++;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n²) expand around center, O(n) Manacher's, **Space**: O(1) to O(n²)

### 54. Decode Ways
**Problem**: Number of ways to decode a string of digits  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int numDecodings(String s) {
    if (s == null || s.length() == 0 || s.charAt(0) == '0') {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int n = s.length();
    int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
    dp[0] = 1; // Empty string has 1 way
    dp[1] = 1; // First character (already checked not '0')
    
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        int oneDigit = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i - 1, i));
        int twoDigits = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i - 2, i));
        
        if (oneDigit >= 1) {
            dp[i] += dp[i - 1];
        }
        
        if (twoDigits >= 10 && twoDigits <= 26) {
            dp[i] += dp[i - 2];
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n];
}

// Space optimized
public int numDecodingsOptimized(String s) {
    if (s == null || s.length() == 0 || s.charAt(0) == '0') {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int prev2 = 1; // dp[i-2]
    int prev1 = 1; // dp[i-1]
    
    for (int i = 1; i < s.length(); i++) {
        int current = 0;
        
        // Single digit
        if (s.charAt(i) != '0') {
            current += prev1;
        }
        
        // Two digits
        int twoDigits = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(i - 1, i + 1));
        if (twoDigits >= 10 && twoDigits <= 26) {
            current += prev2;
        }
        
        prev2 = prev1;
        prev1 = current;
    }
    
    return prev1;
}

// With memoization
public int numDecodingsMemo(String s) {
    int[] memo = new int[s.length()];
    Arrays.fill(memo, -1);
    return decode(s, 0, memo);
}

private int decode(String s, int index, int[] memo) {
    if (index == s.length()) return 1;
    if (s.charAt(index) == '0') return 0;
    if (memo[index] != -1) return memo[index];
    
    int ways = decode(s, index + 1, memo);
    
    if (index + 1 < s.length()) {
        int twoDigits = Integer.parseInt(s.substring(index, index + 2));
        if (twoDigits <= 26) {
            ways += decode(s, index + 2, memo);
        }
    }
    
    return memo[index] = ways;
}

// Decode ways II (with '*' wildcard)
public int numDecodingsII(String s) {
    int MOD = 1000000007;
    long prev2 = 1, prev1 = helper(s.charAt(0));
    
    for (int i = 1; i < s.length(); i++) {
        long current = 0;
        
        // Single character
        current = (current + prev1 * helper(s.charAt(i))) % MOD;
        
        // Two characters
        current = (current + prev2 * helper(s.charAt(i - 1), s.charAt(i))) % MOD;
        
        prev2 = prev1;
        prev1 = current;
    }
    
    return (int) prev1;
}

private int helper(char c) {
    if (c == '*') return 9;
    if (c == '0') return 0;
    return 1;
}

private int helper(char c1, char c2) {
    if (c1 == '*' && c2 == '*') return 15; // 11-19, 21-26
    if (c1 == '*') {
        if (c2 <= '6') return 2; // 1x, 2x
        return 1; // 1x only
    }
    if (c2 == '*') {
        if (c1 == '1') return 9; // 11-19
        if (c1 == '2') return 6; // 21-26
        return 0;
    }
    
    int num = Integer.parseInt("" + c1 + c2);
    return (num >= 10 && num <= 26) ? 1 : 0;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(1) optimized
