### 56. Implement Stack using Arrays
**Problem**: Design a stack with push, pop, top, empty operations  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
class MyStack {
    private int[] stack;
    private int top;
    private int capacity;
    
    public MyStack(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.stack = new int[capacity];
        this.top = -1;
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        if (isFull()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack overflow");
        }
        stack[++top] = x;
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        return stack[top--];
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        return stack[top];
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return top == -1;
    }
    
    public boolean isFull() {
        return top == capacity - 1;
    }
    
    public int size() {
        return top + 1;
    }
}

// Dynamic stack (resizable)
class DynamicStack {
    private int[] stack;
    private int top;
    private int capacity;
    
    public DynamicStack() {
        this.capacity = 10;
        this.stack = new int[capacity];
        this.top = -1;
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        if (top == capacity - 1) {
            resize();
        }
        stack[++top] = x;
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        int result = stack[top--];
        
        // Shrink array if 1/4 full
        if (top > 0 && top == capacity / 4) {
            shrink();
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private void resize() {
        capacity *= 2;
        stack = Arrays.copyOf(stack, capacity);
    }
    
    private void shrink() {
        capacity /= 2;
        stack = Arrays.copyOf(stack, capacity);
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        return stack[top];
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return top == -1;
    }
}

// Stack using LinkedList
class StackUsingLinkedList {
    private Node head;
    private int size;
    
    private class Node {
        int data;
        Node next;
        
        Node(int data) {
            this.data = data;
        }
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        Node newNode = new Node(x);
        newNode.next = head;
        head = newNode;
        size++;
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        int result = head.data;
        head = head.next;
        size--;
        return result;
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        return head.data;
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return head == null;
    }
    
    public int size() {
        return size;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(1) all operations, **Space**: O(n)

### 57. Implement Queue using Arrays
**Problem**: Design a queue with enqueue, dequeue, front, rear operations  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
class MyQueue {
    private int[] queue;
    private int front;
    private int rear;
    private int size;
    private int capacity;
    
    public MyQueue(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.queue = new int[capacity];
        this.front = 0;
        this.rear = -1;
        this.size = 0;
    }
    
    public void enqueue(int x) {
        if (isFull()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue overflow");
        }
        rear = (rear + 1) % capacity;
        queue[rear] = x;
        size++;
    }
    
    public int dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue underflow");
        }
        int result = queue[front];
        front = (front + 1) % capacity;
        size--;
        return result;
    }
    
    public int front() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        return queue[front];
    }
    
    public int rear() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        return queue[rear];
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }
    
    public boolean isFull() {
        return size == capacity;
    }
    
    public int size() {
        return size;
    }
}

// Dynamic circular queue
class DynamicQueue {
    private int[] queue;
    private int front;
    private int rear;
    private int size;
    private int capacity;
    
    public DynamicQueue() {
        this.capacity = 10;
        this.queue = new int[capacity];
        this.front = 0;
        this.rear = -1;
        this.size = 0;
    }
    
    public void enqueue(int x) {
        if (size == capacity) {
            resize();
        }
        rear = (rear + 1) % capacity;
        queue[rear] = x;
        size++;
    }
    
    public int dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue underflow");
        }
        int result = queue[front];
        front = (front + 1) % capacity;
        size--;
        
        // Shrink if 1/4 full
        if (size > 0 && size == capacity / 4) {
            shrink();
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private void resize() {
        int[] newQueue = new int[capacity * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            newQueue[i] = queue[(front + i) % capacity];
        }
        queue = newQueue;
        front = 0;
        rear = size - 1;
        capacity *= 2;
    }
    
    private void shrink() {
        int[] newQueue = new int[capacity / 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            newQueue[i] = queue[(front + i) % capacity];
        }
        queue = newQueue;
        front = 0;
        rear = size - 1;
        capacity /= 2;
    }
    
    public int front() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        return queue[front];
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }
}

// Queue using LinkedList
class QueueUsingLinkedList {
    private Node front;
    private Node rear;
    private int size;
    
    private class Node {
        int data;
        Node next;
        
        Node(int data) {
            this.data = data;
        }
    }
    
    public void enqueue(int x) {
        Node newNode = new Node(x);
        if (rear == null) {
            front = rear = newNode;
        } else {
            rear.next = newNode;
            rear = newNode;
        }
        size++;
    }
    
    public int dequeue() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue underflow");
        }
        int result = front.data;
        front = front.next;
        if (front == null) {
            rear = null;
        }
        size--;
        return result;
    }
    
    public int front() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        return front.data;
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return front == null;
    }
    
    public int size() {
        return size;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(1) all operations, **Space**: O(n)

### 58. Implement Stack using Queue
**Problem**: Implement stack using queue operations  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
// Using two queues
class MyStackTwoQueues {
    Queue<Integer> q1;
    Queue<Integer> q2;
    
    public MyStackTwoQueues() {
        q1 = new LinkedList<>();
        q2 = new LinkedList<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        q2.offer(x);
        
        // Move all elements from q1 to q2
        while (!q1.isEmpty()) {
            q2.offer(q1.poll());
        }
        
        // Swap the queues
        Queue<Integer> temp = q1;
        q1 = q2;
        q2 = temp;
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (q1.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        return q1.poll();
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (q1.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        return q1.peek();
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return q1.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Using single queue (more efficient)
class MyStackOneQueue {
    Queue<Integer> queue;
    
    public MyStackOneQueue() {
        queue = new LinkedList<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        int size = queue.size();
        queue.offer(x);
        
        // Rotate the queue to bring the new element to front
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            queue.offer(queue.poll());
        }
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        return queue.poll();
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        return queue.peek();
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return queue.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Alternative approach - move elements during pop
class MyStackAlternative {
    Queue<Integer> queue;
    
    public MyStackAlternative() {
        queue = new LinkedList<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        queue.offer(x);
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack underflow");
        }
        
        int size = queue.size();
        
        // Move first (size-1) elements to the back
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; i++) {
            queue.offer(queue.poll());
        }
        
        return queue.poll();
    }
    
    public int top() {
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Stack is empty");
        }
        
        int size = queue.size();
        
        // Move first (size-1) elements to the back
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; i++) {
            queue.offer(queue.poll());
        }
        
        int top = queue.peek();
        queue.offer(queue.poll()); // Move the top element to back too
        
        return top;
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return queue.isEmpty();
    }
}
```
**Time**: Push O(n), Pop/Top O(1) or O(n), **Space**: O(n)

### 59. Implement Queue using Stack
**Problem**: Implement queue using stack operations  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
// Using two stacks (amortized O(1))
class MyQueueTwoStacks {
    Stack<Integer> input;
    Stack<Integer> output;
    
    public MyQueueTwoStacks() {
        input = new Stack<>();
        output = new Stack<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        input.push(x);
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        peek(); // Ensure output stack has elements
        return output.pop();
    }
    
    public int peek() {
        if (output.isEmpty()) {
            // Transfer all elements from input to output
            while (!input.isEmpty()) {
                output.push(input.pop());
            }
        }
        
        if (output.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        return output.peek();
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return input.isEmpty() && output.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Using single stack with recursion
class MyQueueOneStack {
    Stack<Integer> stack;
    
    public MyQueueOneStack() {
        stack = new Stack<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        stack.push(x);
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (stack.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        if (stack.size() == 1) {
            return stack.pop();
        }
        
        int item = stack.pop();
        int result = pop(); // Recursive call
        stack.push(item);
        
        return result;
    }
    
    public int peek() {
        if (stack.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        if (stack.size() == 1) {
            return stack.peek();
        }
        
        int item = stack.pop();
        int result = peek(); // Recursive call
        stack.push(item);
        
        return result;
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return stack.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Alternative approach using auxiliary stack for peek
class MyQueueAlternative {
    Stack<Integer> s1;
    Stack<Integer> s2;
    int front;
    
    public MyQueueAlternative() {
        s1 = new Stack<>();
        s2 = new Stack<>();
    }
    
    public void push(int x) {
        if (s1.isEmpty()) {
            front = x;
        }
        s1.push(x);
    }
    
    public int pop() {
        if (s2.isEmpty()) {
            while (!s1.isEmpty()) {
                s2.push(s1.pop());
            }
        }
        
        if (s2.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        return s2.pop();
    }
    
    public int peek() {
        if (!s2.isEmpty()) {
            return s2.peek();
        }
        return front;
    }
    
    public boolean empty() {
        return s1.isEmpty() && s2.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Function-based implementation
class QueueUsingStackFunctional {
    public static void pushToQueue(Stack<Integer> s1, Stack<Integer> s2, int x) {
        s1.push(x);
    }
    
    public static int popFromQueue(Stack<Integer> s1, Stack<Integer> s2) {
        if (s1.isEmpty() && s2.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        if (s2.isEmpty()) {
            while (!s1.isEmpty()) {
                s2.push(s1.pop());
            }
        }
        
        return s2.pop();
    }
    
    public static int peekQueue(Stack<Integer> s1, Stack<Integer> s2) {
        if (s1.isEmpty() && s2.isEmpty()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
        }
        
        if (s2.isEmpty()) {
            while (!s1.isEmpty()) {
                s2.push(s1.pop());
            }
        }
        
        return s2.peek();
    }
}
```
**Time**: Push O(1), Pop/Peek amortized O(1), **Space**: O(n)

### 60. Next Greater Element
**Problem**: Find next greater element for each element in array  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int[] nextGreaterElements(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    
    Arrays.fill(result, -1);
    
    // Process the array twice to handle circular nature
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        int currentIndex = i % n;
        
        // Pop elements from stack while current element is greater
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && nums[stack.peek()] < nums[currentIndex]) {
            result[stack.pop()] = nums[currentIndex];
        }
        
        // Only push index in first iteration
        if (i < n) {
            stack.push(i);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Next greater element I (different arrays)
public int[] nextGreaterElement(int[] nums1, int[] nums2) {
    Map<Integer, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    
    // Process nums2 to find next greater elements
    for (int num : nums2) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && stack.peek() < num) {
            map.put(stack.pop(), num);
        }
        stack.push(num);
    }
    
    // For nums1, look up in the map
    int[] result = new int[nums1.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < nums1.length; i++) {
        result[i] = map.getOrDefault(nums1[i], -1);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Next greater element to the right (simple array)
public int[] nextGreaterElementRight(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>(); // Store indices
    
    Arrays.fill(result, -1);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && nums[stack.peek()] < nums[i]) {
            result[stack.pop()] = nums[i];
        }
        stack.push(i);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Previous greater element
public int[] previousGreaterElement(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    
    Arrays.fill(result, -1);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && nums[stack.peek()] < nums[i]) {
            stack.pop();
        }
        
        if (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            result[i] = nums[stack.peek()];
        }
        
        stack.push(i);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Next smaller element
public int[] nextSmallerElement(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    
    Arrays.fill(result, -1);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && nums[stack.peek()] > nums[i]) {
            result[stack.pop()] = nums[i];
        }
        stack.push(i);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Daily temperatures (days until warmer)
public int[] dailyTemperatures(int[] temperatures) {
    int n = temperatures.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && temperatures[stack.peek()] < temperatures[i]) {
            int prevIndex = stack.pop();
            result[prevIndex] = i - prevIndex;
        }
        stack.push(i);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// 132 pattern
public boolean find132pattern(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    if (n < 3) return false;
    
    Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
    int second = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    // Traverse from right to left
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (nums[i] < second) return true;
        
        while (!stack.isEmpty() && stack.peek() < nums[i]) {
            second = stack.pop();
        }
        
        stack.push(nums[i]);
    }
    
    return false;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(n)

### 61. Binary Search
**Problem**: Search target in sorted array  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public int search(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == target) {
            return mid;
        } else if (nums[mid] < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return -1;
}

// Recursive implementation
public int searchRecursive(int[] nums, int target) {
    return binarySearchHelper(nums, target, 0, nums.length - 1);
}

private int binarySearchHelper(int[] nums, int target, int left, int right) {
    if (left > right) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
    
    if (nums[mid] == target) {
        return mid;
    } else if (nums[mid] < target) {
        return binarySearchHelper(nums, target, mid + 1, right);
    } else {
        return binarySearchHelper(nums, target, left, mid - 1);
    }
}

// Find first occurrence
public int findFirst(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    int result = -1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == target) {
            result = mid;
            right = mid - 1; // Continue searching left
        } else if (nums[mid] < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Find last occurrence
public int findLast(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    int result = -1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == target) {
            result = mid;
            left = mid + 1; // Continue searching right
        } else if (nums[mid] < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Count occurrences
public int countOccurrences(int[] nums, int target) {
    int first = findFirst(nums, target);
    if (first == -1) return 0;
    
    int last = findLast(nums, target);
    return last - first + 1;
}

// Lower bound (first position where nums[i] >= target)
public int lowerBound(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Upper bound (first position where nums[i] > target)
public int upperBound(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] <= target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}
```
**Time**: O(log n), **Space**: O(1) iterative, O(log n) recursive

### 62. Search in Rotated Sorted Array
**Problem**: Search in rotated sorted array  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int searchRotated(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == target) {
            return mid;
        }
        
        // Check which part is sorted
        if (nums[left] <= nums[mid]) { // Left part is sorted
            if (target >= nums[left] && target < nums[mid]) {
                right = mid - 1;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        } else { // Right part is sorted
            if (target > nums[mid] && target <= nums[right]) {
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return -1;
}

// Search in rotated sorted array II (with duplicates)
public boolean searchRotatedII(int[] nums, int target) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == target) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Handle duplicates
        if (nums[left] == nums[mid] && nums[mid] == nums[right]) {
            left++;
            right--;
        } else if (nums[left] <= nums[mid]) { // Left part is sorted
            if (target >= nums[left] && target < nums[mid]) {
                right = mid - 1;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        } else { // Right part is sorted
            if (target > nums[mid] && target <= nums[right]) {
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Find minimum in rotated sorted array
public int findMin(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] > nums[right]) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return nums[left];
}

// Find minimum in rotated sorted array II (with duplicates)
public int findMinII(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] > nums[right]) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else if (nums[mid] < nums[right]) {
            right = mid;
        } else {
            right--; // Handle duplicates
        }
    }
    
    return nums[left];
}

// Find rotation count
public int findRotationCount(int[] nums) {
    int minIndex = 0;
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] > nums[right]) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Check if array is rotated and sorted
public boolean isRotatedSorted(int[] nums) {
    int n = nums.length;
    int rotationPoint = -1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (nums[i] > nums[i + 1]) {
            if (rotationPoint != -1) {
                return false; // More than one rotation point
            }
            rotationPoint = i;
        }
    }
    
    // If no rotation point, check if sorted
    if (rotationPoint == -1) {
        return true;
    }
    
    // Check if rotated array is valid
    return nums[0] >= nums[n - 1];
}
```
**Time**: O(log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 63. Median of Two Sorted Arrays
**Problem**: Find median of two sorted arrays  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public double findMedianSortedArrays(int[] nums1, int[] nums2) {
    // Ensure nums1 is the smaller array
    if (nums1.length > nums2.length) {
        return findMedianSortedArrays(nums2, nums1);
    }
    
    int m = nums1.length;
    int n = nums2.length;
    int left = 0, right = m;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int partition1 = (left + right) / 2;
        int partition2 = (m + n + 1) / 2 - partition1;
        
        int maxLeft1 = (partition1 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums1[partition1 - 1];
        int maxLeft2 = (partition2 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums2[partition2 - 1];
        
        int minRight1 = (partition1 == m) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums1[partition1];
        int minRight2 = (partition2 == n) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums2[partition2];
        
        if (maxLeft1 <= minRight2 && maxLeft2 <= minRight1) {
            if ((m + n) % 2 == 0) {
                return (Math.max(maxLeft1, maxLeft2) + Math.min(minRight1, minRight2)) / 2.0;
            } else {
                return Math.max(maxLeft1, maxLeft2);
            }
        } else if (maxLeft1 > minRight2) {
            right = partition1 - 1;
        } else {
            left = partition1 + 1;
        }
    }
    
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input arrays are not sorted");
}

// K-th element in two sorted arrays
public int findKthElement(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    if (nums1.length > nums2.length) {
        return findKthElement(nums2, nums1, k);
    }
    
    int m = nums1.length;
    int n = nums2.length;
    
    int low = Math.max(0, k - n);
    int high = Math.min(k, m);
    
    while (low <= high) {
        int cut1 = (low + high) / 2;
        int cut2 = k - cut1;
        
        int left1 = (cut1 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums1[cut1 - 1];
        int left2 = (cut2 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums2[cut2 - 1];
        
        int right1 = (cut1 == m) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums1[cut1];
        int right2 = (cut2 == n) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums2[cut2];
        
        if (left1 <= right2 && left2 <= right1) {
            return Math.max(left1, left2);
        } else if (left1 > right2) {
            high = cut1 - 1;
        } else {
            low = cut1 + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 1;
}

// Merge and find median (less efficient O(m+n))
public double findMedianMerge(int[] nums1, int[] nums2) {
    int m = nums1.length, n = nums2.length;
    int total = m + n;
    int[] merged = new int[total];
    
    int i = 0, j = 0, k = 0;
    
    while (i < m && j < n) {
        if (nums1[i] <= nums2[j]) {
            merged[k++] = nums1[i++];
        } else {
            merged[k++] = nums2[j++];
        }
    }
    
    while (i < m) {
        merged[k++] = nums1[i++];
    }
    
    while (j < n) {
        merged[k++] = nums2[j++];
    }
    
    if (total % 2 == 1) {
        return merged[total / 2];
    } else {
        return (merged[total / 2 - 1] + merged[total / 2]) / 2.0;
    }
}

// Without extra space (just find median elements)
public double findMedianOptimal(int[] nums1, int[] nums2) {
    int m = nums1.length, n = nums2.length;
    int total = m + n;
    
    int target1 = total / 2;
    int target2 = (total % 2 == 0) ? target1 - 1 : target1;
    
    int i = 0, j = 0, count = 0;
    int median1 = 0, median2 = 0;
    
    while (count <= target1) {
        int current;
        
        if (i >= m) {
            current = nums2[j++];
        } else if (j >= n) {
            current = nums1[i++];
        } else if (nums1[i] <= nums2[j]) {
            current = nums1[i++];
        } else {
            current = nums2[j++];
        }
        
        if (count == target2) {
            median2 = current;
        }
        if (count == target1) {
            median1 = current;
        }
        
        count++;
    }
    
    return total % 2 == 0 ? (median1 + median2) / 2.0 : median1;
}
```
**Time**: O(log(min(m,n))), **Space**: O(1)

### 64. Find Peak Element
**Problem**: Find any peak element in array  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int findPeakElement(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] > nums[mid + 1]) {
            right = mid; // Peak is on the left side (including mid)
        } else {
            left = mid + 1; // Peak is on the right side
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Find all peaks
public List<Integer> findAllPeaks(int[] nums) {
    List<Integer> peaks = new ArrayList<>();
    int n = nums.length;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        boolean isPeak = true;
        
        // Check left neighbor
        if (i > 0 && nums[i] <= nums[i - 1]) {
            isPeak = false;
        }
        
        // Check right neighbor
        if (i < n - 1 && nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
            isPeak = false;
        }
        
        if (isPeak) {
            peaks.add(i);
        }
    }
    
    return peaks;
}

// Find peak element II (2D array)
public int[] findPeakGrid(int[][] mat) {
    int left = 0, right = mat[0].length - 1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        int maxRow = 0;
        
        // Find the row with maximum element in column mid
        for (int i = 0; i < mat.length; i++) {
            if (mat[i][mid] > mat[maxRow][mid]) {
                maxRow = i;
            }
        }
        
        boolean leftIsBig = mid - 1 >= 0 && mat[maxRow][mid - 1] > mat[maxRow][mid];
        boolean rightIsBig = mid + 1 < mat[0].length && mat[maxRow][mid + 1] > mat[maxRow][mid];
        
        if (!leftIsBig && !rightIsBig) {
            return new int[]{maxRow, mid};
        } else if (leftIsBig) {
            right = mid - 1;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return new int[]{-1, -1};
}

// Mountain peak (strictly increasing then strictly decreasing)
public int peakIndexInMountainArray(int[] arr) {
    int left = 0, right = arr.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (arr[mid] < arr[mid + 1]) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Find minimum in mountain array
public int findInMountainArray(int target, MountainArray mountainArr) {
    int peak = findPeak(mountainArr);
    
    // Search in increasing part
    int result = binarySearchIncreasing(mountainArr, target, 0, peak);
    if (result != -1) return result;
    
    // Search in decreasing part
    return binarySearchDecreasing(mountainArr, target, peak + 1, mountainArr.length() - 1);
}

private int findPeak(MountainArray mountainArr) {
    int left = 0, right = mountainArr.length() - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (mountainArr.get(mid) < mountainArr.get(mid + 1)) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

private int binarySearchIncreasing(MountainArray mountainArr, int target, int left, int right) {
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        int midVal = mountainArr.get(mid);
        
        if (midVal == target) {
            return mid;
        } else if (midVal < target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return -1;
}

private int binarySearchDecreasing(MountainArray mountainArr, int target, int left, int right) {
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        int midVal = mountainArr.get(mid);
        
        if (midVal == target) {
            return mid;
        } else if (midVal > target) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return -1;
}

// Interface for Mountain Array problem
interface MountainArray {
    int get(int index);
    int length();
}
```
**Time**: O(log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 65. Square Root of Integer
**Problem**: Find square root using binary search  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public int mySqrt(int x) {
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    
    int left = 1, right = x;
    int result = 0;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (mid <= x / mid) { // Avoid overflow: mid * mid <= x
            result = mid;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// With precision (floating point)
public double mySqrtPrecise(double x, double precision) {
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    
    double left = 0, right = x;
    if (x < 1) right = 1; // For numbers less than 1
    
    while (right - left > precision) {
        double mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (mid * mid <= x) {
            left = mid;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Newton's method (faster convergence)
public double sqrtNewton(double x) {
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    
    double guess = x;
    double precision = 1e-10;
    
    while (Math.abs(guess * guess - x) > precision) {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) / 2;
    }
    
    return guess;
}

// Integer square root with perfect square check
public boolean isPerfectSquare(int num) {
    if (num < 0) return false;
    
    int left = 0, right = num;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        long square = (long) mid * mid;
        
        if (square == num) {
            return true;
        } else if (square < num) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Cube root
public double cubeRoot(double x) {
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    
    double left = x < 0 ? x : 0;
    double right = x < 0 ? 0 : x;
    double precision = 1e-9;
    
    while (right - left > precision) {
        double mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        double cube = mid * mid * mid;
        
        if (cube < x) {
            left = mid;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

// Nth root
public double nthRoot(double x, int n) {
    if (n == 1) return x;
    if (x == 0) return 0;
    
    double left = x < 0 && n % 2 == 1 ? x : 0;
    double right = x < 0 && n % 2 == 1 ? 0 : Math.abs(x);
    
    if (Math.abs(x) < 1) {
        right = 1;
    }
    
    double precision = 1e-9;
    
    while (right - left > precision) {
        double mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        double power = Math.pow(mid, n);
        
        if (power < x) {
            left = mid;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}
```
**Time**: O(log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 66. Allocate Minimum Pages
**Problem**: Allocate books to students to minimize maximum pages  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int allocateBooks(int[] books, int students) {
    if (students > books.length) return -1;
    
    int left = Arrays.stream(books).max().getAsInt(); // Min possible answer
    int right = Arrays.stream(books).sum(); // Max possible answer
    int result = -1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (canAllocate(books, students, mid)) {
            result = mid;
            right = mid - 1; // Try for smaller maximum
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private boolean canAllocate(int[] books, int students, int maxPages) {
    int studentsUsed = 1;
    int currentPages = 0;
    
    for (int pages : books) {
        if (currentPages + pages <= maxPages) {
            currentPages += pages;
        } else {
            studentsUsed++;
            currentPages = pages;
            
            if (studentsUsed > students) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Painter's partition (similar problem)
public int paintersPartition(int[] boards, int painters) {
    if (painters > boards.length) return -1;
    
    int left = Arrays.stream(boards).max().getAsInt();
    int right = Arrays.stream(boards).sum();
    int result = -1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (canPaint(boards, painters, mid)) {
            result = mid;
            right = mid - 1;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private boolean canPaint(int[] boards, int painters, int maxTime) {
    int paintersUsed = 1;
    int currentTime = 0;
    
    for (int time : boards) {
        if (currentTime + time <= maxTime) {
            currentTime += time;
        } else {
            paintersUsed++;
            currentTime = time;
            
            if (paintersUsed > painters) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Aggressive cows (maximize minimum distance)
public int aggressiveCows(int[] stalls, int cows) {
    Arrays.sort(stalls);
    
    int left = 1; // Minimum possible distance
    int right = stalls[stalls.length - 1] - stalls[0]; // Maximum possible distance
    int result = 0;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (canPlaceCows(stalls, cows, mid)) {
            result = mid;
            left = mid + 1; // Try for larger minimum distance
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private boolean canPlaceCows(int[] stalls, int cows, int minDistance) {
    int cowsPlaced = 1;
    int lastPosition = stalls[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < stalls.length; i++) {
        if (stalls[i] - lastPosition >= minDistance) {
            cowsPlaced++;
            lastPosition = stalls[i];
            
            if (cowsPlaced >= cows) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

// Split array largest sum
public int splitArray(int[] nums, int m) {
    int left = Arrays.stream(nums).max().getAsInt();
    int right = Arrays.stream(nums).sum();
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (canSplit(nums, m, mid)) {
            right = mid;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

private boolean canSplit(int[] nums, int m, int maxSum) {
    int subarrays = 1;
    int currentSum = 0;
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        if (currentSum + num <= maxSum) {
            currentSum += num;
        } else {
            subarrays++;
            currentSum = num;
            
            if (subarrays > m) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Capacity to ship packages within D days
public int shipWithinDays(int[] weights, int days) {
    int left = Arrays.stream(weights).max().getAsInt();
    int right = Arrays.stream(weights).sum();
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (canShip(weights, days, mid)) {
            right = mid;
        } else {
            left = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

private boolean canShip(int[] weights, int days, int capacity) {
    int daysNeeded = 1;
    int currentWeight = 0;
    
    for (int weight : weights) {
        if (currentWeight + weight <= capacity) {
            currentWeight += weight;
        } else {
            daysNeeded++;
            currentWeight = weight;
            
            if (daysNeeded > days) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}
```
**Time**: O(n × log(sum)), **Space**: O(1)

### 67. Kth Element of Two Sorted Arrays
**Problem**: Find Kth smallest element in union of two sorted arrays  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int findKthElement(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    if (nums1.length > nums2.length) {
        return findKthElement(nums2, nums1, k);
    }
    
    int m = nums1.length;
    int n = nums2.length;
    
    int low = Math.max(0, k - n);
    int high = Math.min(k, m);
    
    while (low <= high) {
        int cut1 = (low + high) / 2;
        int cut2 = k - cut1;
        
        int left1 = (cut1 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums1[cut1 - 1];
        int left2 = (cut2 == 0) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : nums2[cut2 - 1];
        
        int right1 = (cut1 == m) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums1[cut1];
        int right2 = (cut2 == n) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : nums2[cut2];
        
        if (left1 <= right2 && left2 <= right1) {
            return Math.max(left1, left2);
        } else if (left1 > right2) {
            high = cut1 - 1;
        } else {
            low = cut1 + 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 1;
}

// Merge approach (less efficient)
public int findKthElementMerge(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    int m = nums1.length, n = nums2.length;
    int i = 0, j = 0, count = 0;
    
    while (i < m && j < n) {
        if (nums1[i] <= nums2[j]) {
            count++;
            if (count == k) return nums1[i];
            i++;
        } else {
            count++;
            if (count == k) return nums2[j];
            j++;
        }
    }
    
    while (i < m) {
        count++;
        if (count == k) return nums1[i];
        i++;
    }
    
    while (j < n) {
        count++;
        if (count == k) return nums2[j];
        j++;
    }
    
    return -1;
}

// Find range of Kth elements (if duplicates exist)
public int[] findKthRange(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    int kthElement = findKthElement(nums1, nums2, k);
    
    // Find first occurrence
    int firstK = findKthElement(nums1, nums2, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
        int current = findKthElement(nums1, nums2, i);
        if (current == kthElement) {
            firstK = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    // Find last occurrence
    int lastK = k;
    for (int i = k + 1; i <= nums1.length + nums2.length; i++) {
        int current = findKthElement(nums1, nums2, i);
        if (current != kthElement) {
            break;
        }
        lastK = i;
    }
    
    return new int[]{firstK, lastK};
}

// Kth smallest in matrix
public int kthSmallest(int[][] matrix, int k) {
    int n = matrix.length;
    int left = matrix[0][0];
    int right = matrix[n - 1][n - 1];
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        int count = countLessEqual(matrix, mid);
        
        if (count < k) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}

private int countLessEqual(int[][] matrix, int target) {
    int n = matrix.length;
    int count = 0;
    int row = n - 1, col = 0;
    
    while (row >= 0 && col < n) {
        if (matrix[row][col] <= target) {
            count += row + 1;
            col++;
        } else {
            row--;
        }
    }
    
    return count;
}

// Kth smallest in sorted matrix using heap
public int kthSmallestHeap(int[][] matrix, int k) {
    int n = matrix.length;
    PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    
    // Add first element of each row
    for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(n, k); i++) {
        pq.offer(new int[]{matrix[i][0], i, 0});
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
        int[] current = pq.poll();
        int row = current[1], col = current[2];
        
        if (col + 1 < n) {
            pq.offer(new int[]{matrix[row][col + 1], row, col + 1});
        }
    }
    
    return pq.poll()[0];
}
```
**Time**: O(log(min(m,n))), **Space**: O(1)

### 68. Single Element in Sorted Array
**Problem**: Find single element in sorted array where all others appear twice  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int singleNonDuplicate(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        // Make sure mid is even
        if (mid % 2 == 1) {
            mid--;
        }
        
        if (nums[mid] == nums[mid + 1]) {
            // Single element is on the right side
            left = mid + 2;
        } else {
            // Single element is on the left side
            right = mid;
        }
    }
    
    return nums[left];
}

// Alternative approach
public int singleNonDuplicateAlt(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left < right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        boolean halvesAreEven = (right - mid) % 2 == 0;
        
        if (nums[mid] == nums[mid + 1]) {
            if (halvesAreEven) {
                left = mid + 2;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        } else if (nums[mid] == nums[mid - 1]) {
            if (halvesAreEven) {
                right = mid - 2;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        } else {
            return nums[mid];
        }
    }
    
    return nums[left];
}

// Using XOR (if array wasn't sorted)
public int singleNonDuplicateXOR(int[] nums) {
    int result = 0;
    for (int num : nums) {
        result ^= num;
    }
    return result;
}

// Find single element in array where all others appear k times
public int singleNumberK(int[] nums, int k) {
    int[] bits = new int[32];
    
    // Count bits at each position
    for (int num : nums) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if ((num & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                bits[i]++;
            }
        }
    }
    
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        if (bits[i] % k != 0) {
            result |= (1 << i);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Two single elements (all others appear twice)
public int[] singleNumberII(int[] nums) {
    int xor = 0;
    for (int num : nums) {
        xor ^= num;
    }
    
    // Find rightmost set bit
    int rightmostBit = xor & (-xor);
    
    int group1 = 0, group2 = 0;
    for (int num : nums) {
        if ((num & rightmostBit) != 0) {
            group1 ^= num;
        } else {
            group2 ^= num;
        }
    }
    
    return new int[]{group1, group2};
}

// Find missing number in sorted array
public int findMissingNumber(int[] nums) {
    int left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;
    
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
        
        if (nums[mid] == mid) {
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return left;
}
```
**Time**: O(log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 69. Kth Largest Element in Array
**Problem**: Find Kth largest element  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int findKthLargest(int[] nums, int k) {
    // Min heap of size k
    PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        minHeap.offer(num);
        if (minHeap.size() > k) {
            minHeap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    return minHeap.peek();
}

// Using max heap
public int findKthLargestMaxHeap(int[] nums, int k) {
    PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a);
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        maxHeap.offer(num);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
        maxHeap.poll();
    }
    
    return maxHeap.peek();
}

// Quick select algorithm (average O(n))
public int findKthLargestQuickSelect(int[] nums, int k) {
    return quickSelect(nums, 0, nums.length - 1, nums.length - k);
}

private int quickSelect(int[] nums, int left, int right, int kSmallest) {
    if (left == right) {
        return nums[left];
    }
    
    Random random = new Random();
    int pivotIndex = left + random.nextInt(right - left + 1);
    
    pivotIndex = partition(nums, left, right, pivotIndex);
    
    if (kSmallest == pivotIndex) {
        return nums[kSmallest];
    } else if (kSmallest < pivotIndex) {
        return quickSelect(nums, left, pivotIndex - 1, kSmallest);
    } else {
        return quickSelect(nums, pivotIndex + 1, right, kSmallest);
    }
}

private int partition(int[] nums, int left, int right, int pivotIndex) {
    int pivotValue = nums[pivotIndex];
    
    // Move pivot to end
    swap(nums, pivotIndex, right);
    
    int storeIndex = left;
    for (int i = left; i < right; i++) {
        if (nums[i] < pivotValue) {
            swap(nums, storeIndex, i);
            storeIndex++;
        }
    }
    
    // Move pivot to its final place
    swap(nums, storeIndex, right);
    
    return storeIndex;
}

private void swap(int[] nums, int i, int j) {
    int temp = nums[i];
    nums[i] = nums[j];
    nums[j] = temp;
}

// Find K largest elements
public List<Integer> findKLargest(int[] nums, int k) {
    PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        minHeap.offer(num);
        if (minHeap.size() > k) {
            minHeap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    return new ArrayList<>(minHeap);
}

// Kth largest in stream
class KthLargest {
    private PriorityQueue<Integer> heap;
    private int k;
    
    public KthLargest(int k, int[] nums) {
        this.k = k;
        this.heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        
        for (int num : nums) {
            heap.offer(num);
        }
        
        while (heap.size() > k) {
            heap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    public int add(int val) {
        heap.offer(val);
        if (heap.size() > k) {
            heap.poll();
        }
        return heap.peek();
    }
}

// Kth smallest element
public int kthSmallest(int[] nums, int k) {
    PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a);
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        maxHeap.offer(num);
        if (maxHeap.size() > k) {
            maxHeap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    return maxHeap.peek();
}
```
**Time**: O(n log k) heap, O(n) average quickselect, **Space**: O(k)

### 70. Merge K Sorted Lists
**Problem**: Merge K sorted linked lists  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public ListNode mergeKLists(ListNode[] lists) {
    if (lists == null || lists.length == 0) return null;
    
    // Min heap based on node values
    PriorityQueue<ListNode> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a.val - b.val);
    
    // Add first node of each list to heap
    for (ListNode list : lists) {
        if (list != null) {
            heap.offer(list);
        }
    }
    
    ListNode dummy = new ListNode(0);
    ListNode current = dummy;
    
    while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
        ListNode smallest = heap.poll();
        current.next = smallest;
        current = current.next;
        
        if (smallest.next != null) {
            heap.offer(smallest.next);
        }
    }
    
    return dummy.next;
}

// Divide and conquer approach
public ListNode mergeKListsDivideConquer(ListNode[] lists) {
    if (lists == null || lists.length == 0) return null;
    return mergeHelper(lists, 0, lists.length - 1);
}

private ListNode mergeHelper(ListNode[] lists, int start, int end) {
    if (start == end) return lists[start];
    if (start > end) return null;
    
    int mid = start + (end - start) / 2;
    ListNode left = mergeHelper(lists, start, mid);
    ListNode right = mergeHelper(lists, mid + 1, end);
    
    return mergeTwoLists(left, right);
}

private ListNode mergeTwoLists(ListNode l1, ListNode l2) {
    ListNode dummy = new ListNode(0);
    ListNode current = dummy;
    
    while (l1 != null && l2 != null) {
        if (l1.val <= l2.val) {
            current.next = l1;
            l1 = l1.next;
        } else {
            current.next = l2;
            l2 = l2.next;
        }
        current = current.next;
    }
    
    current.next = (l1 != null) ? l1 : l2;
    return dummy.next;
}

// Merge K sorted arrays
public int[] mergeKSortedArrays(int[][] arrays) {
    PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    // Add first element of each array with array index and element index
    for (int i = 0; i < arrays.length; i++) {
        if (arrays[i].length > 0) {
            heap.offer(new int[]{arrays[i][0], i, 0});
        }
    }
    
    while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = heap.poll();
        int value = current[0];
        int arrayIndex = current[1];
        int elementIndex = current[2];
        
        result.add(value);
        
        if (elementIndex + 1 < arrays[arrayIndex].length) {
            heap.offer(new int[]{
                arrays[arrayIndex][elementIndex + 1], 
                arrayIndex, 
                elementIndex + 1
            });
        }
    }
    
    return result.stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray();
}

// Merge K sorted lists iteratively
public ListNode mergeKListsIterative(ListNode[] lists) {
    if (lists == null || lists.length == 0) return null;
    
    while (lists.length > 1) {
        List<ListNode> mergedLists = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < lists.length; i += 2) {
            ListNode l1 = lists[i];
            ListNode l2 = (i + 1 < lists.length) ? lists[i + 1] : null;
            mergedLists.add(mergeTwoLists(l1, l2));
        }
        
        lists = mergedLists.toArray(new ListNode[0]);
    }
    
    return lists[0];
}

// Find smallest range covering elements from K lists
public int[] smallestRange(List<List<Integer>> nums) {
    PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    int max = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    
    // Add first element from each list
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        int val = nums.get(i).get(0);
        heap.offer(new int[]{val, i, 0});
        max = Math.max(max, val);
    }
    
    int[] result = new int[]{0, Integer.MAX_VALUE};
    
    while (heap.size() == nums.size()) {
        int[] current = heap.poll();
        int val = current[0];
        int listIdx = current[1];
        int elemIdx = current[2];
        
        if (max - val < result[1] - result[0]) {
            result[0] = val;
            result[1] = max;
        }
        
        if (elemIdx + 1 < nums.get(listIdx).size()) {
            int nextVal = nums.get(listIdx).get(elemIdx + 1);
            heap.offer(new int[]{nextVal, listIdx, elemIdx + 1});
            max = Math.max(max, nextVal);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n log k) where n is total elements, **Space**: O(k)

### 71. Top K Frequent Elements
**Problem**: Find K most frequent elements  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int[] topKFrequent(int[] nums, int k) {
    // Count frequency
    Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (int num : nums) {
        frequencyMap.put(num, frequencyMap.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    // Min heap of size k based on frequency
    PriorityQueue<Integer> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> 
        frequencyMap.get(a) - frequencyMap.get(b));
    
    for (int num : frequencyMap.keySet()) {
        heap.offer(num);
        if (heap.size() > k) {
            heap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    int[] result = new int[k];
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        result[i] = heap.poll();
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Using max heap
public int[] topKFrequentMaxHeap(int[] nums, int k) {
    Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (int num : nums) {
        frequencyMap.put(num, frequencyMap.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<Map.Entry<Integer, Integer>> maxHeap = 
        new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b.getValue() - a.getValue());
    
    maxHeap.addAll(frequencyMap.entrySet());
    
    int[] result = new int[k];
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        result[i] = maxHeap.poll().getKey();
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Bucket sort approach O(n)
public int[] topKFrequentBucket(int[] nums, int k) {
    Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (int num : nums) {
        frequencyMap.put(num, frequencyMap.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    // Bucket array where index represents frequency
    List<Integer>[] buckets = new List[nums.length + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
        buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
    }
    
    for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : frequencyMap.entrySet()) {
        buckets[entry.getValue()].add(entry.getKey());
    }
    
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = buckets.length - 1; i >= 0 && result.size() < k; i--) {
        result.addAll(buckets[i]);
    }
    
    return result.stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray();
}

// Quick select approach
public int[] topKFrequentQuickSelect(int[] nums, int k) {
    Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (int num : nums) {
        frequencyMap.put(num, frequencyMap.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    int[] unique = frequencyMap.keySet().stream().mapToInt(i -> i).toArray();
    quickSelect(unique, 0, unique.length - 1, unique.length - k, frequencyMap);
    
    return Arrays.copyOfRange(unique, unique.length - k, unique.length);
}

private void quickSelect(int[] nums, int left, int right, int kSmallest, 
                        Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap) {
    if (left == right) return;
    
    Random random = new Random();
    int pivotIndex = left + random.nextInt(right - left + 1);
    pivotIndex = partitionByFrequency(nums, left, right, pivotIndex, frequencyMap);
    
    if (kSmallest == pivotIndex) {
        return;
    } else if (kSmallest < pivotIndex) {
        quickSelect(nums, left, pivotIndex - 1, kSmallest, frequencyMap);
    } else {
        quickSelect(nums, pivotIndex + 1, right, kSmallest, frequencyMap);
    }
}

private int partitionByFrequency(int[] nums, int left, int right, int pivotIndex, 
                                Map<Integer, Integer> frequencyMap) {
    int pivotFrequency = frequencyMap.get(nums[pivotIndex]);
    swap(nums, pivotIndex, right);
    
    int storeIndex = left;
    for (int i = left; i < right; i++) {
        if (frequencyMap.get(nums[i]) < pivotFrequency) {
            swap(nums, storeIndex, i);
            storeIndex++;
        }
    }
    
    swap(nums, storeIndex, right);
    return storeIndex;
}

// Top K frequent words
public List<String> topKFrequentWords(String[] words, int k) {
    Map<String, Integer> frequencyMap = new HashMap<>();
    for (String word : words) {
        frequencyMap.put(word, frequencyMap.getOrDefault(word, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<String> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> {
        int freqCompare = frequencyMap.get(a) - frequencyMap.get(b);
        if (freqCompare == 0) {
            return b.compareTo(a); // Reverse lexicographical for min heap
        }
        return freqCompare;
    });
    
    for (String word : frequencyMap.keySet()) {
        heap.offer(word);
        if (heap.size() > k) {
            heap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
        result.add(0, heap.poll());
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n log k) heap, O(n) bucket sort, **Space**: O(n)

### 72. Median from Data Stream
**Problem**: Find median from stream of integers  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
class MedianFinder {
    private PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap; // Smaller half
    private PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap; // Larger half
    
    public MedianFinder() {
        maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a); // Max heap for smaller half
        minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>(); // Min heap for larger half
    }
    
    public void addNum(int num) {
        if (maxHeap.isEmpty() || num <= maxHeap.peek()) {
            maxHeap.offer(num);
        } else {
            minHeap.offer(num);
        }
        
        // Balance the heaps
        if (maxHeap.size() > minHeap.size() + 1) {
            minHeap.offer(maxHeap.poll());
        } else if (minHeap.size() > maxHeap.size() + 1) {
            maxHeap.offer(minHeap.poll());
        }
    }
    
    public double findMedian() {
        if (maxHeap.size() == minHeap.size()) {
            return (maxHeap.peek() + minHeap.peek()) / 2.0;
        } else if (maxHeap.size() > minHeap.size()) {
            return maxHeap.peek();
        } else {
            return minHeap.peek();
        }
    }
    
    // Additional methods
    public int size() {
        return maxHeap.size() + minHeap.size();
    }
    
    public boolean isEmpty() {
        return maxHeap.isEmpty() && minHeap.isEmpty();
    }
}

// Median finder with removal support
class AdvancedMedianFinder {
    private PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap;
    private PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap;
    private Map<Integer, Integer> removedCount;
    
    public AdvancedMedianFinder() {
        maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a);
        minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
        removedCount = new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public void addNum(int num) {
        if (maxHeap.isEmpty() || num <= getValidTop(maxHeap)) {
            maxHeap.offer(num);
        } else {
            minHeap.offer(num);
        }
        
        balance();
    }
    
    public void removeNum(int num) {
        removedCount.put(num, removedCount.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
        balance();
    }
    
    public double findMedian() {
        cleanTops();
        
        int maxSize = getValidSize(maxHeap);
        int minSize = getValidSize(minHeap);
        
        if (maxSize == minSize) {
            return (getValidTop(maxHeap) + getValidTop(minHeap)) / 2.0;
        } else if (maxSize > minSize) {
            return getValidTop(maxHeap);
        } else {
            return getValidTop(minHeap);
        }
    }
    
    private void balance() {
        cleanTops();
        
        int maxSize = getValidSize(maxHeap);
        int minSize = getValidSize(minHeap);
        
        if (maxSize > minSize + 1) {
            minHeap.offer(maxHeap.poll());
        } else if (minSize > maxSize + 1) {
            maxHeap.offer(minHeap.poll());
        }
    }
    
    private void cleanTops() {
        while (!maxHeap.isEmpty() && removedCount.getOrDefault(maxHeap.peek(), 0) > 0) {
            int top = maxHeap.poll();
            removedCount.put(top, removedCount.get(top) - 1);
            if (removedCount.get(top) == 0) {
                removedCount.remove(top);
            }
        }
        
        while (!minHeap.isEmpty() && removedCount.getOrDefault(minHeap.peek(), 0) > 0) {
            int top = minHeap.poll();
            removedCount.put(top, removedCount.get(top) - 1);
            if (removedCount.get(top) == 0) {
                removedCount.remove(top);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private int getValidTop(PriorityQueue<Integer> heap) {
        cleanTops();
        return heap.isEmpty() ? 0 : heap.peek();
    }
    
    private int getValidSize(PriorityQueue<Integer> heap) {
        return heap.size();
    }
}

// Sliding window median
public double[] medianSlidingWindow(int[] nums, int k) {
    double[] result = new double[nums.length - k + 1];
    AdvancedMedianFinder medianFinder = new AdvancedMedianFinder();
    
    // Add first k elements
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        medianFinder.addNum(nums[i]);
    }
    result[0] = medianFinder.findMedian();
    
    // Slide the window
    for (int i = k; i < nums.length; i++) {
        medianFinder.addNum(nums[i]);
        medianFinder.removeNum(nums[i - k]);
        result[i - k + 1] = medianFinder.findMedian();
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Running median with TreeMap
class MedianFinderTreeMap {
    private TreeMap<Integer, Integer> counts;
    private int totalSize;
    
    public MedianFinderTreeMap() {
        counts = new TreeMap<>();
        totalSize = 0;
    }
    
    public void addNum(int num) {
        counts.put(num, counts.getOrDefault(num, 0) + 1);
        totalSize++;
    }
    
    public double findMedian() {
        if (totalSize % 2 == 1) {
            return findKthElement((totalSize + 1) / 2);
        } else {
            return (findKthElement(totalSize / 2) + findKthElement(totalSize / 2 + 1)) / 2.0;
        }
    }
    
    private int findKthElement(int k) {
        int count = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : counts.entrySet()) {
            count += entry.getValue();
            if (count >= k) {
                return entry.getKey();
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) per operation, **Space**: O(n)

### 73. Maximum Sum Combinations
**Problem**: Find K maximum sum combinations from two arrays  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public List<Integer> solve(int[] A, int[] B, int C) {
    // Sort arrays in descending order
    Arrays.sort(A);
    Arrays.sort(B);
    reverse(A);
    reverse(B);
    
    // Max heap to store sums with their indices
    PriorityQueue<int[]> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b[0] - a[0]);
    Set<String> visited = new HashSet<>();
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    // Start with the maximum possible sum
    maxHeap.offer(new int[]{A[0] + B[0], 0, 0});
    visited.add("0,0");
    
    for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) {
        if (maxHeap.isEmpty()) break;
        
        int[] current = maxHeap.poll();
        int sum = current[0];
        int idxA = current[1];
        int idxB = current[2];
        
        result.add(sum);
        
        // Add next possible combinations
        if (idxA + 1 < A.length && !visited.contains((idxA + 1) + "," + idxB)) {
            maxHeap.offer(new int[]{A[idxA + 1] + B[idxB], idxA + 1, idxB});
            visited.add((idxA + 1) + "," + idxB);
        }
        
        if (idxB + 1 < B.length && !visited.contains(idxA + "," + (idxB + 1))) {
            maxHeap.offer(new int[]{A[idxA] + B[idxB + 1], idxA, idxB + 1});
            visited.add(idxA + "," + (idxB + 1));
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private void reverse(int[] arr) {
    int left = 0, right = arr.length - 1;
    while (left < right) {
        int temp = arr[left];
        arr[left] = arr[right];
        arr[right] = temp;
        left++;
        right--;
    }
}

// K maximum sum combinations with different approach
public List<Integer> kMaxSumCombinations(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    // Generate all combinations and use min heap of size k
    PriorityQueue<Integer> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums1.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < nums2.length; j++) {
            int sum = nums1[i] + nums2[j];
            
            if (minHeap.size() < k) {
                minHeap.offer(sum);
            } else if (sum > minHeap.peek()) {
                minHeap.poll();
                minHeap.offer(sum);
            }
        }
    }
    
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>(minHeap);
    Collections.sort(result, Collections.reverseOrder());
    return result;
}

// Find K pairs with smallest sums
public List<List<Integer>> kSmallestPairs(int[] nums1, int[] nums2, int k) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (nums1.length == 0 || nums2.length == 0 || k == 0) return result;
    
    PriorityQueue<int[]> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    Set<String> visited = new HashSet<>();
    
    minHeap.offer(new int[]{nums1[0] + nums2[0], 0, 0});
    visited.add("0,0");
    
    while (k-- > 0 && !minHeap.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = minHeap.poll();
        int i = current[1];
        int j = current[2];
        
        result.add(Arrays.asList(nums1[i], nums2[j]));
        
        if (i + 1 < nums1.length && !visited.contains((i + 1) + "," + j)) {
            minHeap.offer(new int[]{nums1[i + 1] + nums2[j], i + 1, j});
            visited.add((i + 1) + "," + j);
        }
        
        if (j + 1 < nums2.length && !visited.contains(i + "," + (j + 1))) {
            minHeap.offer(new int[]{nums1[i] + nums2[j + 1], i, j + 1});
            visited.add(i + "," + (j + 1));
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Maximum sum of K elements
public int maximumSum(int[] nums, int k) {
    PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a);
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        maxHeap.offer(num);
    }
    
    int sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < k && !maxHeap.isEmpty(); i++) {
        sum += maxHeap.poll();
    }
    
    return sum;
}

// K closest pairs to origin
public int[][] kClosest(int[][] points, int k) {
    PriorityQueue<int[]> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> {
        int distA = a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1];
        int distB = b[0] * b[0] + b[1] * b[1];
        return distB - distA;
    });
    
    for (int[] point : points) {
        maxHeap.offer(point);
        if (maxHeap.size() > k) {
            maxHeap.poll();
        }
    }
    
    return maxHeap.toArray(new int[k][]);
}
```
**Time**: O(k log k), **Space**: O(k)

### 74. Task Scheduler
**Problem**: Schedule tasks with cooling time  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int leastInterval(char[] tasks, int n) {
    // Count frequency of each task
    int[] frequencies = new int[26];
    for (char task : tasks) {
        frequencies[task - 'A']++;
    }
    
    // Sort frequencies in descending order
    Arrays.sort(frequencies);
    
    // Find the maximum frequency
    int maxFreq = frequencies[25];
    int idleTime = (maxFreq - 1) * n;
    
    // Fill idle time with other tasks
    for (int i = 24; i >= 0 && frequencies[i] > 0; i--) {
        idleTime -= Math.min(frequencies[i], maxFreq - 1);
    }
    
    // If idle time becomes negative, we don't need any idle slots
    return idleTime > 0 ? idleTime + tasks.length : tasks.length;
}

// Using priority queue simulation
public int leastIntervalHeap(char[] tasks, int n) {
    Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
    for (char task : tasks) {
        frequencies.put(task, frequencies.getOrDefault(task, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<Integer> maxHeap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b - a);
    maxHeap.addAll(frequencies.values());
    
    int time = 0;
    
    while (!maxHeap.isEmpty()) {
        int cycle = n + 1;
        List<Integer> temp = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < cycle && (!maxHeap.isEmpty() || !temp.isEmpty()); i++) {
            if (!maxHeap.isEmpty()) {
                int freq = maxHeap.poll();
                if (freq > 1) {
                    temp.add(freq - 1);
                }
            }
            time++;
        }
        
        // Add back the frequencies for next cycle
        for (int freq : temp) {
            maxHeap.offer(freq);
        }
    }
    
    return time;
}

// Detailed simulation with actual scheduling
public String leastIntervalDetailed(char[] tasks, int n) {
    Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
    for (char task : tasks) {
        frequencies.put(task, frequencies.getOrDefault(task, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<Map.Entry<Character, Integer>> maxHeap = 
        new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b.getValue() - a.getValue());
    maxHeap.addAll(frequencies.entrySet());
    
    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
    Queue<Map.Entry<Character, Integer>> waitQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    int time = 0;
    
    while (!maxHeap.isEmpty() || !waitQueue.isEmpty()) {
        time++;
        
        if (!maxHeap.isEmpty()) {
            Map.Entry<Character, Integer> current = maxHeap.poll();
            result.append(current.getKey());
            
            if (current.getValue() > 1) {
                current.setValue(current.getValue() - 1);
                // Add to wait queue with the time when it can be executed again
                waitQueue.offer(current);
            }
        } else {
            result.append("idle");
        }
        
        // Check if any task in wait queue can be added back to heap
        if (!waitQueue.isEmpty() && result.length() - waitQueue.peek().getKey().charValue() >= n) {
            maxHeap.offer(waitQueue.poll());
        }
    }
    
    return result.toString();
}

// Minimum interval between same characters
public int reorganizeString(String s) {
    Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
    for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
        frequencies.put(c, frequencies.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
    }
    
    // Check if reorganization is possible
    int maxFreq = Collections.max(frequencies.values());
    if (maxFreq > (s.length() + 1) / 2) {
        return -1; // Not possible
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<Map.Entry<Character, Integer>> maxHeap = 
        new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b.getValue() - a.getValue());
    maxHeap.addAll(frequencies.entrySet());
    
    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
    Map.Entry<Character, Integer> prev = null;
    
    while (!maxHeap.isEmpty() || prev != null) {
        if (prev != null && maxHeap.isEmpty()) {
            return -1; // Cannot place remaining characters
        }
        
        Map.Entry<Character, Integer> current = maxHeap.poll();
        result.append(current.getKey());
        current.setValue(current.getValue() - 1);
        
        if (prev != null && prev.getValue() > 0) {
            maxHeap.offer(prev);
        }
        
        prev = current.getValue() > 0 ? current : null;
    }
    
    return result.length();
}

// Task scheduler with priority
public List<Character> taskSchedulerWithPriority(char[] tasks, int[] priorities, int n) {
    // Custom comparator: first by priority, then by frequency
    Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Integer> priorityMap = new HashMap<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
        char task = tasks[i];
        frequencies.put(task, frequencies.getOrDefault(task, 0) + 1);
        priorityMap.put(task, priorities[i]);
    }
    
    PriorityQueue<Character> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> {
        int priorityCompare = priorityMap.get(b) - priorityMap.get(a);
        if (priorityCompare != 0) return priorityCompare;
        return frequencies.get(b) - frequencies.get(a);
    });
    
    heap.addAll(frequencies.keySet());
    
    List<Character> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Queue<Character> waitQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    Map<Character, Integer> lastExecuted = new HashMap<>();
    
    int time = 0;
    while (!heap.isEmpty() || !waitQueue.isEmpty()) {
        time++;
        
        // Move tasks from wait queue back to heap if cooling period is over
        while (!waitQueue.isEmpty()) {
            char task = waitQueue.peek();
            if (time - lastExecuted.get(task) > n) {
                heap.offer(waitQueue.poll());
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            char task = heap.poll();
            result.add(task);
            lastExecuted.put(task, time);
            
            frequencies.put(task, frequencies.get(task) - 1);
            if (frequencies.get(task) > 0) {
                waitQueue.offer(task);
            }
        } else {
            result.add('?'); // Idle time
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(time), **Space**: O(1) for task types

### 75. Clone Graph
**Problem**: Deep clone an undirected graph  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class Node {
    public int val;
    public List<Node> neighbors;
    public Node() {
        val = 0;
        neighbors = new ArrayList<Node>();
    }
    public Node(int _val) {
        val = _val;
        neighbors = new ArrayList<Node>();
    }
    public Node(int _val, ArrayList<Node> _neighbors) {
        val = _val;
        neighbors = _neighbors;
    }
}

public Node cloneGraph(Node node) {
    if (node == null) return null;
    
    Map<Node, Node> cloned = new HashMap<>();
    return dfsClone(node, cloned);
}

private Node dfsClone(Node node, Map<Node, Node> cloned) {
    if (cloned.containsKey(node)) {
        return cloned.get(node);
    }
    
    Node clone = new Node(node.val);
    cloned.put(node, clone);
    
    for (Node neighbor : node.neighbors) {
        clone.neighbors.add(dfsClone(neighbor, cloned));
    }
    
    return clone;
}

// BFS approach
public Node cloneGraphBFS(Node node) {
    if (node == null) return null;
    
    Map<Node, Node> cloned = new HashMap<>();
    Queue<Node> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    
    Node clone = new Node(node.val);
    cloned.put(node, clone);
    queue.offer(node);
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Node current = queue.poll();
        
        for (Node neighbor : current.neighbors) {
            if (!cloned.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                cloned.put(neighbor, new Node(neighbor.val));
                queue.offer(neighbor);
            }
            cloned.get(current).neighbors.add(cloned.get(neighbor));
        }
    }
    
    return clone;
}

// Clone directed graph
public Node cloneDirectedGraph(Node node) {
    if (node == null) return null;
    
    Map<Node, Node> cloned = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Node> visited = new HashSet<>();
    
    return dfsCloneDirected(node, cloned, visited);
}

private Node dfsCloneDirected(Node node, Map<Node, Node> cloned, Set<Node> visited) {
    if (cloned.containsKey(node)) {
        return cloned.get(node);
    }
    
    Node clone = new Node(node.val);
    cloned.put(node, clone);
    visited.add(node);
    
    for (Node neighbor : node.neighbors) {
        clone.neighbors.add(dfsCloneDirected(neighbor, cloned, visited));
    }
    
    return clone;
}

public GraphNodeWithData cloneGraphWithData(GraphNodeWithData node) {

private GraphNodeWithData dfsCloneWithData(GraphNodeWithData node, 
                                          Map<GraphNodeWithData, GraphNodeWithData> cloned) {

        return cloned.get(node);
    }
    
    GraphNodeWithData clone = new GraphNodeWithData(node.val, node.data);
```
