### 90. Subset Sum Problem
**Problem**: Check if subset with given sum exists  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Recursive approach
public boolean isSubsetSum(int[] arr, int sum) {
    return isSubsetSumRec(arr, arr.length, sum);
}

private boolean isSubsetSumRec(int[] arr, int n, int sum) {
    // Base cases
    if (sum == 0) return true;
    if (n == 0) return false;
    
    // If last element is greater than sum, ignore it
    if (arr[n - 1] > sum) {
        return isSubsetSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum);
    }
    
    // Check if sum can be obtained by including or excluding last element
    return isSubsetSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum) || 
           isSubsetSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum - arr[n - 1]);
}

// Memoization approach
public boolean isSubsetSumMemo(int[] arr, int sum) {
    int n = arr.length;
    Boolean[][] memo = new Boolean[n + 1][sum + 1];
    return isSubsetSumMemoHelper(arr, n, sum, memo);
}

private boolean isSubsetSumMemoHelper(int[] arr, int n, int sum, Boolean[][] memo) {
    if (sum == 0) return true;
    if (n == 0) return false;
    
    if (memo[n][sum] != null) {
        return memo[n][sum];
    }
    
    if (arr[n - 1] > sum) {
        memo[n][sum] = isSubsetSumMemoHelper(arr, n - 1, sum, memo);
    } else {
        memo[n][sum] = isSubsetSumMemoHelper(arr, n - 1, sum, memo) || 
                      isSubsetSumMemoHelper(arr, n - 1, sum - arr[n - 1], memo);
    }
    
    return memo[n][sum];
}

// Dynamic Programming approach
public boolean isSubsetSumDP(int[] arr, int sum) {
    int n = arr.length;
    boolean[][] dp = new boolean[n + 1][sum + 1];
    
    // Base case: sum = 0 is always possible
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = true;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= sum; j++) {
            if (arr[i - 1] > j) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] || dp[i - 1][j - arr[i - 1]];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n][sum];
}

// Space optimized DP
public boolean isSubsetSumOptimized(int[] arr, int sum) {
    boolean[] dp = new boolean[sum + 1];
    dp[0] = true;
    
    for (int num : arr) {
        for (int j = sum; j >= num; j--) {
            dp[j] = dp[j] || dp[j - num];
        }
    }
    
    return dp[sum];
}

// Find all subsets with given sum
public List<List<Integer>> findSubsetsWithSum(int[] arr, int targetSum) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> currentSubset = new ArrayList<>();
    findSubsetsWithSumBacktrack(arr, 0, targetSum, currentSubset, result);
    return result;
}

private void findSubsetsWithSumBacktrack(int[] arr, int index, int remainingSum, 
                                       List<Integer> currentSubset, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (remainingSum == 0) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentSubset));
        return;
    }
    
    if (index >= arr.length || remainingSum < 0) {
        return;
    }
    
    // Include current element
    currentSubset.add(arr[index]);
    findSubsetsWithSumBacktrack(arr, index + 1, remainingSum - arr[index], currentSubset, result);
    currentSubset.remove(currentSubset.size() - 1);
    
    // Exclude current element
    findSubsetsWithSumBacktrack(arr, index + 1, remainingSum, currentSubset, result);
}

// Count number of subsets with given sum
public int countSubsetsWithSum(int[] arr, int sum) {
    return countSubsetsWithSumRec(arr, arr.length, sum);
}

private int countSubsetsWithSumRec(int[] arr, int n, int sum) {
    if (sum == 0) return 1;
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    
    if (arr[n - 1] > sum) {
        return countSubsetsWithSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum);
    }
    
    return countSubsetsWithSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum) + 
           countSubsetsWithSumRec(arr, n - 1, sum - arr[n - 1]);
}

// Count subsets with given sum using DP
public int countSubsetsWithSumDP(int[] arr, int sum) {
    int n = arr.length;
    int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][sum + 1];
    
    // Base case
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = 1;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= sum; j++) {
            if (arr[i - 1] > j) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] + dp[i - 1][j - arr[i - 1]];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n][sum];
}
```
**Time**: O(2^n) recursive, O(n×sum) DP, **Space**: O(n×sum) DP, O(sum) optimized

### 91. Generate All Subsets
**Problem**: Generate all possible subsets (power set)  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Recursive backtracking approach
public List<List<Integer>> subsets(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> currentSubset = new ArrayList<>();
    generateSubsets(nums, 0, currentSubset, result);
    return result;
}

private void generateSubsets(int[] nums, int index, List<Integer> currentSubset, 
                           List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (index == nums.length) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentSubset));
        return;
    }
    
    // Include current element
    currentSubset.add(nums[index]);
    generateSubsets(nums, index + 1, currentSubset, result);
    
    // Exclude current element (backtrack)
    currentSubset.remove(currentSubset.size() - 1);
    generateSubsets(nums, index + 1, currentSubset, result);
}

// Iterative approach
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsIterative(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    result.add(new ArrayList<>()); // Empty subset
    
    for (int num : nums) {
        int size = result.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            List<Integer> newSubset = new ArrayList<>(result.get(i));
            newSubset.add(num);
            result.add(newSubset);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Bit manipulation approach
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsBitManipulation(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int n = nums.length;
    int totalSubsets = 1 << n; // 2^n
    
    for (int i = 0; i < totalSubsets; i++) {
        List<Integer> subset = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                subset.add(nums[j]);
            }
        }
        result.add(subset);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Generate subsets with duplicates
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsWithDup(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Arrays.sort(nums); // Sort to handle duplicates
    generateSubsetsWithDup(nums, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateSubsetsWithDup(int[] nums, int index, List<Integer> currentSubset, 
                                  List<List<Integer>> result) {
    result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentSubset));
    
    for (int i = index; i < nums.length; i++) {
        // Skip duplicates
        if (i > index && nums[i] == nums[i - 1]) {
            continue;
        }
        
        currentSubset.add(nums[i]);
        generateSubsetsWithDup(nums, i + 1, currentSubset, result);
        currentSubset.remove(currentSubset.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Generate k-sized subsets
public List<List<Integer>> combine(int n, int k) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> combination = new ArrayList<>();
    generateCombinations(1, n, k, combination, result);
    return result;
}

private void generateCombinations(int start, int n, int k, List<Integer> combination, 
                                List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (combination.size() == k) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(combination));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = start; i <= n; i++) {
        combination.add(i);
        generateCombinations(i + 1, n, k, combination, result);
        combination.remove(combination.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Generate subsets of specific size from array
public List<List<Integer>> combinationsFromArray(int[] nums, int k) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> combination = new ArrayList<>();
    generateCombinationsFromArray(nums, 0, k, combination, result);
    return result;
}

private void generateCombinationsFromArray(int[] nums, int index, int k, 
                                         List<Integer> combination, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (combination.size() == k) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(combination));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = index; i < nums.length; i++) {
        combination.add(nums[i]);
        generateCombinationsFromArray(nums, i + 1, k, combination, result);
        combination.remove(combination.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Generate all unique subsets lexicographically
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsLexicographic(int[] nums) {
    Arrays.sort(nums);
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    generateSubsetsLexicographic(nums, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateSubsetsLexicographic(int[] nums, int index, List<Integer> currentSubset, 
                                        List<List<Integer>> result) {
    result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentSubset));
    
    for (int i = index; i < nums.length; i++) {
        currentSubset.add(nums[i]);
        generateSubsetsLexicographic(nums, i + 1, currentSubset, result);
        currentSubset.remove(currentSubset.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Count total number of subsets
public int countSubsets(int[] nums) {
    return 1 << nums.length; // 2^n
}

// Generate subsets using mathematical formula
public List<List<Integer>> subsetsUsingCombinations(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int n = nums.length;
    
    for (int size = 0; size <= n; size++) {
        List<List<Integer>> subsetsOfSize = combinationsFromArray(nums, size);
        result.addAll(subsetsOfSize);
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(2^n × n), **Space**: O(2^n × n)

### 92. Generate All Permutations
**Problem**: Generate all permutations of given array  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Recursive backtracking approach
public List<List<Integer>> permute(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> currentPermutation = new ArrayList<>();
    boolean[] used = new boolean[nums.length];
    generatePermutations(nums, used, currentPermutation, result);
    return result;
}

private void generatePermutations(int[] nums, boolean[] used, List<Integer> currentPermutation, 
                                List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (currentPermutation.size() == nums.length) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentPermutation));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (!used[i]) {
            used[i] = true;
            currentPermutation.add(nums[i]);
            generatePermutations(nums, used, currentPermutation, result);
            currentPermutation.remove(currentPermutation.size() - 1);
            used[i] = false;
        }
    }
}

// Permutations with duplicates
public List<List<Integer>> permuteUnique(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Arrays.sort(nums); // Sort to handle duplicates
    boolean[] used = new boolean[nums.length];
    generateUniquePermutations(nums, used, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateUniquePermutations(int[] nums, boolean[] used, List<Integer> currentPermutation, 
                                      List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (currentPermutation.size() == nums.length) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentPermutation));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        
        // Skip duplicates: if current element is same as previous and previous is not used
        if (i > 0 && nums[i] == nums[i - 1] && !used[i - 1]) {
            continue;
        }
        
        used[i] = true;
        currentPermutation.add(nums[i]);
        generateUniquePermutations(nums, used, currentPermutation, result);
        currentPermutation.remove(currentPermutation.size() - 1);
        used[i] = false;
    }
}

// Generate permutations using swapping (Heap's algorithm style)
public List<List<Integer>> permuteBySwapping(int[] nums) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    generatePermutationsBySwapping(nums, 0, result);
    return result;
}

private void generatePermutationsBySwapping(int[] nums, int index, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (index == nums.length) {
        List<Integer> permutation = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int num : nums) {
            permutation.add(num);
        }
        result.add(permutation);
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = index; i < nums.length; i++) {
        swap(nums, index, i);
        generatePermutationsBySwapping(nums, index + 1, result);
        swap(nums, index, i); // Backtrack
    }
}

private void swap(int[] nums, int i, int j) {
    int temp = nums[i];
    nums[i] = nums[j];
    nums[j] = temp;
}

// Next permutation (lexicographically next greater permutation)
public void nextPermutation(int[] nums) {
    int i = nums.length - 2;
    
    // Find the largest index i such that nums[i] < nums[i + 1]
    while (i >= 0 && nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
        i--;
    }
    
    if (i >= 0) {
        // Find the largest index j greater than i such that nums[i] < nums[j]
        int j = nums.length - 1;
        while (nums[j] <= nums[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        swap(nums, i, j);
    }
    
    // Reverse the suffix starting at index i + 1
    reverse(nums, i + 1);
}

private void reverse(int[] nums, int start) {
    int end = nums.length - 1;
    while (start < end) {
        swap(nums, start, end);
        start++;
        end--;
    }
}

// Previous permutation (lexicographically previous smaller permutation)
public void prevPermutation(int[] nums) {
    int i = nums.length - 2;
    
    // Find the largest index i such that nums[i] > nums[i + 1]
    while (i >= 0 && nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
        i--;
    }
    
    if (i >= 0) {
        // Find the largest index j greater than i such that nums[i] > nums[j]
        int j = nums.length - 1;
        while (nums[j] >= nums[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        swap(nums, i, j);
    }
    
    // Reverse the suffix starting at index i + 1
    reverse(nums, i + 1);
}

// String permutations
public List<String> permuteString(String s) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    char[] chars = s.toCharArray();
    Arrays.sort(chars); // Sort for lexicographic order
    boolean[] used = new boolean[chars.length];
    generateStringPermutations(chars, used, new StringBuilder(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateStringPermutations(char[] chars, boolean[] used, StringBuilder current, 
                                      List<String> result) {
    if (current.length() == chars.length) {
        result.add(current.toString());
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        
        // Skip duplicates
        if (i > 0 && chars[i] == chars[i - 1] && !used[i - 1]) {
            continue;
        }
        
        used[i] = true;
        current.append(chars[i]);
        generateStringPermutations(chars, used, current, result);
        current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1);
        used[i] = false;
    }
}

// Count total permutations
public long countPermutations(int n) {
    long result = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        result *= i;
    }
    return result;
}

// Count permutations with repetition
public long countPermutationsWithRepetition(int[] counts) {
    int total = Arrays.stream(counts).sum();
    long result = countPermutations(total);
    
    for (int count : counts) {
        result /= countPermutations(count);
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Generate k-length permutations
public List<List<Integer>> permuteKLength(int[] nums, int k) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    boolean[] used = new boolean[nums.length];
    generateKPermutations(nums, k, used, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateKPermutations(int[] nums, int k, boolean[] used, List<Integer> current, 
                                 List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (current.size() == k) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(current));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (!used[i]) {
            used[i] = true;
            current.add(nums[i]);
            generateKPermutations(nums, k, used, current, result);
            current.remove(current.size() - 1);
            used[i] = false;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n! × n), **Space**: O(n! × n)

### 93. N-Queens Problem
**Problem**: Place N queens on N×N chessboard so that no two queens attack each other  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public List<List<String>> solveNQueens(int n) {
    List<List<String>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    char[][] board = new char[n][n];
    
    // Initialize board
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], '.');
    }
    
    solveNQueensBacktrack(board, 0, result);
    return result;
}

private void solveNQueensBacktrack(char[][] board, int row, List<List<String>> result) {
    if (row == board.length) {
        result.add(constructBoard(board));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int col = 0; col < board.length; col++) {
        if (isValidPlacement(board, row, col)) {
            board[row][col] = 'Q';
            solveNQueensBacktrack(board, row + 1, result);
            board[row][col] = '.'; // Backtrack
        }
    }
}

private boolean isValidPlacement(char[][] board, int row, int col) {
    int n = board.length;
    
    // Check column
    for (int i = 0; i < row; i++) {
        if (board[i][col] == 'Q') {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check upper-left diagonal
    for (int i = row - 1, j = col - 1; i >= 0 && j >= 0; i--, j--) {
        if (board[i][j] == 'Q') {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check upper-right diagonal
    for (int i = row - 1, j = col + 1; i >= 0 && j < n; i--, j++) {
        if (board[i][j] == 'Q') {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

private List<String> constructBoard(char[][] board) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    for (char[] row : board) {
        result.add(new String(row));
    }
    return result;
}

// Optimized N-Queens with bit manipulation
public List<List<String>> solveNQueensOptimized(int n) {
    List<List<String>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int[] queensPositions = new int[n]; // queensPositions[i] = column of queen in row i
    solveNQueensOptimizedBacktrack(0, n, queensPositions, result);
    return result;
}

private void solveNQueensOptimizedBacktrack(int row, int n, int[] queensPositions, 
                                          List<List<String>> result) {
    if (row == n) {
        result.add(constructSolution(queensPositions, n));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int col = 0; col < n; col++) {
        if (isValidOptimized(queensPositions, row, col)) {
            queensPositions[row] = col;
            solveNQueensOptimizedBacktrack(row + 1, n, queensPositions, result);
        }
    }
}

private boolean isValidOptimized(int[] queensPositions, int row, int col) {
    for (int i = 0; i < row; i++) {
        // Check column and diagonals
        if (queensPositions[i] == col || 
            queensPositions[i] - i == col - row || 
            queensPositions[i] + i == col + row) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

private List<String> constructSolution(int[] queensPositions, int n) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        StringBuilder row = new StringBuilder();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (j == queensPositions[i]) {
                row.append('Q');
            } else {
                row.append('.');
            }
        }
        result.add(row.toString());
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Count total number of solutions
public int totalNQueens(int n) {
    int[] count = {0};
    int[] queensPositions = new int[n];
    countNQueensSolutions(0, n, queensPositions, count);
    return count[0];
}

private void countNQueensSolutions(int row, int n, int[] queensPositions, int[] count) {
    if (row == n) {
        count[0]++;
        return;
    }
    
    for (int col = 0; col < n; col++) {
        if (isValidOptimized(queensPositions, row, col)) {
            queensPositions[row] = col;
            countNQueensSolutions(row + 1, n, queensPositions, count);
        }
    }
}

// Check if specific configuration is valid
public boolean isValidNQueensConfiguration(List<String> board) {
    int n = board.size();
    List<Integer> queenPositions = new ArrayList<>();
    
    // Extract queen positions
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        String row = board.get(i);
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (row.charAt(j) == 'Q') {
                queenPositions.add(j);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Check if all placements are valid
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            // Same column or diagonal
            if (queenPositions.get(i).equals(queenPositions.get(j)) ||
                Math.abs(queenPositions.get(i) - queenPositions.get(j)) == Math.abs(i - j)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Find first valid solution
public List<String> findFirstNQueensSolution(int n) {
    char[][] board = new char[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], '.');
    }
    
    if (findFirstSolution(board, 0)) {
        return constructBoard(board);
    }
    
    return new ArrayList<>(); // No solution found
}

private boolean findFirstSolution(char[][] board, int row) {
    if (row == board.length) {
        return true;
    }
    
    for (int col = 0; col < board.length; col++) {
        if (isValidPlacement(board, row, col)) {
            board[row][col] = 'Q';
            if (findFirstSolution(board, row + 1)) {
                return true;
            }
            board[row][col] = '.'; // Backtrack
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
```
**Time**: O(N!), **Space**: O(N²)

### 94. Sudoku Solver
**Problem**: Fill 9×9 Sudoku grid following rules  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public void solveSudoku(char[][] board) {
    solveSudokuBacktrack(board);
}

private boolean solveSudokuBacktrack(char[][] board) {
    for (int row = 0; row < 9; row++) {
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            if (board[row][col] == '.') {
                for (char digit = '1'; digit <= '9'; digit++) {
                    if (isValidSudokuPlacement(board, row, col, digit)) {
                        board[row][col] = digit;
                        
                        if (solveSudokuBacktrack(board)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                        
                        board[row][col] = '.'; // Backtrack
                    }
                }
                return false; // No valid digit found for this cell
            }
        }
    }
    return true; // All cells filled successfully
}

private boolean isValidSudokuPlacement(char[][] board, int row, int col, char digit) {
    // Check row
    for (int j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
        if (board[row][j] == digit) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check column
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        if (board[i][col] == digit) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Check 3x3 sub-box
    int boxRow = (row / 3) * 3;
    int boxCol = (col / 3) * 3;
    
    for (int i = boxRow; i < boxRow + 3; i++) {
        for (int j = boxCol; j < boxCol + 3; j++) {
            if (board[i][j] == digit) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Validate existing Sudoku board
public boolean isValidSudoku(char[][] board) {
    Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 9; j++) {
            char digit = board[i][j];
            if (digit != '.') {
                String inRow = digit + " in row " + i;
                String inCol = digit + " in col " + j;
                String inBox = digit + " in box " + (i/3) + "-" + (j/3);
                
                if (!seen.add(inRow) || !seen.add(inCol) || !seen.add(inBox)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Optimized Sudoku solver using constraint propagation
public void solveSudokuOptimized(char[][] board) {
    // Find cell with minimum possible values (most constrained)
    solveSudokuOptimizedBacktrack(board);
}

private boolean solveSudokuOptimizedBacktrack(char[][] board) {
    int[] bestCell = findMostConstrainedCell(board);
    if (bestCell == null) {
        return true; // All cells filled
    }
    
    int row = bestCell[0];
    int col = bestCell[1];
    
    for (char digit = '1'; digit <= '9'; digit++) {
        if (isValidSudokuPlacement(board, row, col, digit)) {
            board[row][col] = digit;
            
            if (solveSudokuOptimizedBacktrack(board)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            board[row][col] = '.'; // Backtrack
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

private int[] findMostConstrainedCell(char[][] board) {
    int minOptions = 10;
    int[] bestCell = null;
    
    for (int row = 0; row < 9; row++) {
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            if (board[row][col] == '.') {
                int options = countValidOptions(board, row, col);
                if (options < minOptions) {
                    minOptions = options;
                    bestCell = new int[]{row, col};
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return bestCell;
}

private int countValidOptions(char[][] board, int row, int col) {
    int count = 0;
    for (char digit = '1'; digit <= '9'; digit++) {
        if (isValidSudokuPlacement(board, row, col, digit)) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

// Generate valid Sudoku puzzle
public char[][] generateSudoku() {
    char[][] board = new char[9][9];
    
    // Initialize empty board
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], '.');
    }
    
    // Fill diagonal 3x3 boxes first (they don't conflict with each other)
    fillDiagonalBoxes(board);
    
    // Fill remaining cells
    solveSudokuBacktrack(board);
    
    return board;
}

private void fillDiagonalBoxes(char[][] board) {
    for (int box = 0; box < 9; box += 3) {
        fillBox(board, box, box);
    }
}

private void fillBox(char[][] board, int rowStart, int colStart) {
    List<Character> numbers = Arrays.asList('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9');
    Collections.shuffle(numbers);
    
    int index = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            board[rowStart + i][colStart + j] = numbers.get(index++);
        }
    }
}

// Count number of solutions for given Sudoku
public int countSudokuSolutions(char[][] board) {
    int[] count = {0};
    countSudokuSolutionsBacktrack(board, count);
    return count[0];
}

private void countSudokuSolutionsBacktrack(char[][] board, int[] count) {
    for (int row = 0; row < 9; row++) {
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            if (board[row][col] == '.') {
                for (char digit = '1'; digit <= '9'; digit++) {
                    if (isValidSudokuPlacement(board, row, col, digit)) {
                        board[row][col] = digit;
                        countSudokuSolutionsBacktrack(board, count);
                        board[row][col] = '.'; // Backtrack
                    }
                }
                return; // Stop here to avoid counting partial solutions
            }
        }
    }
    count[0]++; // Found a complete solution
}

// Check if Sudoku has unique solution
public boolean hasUniqueSolution(char[][] board) {
    return countSudokuSolutions(board) == 1;
}
```
**Time**: O(9^(n×n)), **Space**: O(n×n) where n = 9

### 95. Combination Sum
**Problem**: Find all combinations that sum to target  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Combination Sum I (unlimited use of each number)
public List<List<Integer>> combinationSum(int[] candidates, int target) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Arrays.sort(candidates); // Sort for optimization
    combinationSumBacktrack(candidates, target, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void combinationSumBacktrack(int[] candidates, int remainingTarget, int startIndex, 
                                   List<Integer> currentCombination, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (remainingTarget == 0) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentCombination));
        return;
    }
    
    if (remainingTarget < 0) {
        return; // Exceeded target
    }
    
    for (int i = startIndex; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        // Optimization: if current number > remaining target, no need to continue
        if (candidates[i] > remainingTarget) {
            break;
        }
        
        currentCombination.add(candidates[i]);
        // Allow reuse of same number (i instead of i + 1)
        combinationSumBacktrack(candidates, remainingTarget - candidates[i], i, 
                              currentCombination, result);
        currentCombination.remove(currentCombination.size() - 1); // Backtrack
    }
}

// Combination Sum II (each number used only once)
public List<List<Integer>> combinationSum2(int[] candidates, int target) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    Arrays.sort(candidates);
    combinationSum2Backtrack(candidates, target, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void combinationSum2Backtrack(int[] candidates, int remainingTarget, int startIndex, 
                                    List<Integer> currentCombination, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (remainingTarget == 0) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentCombination));
        return;
    }
    
    if (remainingTarget < 0) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = startIndex; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        // Skip duplicates at same level
        if (i > startIndex && candidates[i] == candidates[i - 1]) {
            continue;
        }
        
        if (candidates[i] > remainingTarget) {
            break;
        }
        
        currentCombination.add(candidates[i]);
        // Move to next index (i + 1) since each number used only once
        combinationSum2Backtrack(candidates, remainingTarget - candidates[i], i + 1, 
                                currentCombination, result);
        currentCombination.remove(currentCombination.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Combination Sum III (use k numbers, each 1-9 used at most once)
public List<List<Integer>> combinationSum3(int k, int n) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    combinationSum3Backtrack(k, n, 1, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void combinationSum3Backtrack(int k, int remainingTarget, int startNum, 
                                    List<Integer> currentCombination, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (currentCombination.size() == k) {
        if (remainingTarget == 0) {
            result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentCombination));
        }
        return;
    }
    
    if (remainingTarget <= 0) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = startNum; i <= 9; i++) {
        if (i > remainingTarget) {
            break; // Optimization
        }
        
        currentCombination.add(i);
        combinationSum3Backtrack(k, remainingTarget - i, i + 1, currentCombination, result);
        currentCombination.remove(currentCombination.size() - 1);
    }
}

// Combination Sum IV (count ways to make target sum using unlimited elements)
public int combinationSum4(int[] nums, int target) {
    int[] dp = new int[target + 1];
    dp[0] = 1; // One way to make sum 0
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= target; i++) {
        for (int num : nums) {
            if (i >= num) {
                dp[i] += dp[i - num];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[target];
}

// Combination Sum with minimum number of coins
public int coinChange(int[] coins, int amount) {
    int[] dp = new int[amount + 1];
    Arrays.fill(dp, amount + 1); // Initialize with impossible value
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= amount; i++) {
        for (int coin : coins) {
            if (i >= coin) {
                dp[i] = Math.min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[amount] > amount ? -1 : dp[amount];
}

// Find all combinations with minimum coins
public List<List<Integer>> findMinCoinCombinations(int[] coins, int amount) {
    List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int minCoins = coinChange(coins, amount);
    
    if (minCoins == -1) {
        return result; // No solution
    }
    
    findMinCoinCombinationsBacktrack(coins, amount, minCoins, new ArrayList<>(), result);
    return result;
}

private void findMinCoinCombinationsBacktrack(int[] coins, int remainingAmount, int remainingCoins, 
                                            List<Integer> currentCombination, List<List<Integer>> result) {
    if (remainingAmount == 0 && remainingCoins == 0) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentCombination));
        return;
    }
    
    if (remainingAmount <= 0 || remainingCoins <= 0) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int coin : coins) {
        if (coin <= remainingAmount) {
            currentCombination.add(coin);
            findMinCoinCombinationsBacktrack(coins, remainingAmount - coin, remainingCoins - 1, 
                                           currentCombination, result);
            currentCombination.remove(currentCombination.size() - 1);
        }
    }
}

// Target sum using +/- signs
public int findTargetSumWays(int[] nums, int target) {
    int sum = Arrays.stream(nums).sum();
    
    // Check if target is achievable
    if (target > sum || target < -sum || (target + sum) % 2 == 1) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int newTarget = (target + sum) / 2;
    return countSubsetsWithSumDP(nums, newTarget);
}

// Letter combinations that sum to target (using letter values a=1, b=2, etc.)
public List<String> letterCombinationsSum(int target) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    letterCombinationsSumBacktrack(target, new StringBuilder(), result);
    return result;
}

private void letterCombinationsSumBacktrack(int remainingTarget, StringBuilder current, 
                                          List<String> result) {
    if (remainingTarget == 0) {
        result.add(current.toString());
        return;
    }
    
    if (remainingTarget < 0) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 26 && i <= remainingTarget; i++) {
        char letter = (char)('a' + i - 1);
        current.append(letter);
        letterCombinationsSumBacktrack(remainingTarget - i, current, result);
        current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1);
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(2^n) for backtracking approaches, O(n × target) for DP, **Space**: O(target)

### 96. Word Search
**Problem**: Search for word in 2D grid  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public boolean exist(char[][] board, String word) {
    if (board == null || board.length == 0 || word == null || word.length() == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    
    int rows = board.length;
    int cols = board[0].length;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
            if (board[i][j] == word.charAt(0)) {
                boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][cols];
                if (wordSearchDFS(board, word, i, j, 0, visited)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

private boolean wordSearchDFS(char[][] board, String word, int row, int col, 
                            int index, boolean[][] visited) {
    if (index == word.length()) {
        return true; // Found complete word
    }
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= board.length || col < 0 || col >= board[0].length || 
        visited[row][col] || board[row][col] != word.charAt(index)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = true;
    
    // Search in all 4 directions
    int[][] directions = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};
    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        if (wordSearchDFS(board, word, row + dir[0], col + dir[1], index + 1, visited)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = false; // Backtrack
    return false;
}

// Word Search without additional visited array (modify board)
public boolean existOptimized(char[][] board, String word) {
    for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) {
            if (wordSearchOptimized(board, word, i, j, 0)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

private boolean wordSearchOptimized(char[][] board, String word, int row, int col, int index) {
    if (index == word.length()) return true;
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= board.length || col < 0 || col >= board[0].length || 
        board[row][col] != word.charAt(index)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    char temp = board[row][col];
    board[row][col] = '*'; // Mark as visited
    
    boolean found = wordSearchOptimized(board, word, row - 1, col, index + 1) ||
                   wordSearchOptimized(board, word, row + 1, col, index + 1) ||
                   wordSearchOptimized(board, word, row, col - 1, index + 1) ||
                   wordSearchOptimized(board, word, row, col + 1, index + 1);
    
    board[row][col] = temp; // Restore original character
    return found;
}

// Word Search II: find all words from dictionary in board
public List<String> findWords(char[][] board, String[] words) {
    TrieNode root = buildTrie(words);
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) {
            findWordsBacktrack(board, i, j, root, result);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

class TrieNode {
    TrieNode[] children = new TrieNode[26];
    String word = null;
}

private TrieNode buildTrie(String[] words) {
    TrieNode root = new TrieNode();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        TrieNode node = root;
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (node.children[index] == null) {
                node.children[index] = new TrieNode();
            }
            node = node.children[index];
        }
        node.word = word;
    }
    
    return root;
}

private void findWordsBacktrack(char[][] board, int row, int col, TrieNode node, List<String> result) {
    if (row < 0 || row >= board.length || col < 0 || col >= board[0].length) {
        return;
    }
    
    char c = board[row][col];
    if (c == '*' || node.children[c - 'a'] == null) {
        return;
    }
    
    node = node.children[c - 'a'];
    if (node.word != null) {
        result.add(node.word);
        node.word = null; // Avoid duplicates
    }
    
    board[row][col] = '*'; // Mark as visited
    
    // Search in all 4 directions
    findWordsBacktrack(board, row - 1, col, node, result);
    findWordsBacktrack(board, row + 1, col, node, result);
    findWordsBacktrack(board, row, col - 1, node, result);
    findWordsBacktrack(board, row, col + 1, node, result);
    
    board[row][col] = c; // Restore
}

// Find longest word in board
public String findLongestWord(char[][] board, String[] words) {
    String longest = "";
    
    for (String word : words) {
        if (word.length() > longest.length() && exist(board, word)) {
            longest = word;
        }
    }
    
    return longest;
}

// Count total number of words that can be formed
public int countWordsInBoard(char[][] board, String[] words) {
    int count = 0;
    for (String word : words) {
        if (exist(board, word)) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

// Find all possible words of given length
public List<String> findAllWordsOfLength(char[][] board, int length) {
    Set<String> result = new HashSet<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[board.length][board[0].length];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) {
            findWordsOfLengthDFS(board, i, j, length, "", visited, result);
        }
    }
    
    return new ArrayList<>(result);
}

private void findWordsOfLengthDFS(char[][] board, int row, int col, int remainingLength, 
                                String current, boolean[][] visited, Set<String> result) {
    if (remainingLength == 0) {
        result.add(current);
        return;
    }
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= board.length || col < 0 || col >= board[0].length || visited[row][col]) {
        return;
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = true;
    current += board[row][col];
    
    // Search in all 4 directions
    int[][] directions = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};
    for (int[] dir : directions) {
        findWordsOfLengthDFS(board, row + dir[0], col + dir[1], remainingLength - 1, 
                           current, visited, result);
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = false; // Backtrack
}
```
**Time**: O(m×n×4^L) where L is word length, **Space**: O(L)

### 97. Palindrome Partitioning
**Problem**: Partition string into all palindromic substrings  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public List<List<String>> partition(String s) {
    List<List<String>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    List<String> currentPartition = new ArrayList<>();
    partitionBacktrack(s, 0, currentPartition, result);
    return result;
}

private void partitionBacktrack(String s, int start, List<String> currentPartition, 
                              List<List<String>> result) {
    if (start == s.length()) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentPartition));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int end = start; end < s.length(); end++) {
        String substring = s.substring(start, end + 1);
        if (isPalindrome(substring)) {
            currentPartition.add(substring);
            partitionBacktrack(s, end + 1, currentPartition, result);
            currentPartition.remove(currentPartition.size() - 1); // Backtrack
        }
    }
}

private boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
    int left = 0, right = s.length() - 1;
    while (left < right) {
        if (s.charAt(left) != s.charAt(right)) {
            return false;
        }
        left++;
        right--;
    }
    return true;
}

// Optimized palindrome partitioning with precomputed palindrome table
public List<List<String>> partitionOptimized(String s) {
    int n = s.length();
    boolean[][] isPalin = new boolean[n][n];
    
    // Precompute palindrome table
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        isPalin[i][i] = true;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        isPalin[i][i + 1] = (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i + 1));
    }
    
    for (int len = 3; len <= n; len++) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
            int j = i + len - 1;
            isPalin[i][j] = (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) && isPalin[i + 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    
    List<List<String>> result = new ArrayList<>();
    partitionOptimizedBacktrack(s, 0, new ArrayList<>(), result, isPalin);
    return result;
}

private void partitionOptimizedBacktrack(String s, int start, List<String> currentPartition, 
                                       List<List<String>> result, boolean[][] isPalin) {
    if (start == s.length()) {
        result.add(new ArrayList<>(currentPartition));
        return;
    }
    
    for (int end = start; end < s.length(); end++) {
        if (isPalin[start][end]) {
            currentPartition.add(s.substring(start, end + 1));
            partitionOptimizedBacktrack(s, end + 1, currentPartition, result, isPalin);
            currentPartition.remove(currentPartition.size() - 1);
        }
    }
}

// Minimum cuts for palindrome partitioning
public int minCut(String s) {
    int n = s.length();
    boolean[][] isPalin = precomputePalindromes(s);
    int[] dp = new int[n];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        dp[i] = i; // Maximum cuts needed
        
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (isPalin[j][i]) {
                dp[i] = Math.min(dp[i], j == 0 ? 0 : dp[j - 1] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n - 1];
}

private boolean[][] precomputePalindromes(String s) {
    int n = s.length();
    boolean[][] isPalin = new boolean[n][n];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        isPalin[i][i] = true;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        isPalin[i][i + 1] = (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(i + 1));
    }
    
    for (int len = 3; len <= n; len++) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
            int j = i + len - 1;
            isPalin[i][j] = (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) && isPalin[i + 1][j - 1];
        }
    }
    
    return isPalin;
}

// Find all palindromic substrings
public List<String> findAllPalindromes(String s) {
    Set<String> palindromes = new HashSet<>();
    int n = s.length();
    
    // Find all odd-length palindromes
    for (int center = 0; center < n; center++) {
        expandAroundCenter(s, center, center, palindromes);
    }
    
    // Find all even-length palindromes
    for (int center = 0; center < n - 1; center++) {
        expandAroundCenter(s, center, center + 1, palindromes);
    }
    
    return new ArrayList<>(palindromes);
}

private void expandAroundCenter(String s, int left, int right, Set<String> palindromes) {
    while (left >= 0 && right < s.length() && s.charAt(left) == s.charAt(right)) {
        palindromes.add(s.substring(left, right + 1));
        left--;
        right++;
    }
}

// Count palindromic substrings
public int countSubstrings(String s) {
    int count = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    
    for (int center = 0; center < n; center++) {
        count += countPalindromes(s, center, center); // Odd length
        count += countPalindromes(s, center, center + 1); // Even length
    }
    
    return count;
}

private int countPalindromes(String s, int left, int right) {
    int count = 0;
    while (left >= 0 && right < s.length() && s.charAt(left) == s.charAt(right)) {
        count++;
        left--;
        right++;
    }
    return count;
}

// Longest palindromic subsequence
public int longestPalindromeSubseq(String s) {
    int n = s.length();
    int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
    
    // Every single character is a palindrome of length 1
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        dp[i][i] = 1;
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
            int j = i + len - 1;
            if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 2;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[0][n - 1];
}
```
**Time**: O(n × 2^n) for partitioning, O(n²) for min cuts, **Space**: O(n²)

### 98. Letter Combinations of Phone Number
**Problem**: Generate all letter combinations from phone number digits  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public List<String> letterCombinations(String digits) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (digits == null || digits.length() == 0) {
        return result;
    }
    
    String[] mapping = {
        "",     // 0
        "",     // 1
        "abc",  // 2
        "def",  // 3
        "ghi",  // 4
        "jkl",  // 5
        "mno",  // 6
        "pqrs", // 7
        "tuv",  // 8
        "wxyz"  // 9
    };
    
    letterCombinationsBacktrack(digits, 0, new StringBuilder(), result, mapping);
    return result;
}

private void letterCombinationsBacktrack(String digits, int index, StringBuilder current, 
                                       List<String> result, String[] mapping) {
    if (index == digits.length()) {
        result.add(current.toString());
        return;
    }
    
    int digit = digits.charAt(index) - '0';
    String letters = mapping[digit];
    
    for (char letter : letters.toCharArray()) {
        current.append(letter);
        letterCombinationsBacktrack(digits, index + 1, current, result, mapping);
        current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1); // Backtrack
    }
}

// Iterative approach
public List<String> letterCombinationsIterative(String digits) {
    if (digits == null || digits.length() == 0) {
        return new ArrayList<>();
    }
    
    String[] mapping = {"", "", "abc", "def", "ghi", "jkl", "mno", "pqrs", "tuv", "wxyz"};
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    result.add(""); // Start with empty string
    
    for (char digit : digits.toCharArray()) {
        List<String> temp = new ArrayList<>();
        String letters = mapping[digit - '0'];
        
        for (String combination : result) {
            for (char letter : letters.toCharArray()) {
                temp.add(combination + letter);
            }
        }
        
        result = temp;
    }
    
    return result;
}

// Count total combinations
public int countLetterCombinations(String digits) {
    if (digits == null || digits.length() == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int[] letterCount = {0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 3, 4}; // Count for each digit
    int totalCombinations = 1;
    
    for (char digit : digits.toCharArray()) {
        totalCombinations *= letterCount[digit - '0'];
    }
    
    return totalCombinations;
}
```
**Time**: O(4^n × n), **Space**: O(4^n × n)

### 99. Generate Parentheses
**Problem**: Generate all valid combinations of n pairs of parentheses  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public List<String> generateParenthesis(int n) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    generateParenthesisBacktrack(n, 0, 0, new StringBuilder(), result);
    return result;
}

private void generateParenthesisBacktrack(int n, int openCount, int closeCount, 
                                        StringBuilder current, List<String> result) {
    if (current.length() == 2 * n) {
        result.add(current.toString());
        return;
    }
    
    // Add opening parenthesis if we haven't used all n
    if (openCount < n) {
        current.append('(');
        generateParenthesisBacktrack(n, openCount + 1, closeCount, current, result);
        current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1); // Backtrack
    }
    
    // Add closing parenthesis if it doesn't exceed opening count
    if (closeCount < openCount) {
        current.append(')');
        generateParenthesisBacktrack(n, openCount, closeCount + 1, current, result);
        current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1); // Backtrack
    }
}

// Alternative approach using string concatenation
public List<String> generateParenthesisAlt(int n) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    generateParenthesisAltBacktrack(n, 0, 0, "", result);
    return result;
}

private void generateParenthesisAltBacktrack(int n, int openCount, int closeCount, 
                                           String current, List<String> result) {
    if (current.length() == 2 * n) {
        result.add(current);
        return;
    }
    
    if (openCount < n) {
        generateParenthesisAltBacktrack(n, openCount + 1, closeCount, current + "(", result);
    }
    
    if (closeCount < openCount) {
        generateParenthesisAltBacktrack(n, openCount, closeCount + 1, current + ")", result);
    }
}

// Count valid parentheses combinations (Catalan number)
public int countParentheses(int n) {
    return catalanNumber(n);
}

private int catalanNumber(int n) {
    if (n <= 1) return 1;
    
    int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
    dp[0] = dp[1] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            dp[i] += dp[j] * dp[i - 1 - j];
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n];
}

// Check if parentheses string is valid
public boolean isValidParentheses(String s) {
    int count = 0;
    for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
        if (c == '(') {
            count++;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            count--;
            if (count < 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return count == 0;
}
```
**Time**: O(4^n / √n), **Space**: O(4^n / √n)

### 100. Rat in a Maze
**Problem**: Find path from top-left to bottom-right in maze  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public List<String> findPath(int[][] maze, int n) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (maze[0][0] == 0 || maze[n-1][n-1] == 0) {
        return result; // Start or end is blocked
    }
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
    findPathBacktrack(maze, 0, 0, n, "", visited, result);
    return result;
}

private void findPathBacktrack(int[][] maze, int row, int col, int n, String path, 
                             boolean[][] visited, List<String> result) {
    if (row == n - 1 && col == n - 1) {
        result.add(path);
        return;
    }
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= n || col < 0 || col >= n || 
        maze[row][col] == 0 || visited[row][col]) {
        return;
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = true;
    
    // Try all 4 directions: Down, Left, Right, Up (lexicographical order)
    findPathBacktrack(maze, row + 1, col, n, path + "D", visited, result);
    findPathBacktrack(maze, row, col - 1, n, path + "L", visited, result);
    findPathBacktrack(maze, row, col + 1, n, path + "R", visited, result);
    findPathBacktrack(maze, row - 1, col, n, path + "U", visited, result);
    
    visited[row][col] = false; // Backtrack
}

// Find single path (if exists)
public String findSinglePath(int[][] maze, int n) {
    if (maze[0][0] == 0 || maze[n-1][n-1] == 0) {
        return "";
    }
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
    StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder();
    
    if (findSinglePathHelper(maze, 0, 0, n, path, visited)) {
        return path.toString();
    }
    
    return "";
}

private boolean findSinglePathHelper(int[][] maze, int row, int col, int n, 
                                   StringBuilder path, boolean[][] visited) {
    if (row == n - 1 && col == n - 1) {
        return true;
    }
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= n || col < 0 || col >= n || 
        maze[row][col] == 0 || visited[row][col]) {
        return false;
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = true;
    
    // Try Down
    path.append('D');
    if (findSinglePathHelper(maze, row + 1, col, n, path, visited)) {
        return true;
    }
    path.deleteCharAt(path.length() - 1);
    
    // Try Left
    path.append('L');
    if (findSinglePathHelper(maze, row, col - 1, n, path, visited)) {
        return true;
    }
    path.deleteCharAt(path.length() - 1);
    
    // Try Right
    path.append('R');
    if (findSinglePathHelper(maze, row, col + 1, n, path, visited)) {
        return true;
    }
    path.deleteCharAt(path.length() - 1);
    
    // Try Up
    path.append('U');
    if (findSinglePathHelper(maze, row - 1, col, n, path, visited)) {
        return true;
    }
    path.deleteCharAt(path.length() - 1);
    
    visited[row][col] = false;
    return false;
}

// Count total paths
public int countPaths(int[][] maze, int n) {
    if (maze[0][0] == 0 || maze[n-1][n-1] == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
    return countPathsHelper(maze, 0, 0, n, visited);
}

private int countPathsHelper(int[][] maze, int row, int col, int n, boolean[][] visited) {
    if (row == n - 1 && col == n - 1) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    if (row < 0 || row >= n || col < 0 || col >= n || 
        maze[row][col] == 0 || visited[row][col]) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    visited[row][col] = true;
    
    int totalPaths = countPathsHelper(maze, row + 1, col, n, visited) + // Down
                    countPathsHelper(maze, row, col - 1, n, visited) +  // Left
                    countPathsHelper(maze, row, col + 1, n, visited) +  // Right
                    countPathsHelper(maze, row - 1, col, n, visited);   // Up
    
    visited[row][col] = false;
    return totalPaths;
}

// Find shortest path
public String findShortestPath(int[][] maze, int n) {
    if (maze[0][0] == 0 || maze[n-1][n-1] == 0) {
        return "";
    }
    
    Queue<Node> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
    
    queue.offer(new Node(0, 0, ""));
    visited[0][0] = true;
    
    int[][] directions = {{1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}};
    String[] dirChars = {"D", "L", "R", "U"};
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Node current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current.row == n - 1 && current.col == n - 1) {
            return current.path;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int newRow = current.row + directions[i][0];
            int newCol = current.col + directions[i][1];
            
            if (newRow >= 0 && newRow < n && newCol >= 0 && newCol < n && 
                maze[newRow][newCol] == 1 && !visited[newRow][newCol]) {
                
                visited[newRow][newCol] = true;
                queue.offer(new Node(newRow, newCol, current.path + dirChars[i]));
            }
        }
    }
    
    return "";
}

class Node {
    int row, col;
    String path;
    
    Node(int row, int col, String path) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
        this.path = path;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(4^(n²)), **Space**: O(n²)

### 101. M-Coloring Problem
**Problem**: Color graph with M colors such that no two adjacent vertices have same color  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public boolean graphColoring(boolean[][] graph, int m, int n) {
    int[] color = new int[n];
    return graphColoringBacktrack(graph, m, color, 0, n);
}

private boolean graphColoringBacktrack(boolean[][] graph, int m, int[] color, 
                                     int vertex, int n) {
    if (vertex == n) {
        return true; // All vertices colored successfully
    }
    
    for (int c = 1; c <= m; c++) {
        if (isSafeToColor(graph, vertex, c, color, n)) {
            color[vertex] = c;
            
            if (graphColoringBacktrack(graph, m, color, vertex + 1, n)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            color[vertex] = 0; // Backtrack
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

private boolean isSafeToColor(boolean[][] graph, int vertex, int c, int[] color, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (graph[vertex][i] && color[i] == c) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Find all possible colorings
public List<int[]> findAllColorings(boolean[][] graph, int m, int n) {
    List<int[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int[] color = new int[n];
    findAllColoringsBacktrack(graph, m, color, 0, n, result);
    return result;
}

private void findAllColoringsBacktrack(boolean[][] graph, int m, int[] color, int vertex, 
                                     int n, List<int[]> result) {
    if (vertex == n) {
        result.add(color.clone());
        return;
    }
    
    for (int c = 1; c <= m; c++) {
        if (isSafeToColor(graph, vertex, c, color, n)) {
            color[vertex] = c;
            findAllColoringsBacktrack(graph, m, color, vertex + 1, n, result);
            color[vertex] = 0;
        }
    }
}

// Find minimum colors needed (chromatic number approximation)
public int findMinColors(boolean[][] graph, int n) {
    for (int m = 1; m <= n; m++) {
        if (graphColoring(graph, m, n)) {
            return m;
        }
    }
    return n; // Worst case
}

// Count total valid colorings
public int countColorings(boolean[][] graph, int m, int n) {
    int[] count = {0};
    int[] color = new int[n];
    countColoringsBacktrack(graph, m, color, 0, n, count);
    return count[0];
}

private void countColoringsBacktrack(boolean[][] graph, int m, int[] color, int vertex, 
                                   int n, int[] count) {
    if (vertex == n) {
        count[0]++;
        return;
    }
    
    for (int c = 1; c <= m; c++) {
        if (isSafeToColor(graph, vertex, c, color, n)) {
            color[vertex] = c;
            countColoringsBacktrack(graph, m, color, vertex + 1, n, count);
            color[vertex] = 0;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(m^n), **Space**: O(n)

### 102. Knight's Tour Problem
**Problem**: Find sequence of moves for knight to visit every square exactly once  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int[][] knightTour(int n) {
    int[][] board = new int[n][n];
    
    // Initialize board with -1
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], -1);
    }
    
    // Knight moves
    int[] xMove = {2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1, 1, 2};
    int[] yMove = {1, 2, 2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1};
    
    board[0][0] = 0; // Start from (0,0)
    
    if (knightTourBacktrack(board, 0, 0, 1, xMove, yMove, n)) {
        return board;
    }
    
    return new int[0][0]; // No solution
}

private boolean knightTourBacktrack(int[][] board, int x, int y, int moveCount, 
                                  int[] xMove, int[] yMove, int n) {
    if (moveCount == n * n) {
        return true; // All squares visited
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        int nextX = x + xMove[i];
        int nextY = y + yMove[i];
        
        if (isSafeMove(board, nextX, nextY, n)) {
            board[nextX][nextY] = moveCount;
            
            if (knightTourBacktrack(board, nextX, nextY, moveCount + 1, xMove, yMove, n)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            board[nextX][nextY] = -1; // Backtrack
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}

private boolean isSafeMove(int[][] board, int x, int y, int n) {
    return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && board[x][y] == -1;
}

// Optimized Knight's Tour using Warnsdorff's heuristic
public int[][] knightTourOptimized(int n) {
    int[][] board = new int[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], -1);
    }
    
    int[] xMove = {2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1, 1, 2};
    int[] yMove = {1, 2, 2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1};
    
    board[0][0] = 0;
    
    if (knightTourWarnsdorff(board, 0, 0, 1, xMove, yMove, n)) {
        return board;
    }
    
    return new int[0][0];
}

private boolean knightTourWarnsdorff(int[][] board, int x, int y, int moveCount, 
                                   int[] xMove, int[] yMove, int n) {
    if (moveCount == n * n) {
        return true;
    }
    
    // Get all possible next moves
    List<Move> nextMoves = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        int nextX = x + xMove[i];
        int nextY = y + yMove[i];
        
        if (isSafeMove(board, nextX, nextY, n)) {
            int accessibility = getAccessibility(board, nextX, nextY, xMove, yMove, n);
            nextMoves.add(new Move(nextX, nextY, accessibility));
        }
    }
    
    // Sort by accessibility (Warnsdorff's rule - choose square with minimum accessibility)
    nextMoves.sort((a, b) -> a.accessibility - b.accessibility);
    
    for (Move move : nextMoves) {
        board[move.x][move.y] = moveCount;
        
        if (knightTourWarnsdorff(board, move.x, move.y, moveCount + 1, xMove, yMove, n)) {
            return true;
        }
        
        board[move.x][move.y] = -1;
    }
    
    return false;
}

private int getAccessibility(int[][] board, int x, int y, int[] xMove, int[] yMove, int n) {
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        int nextX = x + xMove[i];
        int nextY = y + yMove[i];
        
        if (isSafeMove(board, nextX, nextY, n)) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

class Move {
    int x, y, accessibility;
    
    Move(int x, int y, int accessibility) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.accessibility = accessibility;
    }
}

// Count all possible knight tours
public int countKnightTours(int n) {
    int[][] board = new int[n][n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Arrays.fill(board[i], -1);
    }
    
    int[] xMove = {2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1, 1, 2};
    int[] yMove = {1, 2, 2, 1, -1, -2, -2, -1};
    
    int[] count = {0};
    board[0][0] = 0;
    countKnightToursBacktrack(board, 0, 0, 1, xMove, yMove, n, count);
    
    return count[0];
}

private void countKnightToursBacktrack(int[][] board, int x, int y, int moveCount, 
                                     int[] xMove, int[] yMove, int n, int[] count) {
    if (moveCount == n * n) {
        count[0]++;
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        int nextX = x + xMove[i];
        int nextY = y + yMove[i];
        
        if (isSafeMove(board, nextX, nextY, n)) {
            board[nextX][nextY] = moveCount;
            countKnightToursBacktrack(board, nextX, nextY, moveCount + 1, xMove, yMove, n, count);
            board[nextX][nextY] = -1;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(8^(n²)), **Space**: O(n²)

### 103. Expression Add Operators
**Problem**: Add +, -, * operators to string of digits to get target  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public List<String> addOperators(String num, int target) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (num == null || num.length() == 0) {
        return result;
    }
    
    addOperatorsBacktrack(num, target, 0, "", 0, 0, result);
    return result;
}

private void addOperatorsBacktrack(String num, int target, int index, String expr, 
                                 long eval, long prev, List<String> result) {
    if (index == num.length()) {
        if (eval == target) {
            result.add(expr);
        }
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = index; i < num.length(); i++) {
        String str = num.substring(index, i + 1);
        
        // Skip numbers with leading zeros (except single digit 0)
        if (str.length() > 1 && str.charAt(0) == '0') {
            break;
        }
        
        long curr = Long.parseLong(str);
        
        if (index == 0) {
            // First number, no operator needed
            addOperatorsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, str, curr, curr, result);
        } else {
            // Addition
            addOperatorsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, expr + "+" + str, 
                                eval + curr, curr, result);
            
            // Subtraction
            addOperatorsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, expr + "-" + str, 
                                eval - curr, -curr, result);
            
            // Multiplication (need to handle operator precedence)
            addOperatorsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, expr + "*" + str, 
                                eval - prev + prev * curr, prev * curr, result);
        }
    }
}

// Count valid expressions
public int countValidExpressions(String num, int target) {
    if (num == null || num.length() == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int[] count = {0};
    countExpressionsBacktrack(num, target, 0, 0, 0, count);
    return count[0];
}

private void countExpressionsBacktrack(String num, int target, int index, 
                                     long eval, long prev, int[] count) {
    if (index == num.length()) {
        if (eval == target) {
            count[0]++;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = index; i < num.length(); i++) {
        String str = num.substring(index, i + 1);
        
        if (str.length() > 1 && str.charAt(0) == '0') {
            break;
        }
        
        long curr = Long.parseLong(str);
        
        if (index == 0) {
            countExpressionsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, curr, curr, count);
        } else {
            // Addition
            countExpressionsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, eval + curr, curr, count);
            // Subtraction
            countExpressionsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, eval - curr, -curr, count);
            // Multiplication
            countExpressionsBacktrack(num, target, i + 1, eval - prev + prev * curr, 
                                    prev * curr, count);
        }
    }
}

// Find expressions with minimum operators
public List<String> findMinOperatorExpressions(String num, int target) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int minOps = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    
    // First find minimum number of operators needed
    List<String> allExpressions = addOperators(num, target);
    
    for (String expr : allExpressions) {
        int opCount = countOperators(expr);
        if (opCount < minOps) {
            minOps = opCount;
            result.clear();
            result.add(expr);
        } else if (opCount == minOps) {
            result.add(expr);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private int countOperators(String expr) {
    int count = 0;
    for (char c : expr.toCharArray()) {
        if (c == '+' || c == '-' || c == '*') {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
```
**Time**: O(4^n × n), **Space**: O(n)

### 104. Restore IP Addresses
**Problem**: Restore all valid IP addresses from string  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public List<String> restoreIpAddresses(String s) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    if (s.length() < 4 || s.length() > 12) {
        return result; // Invalid length for IP
    }
    
    restoreIPBacktrack(s, 0, 0, "", result);
    return result;
}

private void restoreIPBacktrack(String s, int index, int parts, String current, 
                              List<String> result) {
    if (parts == 4) {
        if (index == s.length()) {
            result.add(current.substring(1)); // Remove leading dot
        }
        return;
    }
    
    if (index >= s.length()) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3 && index + i <= s.length(); i++) {
        String segment = s.substring(index, index + i);
        
        if (isValidIPSegment(segment)) {
            restoreIPBacktrack(s, index + i, parts + 1, current + "." + segment, result);
        }
    }
}

private boolean isValidIPSegment(String segment) {
    if (segment.length() == 0 || segment.length() > 3) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // No leading zeros unless segment is "0"
    if (segment.length() > 1 && segment.charAt(0) == '0') {
        return false;
    }
    
    int num = Integer.parseInt(segment);
    return num >= 0 && num <= 255;
}

// Count valid IP addresses
public int countValidIPs(String s) {
    if (s.length() < 4 || s.length() > 12) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    int[] count = {0};
    countIPBacktrack(s, 0, 0, count);
    return count[0];
}

private void countIPBacktrack(String s, int index, int parts, int[] count) {
    if (parts == 4) {
        if (index == s.length()) {
            count[0]++;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    if (index >= s.length()) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3 && index + i <= s.length(); i++) {
        String segment = s.substring(index, index + i);
        
        if (isValidIPSegment(segment)) {
            countIPBacktrack(s, index + i, parts + 1, count);
        }
    }
}

// Generate all possible IP formats (including invalid ones for debugging)
public List<String> generateAllIPFormats(String s) {
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    generateAllIPBacktrack(s, 0, 0, "", result);
    return result;
}

private void generateAllIPBacktrack(String s, int index, int parts, String current, 
                                  List<String> result) {
    if (parts == 4) {
        if (index == s.length()) {
            result.add(current.substring(1));
        }
        return;
    }
    
    if (index >= s.length()) {
        return;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3 && index + i <= s.length(); i++) {
        String segment = s.substring(index, index + i);
        generateAllIPBacktrack(s, index + i, parts + 1, current + "." + segment, result);
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(3^4 × |s|) = O(81 × |s|), **Space**: O(1)
