## 🔄 **13. GREEDY ALGORITHMS**

### 105. Activity Selection Problem
**Problem**: Select maximum number of non-overlapping activities  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class Activity {
    int start, end, index;
    
    Activity(int start, int end, int index) {
        this.start = start;
        this.end = end;
        this.index = index;
    }
}

public List<Integer> activitySelection(int[] start, int[] end) {
    int n = start.length;
    Activity[] activities = new Activity[n];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        activities[i] = new Activity(start[i], end[i], i);
    }
    
    // Sort by end time (greedy choice)
    Arrays.sort(activities, (a, b) -> a.end - b.end);
    
    List<Integer> selected = new ArrayList<>();
    selected.add(activities[0].index);
    int lastSelected = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (activities[i].start >= activities[lastSelected].end) {
            selected.add(activities[i].index);
            lastSelected = i;
        }
    }
    
    return selected;
}

// Maximum number of activities
public int maxActivities(int[] start, int[] end) {
    return activitySelection(start, end).size();
}

// Activity selection with weights
public int maxWeightActivitySelection(int[] start, int[] end, int[] weight) {
    int n = start.length;
    
    // Create activities with weights
    class WeightedActivity {
        int start, end, weight, index;
        
        WeightedActivity(int start, int end, int weight, int index) {
            this.start = start;
            this.end = end;
            this.weight = weight;
            this.index = index;
        }
    }
    
    WeightedActivity[] activities = new WeightedActivity[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        activities[i] = new WeightedActivity(start[i], end[i], weight[i], i);
    }
    
    // Sort by end time
    Arrays.sort(activities, (a, b) -> a.end - b.end);
    
    // DP to find maximum weight
    int[] dp = new int[n];
    dp[0] = activities[0].weight;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int includeWeight = activities[i].weight;
        int latestNonConflicting = findLatestNonConflicting(activities, i);
        
        if (latestNonConflicting != -1) {
            includeWeight += dp[latestNonConflicting];
        }
        
        dp[i] = Math.max(dp[i - 1], includeWeight);
    }
    
    return dp[n - 1];
}

private int findLatestNonConflicting(Activity[] activities, int index) {
    for (int i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (activities[i].end <= activities[index].start) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

// Meeting rooms problem
public int minMeetingRooms(int[][] intervals) {
    if (intervals.length == 0) return 0;
    
    Arrays.sort(intervals, (a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    
    PriorityQueue<Integer> heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
    
    for (int[] interval : intervals) {
        if (!heap.isEmpty() && heap.peek() <= interval[0]) {
            heap.poll();
        }
        heap.offer(interval[1]);
    }
    
    return heap.size();
}

// Maximum meetings in one room
public int maxMeetingsInOneRoom(int[] start, int[] end) {
    return activitySelection(start, end).size();
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(n)

### 106. Fractional Knapsack
**Problem**: Maximize value in knapsack allowing fractional items  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class Item {
    int value, weight;
    double ratio;
    
    Item(int value, int weight) {
        this.value = value;
        this.weight = weight;
        this.ratio = (double) value / weight;
    }
}

public double fractionalKnapsack(int capacity, Item[] items) {
    // Sort by value-to-weight ratio in descending order
    Arrays.sort(items, (a, b) -> Double.compare(b.ratio, a.ratio));
    
    double maxValue = 0.0;
    int currentWeight = 0;
    
    for (Item item : items) {
        if (currentWeight + item.weight <= capacity) {
            // Take entire item
            currentWeight += item.weight;
            maxValue += item.value;
        } else {
            // Take fraction of item
            int remainingCapacity = capacity - currentWeight;
            maxValue += item.value * ((double) remainingCapacity / item.weight);
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return maxValue;
}

// Alternative implementation with arrays
public double fractionalKnapsackArrays(int capacity, int[] values, int[] weights) {
    int n = values.length;
    Item[] items = new Item[n];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        items[i] = new Item(values[i], weights[i]);
    }
    
    return fractionalKnapsack(capacity, items);
}

// Get the items taken in optimal solution
public List<ItemTaken> fractionalKnapsackSolution(int capacity, Item[] items) {
    Arrays.sort(items, (a, b) -> Double.compare(b.ratio, a.ratio));
    
    List<ItemTaken> solution = new ArrayList<>();
    int currentWeight = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (currentWeight + items[i].weight <= capacity) {
            solution.add(new ItemTaken(i, 1.0, items[i].value));
            currentWeight += items[i].weight;
        } else {
            double fraction = (double)(capacity - currentWeight) / items[i].weight;
            if (fraction > 0) {
                solution.add(new ItemTaken(i, fraction, items[i].value * fraction));
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return solution;
}

class ItemTaken {
    int itemIndex;
    double fractionTaken;
    double valueTaken;
    
    ItemTaken(int itemIndex, double fractionTaken, double valueTaken) {
        this.itemIndex = itemIndex;
        this.fractionTaken = fractionTaken;
        this.valueTaken = valueTaken;
    }
}

// Compare with 0/1 Knapsack for demonstration
public int zeroOneKnapsack(int capacity, int[] values, int[] weights) {
    int n = values.length;
    int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][capacity + 1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int w = 1; w <= capacity; w++) {
            if (weights[i - 1] <= w) {
                dp[i][w] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][w], 
                                   dp[i - 1][w - weights[i - 1]] + values[i - 1]);
            } else {
                dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n][capacity];
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 107. Job Scheduling Problem
**Problem**: Schedule jobs to maximize profit within deadlines  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class Job {
    char id;
    int deadline, profit;
    
    Job(char id, int deadline, int profit) {
        this.id = id;
        this.deadline = deadline;
        this.profit = profit;
    }
}

public JobResult jobScheduling(Job[] jobs) {
    // Sort jobs by profit in descending order
    Arrays.sort(jobs, (a, b) -> b.profit - a.profit);
    
    int maxDeadline = Arrays.stream(jobs).mapToInt(job -> job.deadline).max().orElse(0);
    boolean[] slot = new boolean[maxDeadline + 1];
    char[] result = new char[maxDeadline + 1];
    int totalProfit = 0;
    int jobCount = 0;
    
    for (Job job : jobs) {
        // Find a free slot for this job (starting from deadline)
        for (int j = Math.min(maxDeadline, job.deadline); j > 0; j--) {
            if (!slot[j]) {
                result[j] = job.id;
                slot[j] = true;
                totalProfit += job.profit;
                jobCount++;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    List<Character> scheduledJobs = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 1; i <= maxDeadline; i++) {
        if (slot[i]) {
            scheduledJobs.add(result[i]);
        }
    }
    
    return new JobResult(jobCount, totalProfit, scheduledJobs);
}

class JobResult {
    int jobCount;
    int totalProfit;
    List<Character> scheduledJobs;
    
    JobResult(int jobCount, int totalProfit, List<Character> scheduledJobs) {
        this.jobCount = jobCount;
        this.totalProfit = totalProfit;
        this.scheduledJobs = scheduledJobs;
    }
}

// Job scheduling with Union-Find optimization
public JobResult jobSchedulingOptimized(Job[] jobs) {
    Arrays.sort(jobs, (a, b) -> b.profit - a.profit);
    
    int maxDeadline = Arrays.stream(jobs).mapToInt(job -> job.deadline).max().orElse(0);
    
    // Union-Find to find available slots efficiently
    int[] parent = new int[maxDeadline + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxDeadline; i++) {
        parent[i] = i;
    }
    
    List<Character> scheduledJobs = new ArrayList<>();
    int totalProfit = 0;
    
    for (Job job : jobs) {
        int availableSlot = find(parent, Math.min(job.deadline, maxDeadline));
        
        if (availableSlot > 0) {
            scheduledJobs.add(job.id);
            totalProfit += job.profit;
            
            // Union this slot with the previous one
            parent[availableSlot] = availableSlot - 1;
        }
    }
    
    return new JobResult(scheduledJobs.size(), totalProfit, scheduledJobs);
}

private int find(int[] parent, int i) {
    if (parent[i] == i) {
        return i;
    }
    return parent[i] = find(parent, parent[i]);
}

// Minimum platforms needed for trains
public int findPlatform(int[] arrival, int[] departure) {
    Arrays.sort(arrival);
    Arrays.sort(departure);
    
    int platformsNeeded = 1;
    int maxPlatforms = 1;
    int i = 1, j = 0;
    
    while (i < arrival.length && j < departure.length) {
        if (arrival[i] <= departure[j]) {
            platformsNeeded++;
            i++;
        } else {
            platformsNeeded--;
            j++;
        }
        
        maxPlatforms = Math.max(maxPlatforms, platformsNeeded);
    }
    
    return maxPlatforms;
}

// Job scheduling with different machines
public int minMachinesNeeded(int[][] jobs) {
    if (jobs.length == 0) return 0;
    
    // Sort by start time
    Arrays.sort(jobs, (a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
    
    PriorityQueue<Integer> machines = new PriorityQueue<>();
    
    for (int[] job : jobs) {
        if (!machines.isEmpty() && machines.peek() <= job[0]) {
            machines.poll();
        }
        machines.offer(job[1]);
    }
    
    return machines.size();
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(n)

### 108. Minimum Spanning Tree (Greedy Approach)
**Problem**: Find MST using greedy algorithms  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
// Kruskal's Algorithm
class Edge {
    int src, dest, weight;
    
    Edge(int src, int dest, int weight) {
        this.src = src;
        this.dest = dest;
        this.weight = weight;
    }
}

class UnionFind {
    int[] parent, rank;
    
    UnionFind(int n) {
        parent = new int[n];
        rank = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            parent[i] = i;
            rank[i] = 0;
        }
    }
    
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }
    
    boolean union(int x, int y) {
        int px = find(x), py = find(y);
        if (px == py) return false;
        
        if (rank[px] < rank[py]) {
            parent[px] = py;
        } else if (rank[px] > rank[py]) {
            parent[py] = px;
        } else {
            parent[py] = px;
            rank[px]++;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

public int kruskalMST(int V, List<Edge> edges) {
    Collections.sort(edges, (a, b) -> a.weight - b.weight);
    
    UnionFind uf = new UnionFind(V);
    int totalWeight = 0;
    int edgesUsed = 0;
    
    for (Edge edge : edges) {
        if (uf.union(edge.src, edge.dest)) {
            totalWeight += edge.weight;
            edgesUsed++;
            if (edgesUsed == V - 1) break;
        }
    }
    
    return edgesUsed == V - 1 ? totalWeight : -1;
}

// Prim's Algorithm
public int primMST(int V, int[][] graph) {
    boolean[] visited = new boolean[V];
    int[] key = new int[V];
    Arrays.fill(key, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
    
    key[0] = 0;
    int totalWeight = 0;
    
    for (int count = 0; count < V; count++) {
        int u = findMinKey(key, visited, V);
        if (u == -1) return -1;
        
        visited[u] = true;
        totalWeight += key[u];
        
        for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
            if (!visited[v] && graph[u][v] != 0 && graph[u][v] < key[v]) {
                key[v] = graph[u][v];
            }
        }
    }
    
    return totalWeight;
}

private int findMinKey(int[] key, boolean[] visited, int V) {
    int min = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    int minIndex = -1;
    
    for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
        if (!visited[v] && key[v] < min) {
            min = key[v];
            minIndex = v;
        }
    }
    
    return minIndex;
}

// Get MST edges
public List<Edge> getMSTEdges(int V, List<Edge> edges) {
    Collections.sort(edges, (a, b) -> a.weight - b.weight);
    
    UnionFind uf = new UnionFind(V);
    List<Edge> mstEdges = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (Edge edge : edges) {
        if (uf.union(edge.src, edge.dest)) {
            mstEdges.add(edge);
            if (mstEdges.size() == V - 1) break;
        }
    }
    
    return mstEdges;
}
```
**Time**: O(E log E) for Kruskal's, O(V²) for Prim's, **Space**: O(V)

### 109. Huffman Coding
**Problem**: Generate optimal prefix codes for characters  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class HuffmanNode {
    int frequency;
    char character;
    HuffmanNode left, right;
    
    HuffmanNode(char character, int frequency) {
        this.character = character;
        this.frequency = frequency;
    }
    
    HuffmanNode(int frequency) {
        this.frequency = frequency;
        this.character = '\0';
    }
}

public Map<Character, String> huffmanCoding(Map<Character, Integer> frequencies) {
    PriorityQueue<HuffmanNode> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a.frequency - b.frequency);
    
    // Create leaf nodes
    for (Map.Entry<Character, Integer> entry : frequencies.entrySet()) {
        pq.offer(new HuffmanNode(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()));
    }
    
    // Build Huffman tree
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        HuffmanNode left = pq.poll();
        HuffmanNode right = pq.poll();
        
        HuffmanNode merged = new HuffmanNode(left.frequency + right.frequency);
        merged.left = left;
        merged.right = right;
        
        pq.offer(merged);
    }
    
    HuffmanNode root = pq.poll();
    Map<Character, String> codes = new HashMap<>();
    
    if (root.left == null && root.right == null) {
        codes.put(root.character, "0");
    } else {
        generateCodes(root, "", codes);
    }
    
    return codes;
}

private void generateCodes(HuffmanNode node, String code, Map<Character, String> codes) {
    if (node == null) return;
    
    if (node.left == null && node.right == null) {
        codes.put(node.character, code);
        return;
    }
    
    generateCodes(node.left, code + "0", codes);
    generateCodes(node.right, code + "1", codes);
}

// Encode and decode text
public String encode(String text, Map<Character, String> codes) {
    StringBuilder encoded = new StringBuilder();
    for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
        encoded.append(codes.get(c));
    }
    return encoded.toString();
}

public String decode(String encodedText, HuffmanNode root) {
    StringBuilder decoded = new StringBuilder();
    HuffmanNode current = root;
    
    for (char bit : encodedText.toCharArray()) {
        current = (bit == '0') ? current.left : current.right;
        
        if (current.left == null && current.right == null) {
            decoded.append(current.character);
            current = root;
        }
    }
    
    return decoded.toString();
}

public Map<Character, Integer> getFrequencies(String text) {
    Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
    for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
        frequencies.put(c, frequencies.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
    }
    return frequencies;
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(n)

### 110. Coin Change (Greedy)
**Problem**: Make change using minimum number of coins  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public int coinChangeGreedy(int[] coins, int amount) {
    Arrays.sort(coins);
    int coinCount = 0;
    
    for (int i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0 && amount > 0; i--) {
        int count = amount / coins[i];
        coinCount += count;
        amount -= count * coins[i];
    }
    
    return amount == 0 ? coinCount : -1;
}

public List<Integer> coinChangeGreedyCoins(int[] coins, int amount) {
    Arrays.sort(coins);
    List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0 && amount > 0; i--) {
        int count = amount / coins[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
            result.add(coins[i]);
        }
        amount -= count * coins[i];
    }
    
    return amount == 0 ? result : new ArrayList<>();
}

// Check if coin system is canonical
public boolean isCanonicalCoinSystem(int[] coins) {
    Arrays.sort(coins);
    
    for (int amount = 1; amount <= coins[coins.length - 1] * 2; amount++) {
        int greedyResult = coinChangeGreedy(coins, amount);
        int optimalResult = coinChangeDP(coins, amount);
        
        if (greedyResult != optimalResult) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

private int coinChangeDP(int[] coins, int amount) {
    int[] dp = new int[amount + 1];
    Arrays.fill(dp, amount + 1);
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= amount; i++) {
        for (int coin : coins) {
            if (i >= coin) {
                dp[i] = Math.min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[amount] > amount ? -1 : dp[amount];
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(1) for greedy approach

### 111. Gas Station Problem
**Problem**: Find starting gas station to complete circular tour  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int canCompleteCircuit(int[] gas, int[] cost) {
    int totalGas = 0;
    int totalCost = 0;
    int currentGas = 0;
    int startIndex = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < gas.length; i++) {
        totalGas += gas[i];
        totalCost += cost[i];
        currentGas += gas[i] - cost[i];
        
        if (currentGas < 0) {
            startIndex = i + 1;
            currentGas = 0;
        }
    }
    
    return totalGas >= totalCost ? startIndex : -1;
}

public List<Integer> findAllStartingPoints(int[] gas, int[] cost) {
    List<Integer> validStarts = new ArrayList<>();
    int n = gas.length;
    
    for (int start = 0; start < n; start++) {
        if (canStartFromIndex(gas, cost, start)) {
            validStarts.add(start);
        }
    }
    
    return validStarts;
}

private boolean canStartFromIndex(int[] gas, int[] cost, int start) {
    int n = gas.length;
    int currentGas = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int index = (start + i) % n;
        currentGas += gas[index] - cost[index];
        
        if (currentGas < 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(1)

### 112. Two City Scheduling
**Problem**: Minimize cost to send people to two cities  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int twoCitySchedCost(int[][] costs) {
    Arrays.sort(costs, (a, b) -> (a[0] - a[1]) - (b[0] - b[1]));
    
    int totalCost = 0;
    int n = costs.length / 2;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        totalCost += costs[i][0]; // City A
    }
    
    for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        totalCost += costs[i][1]; // City B
    }
    
    return totalCost;
}

public class TwoCityResult {
    int totalCost;
    List<Integer> cityA;
    List<Integer> cityB;
    
    TwoCityResult(int totalCost, List<Integer> cityA, List<Integer> cityB) {
        this.totalCost = totalCost;
        this.cityA = cityA;
        this.cityB = cityB;
    }
}

public TwoCityResult twoCitySchedDetails(int[][] costs) {
    int n = costs.length / 2;
    Integer[] indices = new Integer[costs.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < costs.length; i++) {
        indices[i] = i;
    }
    
    Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> (costs[a][0] - costs[a][1]) - (costs[b][0] - costs[b][1]));
    
    List<Integer> cityA = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> cityB = new ArrayList<>();
    int totalCost = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cityA.add(indices[i]);
        totalCost += costs[indices[i]][0];
    }
    
    for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        cityB.add(indices[i]);
        totalCost += costs[indices[i]][1];
    }
    
    return new TwoCityResult(totalCost, cityA, cityB);
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 113. Minimum Number of Arrows
**Problem**: Minimum arrows to burst all balloons  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public int findMinArrowShots(int[][] points) {
    if (points.length == 0) return 0;
    
    Arrays.sort(points, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(a[1], b[1]));
    
    int arrows = 1;
    int end = points[0][1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
        if (points[i][0] > end) {
            arrows++;
            end = points[i][1];
        }
    }
    
    return arrows;
}

public List<Integer> findArrowPositions(int[][] points) {
    if (points.length == 0) return new ArrayList<>();
    
    Arrays.sort(points, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(a[1], b[1]));
    
    List<Integer> arrows = new ArrayList<>();
    int end = points[0][1];
    arrows.add(end);
    
    for (int i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
        if (points[i][0] > end) {
            end = points[i][1];
            arrows.add(end);
        }
    }
    
    return arrows;
}

// Remove minimum intervals to make non-overlapping
public int eraseOverlapIntervals(int[][] intervals) {
    if (intervals.length <= 1) return 0;
    
    Arrays.sort(intervals, (a, b) -> a[1] - b[1]);
    
    int count = 0;
    int end = intervals[0][1];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < intervals.length; i++) {
        if (intervals[i][0] < end) {
            count++;
        } else {
            end = intervals[i][1];
        }
    }
    
    return count;
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 114. Assign Cookies
**Problem**: Maximize number of content children  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public int findContentChildren(int[] greed, int[] cookies) {
    Arrays.sort(greed);
    Arrays.sort(cookies);
    
    int child = 0;
    int cookie = 0;
    
    while (child < greed.length && cookie < cookies.length) {
        if (cookies[cookie] >= greed[child]) {
            child++;
        }
        cookie++;
    }
    
    return child;
}

public List<Integer> getContentChildren(int[] greed, int[] cookies) {
    Integer[] greedIndices = new Integer[greed.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < greed.length; i++) {
        greedIndices[i] = i;
    }
    
    Arrays.sort(greedIndices, (a, b) -> greed[a] - greed[b]);
    Arrays.sort(cookies);
    
    List<Integer> contentChildren = new ArrayList<>();
    int cookie = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < greedIndices.length && cookie < cookies.length; i++) {
        int childIndex = greedIndices[i];
        
        if (cookies[cookie] >= greed[childIndex]) {
            contentChildren.add(childIndex);
            cookie++;
        }
    }
    
    return contentChildren;
}

// With priority consideration
public int findContentChildrenWithPriority(int[] greed, int[] cookies, int[] priority) {
    Integer[] indices = new Integer[greed.length];
    for (int i = 0; i < greed.length; i++) {
        indices[i] = i;
    }
    
    Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> {
        if (priority[a] != priority[b]) {
            return priority[b] - priority[a];
        }
        return greed[a] - greed[b];
    });
    
    Arrays.sort(cookies);
    boolean[] used = new boolean[cookies.length];
    int contentChildren = 0;
    
    for (int childIndex : indices) {
        for (int j = 0; j < cookies.length; j++) {
            if (!used[j] && cookies[j] >= greed[childIndex]) {
                used[j] = true;
                contentChildren++;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return contentChildren;
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n), **Space**: O(1)

### 115. Jump Game
**Problem**: Determine if you can reach the last index  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public boolean canJump(int[] nums) {
    int maxReach = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        if (i > maxReach) {
            return false;
        }
        
        maxReach = Math.max(maxReach, i + nums[i]);
        
        if (maxReach >= nums.length - 1) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    return true;
}

// Jump Game II - minimum jumps to reach end
public int jump(int[] nums) {
    int jumps = 0;
    int currentEnd = 0;
    int farthest = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.length - 1; i++) {
        farthest = Math.max(farthest, i + nums[i]);
        
        if (i == currentEnd) {
            jumps++;
            currentEnd = farthest;
        }
    }
    
    return jumps;
}

// Get the actual jump path
public List<Integer> getJumpPath(int[] nums) {
    if (nums.length <= 1) return Arrays.asList(0);
    
    int[] parent = new int[nums.length];
    Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
    
    Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
    boolean[] visited = new boolean[nums.length];
    
    queue.offer(0);
    visited[0] = true;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int current = queue.poll();
        
        if (current == nums.length - 1) {
            return reconstructPath(parent, current);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= nums[current] && current + i < nums.length; i++) {
            int next = current + i;
            if (!visited[next]) {
                visited[next] = true;
                parent[next] = current;
                queue.offer(next);
            }
        }
    }
    
    return new ArrayList<>();
}

private List<Integer> reconstructPath(int[] parent, int end) {
    List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = end; i != -1; i = parent[i]) {
        path.add(i);
    }
    Collections.reverse(path);
    return path;
}

// Maximum reach from any position
public int maxReachFromPosition(int[] nums, int start) {
    if (start >= nums.length) return -1;
    
    int maxReach = start;
    
    for (int i = start; i <= maxReach && i < nums.length; i++) {
        maxReach = Math.max(maxReach, i + nums[i]);
    }
    
    return maxReach;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(1)

### 116. Candy Distribution
**Problem**: Distribute minimum candies to children with ratings  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public int candy(int[] ratings) {
    int n = ratings.length;
    int[] candies = new int[n];
    Arrays.fill(candies, 1);
    
    // Left to right pass
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (ratings[i] > ratings[i - 1]) {
            candies[i] = candies[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Right to left pass
    for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (ratings[i] > ratings[i + 1]) {
            candies[i] = Math.max(candies[i], candies[i + 1] + 1);
        }
    }
    
    return Arrays.stream(candies).sum();
}

// Space optimized approach
public int candyOptimized(int[] ratings) {
    if (ratings.length <= 1) return ratings.length;
    
    int totalCandies = 1;
    int up = 0, down = 0, peak = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < ratings.length; i++) {
        if (ratings[i - 1] < ratings[i]) {
            up++;
            down = 0;
            peak = up;
            totalCandies += 1 + up;
        } else if (ratings[i - 1] > ratings[i]) {
            up = 0;
            down++;
            totalCandies += 1 + down + (down > peak ? 1 : 0);
        } else {
            up = down = peak = 0;
            totalCandies += 1;
        }
    }
    
    return totalCandies;
}

// Get actual candy distribution
public int[] getCandyDistribution(int[] ratings) {
    int n = ratings.length;
    int[] candies = new int[n];
    Arrays.fill(candies, 1);
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (ratings[i] > ratings[i - 1]) {
            candies[i] = candies[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (ratings[i] > ratings[i + 1]) {
            candies[i] = Math.max(candies[i], candies[i + 1] + 1);
        }
    }
    
    return candies;
}

// Minimum candies with constraints
public int candyWithConstraints(int[] ratings, int minCandies, int maxCandies) {
    int[] baseCandies = getCandyDistribution(ratings);
    int totalCandies = 0;
    
    for (int candy : baseCandies) {
        totalCandies += Math.max(minCandies, Math.min(maxCandies, candy));
    }
    
    return totalCandies;
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(n)

### 117. Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
**Problem**: Design and implement a trie data structure  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class TrieNode {
    TrieNode[] children;
    boolean isEndOfWord;
    
    public TrieNode() {
        children = new TrieNode[26];
        isEndOfWord = false;
    }
}

class Trie {
    private TrieNode root;
    
    public Trie() {
        root = new TrieNode();
    }
    
    public void insert(String word) {
        TrieNode current = root;
        
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                current.children[index] = new TrieNode();
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        
        current.isEndOfWord = true;
    }
    
    public boolean search(String word) {
        TrieNode current = root;
        
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                return false;
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        
        return current.isEndOfWord;
    }
    
    public boolean startsWith(String prefix) {
        TrieNode current = root;
        
        for (char c : prefix.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                return false;
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    // Get all words with given prefix
    public List<String> getWordsWithPrefix(String prefix) {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
        TrieNode current = root;
        
        for (char c : prefix.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                return result;
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        
        dfs(current, prefix, result);
        return result;
    }
    
    private void dfs(TrieNode node, String prefix, List<String> result) {
        if (node.isEndOfWord) {
            result.add(prefix);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            if (node.children[i] != null) {
                dfs(node.children[i], prefix + (char)('a' + i), result);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public boolean delete(String word) {
        return deleteHelper(root, word, 0);
    }
    
    private boolean deleteHelper(TrieNode node, String word, int index) {
        if (index == word.length()) {
            if (!node.isEndOfWord) {
                return false;
            }
            node.isEndOfWord = false;
            return !hasChildren(node);
        }
        
        int charIndex = word.charAt(index) - 'a';
        TrieNode child = node.children[charIndex];
        
        if (child == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        boolean shouldDeleteChild = deleteHelper(child, word, index + 1);
        
        if (shouldDeleteChild) {
            node.children[charIndex] = null;
            return !node.isEndOfWord && !hasChildren(node);
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private boolean hasChildren(TrieNode node) {
        for (TrieNode child : node.children) {
            if (child != null) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(m) for insert/search/delete, **Space**: O(ALPHABET_SIZE * N * M)

### 118. Maximum XOR of Two Numbers
**Problem**: Find maximum XOR of any two numbers in array using Trie  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class TrieNodeXOR {
    TrieNodeXOR[] children = new TrieNodeXOR[2];
}

public int findMaximumXOR(int[] nums) {
    TrieNodeXOR root = new TrieNodeXOR();
    
    // Insert all numbers into trie
    for (int num : nums) {
        insertNumber(root, num);
    }
    
    int maxXOR = 0;
    
    // For each number, find maximum XOR
    for (int num : nums) {
        maxXOR = Math.max(maxXOR, findMaxXOR(root, num));
    }
    
    return maxXOR;
}

private void insertNumber(TrieNodeXOR root, int num) {
    TrieNodeXOR current = root;
    
    for (int i = 31; i >= 0; i--) {
        int bit = (num >> i) & 1;
        if (current.children[bit] == null) {
            current.children[bit] = new TrieNodeXOR();
        }
        current = current.children[bit];
    }
}

private int findMaxXOR(TrieNodeXOR root, int num) {
    TrieNodeXOR current = root;
    int maxXOR = 0;
    
    for (int i = 31; i >= 0; i--) {
        int bit = (num >> i) & 1;
        int oppositeBit = 1 - bit;
        
        if (current.children[oppositeBit] != null) {
            maxXOR |= (1 << i);
            current = current.children[oppositeBit];
        } else {
            current = current.children[bit];
        }
    }
    
    return maxXOR;
}

// Maximum XOR with queries
public int[] maximizeXor(int[] nums, int[][] queries) {
    Arrays.sort(nums);
    int n = queries.length;
    int[] result = new int[n];
    
    // Sort queries by limit
    Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        indices[i] = i;
    }
    Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> queries[a][1] - queries[b][1]);
    
    TrieNodeXOR root = new TrieNodeXOR();
    int numIndex = 0;
    
    for (int i : indices) {
        int x = queries[i][0];
        int limit = queries[i][1];
        
        // Insert all numbers <= limit
        while (numIndex < nums.length && nums[numIndex] <= limit) {
            insertNumber(root, nums[numIndex]);
            numIndex++;
        }
        
        result[i] = (numIndex == 0) ? -1 : findMaxXOR(root, x);
    }
    
    return result;
}
```
**Time**: O(n * log(max_value)), **Space**: O(n * log(max_value))

### 119. Word Search II
**Problem**: Find all words in board using Trie  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public List<String> findWords(char[][] board, String[] words) {
    TrieNode root = buildTrie(words);
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) {
            dfs(board, i, j, root, result);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private TrieNode buildTrie(String[] words) {
    TrieNode root = new TrieNode();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        TrieNode current = root;
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                current.children[index] = new TrieNode();
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        current.word = word;
    }
    
    return root;
}

private void dfs(char[][] board, int i, int j, TrieNode node, List<String> result) {
    if (i < 0 || i >= board.length || j < 0 || j >= board[0].length) {
        return;
    }
    
    char c = board[i][j];
    if (c == '#' || node.children[c - 'a'] == null) {
        return;
    }
    
    node = node.children[c - 'a'];
    
    if (node.word != null) {
        result.add(node.word);
        node.word = null; // Avoid duplicates
    }
    
    board[i][j] = '#'; // Mark as visited
    
    dfs(board, i + 1, j, node, result);
    dfs(board, i - 1, j, node, result);
    dfs(board, i, j + 1, node, result);
    dfs(board, i, j - 1, node, result);
    
    board[i][j] = c; // Restore
}

class TrieNodeWord {
    TrieNodeWord[] children = new TrieNodeWord[26];
    String word = null;
}

// Optimized version with pruning
public List<String> findWordsOptimized(char[][] board, String[] words) {
    TrieNodeWord root = buildTrieOptimized(words);
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < board.length; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[0].length; j++) {
            dfsOptimized(board, i, j, root, result);
        }
    }
    
    return result;
}

private TrieNodeWord buildTrieOptimized(String[] words) {
    TrieNodeWord root = new TrieNodeWord();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        TrieNodeWord current = root;
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                current.children[index] = new TrieNodeWord();
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        current.word = word;
    }
    
    return root;
}

private void dfsOptimized(char[][] board, int i, int j, TrieNodeWord node, List<String> result) {
    if (i < 0 || i >= board.length || j < 0 || j >= board[0].length) {
        return;
    }
    
    char c = board[i][j];
    if (c == '#' || node.children[c - 'a'] == null) {
        return;
    }
    
    node = node.children[c - 'a'];
    
    if (node.word != null) {
        result.add(node.word);
        node.word = null; // Remove to avoid duplicates
    }
    
    board[i][j] = '#';
    
    dfsOptimized(board, i + 1, j, node, result);
    dfsOptimized(board, i - 1, j, node, result);
    dfsOptimized(board, i, j + 1, node, result);
    dfsOptimized(board, i, j - 1, node, result);
    
    board[i][j] = c;
    
    // Prune the trie if no more words can be formed
    if (allChildrenNull(node)) {
        node = null;
    }
}

private boolean allChildrenNull(TrieNodeWord node) {
    for (TrieNodeWord child : node.children) {
        if (child != null) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```
**Time**: O(M * N * 4^L), **Space**: O(W * L)

### 120. Replace Words
**Problem**: Replace words with their roots using Trie  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public String replaceWords(List<String> dictionary, String sentence) {
    TrieNode root = new TrieNode();
    
    // Build trie with dictionary roots
    for (String root_word : dictionary) {
        insertRoot(root, root_word);
    }
    
    String[] words = sentence.split(" ");
    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
        if (i > 0) result.append(" ");
        result.append(findRoot(root, words[i]));
    }
    
    return result.toString();
}

private void insertRoot(TrieNode root, String word) {
    TrieNode current = root;
    
    for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
        int index = c - 'a';
        if (current.children[index] == null) {
            current.children[index] = new TrieNode();
        }
        current = current.children[index];
    }
    
    current.isEndOfWord = true;
}

private String findRoot(TrieNode root, String word) {
    TrieNode current = root;
    StringBuilder prefix = new StringBuilder();
    
    for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
        int index = c - 'a';
        if (current.children[index] == null) {
            break;
        }
        
        prefix.append(c);
        current = current.children[index];
        
        if (current.isEndOfWord) {
            return prefix.toString();
        }
    }
    
    return word; // Return original word if no root found
}

// Multiple dictionaries with priority
public String replaceWordsWithPriority(List<List<String>> dictionaries, String sentence) {
    TrieNodeWithPriority root = new TrieNodeWithPriority();
    
    // Build trie with priorities
    for (int priority = 0; priority < dictionaries.size(); priority++) {
        for (String word : dictionaries.get(priority)) {
            insertWithPriority(root, word, priority);
        }
    }
    
    String[] words = sentence.split(" ");
    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
    
    for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
        if (i > 0) result.append(" ");
        result.append(findRootWithPriority(root, words[i]));
    }
    
    return result.toString();
}

class TrieNodeWithPriority {
    TrieNodeWithPriority[] children = new TrieNodeWithPriority[26];
    boolean isEndOfWord = false;
    int priority = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
}

private void insertWithPriority(TrieNodeWithPriority root, String word, int priority) {
    TrieNodeWithPriority current = root;
    
    for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
        int index = c - 'a';
        if (current.children[index] == null) {
            current.children[index] = new TrieNodeWithPriority();
        }
        current = current.children[index];
    }
    
    current.isEndOfWord = true;
    current.priority = Math.min(current.priority, priority);
}

private String findRootWithPriority(TrieNodeWithPriority root, String word) {
    TrieNodeWithPriority current = root;
    StringBuilder prefix = new StringBuilder();
    String bestRoot = word;
    int bestPriority = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    
    for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
        int index = c - 'a';
        if (current.children[index] == null) {
            break;
        }
        
        prefix.append(c);
        current = current.children[index];
        
        if (current.isEndOfWord && current.priority < bestPriority) {
            bestRoot = prefix.toString();
            bestPriority = current.priority;
        }
    }
    
    return bestRoot;
}
```
**Time**: O(N + M), **Space**: O(TRIE)

### 121. Design Add and Search Words Data Structure
**Problem**: Support adding words and searching with wildcards  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
class WordDictionary {
    private TrieNode root;
    
    public WordDictionary() {
        root = new TrieNode();
    }
    
    public void addWord(String word) {
        TrieNode current = root;
        
        for (char c : word.toCharArray()) {
            int index = c - 'a';
            if (current.children[index] == null) {
                current.children[index] = new TrieNode();
            }
            current = current.children[index];
        }
        
        current.isEndOfWord = true;
    }
    
    public boolean search(String word) {
        return searchHelper(word, 0, root);
    }
    
    private boolean searchHelper(String word, int index, TrieNode node) {
        if (index == word.length()) {
            return node.isEndOfWord;
        }
        
        char c = word.charAt(index);
        
        if (c == '.') {
            // Wildcard - try all possible children
            for (TrieNode child : node.children) {
                if (child != null && searchHelper(word, index + 1, child)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        } else {
            // Regular character
            int charIndex = c - 'a';
            if (node.children[charIndex] == null) {
                return false;
            }
            return searchHelper(word, index + 1, node.children[charIndex]);
        }
    }
    
    // Search with multiple wildcards
    public List<String> searchPattern(String pattern) {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
        searchPatternHelper(pattern, 0, root, new StringBuilder(), result);
        return result;
    }
    
    private void searchPatternHelper(String pattern, int index, TrieNode node, 
                                   StringBuilder current, List<String> result) {
        if (index == pattern.length()) {
            if (node.isEndOfWord) {
                result.add(current.toString());
            }
            return;
        }
        
        char c = pattern.charAt(index);
        
        if (c == '.') {
            for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
                if (node.children[i] != null) {
                    current.append((char)('a' + i));
                    searchPatternHelper(pattern, index + 1, node.children[i], current, result);
                    current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1);
                }
            }
        } else {
            int charIndex = c - 'a';
            if (node.children[charIndex] != null) {
                current.append(c);
                searchPatternHelper(pattern, index + 1, node.children[charIndex], current, result);
                current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Count words matching pattern
    public int countMatches(String pattern) {
        return countMatchesHelper(pattern, 0, root);
    }
    
    private int countMatchesHelper(String pattern, int index, TrieNode node) {
        if (index == pattern.length()) {
            return node.isEndOfWord ? 1 : 0;
        }
        
        char c = pattern.charAt(index);
        int count = 0;
        
        if (c == '.') {
            for (TrieNode child : node.children) {
                if (child != null) {
                    count += countMatchesHelper(pattern, index + 1, child);
                }
            }
        } else {
            int charIndex = c - 'a';
            if (node.children[charIndex] != null) {
                count = countMatchesHelper(pattern, index + 1, node.children[charIndex]);
            }
        }
        
        return count;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(M) for add, O(M * 26^K) for search with K wildcards, **Space**: O(TRIE)

### 122. Longest Word in Dictionary
**Problem**: Find longest word that can be built letter by letter  
**Difficulty**: Easy

```java
public String longestWord(String[] words) {
    Trie trie = new Trie();
    
    // Insert all words
    for (String word : words) {
        trie.insert(word);
    }
    
    String longestWord = "";
    
    // Check each word if it can be built
    for (String word : words) {
        if (canBeBuild(trie, word) && 
            (word.length() > longestWord.length() || 
             (word.length() == longestWord.length() && word.compareTo(longestWord) < 0))) {
            longestWord = word;
        }
    }
    
    return longestWord;
}

private boolean canBeBuild(Trie trie, String word) {
    for (int i = 1; i <= word.length(); i++) {
        if (!trie.search(word.substring(0, i))) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// DFS approach for finding all buildable words
public String longestWordDFS(String[] words) {
    Trie trie = new Trie();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        trie.insert(word);
    }
    
    return dfsFindLongest(trie.root, "");
}

private String dfsFindLongest(TrieNode node, String currentWord) {
    String longestWord = currentWord;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (node.children[i] != null && node.children[i].isEndOfWord) {
            String candidate = dfsFindLongest(node.children[i], 
                                            currentWord + (char)('a' + i));
            
            if (candidate.length() > longestWord.length() || 
                (candidate.length() == longestWord.length() && 
                 candidate.compareTo(longestWord) < 0)) {
                longestWord = candidate;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return longestWord;
}

// Get all longest words
public List<String> allLongestWords(String[] words) {
    Trie trie = new Trie();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        trie.insert(word);
    }
    
    List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
    int maxLength = 0;
    
    for (String word : words) {
        if (canBeBuild(trie, word)) {
            if (word.length() > maxLength) {
                result.clear();
                result.add(word);
                maxLength = word.length();
            } else if (word.length() == maxLength) {
                result.add(word);
            }
        }
    }
    
    Collections.sort(result);
    return result;
}

// Count buildable words
public int countBuildableWords(String[] words) {
    Trie trie = new Trie();
    
    for (String word : words) {
        trie.insert(word);
    }
    
    int count = 0;
    for (String word : words) {
        if (canBeBuild(trie, word)) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    return count;
}
```
**Time**: O(N * M), **Space**: O(ALPHABET_SIZE * N * M)
