```java
                if (solution == null) return null;
                
                remainders[i] = solution[0];
                moduli[i] = m[i] / gcd(a[i], m[i]);
            }
            
            long result = solveCRT(remainders, moduli);
            return result == -1 ? null : new long[]{result};
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log(max moduli)), **Space**: O(1)

### 139. Pollard's Rho Algorithm
**Problem**: Integer factorization  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class PollardsRho {
    
    public static long findFactor(long n) {
        if (n % 2 == 0) return 2;
        if (isPrime(n)) return n;
        
        long x = 2;
        long y = 2;
        long c = 1;
        long d = 1;
        
        // Function f(x) = x^2 + c mod n
        while (d == 1) {
            x = f(x, c, n);
            y = f(f(y, c, n), c, n);
            d = gcd(Math.abs(x - y), n);
            
            if (d == n) {
                // Try different c value
                c++;
                x = 2;
                y = 2;
                d = 1;
            }
        }
        
        return d;
    }
    
    private static long f(long x, long c, long n) {
        return ((x * x) % n + c) % n;
    }
    
    // Optimized Brent's improvement
    public static long brentFindFactor(long n) {
        if (n % 2 == 0) return 2;
        if (isPrime(n)) return n;
        
        long y = 1;
        long c = 1;
        long m = 1;
        long g = 1;
        long r = 1;
        long q = 1;
        
        while (g == 1) {
            long x = y;
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                y = f(y, c, n);
            }
            
            long k = 0;
            while (k < r && g == 1) {
                long ys = y;
                for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(m, r - k); i++) {
                    y = f(y, c, n);
                    q = (q * Math.abs(x - y)) % n;
                }
                
                g = gcd(q, n);
                k += m;
            }
            
            r *= 2;
            
            if (g == n) {
                // Backtrack
                do {
                    y = f(y, c, n);
                    g = gcd(Math.abs(x - y), n);
                } while (g == 1);
            }
            
            if (g == n) {
                c++;
                y = 1;
                r = 1;
                g = 1;
                q = 1;
            }
        }
        
        return g;
    }
    
    // Complete factorization
    public static List<Long> factorize(long n) {
        List<Long> factors = new ArrayList<>();
        factorizeHelper(n, factors);
        Collections.sort(factors);
        return factors;
    }
    
    private static void factorizeHelper(long n, List<Long> factors) {
        if (n == 1) return;
        
        if (isPrime(n)) {
            factors.add(n);
            return;
        }
        
        long factor = brentFindFactor(n);
        factorizeHelper(factor, factors);
        factorizeHelper(n / factor, factors);
    }
    
    // Count distinct prime factors
    public static int countDistinctPrimeFactors(long n) {
        Set<Long> primeFactors = new HashSet<>();
        countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n, primeFactors);
        return primeFactors.size();
    }
    
    private static void countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(long n, Set<Long> primeFactors) {
        if (n == 1) return;
        
        if (isPrime(n)) {
            primeFactors.add(n);
            return;
        }
        
        long factor = brentFindFactor(n);
        countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(factor, primeFactors);
        countDistinctPrimeFactorsHelper(n / factor, primeFactors);
    }
    
    // Prime factorization with powers
    public static Map<Long, Integer> primeFactorization(long n) {
        Map<Long, Integer> factorization = new HashMap<>();
        primeFactorizationHelper(n, factorization);
        return factorization;
    }
    
    private static void primeFactorizationHelper(long n, Map<Long, Integer> factorization) {
        if (n == 1) return;
        
        if (isPrime(n)) {
            factorization.put(n, factorization.getOrDefault(n, 0) + 1);
            return;
        }
        
        long factor = brentFindFactor(n);
        primeFactorizationHelper(factor, factorization);
        primeFactorizationHelper(n / factor, factorization);
    }
    
    // Applications
    public static class NumberTheoryApplications {
        
        // Euler's totient function φ(n)
        public static long eulerTotient(long n) {
            Map<Long, Integer> factors = primeFactorization(n);
            long result = n;
            
            for (long p : factors.keySet()) {
                result = result / p * (p - 1);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Number of divisors
        public static long countDivisors(long n) {
            Map<Long, Integer> factors = primeFactorization(n);
            long count = 1;
            
            for (int exponent : factors.values()) {
                count *= (exponent + 1);
            }
            
            return count;
        }
        
        // Sum of divisors
        public static long sumOfDivisors(long n) {
            Map<Long, Integer> factors = primeFactorization(n);
            long sum = 1;
            
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> entry : factors.entrySet()) {
                long p = entry.getKey();
                int exp = entry.getValue();
                
                long termSum = 0;
                long power = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i <= exp; i++) {
                    termSum += power;
                    power *= p;
                }
                
                sum *= termSum;
            }
            
            return sum;
        }
        
        // Check if number is perfect
        public static boolean isPerfectNumber(long n) {
            return sumOfDivisors(n) - n == n;
        }
        
        // Check if numbers are coprime
        public static boolean areCoprime(long a, long b) {
            return gcd(a, b) == 1;
        }
        
        // Carmichael function λ(n)
        public static long carmichaelFunction(long n) {
            Map<Long, Integer> factors = primeFactorization(n);
            long result = 1;
            
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> entry : factors.entrySet()) {
                long p = entry.getKey();
                int exp = entry.getValue();
                
                if (p == 2 && exp >= 3) {
                    result = lcm(result, (long) Math.pow(2, exp - 2));
                } else {
                    result = lcm(result, (long) (Math.pow(p, exp - 1) * (p - 1)));
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    private static boolean isPrime(long n) {
        if (n < 2) return false;
        if (n == 2 || n == 3) return true;
        if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false;
        
        for (long i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
            if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
    
    private static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n^(1/4)), **Space**: O(log n)

### 140. Manacher's Algorithm
**Problem**: Find all palindromic substrings in linear time  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class ManachersAlgorithm {
    
    public static int[] manacher(String s) {
        String processed = preprocess(s);
        int n = processed.length();
        int[] P = new int[n];
        int center = 0;
        int right = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int mirror = 2 * center - i;
            
            if (i < right) {
                P[i] = Math.min(right - i, P[mirror]);
            }
            
            // Try to expand palindrome centered at i
            try {
                while (processed.charAt(i + P[i] + 1) == processed.charAt(i - P[i] - 1)) {
                    P[i]++;
                }
            } catch (StringIndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
                // Boundary reached
            }
            
            // If palindrome centered at i extends past right, adjust center and right
            if (i + P[i] > right) {
                center = i;
                right = i + P[i];
            }
        }
        
        return P;
    }
    
    private static String preprocess(String s) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append('^');
        
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            sb.append('#').append(c);
        }
        
        sb.append('#').append('$');
        return sb.toString();
    }
    
    // Find longest palindromic substring
    public static String longestPalindrome(String s) {
        if (s == null || s.length() == 0) return "";
        
        int[] P = manacher(s);
        int maxLen = 0;
        int centerIndex = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
            if (P[i] > maxLen) {
                maxLen = P[i];
                centerIndex = i;
            }
        }
        
        int start = (centerIndex - maxLen) / 2;
        return s.substring(start, start + maxLen);
    }
    
    // Count all palindromic substrings
    public static int countPalindromes(String s) {
        int[] P = manacher(s);
        int count = 0;
        
        for (int radius : P) {
            count += (radius + 1) / 2;
        }
        
        return count;
    }
    
    // Find all unique palindromic substrings
    public static Set<String> getAllPalindromes(String s) {
        Set<String> palindromes = new HashSet<>();
        int[] P = manacher(s);
        String processed = preprocess(s);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
            for (int len = 1; len <= P[i]; len++) {
                if (processed.charAt(i - len) != '#' && processed.charAt(i + len) != '#') {
                    int start = (i - len) / 2;
                    int end = (i + len) / 2;
                    palindromes.add(s.substring(start, end + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        
        return palindromes;
    }
    
    // Check if substring is palindrome in O(1) after preprocessing
    public static class PalindromeChecker {
        private int[] P;
        private String original;
        
        public PalindromeChecker(String s) {
            this.original = s;
            this.P = manacher(s);
        }
        
        public boolean isPalindrome(int start, int end) {
            if (start < 0 || end >= original.length() || start > end) {
                return false;
            }
            
            int len = end - start + 1;
            int center = 2 * start + len;
            
            return P[center] >= len;
        }
        
        public int getLongestPalindromeAt(int center) {
            if (center < 0 || center >= original.length()) return 0;
            
            int processedCenter = 2 * center + 1;
            return P[processedCenter];
        }
    }
    
    // Applications
    public static class PalindromeApplications {
        
        // Minimum insertions to make string palindrome
        public static int minInsertionsToMakePalindrome(String s) {
            int n = s.length();
            String rev = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
            
            // Find LCS of s and reverse of s
            int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (s.charAt(i - 1) == rev.charAt(j - 1)) {
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
                    } else {
                        dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return n - dp[n][n];
        }
        
        // Partition string into minimum palindromes
        public static int minPalindromePartitions(String s) {
            int n = s.length();
            PalindromeChecker checker = new PalindromeChecker(s);
            
            int[] dp = new int[n + 1];
            Arrays.fill(dp, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dp[0] = 0;
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                    if (checker.isPalindrome(j, i - 1)) {
                        dp[i] = Math.min(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp[n];
        }
        
        // Find palindromic subsequence of maximum length
        public static int longestPalindromicSubsequence(String s) {
            int n = s.length();
            int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
            
            // Single characters are palindromes
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                dp[i][i] = 1;
            }
            
            // Check for palindromes of length 2 and more
            for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
                    int j = i + len - 1;
                    
                    if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 2;
                    } else {
                        dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp[0][n - 1];
        }
        
        // Check if string can be rearranged to form palindrome
        public static boolean canFormPalindrome(String s) {
            Map<Character, Integer> charCount = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
                charCount.put(c, charCount.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            int oddCount = 0;
            for (int count : charCount.values()) {
                if (count % 2 == 1) {
                    oddCount++;
                }
            }
            
            return oddCount <= 1;
        }
        
        // Generate palindrome by adding minimum characters at beginning
        public static String makeMinimalPalindrome(String s) {
            String rev = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
            String combined = s + "#" + rev;
            
            int[] lps = computeLPS(combined);
            int overlap = lps[combined.length() - 1];
            
            return rev.substring(0, s.length() - overlap) + s;
        }
        
        private static int[] computeLPS(String pattern) {
            int n = pattern.length();
            int[] lps = new int[n];
            int len = 0;
            int i = 1;
            
            while (i < n) {
                if (pattern.charAt(i) == pattern.charAt(len)) {
                    len++;
                    lps[i] = len;
                    i++;
                } else {
                    if (len != 0) {
                        len = lps[len - 1];
                    } else {
                        lps[i] = 0;
                        i++;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return lps;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n), **Space**: O(n)

### 141. Persistent Segment Tree
**Problem**: Version control for segment trees  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class PersistentSegmentTree {
    static class Node {
        int value;
        Node left, right;
        
        Node(int value) {
            this.value = value;
        }
        
        Node(Node left, Node right) {
            this.left = left;
            this.right = right;
            this.value = (left != null ? left.value : 0) + (right != null ? right.value : 0);
        }
    }
    
    private Node[] roots;
    private int n;
    private int versionCount;
    
    public PersistentSegmentTree(int[] arr) {
        this.n = arr.length;
        this.roots = new Node[100000]; // Support up to 100k versions
        this.versionCount = 0;
        
        // Build initial tree
        roots[versionCount++] = build(arr, 0, n - 1);
    }
    
    private Node build(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        if (start == end) {
            return new Node(arr[start]);
        }
        
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        Node left = build(arr, start, mid);
        Node right = build(arr, mid + 1, end);
        
        return new Node(left, right);
    }
    
    public int update(int version, int index, int value) {
        if (version >= versionCount) return -1;
        
        roots[versionCount] = update(roots[version], 0, n - 1, index, value);
        return versionCount++;
    }
    
    private Node update(Node node, int start, int end, int index, int value) {
        if (start == end) {
            return new Node(value);
        }
        
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        Node newNode = new Node(0);
        
        if (index <= mid) {
            newNode.left = update(node.left, start, mid, index, value);
            newNode.right = node.right;
        } else {
            newNode.left = node.left;
            newNode.right = update(node.right, mid + 1, end, index, value);
        }
        
        newNode.value = (newNode.left != null ? newNode.left.value : 0) + 
                       (newNode.right != null ? newNode.right.value : 0);
        
        return newNode;
    }
    
    public int query(int version, int left, int right) {
        if (version >= versionCount) return 0;
        return query(roots[version], 0, n - 1, left, right);
    }
    
    private int query(Node node, int start, int end, int left, int right) {
        if (node == null || left > end || right < start) return 0;
        if (left <= start && end <= right) return node.value;
        
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        return query(node.left, start, mid, left, right) + 
               query(node.right, mid + 1, end, left, right);
    }
    
    // Kth smallest in range
    public int kthSmallest(int version, int left, int right, int k) {
        return kthSmallest(roots[version], 0, n - 1, left, right, k);
    }
    
    private int kthSmallest(Node node, int start, int end, int left, int right, int k) {
        if (start == end) return start;
        
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        int leftCount = query(node.left, start, mid, left, right);
        
        if (k <= leftCount) {
            return kthSmallest(node.left, start, mid, left, right, k);
        } else {
            return kthSmallest(node.right, mid + 1, end, left, right, k - leftCount);
        }
    }
    
    // Count elements <= value in range
    public int countLessEqual(int version, int left, int right, int value) {
        return query(version, left, Math.min(right, value));
    }
    
    // Range update (lazy propagation version)
    public int rangeUpdate(int version, int left, int right, int delta) {
        roots[versionCount] = rangeUpdate(roots[version], 0, n - 1, left, right, delta);
        return versionCount++;
    }
    
    private Node rangeUpdate(Node node, int start, int end, int left, int right, int delta) {
        if (left > end || right < start) return node;
        
        if (left <= start && end <= right) {
            Node newNode = new Node(node.value + delta * (end - start + 1));
            newNode.left = node.left;
            newNode.right = node.right;
            return newNode;
        }
        
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        Node newNode = new Node(0);
        newNode.left = rangeUpdate(node.left, start, mid, left, right, delta);
        newNode.right = rangeUpdate(node.right, mid + 1, end, left, right, delta);
        newNode.value = (newNode.left != null ? newNode.left.value : 0) + 
                       (newNode.right != null ? newNode.right.value : 0);
        
        return newNode;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) per operation, **Space**: O(n log n)

### 142. Link-Cut Tree
**Problem**: Dynamic tree connectivity queries  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class LinkCutTree {
    static class Node {
        Node parent, left, right;
        int value, pathValue;
        boolean reversed;
        
        Node(int value) {
            this.value = value;
            this.pathValue = value;
        }
        
        boolean isRoot() {
            return parent == null || (parent.left != this && parent.right != this);
        }
        
        void push() {
            if (reversed) {
                Node temp = left;
                left = right;
                right = temp;
                
                if (left != null) left.reversed ^= true;
                if (right != null) right.reversed ^= true;
                
                reversed = false;
            }
        }
        
        void update() {
            pathValue = value;
            if (left != null) pathValue += left.pathValue;
            if (right != null) pathValue += right.pathValue;
        }
    }
    
    private Map<Integer, Node> nodes;
    
    public LinkCutTree() {
        nodes = new HashMap<>();
    }
    
    public void makeTree(int v, int value) {
        nodes.put(v, new Node(value));
    }
    
    private void splay(Node x) {
        while (!x.isRoot()) {
            Node p = x.parent;
            Node g = p.parent;
            
            if (!p.isRoot()) g.push();
            p.push();
            x.push();
            
            if (!p.isRoot()) {
                if ((g.left == p) == (p.left == x)) {
                    rotate(p);
                } else {
                    rotate(x);
                }
            }
            rotate(x);
        }
        x.push();
    }
    
    private void rotate(Node x) {
        Node p = x.parent;
        Node g = p.parent;
        
        if (g != null) {
            if (g.left == p) g.left = x;
            else g.right = x;
        }
        
        if (p.left == x) {
            p.left = x.right;
            x.right = p;
        } else {
            p.right = x.left;
            x.left = p;
        }
        
        x.parent = g;
        p.parent = x;
        if (p.left != null) p.left.parent = p;
        if (p.right != null) p.right.parent = p;
        
        p.update();
        x.update();
    }
    
    public void expose(int v) {
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        Node last = null;
        
        while (x != null) {
            splay(x);
            x.right = last;
            x.update();
            last = x;
            x = x.parent;
        }
    }
    
    public void makeRoot(int v) {
        expose(v);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        splay(x);
        x.reversed ^= true;
    }
    
    public void link(int u, int v) {
        makeRoot(u);
        nodes.get(u).parent = nodes.get(v);
    }
    
    public void cut(int u, int v) {
        makeRoot(u);
        expose(v);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        splay(x);
        
        if (x.left != null && x.left.parent == x) {
            x.left.parent = null;
            x.left = null;
            x.update();
        }
    }
    
    public boolean connected(int u, int v) {
        expose(u);
        expose(v);
        
        Node x = nodes.get(u);
        while (x.parent != null) {
            x = x.parent;
        }
        
        Node y = nodes.get(v);
        while (y.parent != null) {
            y = y.parent;
        }
        
        return x == y;
    }
    
    public int pathQuery(int u, int v) {
        makeRoot(u);
        expose(v);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        splay(x);
        return x.pathValue;
    }
    
    public void pathUpdate(int u, int v, int delta) {
        makeRoot(u);
        expose(v);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        splay(x);
        x.value += delta;
        x.update();
    }
    
    // Find LCA
    public int lca(int u, int v) {
        expose(u);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        Node lca = null;
        
        while (x != null) {
            lca = x;
            x = x.parent;
        }
        
        return getNodeId(lca);
    }
    
    private int getNodeId(Node node) {
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Node> entry : nodes.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getValue() == node) {
                return entry.getKey();
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Find root of tree containing v
    public int findRoot(int v) {
        expose(v);
        Node x = nodes.get(v);
        
        while (x.left != null) {
            x = x.left;
        }
        
        splay(x);
        return getNodeId(x);
    }
    
    // Dynamic connectivity with rollback
    public static class DynamicConnectivity {
        private LinkCutTree lct;
        private List<Operation> operations;
        
        static class Operation {
            String type;
            int u, v;
            
            Operation(String type, int u, int v) {
                this.type = type;
                this.u = u;
                this.v = v;
            }
        }
        
        public DynamicConnectivity() {
            lct = new LinkCutTree();
            operations = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        public void addNode(int v) {
            lct.makeTree(v, 0);
        }
        
        public void link(int u, int v) {
            lct.link(u, v);
            operations.add(new Operation("link", u, v));
        }
        
        public void cut(int u, int v) {
            lct.cut(u, v);
            operations.add(new Operation("cut", u, v));
        }
        
        public boolean connected(int u, int v) {
            return lct.connected(u, v);
        }
        
        public void rollback(int steps) {
            for (int i = 0; i < steps && !operations.isEmpty(); i++) {
                Operation op = operations.remove(operations.size() - 1);
                
                if (op.type.equals("link")) {
                    lct.cut(op.u, op.v);
                } else if (op.type.equals("cut")) {
                    lct.link(op.u, op.v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) amortized, **Space**: O(n)

### 143. Wavelet Tree
**Problem**: Range queries on sequences  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class WaveletTree {
    static class Node {
        int left, right;
        Node leftChild, rightChild;
        int[] prefixSum;
        
        Node(int left, int right) {
            this.left = left;
            this.right = right;
        }
    }
    
    private Node root;
    private int[] values;
    private int minVal, maxVal;
    
    public WaveletTree(int[] arr) {
        values = arr.clone();
        minVal = Arrays.stream(arr).min().orElse(0);
        maxVal = Arrays.stream(arr).max().orElse(0);
        
        root = build(0, arr.length - 1, minVal, maxVal, arr);
    }
    
    private Node build(int left, int right, int minVal, int maxVal, int[] arr) {
        Node node = new Node(left, right);
        node.prefixSum = new int[right - left + 2];
        
        if (minVal == maxVal) {
            // Leaf node
            for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
                node.prefixSum[i - left + 1] = node.prefixSum[i - left] + 1;
            }
            return node;
        }
        
        int mid = (minVal + maxVal) / 2;
        List<Integer> leftList = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rightList = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
            node.prefixSum[i - left + 1] = node.prefixSum[i - left];
            
            if (arr[i] <= mid) {
                leftList.add(arr[i]);
                node.prefixSum[i - left + 1]++;
            } else {
                rightList.add(arr[i]);
            }
        }
        
        // Build children
        if (!leftList.isEmpty()) {
            int[] leftArr = leftList.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
            node.leftChild = build(left, left + leftList.size() - 1, minVal, mid, leftArr);
        }
        
        if (!rightList.isEmpty()) {
            int[] rightArr = rightList.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
            node.rightChild = build(left + leftList.size(), right, mid + 1, maxVal, rightArr);
        }
        
        return node;
    }
    
    // Count occurrences of value in range [l, r]
    public int count(int l, int r, int value) {
        if (value < minVal || value > maxVal) return 0;
        return count(root, l, r, minVal, maxVal, value);
    }
    
    private int count(Node node, int l, int r, int minVal, int maxVal, int value) {
        if (l > r || node == null) return 0;
        if (minVal == maxVal) return r - l + 1;
        
        int mid = (minVal + maxVal) / 2;
        int leftStart = node.left;
        
        if (value <= mid) {
            int newL = leftStart + node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            return count(node.leftChild, newL, newR, minVal, mid, value);
        } else {
            int leftCount = node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newL = leftStart + (l - leftStart) - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + (r - leftStart + 1) - node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            return count(node.rightChild, newL, newR, mid + 1, maxVal, value);
        }
    }
    
    // Kth smallest element in range [l, r] (0-indexed)
    public int kthSmallest(int l, int r, int k) {
        return kthSmallest(root, l, r, minVal, maxVal, k);
    }
    
    private int kthSmallest(Node node, int l, int r, int minVal, int maxVal, int k) {
        if (minVal == maxVal) return minVal;
        
        int mid = (minVal + maxVal) / 2;
        int leftStart = node.left;
        int leftCount = node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
        
        if (k < leftCount) {
            int newL = leftStart + node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            return kthSmallest(node.leftChild, newL, newR, minVal, mid, k);
        } else {
            int newL = leftStart + (l - leftStart) - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + (r - leftStart + 1) - node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            return kthSmallest(node.rightChild, newL, newR, mid + 1, maxVal, k - leftCount);
        }
    }
    
    // Count values <= x in range [l, r]
    public int countLessEqual(int l, int r, int x) {
        return countLessEqual(root, l, r, minVal, maxVal, x);
    }
    
    private int countLessEqual(Node node, int l, int r, int minVal, int maxVal, int x) {
        if (l > r || node == null || maxVal < minVal) return 0;
        if (maxVal <= x) return r - l + 1;
        if (minVal > x) return 0;
        
        int mid = (minVal + maxVal) / 2;
        int leftStart = node.left;
        int result = 0;
        
        // Count in left subtree
        int leftCount = node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
        if (leftCount > 0) {
            int newL = leftStart + node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            result += countLessEqual(node.leftChild, newL, newR, minVal, mid, x);
        }
        
        // Count in right subtree
        if (x > mid) {
            int newL = leftStart + (l - leftStart) - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + (r - leftStart + 1) - node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            result += countLessEqual(node.rightChild, newL, newR, mid + 1, maxVal, x);
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    // Range median
    public double rangeMedian(int l, int r) {
        int size = r - l + 1;
        if (size % 2 == 1) {
            return kthSmallest(l, r, size / 2);
        } else {
            int mid1 = kthSmallest(l, r, size / 2 - 1);
            int mid2 = kthSmallest(l, r, size / 2);
            return (mid1 + mid2) / 2.0;
        }
    }
    
    // Quantile queries
    public int quantile(int l, int r, double p) {
        int size = r - l + 1;
        int k = (int) (p * size);
        k = Math.min(k, size - 1);
        return kthSmallest(l, r, k);
    }
    
    // Count distinct values in range
    public int countDistinct(int l, int r) {
        return countDistinct(root, l, r, minVal, maxVal);
    }
    
    private int countDistinct(Node node, int l, int r, int minVal, int maxVal) {
        if (l > r || node == null) return 0;
        if (minVal == maxVal) return 1;
        
        int mid = (minVal + maxVal) / 2;
        int leftStart = node.left;
        int result = 0;
        
        // Check left subtree
        int leftCount = node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
        if (leftCount > 0) {
            int newL = leftStart + node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            result += countDistinct(node.leftChild, newL, newR, minVal, mid);
        }
        
        // Check right subtree
        int rightCount = (r - l + 1) - leftCount;
        if (rightCount > 0) {
            int newL = leftStart + (l - leftStart) - node.prefixSum[l - leftStart];
            int newR = leftStart + (r - leftStart + 1) - node.prefixSum[r - leftStart + 1] - 1;
            result += countDistinct(node.rightChild, newL, newR, mid + 1, maxVal);
        }
        
        return result;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log σ) per query where σ is alphabet size, **Space**: O(n log σ)

### 144. Palindromic Tree (Eertree)
**Problem**: All palindromic substrings in linear time  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class PalindromicTree {
    static class Node {
        Map<Character, Node> edges = new HashMap<>();
        Node suffixLink;
        int length;
        int count;
        
        Node(int length) {
            this.length = length;
        }
    }
    
    private Node oddRoot, evenRoot;
    private Node lastNode;
    private String text;
    private List<Node> nodes;
    
    public PalindromicTree() {
        oddRoot = new Node(-1);  // Root for odd length palindromes
        evenRoot = new Node(0);  // Root for even length palindromes
        
        oddRoot.suffixLink = oddRoot;
        evenRoot.suffixLink = oddRoot;
        
        lastNode = oddRoot;
        text = "";
        nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        nodes.add(oddRoot);
        nodes.add(evenRoot);
    }
    
    public void addCharacter(char c) {
        text += c;
        int pos = text.length() - 1;
        
        Node current = lastNode;
        
        // Find the longest palindromic suffix
        while (true) {
            int reversePos = pos - current.length - 1;
            if (reversePos >= 0 && text.charAt(reversePos) == c) {
                break;
            }
            current = current.suffixLink;
        }
        
        // Check if palindrome already exists
        if (current.edges.containsKey(c)) {
            lastNode = current.edges.get(c);
            lastNode.count++;
            return;
        }
        
        // Create new palindrome
        Node newNode = new Node(current.length + 2);
        current.edges.put(c, newNode);
        nodes.add(newNode);
        newNode.count = 1;
        
        if (newNode.length == 1) {
            newNode.suffixLink = evenRoot;
        } else {
            // Find suffix link
            current = current.suffixLink;
            while (true) {
                int reversePos = pos - current.length - 1;
                if (reversePos >= 0 && text.charAt(reversePos) == c) {
                    newNode.suffixLink = current.edges.get(c);
                    break;
                }
                current = current.suffixLink;
            }
        }
        
        lastNode = newNode;
    }
    
    public void addString(String s) {
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            addCharacter(c);
        }
    }
    
    public int countPalindromes() {
        int count = 0;
        for (Node node : nodes) {
            if (node.length > 0) {
                count += node.count;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
    
    public int countDistinctPalindromes() {
        int count = 0;
        for (Node node : nodes) {
            if (node.length > 0) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
    
    // Get all palindromic substrings
    public List<String> getAllPalindromes() {
        List<String> palindromes = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (Node node : nodes) {
            if (node.length > 0) {
                String palindrome = getPalindromeString(node);
                palindromes.add(palindrome);
            }
        }
        
        return palindromes;
    }
    
    private String getPalindromeString(Node node) {
        // Reconstruct palindrome from node
        // This is a simplified version - in practice, you'd track positions
        int len = node.length;
        int pos = text.length() - 1;
        
        // Find occurrence of this palindrome ending at current position
        while (pos >= 0) {
            if (pos - len + 1 >= 0) {
                String candidate = text.substring(pos - len + 1, pos + 1);
                if (isPalindrome(candidate)) {
                    return candidate;
                }
            }
            pos--;
        }
        
        return "";
    }
    
    private boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int left = 0, right = s.length() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            if (s.charAt(left++) != s.charAt(right--)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    // Count palindromes of each length
    public Map<Integer, Integer> countByLength() {
        Map<Integer, Integer> lengthCount = new HashMap<>();
        
        for (Node node : nodes) {
            if (node.length > 0) {
                lengthCount.put(node.length, 
                    lengthCount.getOrDefault(node.length, 0) + node.count);
            }
        }
        
        return lengthCount;
    }
    
    // Applications
    public static class PalindromeApplications {
        
        // Find longest palindromic substring
        public static String longestPalindrome(String s) {
            PalindromicTree tree = new PalindromicTree();
            tree.addString(s);
            
            String longest = "";
            for (Node node : tree.nodes) {
                if (node.length > longest.length()) {
                    String palindrome = tree.getPalindromeString(node);
                    if (palindrome.length() > longest.length()) {
                        longest = palindrome;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return longest;
        }
        
        // Count palindromic subsequences
        public static int countPalindromicSubsequences(String s) {
            int n = s.length();
            int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
            
            // Single characters
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                dp[i][i] = 1;
            }
            
            // Check all lengths
            for (int len = 2; len <= n; len++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
                    int j = i + len - 1;
                    
                    if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j] + dp[i][j - 1] + 1;
                    } else {
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j] + dp[i][j - 1] - dp[i + 1][j - 1];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp[0][n - 1];
        }
        
        // Check if string can be made palindrome by removing k characters
        public static boolean canBePalindrome(String s, int k) {
            int n = s.length();
            String rev = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
            
            // Find LCS
            int[][] dp = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
            
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    if (s.charAt(i - 1) == rev.charAt(j - 1)) {
                        dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
                    } else {
                        dp[i][j] = Math.max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int lcs = dp[n][n];
            return n - lcs <= k;
        }
        
        // Find all palindromic partitions
        public static List<List<String>> palindromePartitions(String s) {
            List<List<String>> result = new ArrayList<>();
            List<String> current = new ArrayList<>();
            
            backtrack(s, 0, current, result);
            return result;
        }
        
        private static void backtrack(String s, int start, List<String> current, 
                                    List<List<String>> result) {
            if (start == s.length()) {
                result.add(new ArrayList<>(current));
                return;
            }
            
            for (int end = start; end < s.length(); end++) {
                String substring = s.substring(start, end + 1);
                if (isPalindromeHelper(substring)) {
                    current.add(substring);
                    backtrack(s, end + 1, current, result);
                    current.remove(current.size() - 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static boolean isPalindromeHelper(String s) {
            int left = 0, right = s.length() - 1;
            while (left < right) {
                if (s.charAt(left++) != s.charAt(right--)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n) for construction, **Space**: O(n)

### 145. Geometric Algorithms - Line Intersection
**Problem**: Computational geometry fundamentals  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class GeometricAlgorithms {
    
    static class Point {
        double x, y;
        
        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
        
        Point subtract(Point other) {
            return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
        }
        
        double dot(Point other) {
            return x * other.x + y * other.y;
        }
        
        double cross(Point other) {
            return x * other.y - y * other.x;
        }
        
        double distance(Point other) {
            return Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - other.x, 2) + Math.pow(y - other.y, 2));
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("(%.2f, %.2f)", x, y);
        }
    }
    
    static class Line {
        Point p1, p2;
        
        Line(Point p1, Point p2) {
            this.p1 = p1;
            this.p2 = p2;
        }
        
        // Check if two line segments intersect
        public boolean intersects(Line other) {
            return doIntersect(this.p1, this.p2, other.p1, other.p2);
        }
        
        // Find intersection point of two lines (if exists)
        public Point intersection(Line other) {
            return lineIntersection(this.p1, this.p2, other.p1, other.p2);
        }
        
        // Distance from point to line
        public double distanceToPoint(Point p) {
            return distancePointToLine(p, this.p1, this.p2);
        }
    }
    
    // Check orientation of ordered triplet (p, q, r)
    public static int orientation(Point p, Point q, Point r) {
        double val = (q.y - p.y) * (r.x - q.x) - (q.x - p.x) * (r.y - q.y);
        if (Math.abs(val) < 1e-9) return 0;  // Collinear
        return (val > 0) ? 1 : 2; // Clockwise or Counterclockwise
    }
    
    // Check if point q lies on line segment pr
    public static boolean onSegment(Point p, Point q, Point r) {
        return q.x <= Math.max(p.x, r.x) && q.x >= Math.min(p.x, r.x) &&
               q.y <= Math.max(p.y, r.y) && q.y >= Math.min(p.y, r.y);
    }
    
    // Check if line segments p1q1 and p2q2 intersect
    public static boolean doIntersect(Point p1, Point q1, Point p2, Point q2) {
        int o1 = orientation(p1, q1, p2);
        int o2 = orientation(p1, q1, q2);
        int o3 = orientation(p2, q2, p1);
        int o4 = orientation(p2, q2, q1);
        
        // General case
        if (o1 != o2 && o3 != o4) return true;
        
        // Special cases
        if (o1 == 0 && onSegment(p1, p2, q1)) return true;
        if (o2 == 0 && onSegment(p1, q2, q1)) return true;
        if (o3 == 0 && onSegment(p2, p1, q2)) return true;
        if (o4 == 0 && onSegment(p2, q1, q2)) return true;
        
        return false;
    }
    
    // Find intersection point of two lines
    public static Point lineIntersection(Point p1, Point p2, Point p3, Point p4) {
        double denom = (p1.x - p2.x) * (p3.y - p4.y) - (p1.y - p2.y) * (p3.x - p4.x);
        
        if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-9) return null; // Lines are parallel
        
        double t = ((p1.x - p3.x) * (p3.y - p4.y) - (p1.y - p3.y) * (p3.x - p4.x)) / denom;
        
        return new Point(p1.x + t * (p2.x - p1.x), p1.y + t * (p2.y - p1.y));
    }
    
    // Distance from point to line
    public static double distancePointToLine(Point p, Point a, Point b) {
        Point ab = b.subtract(a);
        Point ap = p.subtract(a);
        
        double ab2 = ab.dot(ab);
        double ap_ab = ap.dot(ab);
        
        if (ab2 == 0) return p.distance(a);
        
        double t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ap_ab / ab2));
        Point projection = new Point(a.x + t * ab.x, a.y + t * ab.y);
        
        return p.distance(projection);
    }
    
    // Point in polygon test
    public static boolean pointInPolygon(Point point, List<Point> polygon) {
        int n = polygon.size();
        boolean inside = false;
        
        for (int i = 0, j = n - 1; i < n; j = i++) {
            Point pi = polygon.get(i);
            Point pj = polygon.get(j);
            
            if (((pi.y > point.y) != (pj.y > point.y)) &&
                (point.x < (pj.x - pi.x) * (point.y - pi.y) / (pj.y - pi.y) + pi.x)) {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        
        return inside;
    }
    
    // Closest pair of points
    public static Pair<Point, Point> closestPair(List<Point> points) {
        points.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.x, b.x));
        return closestPairRec(points);
    }
    
    private static Pair<Point, Point> closestPairRec(List<Point> points) {
        int n = points.size();
        
        if (n <= 3) {
            return bruteForceClosestPair(points);
        }
        
        int mid = n / 2;
        Point midPoint = points.get(mid);
        
        List<Point> left = points.subList(0, mid);
        List<Point> right = points.subList(mid, n);
        
        Pair<Point, Point> leftPair = closestPairRec(left);
        Pair<Point, Point> rightPair = closestPairRec(right);
        
        double leftDist = leftPair.first.distance(leftPair.second);
        double rightDist = rightPair.first.distance(rightPair.second);
        
        double minDist = Math.min(leftDist, rightDist);
        Pair<Point, Point> minPair = (leftDist < rightDist) ? leftPair : rightPair;
        
        // Check points near the dividing line
        List<Point> strip = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Point p : points) {
            if (Math.abs(p.x - midPoint.x) < minDist) {
                strip.add(p);
            }
        }
        
        strip.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.y, b.y));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < strip.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < strip.size() && 
                 (strip.get(j).y - strip.get(i).y) < minDist; j++) {
                double dist = strip.get(i).distance(strip.get(j));
                if (dist < minDist) {
                    minDist = dist;
                    minPair = new Pair<>(strip.get(i), strip.get(j));
                }
            }
        }
        
        return minPair;
    }
    
    private static Pair<Point, Point> bruteForceClosestPair(List<Point> points) {
        double minDist = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        Pair<Point, Point> result = null;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < points.size(); j++) {
                double dist = points.get(i).distance(points.get(j));
                if (dist < minDist) {
                    minDist = dist;
                    result = new Pair<>(points.get(i), points.get(j));
                }
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    // Polygon area
    public static double polygonArea(List<Point> polygon) {
        double area = 0;
        int n = polygon.size();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (i + 1) % n;
            area += polygon.get(i).x * polygon.get(j).y;
            area -= polygon.get(j).x * polygon.get(i).y;
        }
        
        return Math.abs(area) / 2.0;
    }
    
    static class Pair<T, U> {
        T first;
        U second;
        
        Pair(T first, U second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n) for closest pair, O(n) for others, **Space**: O(n)

### 146. Network Flow - Maximum Flow
**Problem**: Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp, Dinic's algorithm  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class MaxFlow {
    
    // Edmonds-Karp (BFS-based Ford-Fulkerson)
    public static class EdmondsKarp {
        private int[][] capacity;
        private int[][] flow;
        private int n;
        
        public EdmondsKarp(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.capacity = new int[n][n];
            this.flow = new int[n][n];
        }
        
        public void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            capacity[from][to] += cap;
        }
        
        public int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int totalFlow = 0;
            
            while (true) {
                int[] parent = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                queue.offer(source);
                parent[source] = source;
                
                // BFS to find augmenting path
                while (!queue.isEmpty() && parent[sink] == -1) {
                    int curr = queue.poll();
                    
                    for (int next = 0; next < n; next++) {
                        if (parent[next] == -1 && 
                            capacity[curr][next] - flow[curr][next] > 0) {
                            parent[next] = curr;
                            queue.offer(next);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (parent[sink] == -1) break; // No augmenting path
                
                // Find minimum residual capacity
                int pathFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    pathFlow = Math.min(pathFlow, capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                
                // Update flow
                for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    flow[u][v] += pathFlow;
                    flow[v][u] -= pathFlow;
                }
                
                totalFlow += pathFlow;
            }
            
            return totalFlow;
        }
        
        public List<Integer> getMinCut(int source) {
            List<Integer> cut = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
            
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            queue.offer(source);
            visited[source] = true;
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int curr = queue.poll();
                cut.add(curr);
                
                for (int next = 0; next < n; next++) {
                    if (!visited[next] && capacity[curr][next] - flow[curr][next] > 0) {
                        visited[next] = true;
                        queue.offer(next);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return cut;
        }
    }
    
    // Dinic's Algorithm
    public static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, cap, flow, rev;
            
            Edge(int to, int cap, int rev) {
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }
        
        private List<List<Edge>> graph;
        private int[] level;
        private int[] iter;
        private int n;
        
        public Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.graph = new ArrayList<>();
            this.level = new int[n];
            this.iter = new int[n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }
        
        public void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, cap, graph.get(to).size()));
            graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, 0, graph.get(from).size() - 1));
        }
        
        public int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = 0;
            
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                int pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(source, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            
            return flow;
        }
        
        private boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[source] = 0;
            
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            queue.offer(source);
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int curr = queue.poll();
                
                for (Edge edge : graph.get(curr)) {
                    if (level[edge.to] < 0 && edge.flow < edge.cap) {
                        level[edge.to] = level[curr] + 1;
                        queue.offer(edge.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return level[sink] >= 0;
        }
        
        private int dfs(int curr, int sink, int pushed) {
            if (curr == sink || pushed == 0) return pushed;
            
            for (int cid = iter[curr]; cid < graph.get(curr).size(); cid++) {
                Edge edge = graph.get(curr).get(cid);
                
                if (level[curr] + 1 != level[edge.to] || edge.cap <= edge.flow) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                int tr = dfs(edge.to, sink, Math.min(pushed, edge.cap - edge.flow));
                if (tr > 0) {
                    edge.flow += tr;
                    graph.get(edge.to).get(edge.rev).flow -= tr;
                    return tr;
                }
            }
            
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    // Min-Cost Max-Flow
    public static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, cap, cost, flow, rev;
            
            Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev) {
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }
        
        private List<List<Edge>> graph;
        private int[] dist;
        private int[] parent;
        private int[] parentEdge;
        private int n;
        
        public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.graph = new ArrayList<>();
            this.dist = new int[n];
            this.parent = new int[n];
            this.parentEdge = new int[n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }
        
        public void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, cap, cost, graph.get(to).size()));
            graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost, graph.get(from).size() - 1));
        }
        
        public Pair<Integer, Integer> minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = 0;
            int cost = 0;
            
            while (spfa(source, sink)) {
                int pushFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                
                // Find bottleneck
                for (int curr = sink; curr != source; curr = parent[curr]) {
                    Edge edge = graph.get(parent[curr]).get(parentEdge[curr]);
                    pushFlow = Math.min(pushFlow, edge.cap - edge.flow);
                }
                
                // Update flow and cost
                for (int curr = sink; curr != source; curr = parent[curr]) {
                    Edge edge = graph.get(parent[curr]).get(parentEdge[curr]);
                    edge.flow += pushFlow;
                    graph.get(curr).get(edge.rev).flow -= pushFlow;
                    cost += pushFlow * edge.cost;
                }
                
                flow += pushFlow;
            }
            
            return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
        }
        
        private boolean spfa(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            
            dist[source] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];
            
            queue.offer(source);
            inQueue[source] = true;
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int curr = queue.poll();
                inQueue[curr] = false;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(curr).size(); i++) {
                    Edge edge = graph.get(curr).get(i);
                    
                    if (edge.cap > edge.flow && 
                        dist[curr] + edge.cost < dist[edge.to]) {
                        dist[edge.to] = dist[curr] + edge.cost;
                        parent[edge.to] = curr;
                        parentEdge[edge.to] = i;
                        
                        if (!inQueue[edge.to]) {
                            queue.offer(edge.to);
                            inQueue[edge.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dist[sink] != Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        }
    }
    
    // Applications
    public static class FlowApplications {
        
        // Maximum Bipartite Matching
        public static int maxBipartiteMatching(int[][] graph) {
            int n = graph.length;
            int m = graph[0].length;
            
            EdmondsKarp flow = new EdmondsKarp(n + m + 2);
            int source = n + m;
            int sink = n + m + 1;
            
            // Add edges from source to left vertices
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                flow.addEdge(source, i, 1);
            }
            
            // Add edges from right vertices to sink
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                flow.addEdge(n + j, sink, 1);
            }
            
            // Add edges between matched vertices
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (graph[i][j] == 1) {
                        flow.addEdge(i, n + j, 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return flow.maxFlow(source, sink);
        }
        
        // Minimum Vertex Cover
        public static int minVertexCover(int[][] graph) {
            // König's theorem: |max matching| = |min vertex cover| in bipartite graphs
            return maxBipartiteMatching(graph);
        }
        
        // Maximum Independent Set
        public static int maxIndependentSet(int[][] graph) {
            int n = graph.length;
            int m = graph[0].length;
            return n + m - maxBipartiteMatching(graph);
        }
        
        // Project Selection Problem
        public static int projectSelection(int[] profit, int[][] dependencies) {
            int n = profit.length;
            EdmondsKarp flow = new EdmondsKarp(n + 2);
            int source = n;
            int sink = n + 1;
            
            int totalProfit = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (profit[i] > 0) {
                    flow.addEdge(source, i, profit[i]);
                    totalProfit += profit[i];
                } else {
                    flow.addEdge(i, sink, -profit[i]);
                }
            }
            
            for (int[] dep : dependencies) {
                flow.addEdge(dep[0], dep[1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            
            return totalProfit - flow.maxFlow(source, sink);
        }
    }
    
    static class Pair<T, U> {
        T first;
        U second;
        
        Pair(T first, U second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(V²E) for Edmonds-Karp, O(V²E) for Dinic, **Space**: O(V + E)

### 147. String Hashing & Rolling Hash
**Problem**: Fast string matching and comparison  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public class StringHashing {
    private static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    private static final long MOD2 = 1000000009L;
    private static final long BASE1 = 31L;
    private static final long BASE2 = 37L;
    
    public static class RollingHash {
        private long[] hash1, hash2;
        private long[] pow1, pow2;
        private int n;
        
        public RollingHash(String s) {
            n = s.length();
            hash1 = new long[n + 1];
            hash2 = new long[n + 1];
            pow1 = new long[n + 1];
            pow2 = new long[n + 1];
            
            pow1[0] = pow2[0] = 1;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pow1[i + 1] = (pow1[i] * BASE1) % MOD1;
                pow2[i + 1] = (pow2[i] * BASE2) % MOD2;
                
                hash1[i + 1] = (hash1[i] * BASE1 + s.charAt(i)) % MOD1;
                hash2[i + 1] = (hash2[i] * BASE2 + s.charAt(i)) % MOD2;
            }
        }
        
        public Pair<Long, Long> getHash(int left, int right) {
            long h1 = (hash1[right + 1] - hash1[left] * pow1[right - left + 1] % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            long h2 = (hash2[right + 1] - hash2[left] * pow2[right - left + 1] % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
            return new Pair<>(h1, h2);
        }
        
        public boolean equals(int l1, int r1, int l2, int r2) {
            return getHash(l1, r1).equals(getHash(l2, r2));
        }
        
        public boolean isPalindrome(int left, int right) {
            // Compare with reverse hash (would need reverse hash array)
            String substr = extractSubstring(left, right);
            String rev = new StringBuilder(substr).reverse().toString();
            return substr.equals(rev);
        }
        
        private String extractSubstring(int left, int right) {
            // Helper method - in practice, you'd maintain original string
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    // Pattern matching using rolling hash
    public static List<Integer> rabinKarpSearch(String text, String pattern) {
        List<Integer> matches = new ArrayList<>();
        int n = text.length();
        int m = pattern.length();
        
        if (m > n) return matches;
        
        long patternHash1 = 0, patternHash2 = 0;
        long textHash1 = 0, textHash2 = 0;
        long pow1 = 1, pow2 = 1;
        
        // Calculate pattern hash and first window hash
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            patternHash1 = (patternHash1 * BASE1 + pattern.charAt(i)) % MOD1;
            patternHash2 = (patternHash2 * BASE2 + pattern.charAt(i)) % MOD2;
            
            textHash1 = (textHash1 * BASE1 + text.charAt(i)) % MOD1;
            textHash2 = (textHash2 * BASE2 + text.charAt(i)) % MOD2;
            
            if (i < m - 1) {
                pow1 = (pow1 * BASE1) % MOD1;
                pow2 = (pow2 * BASE2) % MOD2;
            }
        }
        
        // Check first window
        if (patternHash1 == textHash1 && patternHash2 == textHash2) {
            if (text.substring(0, m).equals(pattern)) {
                matches.add(0);
            }
        }
        
        // Roll the hash
        for (int i = m; i < n; i++) {
            // Remove first character
            textHash1 = (textHash1 - text.charAt(i - m) * pow1 % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            textHash2 = (textHash2 - text.charAt(i - m) * pow2 % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
            
            // Add new character
            textHash1 = (textHash1 * BASE1 + text.charAt(i)) % MOD1;
            textHash2 = (textHash2 * BASE2 + text.charAt(i)) % MOD2;
            
            // Check match
            if (patternHash1 == textHash1 && patternHash2 == textHash2) {
                if (text.substring(i - m + 1, i + 1).equals(pattern)) {
                    matches.add(i - m + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return matches;
    }
    
    // Longest Common Substring using hashing
    public static String longestCommonSubstring(String s1, String s2) {
        int left = 0, right = Math.min(s1.length(), s2.length());
        String result = "";
        
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            String lcs = findCommonSubstring(s1, s2, mid);
            
            if (lcs != null) {
                result = lcs;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private static String findCommonSubstring(String s1, String s2, int len) {
        if (len == 0) return "";
        
        Set<Pair<Long, Long>> hashes = new HashSet<>();
        RollingHash rh1 = new RollingHash(s1);
        
        // Add all substrings of s1 with length len
        for (int i = 0; i <= s1.length() - len; i++) {
            hashes.add(rh1.getHash(i, i + len - 1));
        }
        
        RollingHash rh2 = new RollingHash(s2);
        
        // Check substrings of s2
        for (int i = 0; i <= s2.length() - len; i++) {
            Pair<Long, Long> hash = rh2.getHash(i, i + len - 1);
            if (hashes.contains(hash)) {
                return s2.substring(i, i + len);
            }
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    // Distinct substrings count
    public static int countDistinctSubstrings(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        Set<Pair<Long, Long>> hashes = new HashSet<>();
        
        RollingHash rh = new RollingHash(s);
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= n; len++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
                hashes.add(rh.getHash(i, i + len - 1));
            }
        }
        
        return hashes.size();
    }
    
    // Palindromic substrings using hashing
    public static int countPalindromicSubstrings(String s) {
        int n = s.length();
        String rev = new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString();
        
        RollingHash forward = new RollingHash(s);
        RollingHash backward = new RollingHash(rev);
        
        int count = 0;
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= n; len++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
                int j = n - 1 - (i + len - 1); // Corresponding position in reverse
                
                Pair<Long, Long> forwardHash = forward.getHash(i, i + len - 1);
                Pair<Long, Long> backwardHash = backward.getHash(j, j + len - 1);
                
                if (forwardHash.equals(backwardHash)) {
                    // Double check to avoid hash collision
                    String substr = s.substring(i, i + len);
                    if (isPalindrome(substr)) {
                        count++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return count;
    }
    
    private static boolean isPalindrome(String s) {
        int left = 0, right = s.length() - 1;
        while (left < right) {
            if (s.charAt(left++) != s.charAt(right--)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    // String comparison using hash
    public static class HashComparator {
        private Map<String, Pair<Long, Long>> hashCache;
        
        public HashComparator() {
            hashCache = new HashMap<>();
        }
        
        public Pair<Long, Long> getStringHash(String s) {
            if (hashCache.containsKey(s)) {
                return hashCache.get(s);
            }
            
            long hash1 = 0, hash2 = 0;
            
            for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
                hash1 = (hash1 * BASE1 + c) % MOD1;
                hash2 = (hash2 * BASE2 + c) % MOD2;
            }
            
            Pair<Long, Long> hash = new Pair<>(hash1, hash2);
            hashCache.put(s, hash);
            return hash;
        }
        
        public boolean areEqual(String s1, String s2) {
            if (s1.length() != s2.length()) return false;
            return getStringHash(s1).equals(getStringHash(s2));
        }
        
        public int compare(String s1, String s2) {
            Pair<Long, Long> h1 = getStringHash(s1);
            Pair<Long, Long> h2 = getStringHash(s2);
            
            if (h1.first != h2.first) {
                return Long.compare(h1.first, h2.first);
            }
            return Long.compare(h1.second, h2.second);
        }
    }
    
    static class Pair<T, U> {
        T first;
        U second;
        
        Pair(T first, U second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair<?, ?> other = (Pair<?, ?>) obj;
            return Objects.equals(first, other.first) && Objects.equals(second, other.second);
        }
        
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n) for preprocessing, O(1) for queries, **Space**: O(n)

### 148. Advanced Dynamic Programming
**Problem**: Complex DP optimizations and techniques  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedDP {
    
    // Knuth-Yao Optimization for Matrix Chain Multiplication
    public static class MatrixChainOptimization {
        public static int matrixChainOrder(int[] dimensions) {
            int n = dimensions.length - 1;
            int[][] dp = new int[n][n];
            int[][] cut = new int[n][n];
            
            // Length 2 chains
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                dp[i][i + 1] = dimensions[i] * dimensions[i + 1] * dimensions[i + 2];
                cut[i][i + 1] = i;
            }
            
            // Longer chains using Knuth-Yao optimization
            for (int len = 3; len <= n; len++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= n - len; i++) {
                    int j = i + len - 1;
                    dp[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    
                    // Use optimal substructure property
                    int start = (i > 0) ? cut[i][j - 1] : i;
                    int end = (j < n - 1) ? cut[i + 1][j] : j - 1;
                    
                    for (int k = start; k <= end; k++) {
                        int cost = dp[i][k] + dp[k + 1][j] + 
                                  dimensions[i] * dimensions[k + 1] * dimensions[j + 1];
                        
                        if (cost < dp[i][j]) {
                            dp[i][j] = cost;
                            cut[i][j] = k;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp[0][n - 1];
        }
    }
    
    // Convex Hull Optimization
    public static class ConvexHullOptimization {
        static class Line {
            long a, b;
            int id;
            
            Line(long a, long b, int id) {
                this.a = a;
                this.b = b;
                this.id = id;
            }
            
            long eval(long x) {
                return a * x + b;
            }
            
            // Intersection x-coordinate with another line
            double intersectX(Line other) {
                return (double) (other.b - b) / (a - other.a);
            }
        }
        
        public static long[] optimizeDP(long[] a, long[] b, long[] x) {
            int n = a.length;
            long[] dp = new long[n];
            Deque<Line> hull = new ArrayDeque<>();
            
            // Initialize with first line
            hull.addLast(new Line(b[0], 0, 0));
            dp[0] = 0;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                // Remove lines that are no longer optimal
                while (hull.size() > 1) {
                    Line first = hull.peekFirst();
                    Line second = hull.peekFirst();
                    hull.removeFirst();
                    second = hull.peekFirst();
                    hull.addFirst(first);
                    
                    if (first.eval(x[i]) >= second.eval(x[i])) {
                        hull.removeFirst();
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                // Get optimal value
                Line best = hull.peekFirst();
                dp[i] = best.eval(x[i]);
                
                // Add new line
                Line newLine = new Line(b[i], dp[i], i);
                
                // Remove lines that become suboptimal
                while (hull.size() > 1) {
                    Line last = hull.peekLast();
                    Line secondLast = hull.peekLast();
                    hull.removeLast();
                    secondLast = hull.peekLast();
                    hull.addLast(last);
                    
                    if (newLine.intersectX(last) <= last.intersectX(secondLast)) {
                        hull.removeLast();
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                hull.addLast(newLine);
            }
            
            return dp;
        }
    }
    
    // Divide and Conquer Optimization
    public static class DivideConquerOptimization {
        private static long[][] cost;
        private static long[][] dp;
        private static int[][] opt;
        
        public static long solve(long[][] costMatrix, int n, int k) {
            cost = costMatrix;
            dp = new long[k + 1][n];
            opt = new int[k + 1][n];
            
            // Base case
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                dp[1][i] = cost[0][i];
                opt[1][i] = 0;
            }
            
            // Fill DP table
            for (int level = 2; level <= k; level++) {
                divideConquer(level, 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1);
            }
            
            return dp[k][n - 1];
        }
        
        private static void divideConquer(int level, int left, int right, 
                                        int optLeft, int optRight) {
            if (left > right) return;
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            int bestK = -1;
            long bestCost = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            
            for (int k = optLeft; k <= Math.min(mid - 1, optRight); k++) {
                long currentCost = dp[level - 1][k] + cost[k + 1][mid];
                if (currentCost < bestCost) {
                    bestCost = currentCost;
                    bestK = k;
                }
            }
            
            dp[level][mid] = bestCost;
            opt[level][mid] = bestK;
            
            divideConquer(level, left, mid - 1, optLeft, bestK);
            divideConquer(level, mid + 1, right, bestK, optRight);
        }
    }
    
    // SOS (Sum Over Subsets) DP
    public static class SOSDP {
        public static long[] sumOverSubsets(long[] a, int n) {
            long[] dp = a.clone();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        dp[mask] += dp[mask ^ (1 << i)];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp;
        }
        
        public static long[] sumOverSupersets(long[] a, int n) {
            long[] dp = a.clone();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0) {
                        dp[mask] += dp[mask | (1 << i)];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp;
        }
        
        // Count pairs with AND = 0
        public static long countZeroAndPairs(int[] arr) {
            int maxVal = Arrays.stream(arr).max().orElse(0);
            int bits = 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(maxVal);
            
            long[] count = new long[1 << bits];
            for (int x : arr) {
                count[x]++;
            }
            
            // SOS DP to count subsets
            long[] sosCount = sumOverSubsets(count, bits);
            
            long result = 0;
            for (int x : arr) {
                int complement = ((1 << bits) - 1) ^ x;
                result += sosCount[complement];
            }
            
            return result / 2; // Each pair counted twice
        }
    }
    
    // Digit DP
    public static class DigitDP {
        private static String number;
        private static int[][][][] memo;
        
        public static int countNumbersWithProperty(String num) {
            number = num;
            int n = num.length();
            memo = new int[n][2][10][2]; // pos, tight, lastDigit, started
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memo[i][j][k], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return solve(0, 1, 0, 0);
        }
        
        private static int solve(int pos, int tight, int lastDigit, int started) {
            if (pos == number.length()) {
                return started; // Valid number formed
            }
            
            if (memo[pos][tight][lastDigit][started] != -1) {
                return memo[pos][tight][lastDigit][started];
            }
            
            int limit = tight == 1 ? (number.charAt(pos) - '0') : 9;
            int result = 0;
```
