```java
            for (int digit = 0; digit <= limit; digit++) {
                int newTight = (tight == 1 && digit == limit) ? 1 : 0;
                int newStarted = (started == 1 || digit > 0) ? 1 : 0;
                
                // Add your property check here
                if (isValidTransition(lastDigit, digit, started)) {
                    result += solve(pos + 1, newTight, digit, newStarted);
                }
            }
            
            return memo[pos][tight][lastDigit][started] = result;
        }
        
        private static boolean isValidTransition(int lastDigit, int currentDigit, int started) {
            // Example: no two consecutive same digits
            if (started == 1 && lastDigit == currentDigit) {
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    // Bitmask DP for TSP
    public static class BitMaskDP {
        public static int tsp(int[][] dist) {
            int n = dist.length;
            int[][] dp = new int[1 << n][n];
            
            // Initialize with maximum values
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            
            dp[1][0] = 0; // Start from city 0
            
            for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << u)) == 0 || dp[mask][u] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                        if (mask & (1 << v)) continue;
                        
                        int newMask = mask | (1 << v);
                        dp[newMask][v] = Math.min(dp[newMask][v], 
                                                 dp[mask][u] + dist[u][v]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int result = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (dp[(1 << n) - 1][i] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    result = Math.min(result, dp[(1 << n) - 1][i] + dist[i][0]);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Assignment Problem
        public static int assignmentProblem(int[][] cost) {
            int n = cost.length;
            int[] dp = new int[1 << n];
            Arrays.fill(dp, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dp[0] = 0;
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                if (dp[mask] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) continue;
                
                int person = Integer.bitCount(mask);
                if (person == n) continue;
                
                for (int task = 0; task < n; task++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << task)) == 0) {
                        int newMask = mask | (1 << task);
                        dp[newMask] = Math.min(dp[newMask], 
                                              dp[mask] + cost[person][task]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dp[(1 << n) - 1];
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: Varies by technique (O(n³) to O(n²)), **Space**: O(n²) to O(2ⁿ)

### 149. Splay Trees
**Problem**: Self-adjusting binary search tree  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class SplayTree {
    static class Node {
        int key, value;
        Node left, right, parent;
        
        Node(int key, int value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }
    }
    
    private Node root;
    
    public void insert(int key, int value) {
        if (root == null) {
            root = new Node(key, value);
            return;
        }
        
        Node node = find(key);
        if (node != null && node.key == key) {
            node.value = value;
            return;
        }
        
        Node newNode = new Node(key, value);
        
        if (node == null || key < node.key) {
            newNode.right = root;
            if (root != null) {
                newNode.left = root.left;
                root.left = null;
                root.parent = newNode;
                if (newNode.left != null) {
                    newNode.left.parent = newNode;
                }
            }
        } else {
            newNode.left = root;
            if (root != null) {
                newNode.right = root.right;
                root.right = null;
                root.parent = newNode;
                if (newNode.right != null) {
                    newNode.right.parent = newNode;
                }
            }
        }
        
        root = newNode;
    }
    
    public Integer search(int key) {
        Node node = find(key);
        return (node != null && node.key == key) ? node.value : null;
    }
    
    public void delete(int key) {
        Node node = find(key);
        if (node == null || node.key != key) return;
        
        if (node.left == null) {
            root = node.right;
            if (root != null) root.parent = null;
        } else if (node.right == null) {
            root = node.left;
            if (root != null) root.parent = null;
        } else {
            Node leftTree = node.left;
            Node rightTree = node.right;
            
            leftTree.parent = null;
            rightTree.parent = null;
            
            root = leftTree;
            Node maxLeft = findMax(leftTree);
            splay(maxLeft);
            
            root.right = rightTree;
            rightTree.parent = root;
        }
    }
    
    private Node find(int key) {
        Node current = root;
        Node lastNode = null;
        
        while (current != null) {
            lastNode = current;
            if (key == current.key) {
                splay(current);
                return current;
            } else if (key < current.key) {
                current = current.left;
            } else {
                current = current.right;
            }
        }
        
        if (lastNode != null) {
            splay(lastNode);
        }
        
        return lastNode;
    }
    
    private void splay(Node node) {
        while (node.parent != null) {
            Node parent = node.parent;
            Node grandparent = parent.parent;
            
            if (grandparent == null) {
                // Zig step
                if (node == parent.left) {
                    rotateRight(parent);
                } else {
                    rotateLeft(parent);
                }
            } else if ((node == parent.left) == (parent == grandparent.left)) {
                // Zig-zig step
                if (node == parent.left) {
                    rotateRight(grandparent);
                    rotateRight(parent);
                } else {
                    rotateLeft(grandparent);
                    rotateLeft(parent);
                }
            } else {
                // Zig-zag step
                if (node == parent.left) {
                    rotateRight(parent);
                    rotateLeft(grandparent);
                } else {
                    rotateLeft(parent);
                    rotateRight(grandparent);
                }
            }
        }
        
        root = node;
    }
    
    private void rotateLeft(Node node) {
        Node rightChild = node.right;
        node.right = rightChild.left;
        
        if (rightChild.left != null) {
            rightChild.left.parent = node;
        }
        
        rightChild.parent = node.parent;
        
        if (node.parent == null) {
            root = rightChild;
        } else if (node == node.parent.left) {
            node.parent.left = rightChild;
        } else {
            node.parent.right = rightChild;
        }
        
        rightChild.left = node;
        node.parent = rightChild;
    }
    
    private void rotateRight(Node node) {
        Node leftChild = node.left;
        node.left = leftChild.right;
        
        if (leftChild.right != null) {
            leftChild.right.parent = node;
        }
        
        leftChild.parent = node.parent;
        
        if (node.parent == null) {
            root = leftChild;
        } else if (node == node.parent.right) {
            node.parent.right = leftChild;
        } else {
            node.parent.left = leftChild;
        }
        
        leftChild.right = node;
        node.parent = leftChild;
    }
    
    private Node findMax(Node node) {
        while (node.right != null) {
            node = node.right;
        }
        return node;
    }
    
    // Range operations
    public void split(int key, SplayTree leftTree, SplayTree rightTree) {
        Node node = find(key);
        
        if (node != null && node.key == key) {
            leftTree.root = node.left;
            rightTree.root = node.right;
            
            if (leftTree.root != null) leftTree.root.parent = null;
            if (rightTree.root != null) rightTree.root.parent = null;
        } else if (node == null || key < node.key) {
            leftTree.root = node != null ? node.left : null;
            rightTree.root = root;
            
            if (leftTree.root != null) {
                leftTree.root.parent = null;
                if (node != null) node.left = null;
            }
        } else {
            leftTree.root = root;
            rightTree.root = node.right;
            
            if (rightTree.root != null) {
                rightTree.root.parent = null;
                node.right = null;
            }
        }
        
        root = null;
    }
    
    public void join(SplayTree other) {
        if (root == null) {
            root = other.root;
            return;
        }
        
        if (other.root == null) return;
        
        Node maxNode = findMax(root);
        splay(maxNode);
        
        root.right = other.root;
        other.root.parent = root;
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) amortized, **Space**: O(n)

### 150. Van Emde Boas Tree
**Problem**: Integer operations in O(log log u) time  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class VanEmdeBoas {
    static class VEBTree {
        int universeSize;
        Integer min, max;
        VEBTree summary;
        VEBTree[] cluster;
        
        VEBTree(int size) {
            universeSize = size;
            
            if (size > 2) {
                int clusterSize = (int) Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(size));
                cluster = new VEBTree[clusterSize];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < clusterSize; i++) {
                    cluster[i] = new VEBTree(clusterSize);
                }
                
                summary = new VEBTree(clusterSize);
            }
        }
        
        private int high(int x) {
            return x / (int) Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(universeSize));
        }
        
        private int low(int x) {
            return x % (int) Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(universeSize));
        }
        
        private int index(int high, int low) {
            return high * (int) Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(universeSize)) + low;
        }
        
        public boolean member(int x) {
            if (x == min || x == max) return true;
            
            if (universeSize <= 2) return false;
            
            return cluster[high(x)].member(low(x));
        }
        
        public void insert(int x) {
            if (min == null) {
                min = max = x;
                return;
            }
            
            if (x < min) {
                int temp = x;
                x = min;
                min = temp;
            }
            
            if (universeSize > 2) {
                if (cluster[high(x)].min == null) {
                    summary.insert(high(x));
                }
                cluster[high(x)].insert(low(x));
            }
            
            if (x > max) {
                max = x;
            }
        }
        
        public void delete(int x) {
            if (min.equals(max)) {
                min = max = null;
                return;
            }
            
            if (universeSize == 2) {
                if (x == 0) {
                    min = 1;
                } else {
                    min = 0;
                }
                max = min;
                return;
            }
            
            if (x == min) {
                Integer firstCluster = summary.min;
                if (firstCluster == null) {
                    min = max;
                    return;
                }
                
                x = index(firstCluster, cluster[firstCluster].min);
                min = x;
            }
            
            cluster[high(x)].delete(low(x));
            
            if (cluster[high(x)].min == null) {
                summary.delete(high(x));
            }
            
            if (x == max) {
                Integer summaryMax = summary.max;
                if (summaryMax == null) {
                    max = min;
                } else {
                    max = index(summaryMax, cluster[summaryMax].max);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public Integer successor(int x) {
            if (universeSize == 2) {
                if (x == 0 && max != null && max == 1) {
                    return 1;
                }
                return null;
            }
            
            if (min != null && x < min) {
                return min;
            }
            
            Integer maxLow = cluster[high(x)].max;
            if (maxLow != null && low(x) < maxLow) {
                Integer offset = cluster[high(x)].successor(low(x));
                return index(high(x), offset);
            }
            
            Integer succCluster = summary.successor(high(x));
            if (succCluster == null) {
                return null;
            }
            
            Integer offset = cluster[succCluster].min;
            return index(succCluster, offset);
        }
        
        public Integer predecessor(int x) {
            if (universeSize == 2) {
                if (x == 1 && min != null && min == 0) {
                    return 0;
                }
                return null;
            }
            
            if (max != null && x > max) {
                return max;
            }
            
            Integer minLow = cluster[high(x)].min;
            if (minLow != null && low(x) > minLow) {
                Integer offset = cluster[high(x)].predecessor(low(x));
                return index(high(x), offset);
            }
            
            Integer predCluster = summary.predecessor(high(x));
            if (predCluster == null) {
                if (min != null && x > min) {
                    return min;
                }
                return null;
            }
            
            Integer offset = cluster[predCluster].max;
            return index(predCluster, offset);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log log u), **Space**: O(u)

### 151. Randomized Algorithms
**Problem**: Las Vegas and Monte Carlo algorithms  
**Difficulty**: Hard

```java
public class RandomizedAlgorithms {
    private static Random random = new Random();
    
    // Randomized QuickSort
    public static void randomizedQuickSort(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
        if (low < high) {
            int pi = randomizedPartition(arr, low, high);
            randomizedQuickSort(arr, low, pi - 1);
            randomizedQuickSort(arr, pi + 1, high);
        }
    }
    
    private static int randomizedPartition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
        int randomIndex = low + random.nextInt(high - low + 1);
        swap(arr, randomIndex, high);
        return partition(arr, low, high);
    }
    
    private static int partition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
        int pivot = arr[high];
        int i = low - 1;
        
        for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
            if (arr[j] <= pivot) {
                i++;
                swap(arr, i, j);
            }
        }
        
        swap(arr, i + 1, high);
        return i + 1;
    }
    
    // Randomized Selection (QuickSelect)
    public static int randomizedSelect(int[] arr, int k) {
        return randomizedSelect(arr, 0, arr.length - 1, k - 1);
    }
    
    private static int randomizedSelect(int[] arr, int low, int high, int k) {
        if (low == high) return arr[low];
        
        int pi = randomizedPartition(arr, low, high);
        
        if (k == pi) {
            return arr[pi];
        } else if (k < pi) {
            return randomizedSelect(arr, low, pi - 1, k);
        } else {
            return randomizedSelect(arr, pi + 1, high, k);
        }
    }
    
    // Skip List
    public static class SkipList {
        static class Node {
            int value;
            Node[] forward;
            
            Node(int value, int level) {
                this.value = value;
                this.forward = new Node[level + 1];
            }
        }
        
        private static final int MAX_LEVEL = 16;
        private static final double P = 0.5;
        
        private Node header;
        private int level;
        
        public SkipList() {
            header = new Node(Integer.MIN_VALUE, MAX_LEVEL);
            level = 0;
        }
        
        private int randomLevel() {
            int lvl = 0;
            while (random.nextDouble() < P && lvl < MAX_LEVEL) {
                lvl++;
            }
            return lvl;
        }
        
        public void insert(int value) {
            Node[] update = new Node[MAX_LEVEL + 1];
            Node current = header;
            
            // Search and build update array
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && current.forward[i].value < value) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
                update[i] = current;
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            
            if (current == null || current.value != value) {
                int newLevel = randomLevel();
                
                if (newLevel > level) {
                    for (int i = level + 1; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                        update[i] = header;
                    }
                    level = newLevel;
                }
                
                Node newNode = new Node(value, newLevel);
                
                for (int i = 0; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                    newNode.forward[i] = update[i].forward[i];
                    update[i].forward[i] = newNode;
                }
            }
        }
        
        public boolean search(int value) {
            Node current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && current.forward[i].value < value) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            return current != null && current.value == value;
        }
        
        public void delete(int value) {
            Node[] update = new Node[MAX_LEVEL + 1];
            Node current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && current.forward[i].value < value) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
                update[i] = current;
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            
            if (current != null && current.value == value) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= level; i++) {
                    if (update[i].forward[i] != current) break;
                    update[i].forward[i] = current.forward[i];
                }
                
                while (level > 0 && header.forward[level] == null) {
                    level--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Reservoir Sampling
    public static int[] reservoirSampling(int[] stream, int k) {
        int[] reservoir = new int[k];
        
        // Fill reservoir with first k elements
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            reservoir[i] = stream[i];
        }
        
        // Process remaining elements
        for (int i = k; i < stream.length; i++) {
            int j = random.nextInt(i + 1);
            if (j < k) {
                reservoir[j] = stream[i];
            }
        }
        
        return reservoir;
    }
    
    // Randomized Primality Testing (Miller-Rabin)
    public static boolean isProbablyPrime(long n, int k) {
        if (n <= 1) return false;
        if (n <= 3) return true;
        if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
        
        // Write n-1 as d * 2^r
        long d = n - 1;
        int r = 0;
        while (d % 2 == 0) {
            d /= 2;
            r++;
        }
        
        // Perform k rounds of testing
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            long a = 2 + (long) (random.nextDouble() * (n - 4));
            if (!millerRabinTest(n, d, r, a)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private static boolean millerRabinTest(long n, long d, int r, long a) {
        long x = modularExponentiation(a, d, n);
        
        if (x == 1 || x == n - 1) return true;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < r - 1; i++) {
            x = (x * x) % n;
            if (x == n - 1) return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private static long modularExponentiation(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp % 2 == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            exp /= 2;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    // Monte Carlo Integration
    public static double monteCarloIntegration(Function<Double, Double> func, 
                                              double a, double b, int samples) {
        double sum = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
            double x = a + random.nextDouble() * (b - a);
            sum += func.apply(x);
        }
        
        return (b - a) * sum / samples;
    }
    
    // Randomized Min-Cut (Karger's Algorithm)
    public static class KargerMinCut {
        static class Graph {
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> adjacencyList;
            int vertices;
            
            Graph(int vertices) {
                this.vertices = vertices;
                adjacencyList = new HashMap<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < vertices; i++) {
                    adjacencyList.put(i, new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            
            void addEdge(int u, int v) {
                adjacencyList.get(u).add(v);
                adjacencyList.get(v).add(u);
            }
            
            Graph copy() {
                Graph newGraph = new Graph(vertices);
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Integer>> entry : adjacencyList.entrySet()) {
                    newGraph.adjacencyList.put(entry.getKey(), new ArrayList<>(entry.getValue()));
                }
                return newGraph;
            }
        }
        
        public static int kargerMinCut(Graph graph, int iterations) {
            int minCut = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
                Graph g = graph.copy();
                int cut = kargerAlgorithm(g);
                minCut = Math.min(minCut, cut);
            }
            
            return minCut;
        }
        
        private static int kargerAlgorithm(Graph graph) {
            while (graph.vertices > 2) {
                // Pick random edge
                List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<Integer>> entry : graph.adjacencyList.entrySet()) {
                    int u = entry.getKey();
                    for (int v : entry.getValue()) {
                        if (u < v) { // Avoid duplicate edges
                            edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (edges.isEmpty()) break;
                
                int[] randomEdge = edges.get(random.nextInt(edges.size()));
                contractEdge(graph, randomEdge[0], randomEdge[1]);
            }
            
            // Count remaining edges
            int cut = 0;
            for (List<Integer> neighbors : graph.adjacencyList.values()) {
                cut += neighbors.size();
            }
            
            return cut / 2; // Each edge counted twice
        }
        
        private static void contractEdge(Graph graph, int u, int v) {
            // Merge v into u
            List<Integer> vNeighbors = new ArrayList<>(graph.adjacencyList.get(v));
            
            for (int neighbor : vNeighbors) {
                if (neighbor != u) {
                    graph.adjacencyList.get(u).add(neighbor);
                    graph.adjacencyList.get(neighbor).remove((Integer) v);
                    graph.adjacencyList.get(neighbor).add(u);
                }
            }
            
            // Remove self-loops
            graph.adjacencyList.get(u).removeIf(x -> x.equals(v));
            graph.adjacencyList.remove(v);
            graph.vertices--;
        }
    }
    
    private static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }
    
    @FunctionalInterface
    interface Function<T, R> {
        R apply(T t);
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n) expected for sorting, O(log n) expected for skip list, **Space**: O(n)

### 152. Bloom Filters & Probabilistic Data Structures
**Problem**: Memory-efficient approximate membership queries  
**Difficulty**: Medium

```java
public class BloomFilter {
    private boolean[] bitArray;
    private int size;
    private int numHashFunctions;
    private int numElements;
    
    public BloomFilter(int expectedElements, double falsePositiveRate) {
        // Calculate optimal size and number of hash functions
        this.size = (int) Math.ceil(-expectedElements * Math.log(falsePositiveRate) / 
                                   (Math.log(2) * Math.log(2)));
        this.numHashFunctions = (int) Math.ceil((size / (double) expectedElements) * Math.log(2));
        this.bitArray = new boolean[size];
        this.numElements = 0;
    }
    
    public void add(String item) {
        for (int i = 0; i < numHashFunctions; i++) {
            int hash = hash(item, i);
            bitArray[hash] = true;
        }
        numElements++;
    }
    
    public boolean mightContain(String item) {
        for (int i = 0; i < numHashFunctions; i++) {
            int hash = hash(item, i);
            if (!bitArray[hash]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    private int hash(String item, int seed) {
        int hash = 0;
        for (char c : item.toCharArray()) {
            hash = hash * 31 + c + seed;
        }
        return Math.abs(hash) % size;
    }
    
    public double getCurrentFalsePositiveRate() {
        double ratio = (double) numElements / size;
        return Math.pow(1 - Math.exp(-numHashFunctions * ratio), numHashFunctions);
    }
    
    // Count-Min Sketch
    public static class CountMinSketch {
        private int[][] table;
        private int width, depth;
        private int[] hashSeeds;
        
        public CountMinSketch(double epsilon, double delta) {
            this.width = (int) Math.ceil(Math.E / epsilon);
            this.depth = (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(1.0 / delta));
            this.table = new int[depth][width];
            this.hashSeeds = new int[depth];
            
            Random random = new Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                hashSeeds[i] = random.nextInt();
            }
        }
        
        public void increment(String item) {
            increment(item, 1);
        }
        
        public void increment(String item, int count) {
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                table[i][hash] += count;
            }
        }
        
        public int estimate(String item) {
            int min = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                min = Math.min(min, table[i][hash]);
            }
            return min;
        }
        
        private int hash(String item, int row) {
            int hash = hashSeeds[row];
            for (char c : item.toCharArray()) {
                hash = hash * 31 + c;
            }
            return Math.abs(hash) % width;
        }
        
        // Heavy hitters detection
        public List<String> getHeavyHitters(List<String> items, double threshold) {
            List<String> heavyHitters = new ArrayList<>();
            Map<String, Integer> candidates = new HashMap<>();
            
            // Count all items
            for (String item : items) {
                increment(item);
                candidates.put(item, candidates.getOrDefault(item, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            int totalCount = items.size();
            int thresholdCount = (int) (threshold * totalCount);
            
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : candidates.entrySet()) {
                if (estimate(entry.getKey()) >= thresholdCount) {
                    heavyHitters.add(entry.getKey());
                }
            }
            
            return heavyHitters;
        }
    }
    
    // HyperLogLog for cardinality estimation
    public static class HyperLogLog {
        private int[] buckets;
        private int bucketCount;
        private double alpha;
        
        public HyperLogLog(int precision) {
            this.bucketCount = 1 << precision; // 2^precision
            this.buckets = new int[bucketCount];
            
            // Alpha constant for bias correction
            if (bucketCount >= 128) {
                alpha = 0.7213 / (1 + 1.079 / bucketCount);
            } else if (bucketCount >= 64) {
                alpha = 0.709;
            } else if (bucketCount >= 32) {
                alpha = 0.697;
            } else {
                alpha = 0.5;
            }
        }
        
        public void add(String item) {
            long hash = hash64(item);
            
            // Use first p bits for bucket selection
            int bucket = (int) (hash & (bucketCount - 1));
            
            // Count leading zeros in remaining bits
            long remainingBits = hash >>> Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(bucketCount);
            int leadingZeros = Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(remainingBits) + 1;
            
            buckets[bucket] = Math.max(buckets[bucket], leadingZeros);
        }
        
        public long estimate() {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int bucket : buckets) {
                sum += Math.pow(2, -bucket);
            }
            
            double estimate = alpha * bucketCount * bucketCount / sum;
            
            // Small range correction
            if (estimate <= 2.5 * bucketCount) {
                int zeros = 0;
                for (int bucket : buckets) {
                    if (bucket == 0) zeros++;
                }
                if (zeros != 0) {
                    estimate = bucketCount * Math.log(bucketCount / (double) zeros);
                }
            }
            
            // Large range correction
            if (estimate > (1.0 / 30.0) * (1L << 32)) {
                estimate = -((1L << 32) * Math.log(1 - estimate / (1L << 32)));
            }
            
            return Math.round(estimate);
        }
        
        private long hash64(String item) {
            long hash = 0;
            for (char c : item.toCharArray()) {
                hash = hash * 31 + c;
            }
            return hash;
        }
        
        // Merge with another HyperLogLog
        public void merge(HyperLogLog other) {
            if (other.bucketCount != this.bucketCount) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot merge HyperLogLogs with different precisions");
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < bucketCount; i++) {
                buckets[i] = Math.max(buckets[i], other.buckets[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MinHash for similarity estimation
    public static class MinHash {
        private int[] hashValues;
        private int numHashes;
        private int[] hashSeeds;
        
        public MinHash(int numHashes) {
            this.numHashes = numHashes;
            this.hashValues = new int[numHashes];
            this.hashSeeds = new int[numHashes];
            
            Arrays.fill(hashValues, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            
            Random random = new Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashes; i++) {
                hashSeeds[i] = random.nextInt();
            }
        }
        
        public void add(String item) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashes; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                hashValues[i] = Math.min(hashValues[i], hash);
            }
        }
        
        public double similarity(MinHash other) {
            if (other.numHashes != this.numHashes) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("MinHash objects must have same number of hash functions");
            }
            
            int matches = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashes; i++) {
                if (hashValues[i] == other.hashValues[i]) {
                    matches++;
                }
            }
            
            return (double) matches / numHashes;
        }
        
        private int hash(String item, int seed) {
            int hash = hashSeeds[seed];
            for (char c : item.toCharArray()) {
                hash = hash * 31 + c;
            }
            return hash;
        }
        
        // LSH (Locality Sensitive Hashing) bands
        public List<String> getLSHSignature(int bands) {
            List<String> signature = new ArrayList<>();
            int rowsPerBand = numHashes / bands;
            
            for (int band = 0; band < bands; band++) {
                StringBuilder bandHash = new StringBuilder();
                for (int row = 0; row < rowsPerBand; row++) {
                    int index = band * rowsPerBand + row;
                    if (index < numHashes) {
                        bandHash.append(hashValues[index]).append(",");
                    }
                }
                signature.add(bandHash.toString());
            }
            
            return signature;
        }
    }
    
    // Applications
    public static class ProbabilisticApplications {
        
        // Duplicate detection in streaming data
        public static List<String> detectDuplicates(List<String> stream, 
                                                   double falsePositiveRate) {
            BloomFilter seen = new BloomFilter(stream.size(), falsePositiveRate);
            List<String> duplicates = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (String item : stream) {
                if (seen.mightContain(item)) {
                    duplicates.add(item);
                } else {
                    seen.add(item);
                }
            }
            
            return duplicates;
        }
        
        // Top-K frequent elements
        public static List<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> topKFrequent(List<String> items, int k) {
            CountMinSketch sketch = new CountMinSketch(0.01, 0.01);
            Map<String, Integer> candidates = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (String item : items) {
                sketch.increment(item);
                candidates.put(item, sketch.estimate(item));
            }
            
            return candidates.entrySet().stream()
                    .sorted((a, b) -> b.getValue().compareTo(a.getValue()))
                    .limit(k)
                    .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());
        }
        
        // Approximate distinct count
        public static long approximateDistinctCount(List<String> items) {
            HyperLogLog hll = new HyperLogLog(12); // 2^12 = 4096 buckets
            
            for (String item : items) {
                hll.add(item);
            }
            
            return hll.estimate();
        }
        
        // Document similarity
        public static double documentSimilarity(Set<String> doc1, Set<String> doc2, 
                                              int numHashes) {
            MinHash mh1 = new MinHash(numHashes);
            MinHash mh2 = new MinHash(numHashes);
            
            for (String word : doc1) {
                mh1.add(word);
            }
            
            for (String word : doc2) {
                mh2.add(word);
            }
            
            return mh1.similarity(mh2);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(k) for operations where k is number of hash functions, **Space**: O(m) where m is bit array size

### 153. Advanced Graph Algorithms
**Problem**: Specialized graph algorithms  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedGraphAlgorithms {
    
    // Johnson's Algorithm for All-Pairs Shortest Paths
    public static class JohnsonAlgorithm {
        static class Edge {
            int to, weight;
            Edge(int to, int weight) {
                this.to = to;
                this.weight = weight;
            }
        }
        
        public static int[][] allPairsShortestPaths(List<List<Edge>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            
            // Add auxiliary vertex connected to all vertices with weight 0
            List<List<Edge>> augmentedGraph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                augmentedGraph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            
            // Copy original graph
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                augmentedGraph.get(i).addAll(graph.get(i));
            }
            
            // Add edges from auxiliary vertex
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                augmentedGraph.get(n).add(new Edge(i, 0));
            }
            
            // Run Bellman-Ford from auxiliary vertex
            int[] h = bellmanFord(augmentedGraph, n);
            if (h == null) return null; // Negative cycle detected
            
            // Reweight edges
            List<List<Edge>> reweightedGraph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                reweightedGraph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                for (Edge edge : graph.get(i)) {
                    int newWeight = edge.weight + h[i] - h[edge.to];
                    reweightedGraph.get(i).add(new Edge(edge.to, newWeight));
                }
            }
            
            // Run Dijkstra from each vertex
            int[][] distances = new int[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int[] dist = dijkstra(reweightedGraph, i);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (dist[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        distances[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    } else {
                        distances[i][j] = dist[j] - h[i] + h[j];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return distances;
        }
        
        private static int[] bellmanFord(List<List<Edge>> graph, int source) {
            int n = graph.size();
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[source] = 0;
            
            // Relax edges n-1 times
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    if (dist[u] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        for (Edge edge : graph.get(u)) {
                            if (dist[u] + edge.weight < dist[edge.to]) {
                                dist[edge.to] = dist[u] + edge.weight;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Check for negative cycles
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                if (dist[u] != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    for (Edge edge : graph.get(u)) {
                        if (dist[u] + edge.weight < dist[edge.to]) {
                            return null; // Negative cycle
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return Arrays.copyOf(dist, n - 1); // Exclude auxiliary vertex
        }
        
        private static int[] dijkstra(List<List<Edge>> graph, int source) {
            int n = graph.size();
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[source] = 0;
            
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[1] - b[1]);
            pq.offer(new int[]{source, 0});
            
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] current = pq.poll();
                int u = current[0];
                int d = current[1];
                
                if (d > dist[u]) continue;
                
                for (Edge edge : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (dist[u] + edge.weight < dist[edge.to]) {
                        dist[edge.to] = dist[u] + edge.weight;
                        pq.offer(new int[]{edge.to, dist[edge.to]});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return dist;
        }
    }
    
    // Stoer-Wagner Min-Cut Algorithm
    public static class StoerWagnerMinCut {
        public static int globalMinCut(int[][] graph) {
            int n = graph.length;
            int minCut = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            
            // Create adjacency list representation
            List<Set<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new HashSet<>());
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (i != j && graph[i][j] > 0) {
                        adj.get(i).add(j);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Keep track of merged vertices
            List<Set<Integer>> components = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Set<Integer> component = new HashSet<>();
                component.add(i);
                components.add(component);
            }
            
            while (components.size() > 1) {
                MinCutPhaseResult result = minCutPhase(graph, adj, components);
                minCut = Math.min(minCut, result.cutWeight);
                
                // Merge last two vertices found
                int s = result.s;
                int t = result.t;
                mergeVertices(graph, adj, components, s, t);
            }
            
            return minCut;
        }
        
        private static MinCutPhaseResult minCutPhase(int[][] graph, 
                                                   List<Set<Integer>> adj,
                                                   List<Set<Integer>> components) {
            int n = components.size();
            boolean[] added = new boolean[n];
            int[] weight = new int[n];
            
            // Start with arbitrary vertex
            added[0] = true;
            
            // Update weights
            for (int v : adj.get(0)) {
                int componentIndex = findComponent(components, v);
                weight[componentIndex] += getWeight(graph, components.get(0), components.get(componentIndex));
            }
            
            int s = 0, t = 0;
            
            // Add vertices in order of maximum weight
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                int maxWeight = -1;
                int maxVertex = -1;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (!added[j] && weight[j] > maxWeight) {
                        maxWeight = weight[j];
                        maxVertex = j;
                    }
                }
                
                added[maxVertex] = true;
                s = t;
                t = maxVertex;
                
                // Update weights
                for (int neighbor : adj.get(maxVertex)) {
                    int componentIndex = findComponent(components, neighbor);
                    if (!added[componentIndex]) {
                        weight[componentIndex] += getWeight(graph, components.get(maxVertex), 
                                                          components.get(componentIndex));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return new MinCutPhaseResult(s, t, weight[t]);
        }
        
        private static void mergeVertices(int[][] graph, List<Set<Integer>> adj,
                                        List<Set<Integer>> components, int s, int t) {
            // Merge component t into component s
            components.get(s).addAll(components.get(t));
            
            // Update adjacency
            adj.get(s).addAll(adj.get(t));
            adj.get(s).remove(s);
            adj.get(s).remove(t);
            
            // Update other adjacencies
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.size(); i++) {
                if (i != s && i != t) {
                    if (adj.get(i).contains(t)) {
                        adj.get(i).remove(t);
                        adj.get(i).add(s);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Remove component t
            components.remove(t);
            adj.remove(t);
            
            // Update indices
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.size(); i++) {
                Set<Integer> newAdj = new HashSet<>();
                for (int v : adj.get(i)) {
                    if (v > t) {
                        newAdj.add(v - 1);
                    } else if (v < t) {
                        newAdj.add(v);
                    }
                }
                adj.set(i, newAdj);
            }
        }
        
        private static int findComponent(List<Set<Integer>> components, int vertex) {
            for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
                if (components.get(i).contains(vertex)) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
            return -1;
        }
        
        private static int getWeight(int[][] graph, Set<Integer> comp1, Set<Integer> comp2) {
            int weight = 0;
            for (int u : comp1) {
                for (int v : comp2) {
                    weight += graph[u][v];
                }
            }
            return weight;
        }
        
        static class MinCutPhaseResult {
            int s, t, cutWeight;
            
            MinCutPhaseResult(int s, int t, int cutWeight) {
                this.s = s;
                this.t = t;
                this.cutWeight = cutWeight;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Gomory-Hu Tree
    public static class GomoryHuTree {
        static class Edge {
            int to, capacity;
            Edge(int to, int capacity) {
                this.to = to;
                this.capacity = capacity;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<List<Edge>> buildGomoryHuTree(int[][] capacity) {
            int n = capacity.length;
            List<List<Edge>> tree = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                tree.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            
            int[] parent = new int[n];
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                parent[i] = 0;
            }
            
            for (int s = 1; s < n; s++) {
                int t = parent[s];
                
                // Find max flow between s and t
                int flow = maxFlow(capacity, s, t);
                
                // Update tree
                tree.get(s).add(new Edge(t, flow));
                tree.get(t).add(new Edge(s, flow));
                
                // Update parent array based on cut
                boolean[] reachable = findReachable(capacity, s, t);
                for (int i = s + 1; i < n; i++) {
                    if (parent[i] == t && reachable[i]) {
                        parent[i] = s;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return tree;
        }
        
        private static int maxFlow(int[][] capacity, int source, int sink) {
            int n = capacity.length;
            int[][] residual = new int[n][n];
            
            // Initialize residual graph
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(capacity[i], 0, residual[i], 0, n);
            }
            
            int maxFlowValue = 0;
            int[] parent = new int[n];
            
            while (bfs(residual, source, sink, parent)) {
                int pathFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                
                // Find minimum residual capacity along the path
                for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    pathFlow = Math.min(pathFlow, residual[u][v]);
                }
                
                // Update residual capacities
                for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                    int u = parent[v];
                    residual[u][v] -= pathFlow;
                    residual[v][u] += pathFlow;
                }
                
                maxFlowValue += pathFlow;
            }
            
            return maxFlowValue;
        }
        
        private static boolean bfs(int[][] residual, int source, int sink, int[] parent) {
            int n = residual.length;
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            
            queue.offer(source);
            visited[source] = true;
            parent[source] = -1;
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int u = queue.poll();
                
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (!visited[v] && residual[u][v] > 0) {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        parent[v] = u;
                        queue.offer(v);
                        
                        if (v == sink) return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private static boolean[] findReachable(int[][] capacity, int source, int sink) {
            // After max flow, find vertices reachable from source
            maxFlow(capacity, source, sink); // This modifies capacity to residual
            
            int n = capacity.length;
            boolean[] reachable = new boolean[n];
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            
            queue.offer(source);
            reachable[source] = true;
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int u = queue.poll();
                
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (!reachable[v] && capacity[u][v] > 0) {
                        reachable[v] = true;
                        queue.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return reachable;
        }
    }
    
    // Planarity Testing (Boyer-Myrvold Algorithm)
    public static class PlanarityTesting {
        static class Graph {
            List<List<Integer>> adj;
            int n;
            
            Graph(int n) {
                this.n = n;
                this.adj = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            
            void addEdge(int u, int v) {
                adj.get(u).add(v);
                adj.get(v).add(u);
            }
        }
        
        public static boolean isPlanar(Graph graph) {
            int n = graph.n;
            int m = 0;
            
            // Count edges
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                m += graph.adj.get(i).size();
            }
            m /= 2; // Each edge counted twice
            
            // Check necessary conditions
            if (n >= 3 && m > 3 * n - 6) return false;
            if (n >= 3 && !hasNoK5K33(graph)) return false;
            
            // For small graphs, use direct methods
            if (n <= 4) return true;
            
            // Use DFS-based planarity testing
            return dfsBasedPlanarityTest(graph);
        }
        
        private static boolean hasNoK5K33(Graph graph) {
            // Simplified check - in practice, this would be more complex
            return true; // Placeholder
        }
        
        private static boolean dfsBasedPlanarityTest(Graph graph) {
            int n = graph.n;
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
            int[] parent = new int[n];
            int[] low = new int[n];
            int[] disc = new int[n];
            List<int[]> backEdges = new ArrayList<>();
            
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            int[] time = {0};
            
            // Find all back edges using DFS
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    dfsForBackEdges(graph, i, visited, parent, low, disc, time, backEdges);
                }
            }
            
            // Check if back edges can be embedded without crossing
            return checkBackEdgeEmbedding(graph, backEdges, parent);
        }
        
        private static void dfsForBackEdges(Graph graph, int u, boolean[] visited,
                                          int[] parent, int[] low, int[] disc,
                                          int[] time, List<int[]> backEdges) {
            visited[u] = true;
            disc[u] = low[u] = ++time[0];
            
            for (int v : graph.adj.get(u)) {
                if (!visited[v]) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    dfsForBackEdges(graph, v, visited, parent, low, disc, time, backEdges);
                    low[u] = Math.min(low[u], low[v]);
                } else if (v != parent[u]) {
                    low[u] = Math.min(low[u], disc[v]);
                    if (disc[v] < disc[u]) {
                        backEdges.add(new int[]{u, v});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static boolean checkBackEdgeEmbedding(Graph graph, List<int[]> backEdges,
                                                    int[] parent) {
            // Simplified planarity check
            // In practice, this would implement the full Boyer-Myrvold algorithm
            return backEdges.size() <= graph.n; // Simplified condition
        }
    }
    
    // Graph Coloring Algorithms
    public static class GraphColoring {
        
        // Greedy coloring
        public static int greedyColoring(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            int[] colors = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(colors, -1);
            
            colors[0] = 0;
            
            for (int v = 1; v < n; v++) {
                boolean[] used = new boolean[n];
                
                // Mark colors used by adjacent vertices
                for (int neighbor : graph.get(v)) {
                    if (colors[neighbor] != -1) {
                        used[colors[neighbor]] = true;
                    }
                }
                
                // Find first available color
                for (int color = 0; color < n; color++) {
                    if (!used[color]) {
                        colors[v] = color;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Return number of colors used
            return Arrays.stream(colors).max().orElse(0) + 1;
        }
        
        // Welsh-Powell algorithm
        public static int welshPowellColoring(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            
            // Create list of vertices with their degrees
            List<int[]> vertices = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                vertices.add(new int[]{i, graph.get(i).size()});
            }
            
            // Sort by degree in descending order
            vertices.sort((a, b) -> b[1] - a[1]);
            
            int[] colors = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(colors, -1);
            int colorCount = 0;
            
            for (int[] vertex : vertices) {
                int v = vertex[0];
                if (colors[v] == -1) {
                    boolean[] used = new boolean[n];
                    
                    // Mark colors used by adjacent vertices
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(v)) {
                        if (colors[neighbor] != -1) {
                            used[colors[neighbor]] = true;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Find first available color
                    int color = 0;
                    while (color < n && used[color]) {
                        color++;
                    }
                    
                    colors[v] = color;
                    colorCount = Math.max(colorCount, color + 1);
                }
            }
            
            return colorCount;
        }
        
        // Backtracking coloring for exact solution
        public static boolean exactColoring(List<List<Integer>> graph, int k) {
            int n = graph.size();
            int[] colors = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(colors, -1);
            
            return backtrackColoring(graph, colors, 0, k);
        }
        
        private static boolean backtrackColoring(List<List<Integer>> graph,
                                               int[] colors, int vertex, int k) {
            int n = graph.size();
            
            if (vertex == n) return true;
            
            for (int color = 0; color < k; color++) {
                if (isColorSafe(graph, colors, vertex, color)) {
                    colors[vertex] = color;
                    
                    if (backtrackColoring(graph, colors, vertex + 1, k)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    
                    colors[vertex] = -1; // Backtrack
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private static boolean isColorSafe(List<List<Integer>> graph, int[] colors,
                                         int vertex, int color) {
            for (int neighbor : graph.get(vertex)) {
                if (colors[neighbor] == color) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```
