### 154. Computational Number Theory
**Problem**: Advanced number theoretic algorithms  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class ComputationalNumberTheory {
    
    // Quadratic Sieve for integer factorization
    public static class QuadraticSieve {
        
        public static List<Long> factor(long n) {
            if (n < 2) return new ArrayList<>();
            if (isPrime(n)) return Arrays.asList(n);
            
            // Small factors first
            List<Long> factors = new ArrayList<>();
            for (long p = 2; p * p <= n && p < 1000; p++) {
                while (n % p == 0) {
                    factors.add(p);
                    n /= p;
                }
            }
            
            if (n == 1) return factors;
            if (isPrime(n)) {
                factors.add(n);
                return factors;
            }
            
            // Quadratic sieve for remaining composite
            long factor = quadraticSieve(n);
            if (factor > 1 && factor < n) {
                factors.addAll(factor(factor));
                factors.addAll(factor(n / factor));
            }
            
            return factors;
        }
        
        private static long quadraticSieve(long n) {
            int smoothBound = (int) Math.sqrt(Math.log(n) * Math.log(Math.log(n)));
            smoothBound = Math.max(smoothBound, 100);
            
            List<Integer> primes = sieveOfEratosthenes(smoothBound);
            
            // Find smooth numbers
            List<SmoothNumber> smoothNumbers = new ArrayList<>();
            long sqrtN = (long) Math.sqrt(n);
            
            for (long x = sqrtN; x <= sqrtN + 10000; x++) {
                long value = x * x - n;
                if (value > 0) {
                    SmoothNumber smooth = trialDivision(value, x, primes);
                    if (smooth != null) {
                        smoothNumbers.add(smooth);
                        if (smoothNumbers.size() > primes.size() + 10) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Gaussian elimination to find dependencies
            return findDependency(smoothNumbers, n);
        }
        
        private static SmoothNumber trialDivision(long value, long x, List<Integer> primes) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> factorization = new HashMap<>();
            long temp = Math.abs(value);
            
            for (int prime : primes) {
                int count = 0;
                while (temp % prime == 0) {
                    temp /= prime;
                    count++;
                }
                if (count > 0) {
                    factorization.put(prime, count);
                }
            }
            
            if (temp == 1) {
                return new SmoothNumber(x, value, factorization);
            }
            
            return null;
        }
        
        private static long findDependency(List<SmoothNumber> smoothNumbers, long n) {
            // Simplified dependency finding
            // In practice, this would use full Gaussian elimination over GF(2)
            
            for (int i = 0; i < smoothNumbers.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < smoothNumbers.size(); j++) {
                    SmoothNumber s1 = smoothNumbers.get(i);
                    SmoothNumber s2 = smoothNumbers.get(j);
                    
                    if (hasEvenExponents(s1, s2)) {
                        long x1 = s1.x;
                        long x2 = s2.x;
                        
                        long gcd = gcd(Math.abs(x1 - x2), n);
                        if (gcd > 1 && gcd < n) {
                            return gcd;
                        }
                        
                        gcd = gcd(Math.abs(x1 + x2), n);
                        if (gcd > 1 && gcd < n) {
                            return gcd;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return 1;
        }
        
        private static boolean hasEvenExponents(SmoothNumber s1, SmoothNumber s2) {
            Set<Integer> allPrimes = new HashSet<>();
            allPrimes.addAll(s1.factorization.keySet());
            allPrimes.addAll(s2.factorization.keySet());
            
            for (int prime : allPrimes) {
                int exp1 = s1.factorization.getOrDefault(prime, 0);
                int exp2 = s2.factorization.getOrDefault(prime, 0);
                if ((exp1 + exp2) % 2 != 0) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        static class SmoothNumber {
            long x;
            long value;
            Map<Integer, Integer> factorization;
            
            SmoothNumber(long x, long value, Map<Integer, Integer> factorization) {
                this.x = x;
                this.value = value;
                this.factorization = factorization;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Tonelli-Shanks algorithm for square roots modulo prime
    public static long tonelliShanks(long n, long p) {
        if (modularExponentiation(n, (p - 1) / 2, p) != 1) {
            return -1; // n is not a quadratic residue
        }
        
        // Find Q and S such that p - 1 = Q * 2^S with Q odd
        long Q = p - 1;
        int S = 0;
        while (Q % 2 == 0) {
            Q /= 2;
            S++;
        }
        
        if (S == 1) {
            return modularExponentiation(n, (p + 1) / 4, p);
        }
        
        // Find quadratic non-residue z
        long z = 2;
        while (modularExponentiation(z, (p - 1) / 2, p) != p - 1) {
            z++;
        }
        
        long M = S;
        long c = modularExponentiation(z, Q, p);
        long t = modularExponentiation(n, Q, p);
        long R = modularExponentiation(n, (Q + 1) / 2, p);
        
        while (t != 1) {
            // Find smallest i such that t^(2^i) = 1
            long temp = t;
            int i = 1;
            while (temp != 1) {
                temp = (temp * temp) % p;
                i++;
            }
            
            // Update values
            long b = modularExponentiation(c, 1L << (M - i - 1), p);
            M = i;
            c = (b * b) % p;
            t = (t * c) % p;
            R = (R * b) % p;
        }
        
        return R;
    }
    
    // Discrete logarithm using Baby-step Giant-step
    public static long discreteLogarithm(long base, long target, long mod) {
        long n = (long) Math.sqrt(mod) + 1;
        
        // Baby steps: compute base^j for j = 0, 1, ..., n-1
        Map<Long, Long> babySteps = new HashMap<>();
        long gamma = 1;
        
        for (long j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (!babySteps.containsKey(gamma)) {
                babySteps.put(gamma, j);
            }
            gamma = (gamma * base) % mod;
        }
        
        // Giant steps: compute target * (base^(-n))^i for i = 0, 1, ..., n-1
        long baseInvN = modularInverse(modularExponentiation(base, n, mod), mod);
        long y = target;
        
        for (long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (babySteps.containsKey(y)) {
                return i * n + babySteps.get(y);
            }
            y = (y * baseInvN) % mod;
        }
        
        return -1; // No solution found
    }
    
    // Pell's equation solver
    public static class PellEquation {
        static class Solution {
            long x, y;
            Solution(long x, long y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
        }
        
        public static Solution solvePell(long D) {
            if (isPerfectSquare(D)) return null; // No solution for perfect squares
            
            // Find fundamental solution using continued fractions
            List<Long> continuedFraction = getContinuedFraction(D);
            
            long p_prev = 1, p_curr = continuedFraction.get(0);
            long q_prev = 0, q_curr = 1;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < continuedFraction.size(); i++) {
                long a = continuedFraction.get(i);
                
                long p_next = a * p_curr + p_prev;
                long q_next = a * q_curr + q_prev;
                
                // Check if this gives a solution to x² - Dy² = 1
                if (p_next * p_next - D * q_next * q_next == 1) {
                    return new Solution(p_next, q_next);
                }
                
                p_prev = p_curr;
                p_curr = p_next;
                q_prev = q_curr;
                q_curr = q_next;
            }
            
            return null;
        }
        
        private static List<Long> getContinuedFraction(long D) {
            List<Long> result = new ArrayList<>();
            long m = 0, d = 1, a = (long) Math.sqrt(D);
            long a0 = a;
            
            result.add(a0);
            
            Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
            
            while (true) {
                m = d * a - m;
                d = (D - m * m) / d;
                a = (a0 + m) / d;
                
                String state = m + "," + d;
                if (seen.contains(state)) break;
                seen.add(state);
                
                result.add(a);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        public static List<Solution> generateSolutions(long D, int count) {
            Solution fundamental = solvePell(D);
            if (fundamental == null) return new ArrayList<>();
            
            List<Solution> solutions = new ArrayList<>();
            solutions.add(fundamental);
            
            long x = fundamental.x;
            long y = fundamental.y;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < count; i++) {
                long newX = x * fundamental.x + D * y * fundamental.y;
                long newY = x * fundamental.y + y * fundamental.x;
                
                solutions.add(new Solution(newX, newY));
                x = newX;
                y = newY;
            }
            
            return solutions;
        }
    }
    
    // Legendre symbol computation
    public static int legendreSymbol(long a, long p) {
        if (a % p == 0) return 0;
        
        long result = modularExponentiation(a, (p - 1) / 2, p);
        return result == 1 ? 1 : -1;
    }
    
    // Jacobi symbol computation
    public static int jacobiSymbol(long a, long n) {
        if (n <= 0 || n % 2 == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("n must be odd and positive");
        
        a %= n;
        int result = 1;
        
        while (a != 0) {
            while (a % 2 == 0) {
                a /= 2;
                if (n % 8 == 3 || n % 8 == 5) {
                    result = -result;
                }
            }
            
            long temp = a;
            a = n;
            n = temp;
            
            if (a % 4 == 3 && n % 4 == 3) {
                result = -result;
            }
            
            a %= n;
        }
        
        return n == 1 ? result : 0;
    }
    
    // Utility methods
    private static boolean isPrime(long n) {
        if (n < 2) return false;
        if (n == 2) return true;
        if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
        
        for (long i = 3; i * i <= n; i += 2) {
            if (n % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    private static boolean isPerfectSquare(long n) {
        long sqrt = (long) Math.sqrt(n);
        return sqrt * sqrt == n;
    }
    
    private static List<Integer> sieveOfEratosthenes(int n) {
        boolean[] isPrime = new boolean[n + 1];
        Arrays.fill(isPrime, true);
        isPrime[0] = isPrime[1] = false;
        
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            if (isPrime[i]) {
                for (int j = i * i; j <= n; j += i) {
                    isPrime[j] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<Integer> primes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            if (isPrime[i]) {
                primes.add(i);
            }
        }
        
        return primes;
    }
    
    private static long modularExponentiation(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp % 2 == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            exp /= 2;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private static long modularInverse(long a, long m) {
        long[] result = extendedGCD(a, m);
        if (result[0] != 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Modular inverse doesn't exist");
        return ((result[1] % m) + m) % m;
    }
    
    private static long[] extendedGCD(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return new long[]{a, 1, 0};
        
        long[] result = extendedGCD(b, a % b);
        long gcd = result[0];
        long x1 = result[1];
        long y1 = result[2];
        
        long x = y1;
        long y = x1 - (a / b) * y1;
        
        return new long[]{gcd, x, y};
    }
    
    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
```
**Time**: Varies (O(n^(1/4)) for QS, O(√p log p) for Tonelli-Shanks), **Space**: O(√n)

### 155. Approximation Algorithms
**Problem**: Near-optimal solutions for NP-hard problems  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class ApproximationAlgorithms {
    
    // Vertex Cover Approximation (2-approximation)
    public static class VertexCoverApproximation {
        public static Set<Integer> approximateVertexCover(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            Set<Integer> cover = new HashSet<>();
            Set<String> edges = new HashSet<>();
            
            // Create edge set
            for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (u < v) {
                        edges.add(u + "," + v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            while (!edges.isEmpty()) {
                // Pick any edge (u, v)
                String edge = edges.iterator().next();
                String[] vertices = edge.split(",");
                int u = Integer.parseInt(vertices[0]);
                int v = Integer.parseInt(vertices[1]);
                
                // Add both vertices to cover
                cover.add(u);
                cover.add(v);
                
                // Remove all edges incident to u or v
                edges.removeIf(e -> {
                    String[] parts = e.split(",");
                    int x = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                    int y = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                    return x == u || x == v || y == u || y == v;
                });
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
        
        // Greedy vertex cover
        public static Set<Integer> greedyVertexCover(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            Set<Integer> cover = new HashSet<>();
            Set<String> uncoveredEdges = new HashSet<>();
            
            // Initialize uncovered edges
            for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (u < v) {
                        uncoveredEdges.add(u + "," + v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            while (!uncoveredEdges.isEmpty()) {
                // Find vertex that covers most uncovered edges
                int bestVertex = -1;
                int maxCoverage = 0;
                
                for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                    if (cover.contains(u)) continue;
                    
                    int coverage = 0;
                    for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                        String edge1 = u < v ? u + "," + v : v + "," + u;
                        if (uncoveredEdges.contains(edge1)) {
                            coverage++;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (coverage > maxCoverage) {
                        maxCoverage = coverage;
                        bestVertex = u;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestVertex != -1) {
                    cover.add(bestVertex);
                    
                    // Remove covered edges
                    for (int v : graph.get(bestVertex)) {
                        String edge = bestVertex < v ? bestVertex + "," + v : v + "," + bestVertex;
                        uncoveredEdges.remove(edge);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
    }
    
    // Set Cover Approximation (ln n approximation)
    public static class SetCoverApproximation {
        public static List<Integer> greedySetCover(List<Set<Integer>> sets, Set<Integer> universe) {
            List<Integer> cover = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> uncovered = new HashSet<>(universe);
            
            while (!uncovered.isEmpty()) {
                int bestSet = -1;
                int maxCoverage = 0;
                
                // Find set that covers most uncovered elements
                for (int i = 0; i < sets.size(); i++) {
                    Set<Integer> intersection = new HashSet<>(sets.get(i));
                    intersection.retainAll(uncovered);
                    
                    if (intersection.size() > maxCoverage) {
                        maxCoverage = intersection.size();
                        bestSet = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestSet != -1) {
                    cover.add(bestSet);
                    uncovered.removeAll(sets.get(bestSet));
                }
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
        
        // Weighted set cover
        public static List<Integer> weightedSetCover(List<Set<Integer>> sets, 
                                                   List<Double> weights, 
                                                   Set<Integer> universe) {
            List<Integer> cover = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> uncovered = new HashSet<>(universe);
            
            while (!uncovered.isEmpty()) {
                int bestSet = -1;
                double bestRatio = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                
                // Find set with best cost-effectiveness ratio
                for (int i = 0; i < sets.size(); i++) {
                    Set<Integer> intersection = new HashSet<>(sets.get(i));
                    intersection.retainAll(uncovered);
                    
                    if (!intersection.isEmpty()) {
                        double ratio = weights.get(i) / intersection.size();
                        if (ratio < bestRatio) {
                            bestRatio = ratio;
                            bestSet = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestSet != -1) {
                    cover.add(bestSet);
                    uncovered.removeAll(sets.get(bestSet));
                }
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
    }
    
    // TSP Approximation (Christofides Algorithm)
    public static class TSPApproximation {
        static class Edge {
            int u, v;
            double weight;
            
            Edge(int u, int v, double weight) {
                this.u = u;
                this.v = v;
                this.weight = weight;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Integer> christofidesTSP(double[][] distances) {
            int n = distances.length;
            
            // Step 1: Find MST
            List<Edge> mst = findMST(distances);
            
            // Step 2: Find vertices with odd degree in MST
            Set<Integer> oddVertices = findOddDegreeVertices(mst, n);
            
            // Step 3: Find minimum weight perfect matching on odd vertices
            List<Edge> matching = minimumWeightMatching(oddVertices, distances);
            
            // Step 4: Combine MST and matching to form Eulerian graph
            List<List<Integer>> eulerianGraph = buildEulerianGraph(mst, matching, n);
            
            // Step 5: Find Eulerian tour
            List<Integer> eulerianTour = findEulerianTour(eulerianGraph);
            
            // Step 6: Convert to Hamiltonian tour by skipping repeated vertices
            return convertToHamiltonianTour(eulerianTour);
        }
        
        private static List<Edge> findMST(double[][] distances) {
            int n = distances.length;
            List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Create all edges
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    edges.add(new Edge(i, j, distances[i][j]));
                }
            }
            
            // Sort edges by weight
            edges.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.weight, b.weight));
            
            // Kruskal's algorithm
            UnionFind uf = new UnionFind(n);
            List<Edge> mst = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Edge edge : edges) {
                if (uf.union(edge.u, edge.v)) {
                    mst.add(edge);
                    if (mst.size() == n - 1) break;
                }
            }
            
            return mst;
        }
        
        private static Set<Integer> findOddDegreeVertices(List<Edge> mst, int n) {
            int[] degree = new int[n];
            
            for (Edge edge : mst) {
                degree[edge.u]++;
                degree[edge.v]++;
            }
            
            Set<Integer> oddVertices = new HashSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (degree[i] % 2 == 1) {
                    oddVertices.add(i);
                }
            }
            
            return oddVertices;
        }
        
        private static List<Edge> minimumWeightMatching(Set<Integer> vertices, 
                                                       double[][] distances) {
            // Simplified greedy matching (not optimal, but approximation)
            List<Edge> matching = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> matched = new HashSet<>();
            
            List<Integer> vertexList = new ArrayList<>(vertices);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexList.size(); i++) {
                if (matched.contains(vertexList.get(i))) continue;
                
                int u = vertexList.get(i);
                int bestV = -1;
                double minWeight = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                
                for (int j = i + 1; j < vertexList.size(); j++) {
                    int v = vertexList.get(j);
                    if (!matched.contains(v) && distances[u][v] < minWeight) {
                        minWeight = distances[u][v];
                        bestV = v;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestV != -1) {
                    matching.add(new Edge(u, bestV, minWeight));
                    matched.add(u);
                    matched.add(bestV);
                }
            }
            
            return matching;
        }
        
        private static List<List<Integer>> buildEulerianGraph(List<Edge> mst, 
                                                            List<Edge> matching, int n) {
            List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            
            // Add MST edges
            for (Edge edge : mst) {
                graph.get(edge.u).add(edge.v);
                graph.get(edge.v).add(edge.u);
            }
            
            // Add matching edges
            for (Edge edge : matching) {
                graph.get(edge.u).add(edge.v);
                graph.get(edge.v).add(edge.u);
            }
            
            return graph;
        }
        
        private static List<Integer> findEulerianTour(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            // Hierholzer's algorithm for Eulerian tour
            List<Integer> tour = new ArrayList<>();
            Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
            
            // Create adjacency lists (mutable)
            List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (List<Integer> neighbors : graph) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>(neighbors));
            }
            
            stack.push(0);
            
            while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                int v = stack.peek();
                
                if (!adj.get(v).isEmpty()) {
                    int u = adj.get(v).remove(adj.get(v).size() - 1);
                    adj.get(u).remove((Integer) v);
                    stack.push(u);
                } else {
                    tour.add(stack.pop());
                }
            }
            
            Collections.reverse(tour);
            return tour;
        }
        
        private static List<Integer> convertToHamiltonianTour(List<Integer> eulerianTour) {
            List<Integer> hamiltonianTour = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
            
            for (int vertex : eulerianTour) {
                if (!visited.contains(vertex)) {
                    hamiltonianTour.add(vertex);
                    visited.add(vertex);
                }
            }
            
            // Add first vertex to complete the cycle
            if (!hamiltonianTour.isEmpty()) {
                hamiltonianTour.add(hamiltonianTour.get(0));
            }
            
            return hamiltonianTour;
        }
        
        static class UnionFind {
            int[] parent, rank;
            
            UnionFind(int n) {
                parent = new int[n];
                rank = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    parent[i] = i;
                }
            }
            
            int find(int x) {
                if (parent[x] != x) {
                    parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
                }
                return parent[x];
            }
            
            boolean union(int x, int y) {
                int px = find(x), py = find(y);
                if (px == py) return false;
                
                if (rank[px] < rank[py]) {
                    parent[px] = py;
                } else if (rank[px] > rank[py]) {
                    parent[py] = px;
                } else {
                    parent[py] = px;
                    rank[px]++;
                }
                
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Bin Packing Approximation
    public static class BinPackingApproximation {
        
        // First Fit algorithm
        public static List<List<Double>> firstFit(List<Double> items, double binCapacity) {
            List<List<Double>> bins = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> binLoads = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (double item : items) {
                boolean placed = false;
                
                // Try to place in existing bin
                for (int i = 0; i < bins.size(); i++) {
                    if (binLoads.get(i) + item <= binCapacity) {
                        bins.get(i).add(item);
                        binLoads.set(i, binLoads.get(i) + item);
                        placed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                // Create new bin if necessary
                if (!placed) {
                    List<Double> newBin = new ArrayList<>();
                    newBin.add(item);
                    bins.add(newBin);
                    binLoads.add(item);
                }
            }
            
            return bins;
        }
        
        // First Fit Decreasing
        public static List<List<Double>> firstFitDecreasing(List<Double> items, 
                                                           double binCapacity) {
            List<Double> sortedItems = new ArrayList<>(items);
            sortedItems.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
            return firstFit(sortedItems, binCapacity);
        }
        
        // Best Fit algorithm
        public static List<List<Double>> bestFit(List<Double> items, double binCapacity) {
            List<List<Double>> bins = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> binLoads = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (double item : items) {
                int bestBin = -1;
                double minSpaceLeft = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                
                // Find bin with minimum space left after placing item
                for (int i = 0; i < bins.size(); i++) {
                    double spaceLeft = binCapacity - binLoads.get(i) - item;
                    if (spaceLeft >= 0 && spaceLeft < minSpaceLeft) {
                        minSpaceLeft = spaceLeft;
                        bestBin = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestBin != -1) {
                    bins.get(bestBin).add(item);
                    binLoads.set(bestBin, binLoads.get(bestBin) + item);
                } else {
                    // Create new bin
                    List<Double> newBin = new ArrayList<>();
                    newBin.add(item);
                    bins.add(newBin);
                    binLoads.add(item);
                }
            }
            
            return bins;
        }
        
        // Next Fit algorithm (online)
        public static List<List<Double>> nextFit(List<Double> items, double binCapacity) {
            List<List<Double>> bins = new ArrayList<>();
            
            if (items.isEmpty()) return bins;
            
            List<Double> currentBin = new ArrayList<>();
            double currentLoad = 0;
            
            for (double item : items) {
                if (currentLoad + item <= binCapacity) {
                    currentBin.add(item);
                    currentLoad += item;
                } else {
                    // Start new bin
                    bins.add(currentBin);
                    currentBin = new ArrayList<>();
                    currentBin.add(item);
                    currentLoad = item;
                }
            }
            
            if (!currentBin.isEmpty()) {
                bins.add(currentBin);
            }
            
            return bins;
        }
    }
    
    // Load Balancing Approximation
    public static class LoadBalancingApproximation {
        
        // Greedy algorithm for makespan minimization
        public static int[] greedyLoadBalance(int[] jobs, int machines) {
            int[] assignment = new int[jobs.length];
            int[] machineLoads = new int[machines];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < jobs.length; i++) {
                // Assign job to machine with minimum load
                int minMachine = 0;
                for (int j = 1; j < machines; j++) {
                    if (machineLoads[j] < machineLoads[minMachine]) {
                        minMachine = j;
                    }
                }
                
                assignment[i] = minMachine;
                machineLoads[minMachine] += jobs[i];
            }
            
            return assignment;
        }
        
        // Longest Processing Time (LPT) algorithm
        public static int[] lptLoadBalance(int[] jobs, int machines) {
            // Create job indices and sort by processing time (descending)
            Integer[] indices = new Integer[jobs.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < jobs.length; i++) {
                indices[i] = i;
            }
            
            Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> jobs[b] - jobs[a]);
            
            int[] assignment = new int[jobs.length];
            int[] machineLoads = new int[machines];
            
            for (int idx : indices) {
                // Assign job to machine with minimum load
                int minMachine = 0;
                for (int j = 1; j < machines; j++) {
                    if (machineLoads[j] < machineLoads[minMachine]) {
                        minMachine = j;
                    }
                }
                
                assignment[idx] = minMachine;
                machineLoads[minMachine] += jobs[idx];
            }
            
            return assignment;
        }
        
        // Calculate makespan
        public static int calculateMakespan(int[] jobs, int[] assignment, int machines) {
            int[] machineLoads = new int[machines];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < jobs.length; i++) {
                machineLoads[assignment[i]] += jobs[i];
            }
            
            return Arrays.stream(machineLoads).max().orElse(0);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: Varies (O(n) to O(n²) for most approximations), **Space**: O(n)

```java
public class CompetitiveProgramming {
    
    // Fast I/O for competitive programming
    public static class FastIO {
        private BufferedReader br;
        private PrintWriter out;
        private StringTokenizer st;
        
        public FastIO() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        }
        
        public String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        
        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
        
        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
        
        public double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
        
        public void close() {
            try {
                br.close();
                out.close();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
        
        public void println(Object obj) {
            out.println(obj);
        }
        
        public void print(Object obj) {
            out.print(obj);
        }
        
        public void flush() {

        }
    }
    
    // Binary Lifting for LCA and path queries
    public static class BinaryLifting {
        private int n, logN;
        private int[][] up;
        private int[] depth;
        private List<List<Integer>> adj;
        
        public BinaryLifting(List<List<Integer>> tree, int root) {
            this.n = tree.size();
            this.logN = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(Integer.highestOneBit(n - 1)) + 1;
            this.up = new int[n][logN];
            this.depth = new int[n];
            this.adj = tree;
            
            dfs(root, -1);
            
            // Fill binary lifting table
            for (int j = 1; j < logN; j++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (up[i][j - 1] != -1) {
                        up[i][j] = up[up[i][j - 1]][j - 1];
                    } else {
                        up[i][j] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        private void dfs(int v, int parent) {
            up[v][0] = parent;
            
            for (int u : adj.get(v)) {
                if (u != parent) {
                    depth[u] = depth[v] + 1;
                    dfs(u, v);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public int lca(int u, int v) {
            if (depth[u] < depth[v]) {
                int temp = u;
                u = v;
                v = temp;
            }
            
            // Bring u to same level as v
            int diff = depth[u] - depth[v];
            for (int i = 0; i < logN; i++) {
                if ((diff & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    u = up[u][i];
                }
            }
            
            if (u == v) return u;
            
            // Binary search for LCA
            for (int i = logN - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (up[u][i] != up[v][i]) {
                    u = up[u][i];
                    v = up[v][i];
                }
            }
            
            return up[u][0];
        }
        
        public int kthAncestor(int v, int k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < logN; i++) {
                if ((k & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    v = up[v][i];
                    if (v == -1) break;
                }
            }
            return v;
        }
        
        public int distance(int u, int v) {
            return depth[u] + depth[v] - 2 * depth[lca(u, v)];
        }
    }
    
    // Coordinate Compression
    public static class CoordinateCompression {
        private Map<Integer, Integer> compress;
        private Map<Integer, Integer> decompress;
        
        public CoordinateCompression(List<Integer> values) {
            List<Integer> sorted = new ArrayList<>(new TreeSet<>(values));
            compress = new HashMap<>();
            decompress = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < sorted.size(); i++) {
                compress.put(sorted.get(i), i);
                decompress.put(i, sorted.get(i));
            }
        }
        
        public int compress(int value) {
            return compress.get(value);
        }
        
        public int decompress(int index) {
            return decompress.get(index);
        }
        
        public int size() {
            return compress.size();
        }
    }
    
    // Sqrt Decomposition
    public static class SqrtDecomposition {
        private int[] arr;
        private int[] blocks;
        private int blockSize;
        private int numBlocks;
        
        public SqrtDecomposition(int[] array) {
            this.arr = array.clone();
            this.blockSize = (int) Math.sqrt(arr.length) + 1;
            this.numBlocks = (arr.length + blockSize - 1) / blockSize;
            this.blocks = new int[numBlocks];
            
            // Build blocks
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                blocks[i / blockSize] += arr[i];
            }
        }
        
        public void update(int index, int value) {
            blocks[index / blockSize] += value - arr[index];
            arr[index] = value;
        }
        
        public int query(int left, int right) {
            int sum = 0;
            int leftBlock = left / blockSize;
            int rightBlock = right / blockSize;
            
            if (leftBlock == rightBlock) {
                for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
                    sum += arr[i];
                }
            } else {
                // Left partial block
                for (int i = left; i < (leftBlock + 1) * blockSize; i++) {
                    sum += arr[i];
                }
                
                // Middle complete blocks
                for (int i = leftBlock + 1; i < rightBlock; i++) {
                    sum += blocks[i];
                }
                
                // Right partial block
                for (int i = rightBlock * blockSize; i <= right; i++) {
                    sum += arr[i];
                }
            }
            
            return sum;
        }
    }
    
    // Template for contest problems
    public static class ContestTemplate {
        
        // GCD and LCM utilities
        public static long gcd(long a, long b) {
            while (b != 0) {
                long temp = b;
                b = a % b;
                a = temp;
            }
            return a;
        }
        
        public static long lcm(long a, long b) {
            return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
        }
        
        // Modular arithmetic
        public static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
            long result = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if (exp % 2 == 1) {
                    result = (result * base) % mod;
                }
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                exp /= 2;
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        public static long modInverse(long a, long mod) {
            return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
        }
        
        // Combinatorics
        public static long[] factorial;
        public static long[] invFactorial;
        
        public static void precomputeFactorials(int n, long mod) {
            factorial = new long[n + 1];
            invFactorial = new long[n + 1];
            
            factorial[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            }
            
            invFactorial[n] = modInverse(factorial[n], mod);
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                invFactorial[i] = (invFactorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        public static long nCr(int n, int r, long mod) {
            if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
            return (factorial[n] * invFactorial[r] % mod) * invFactorial[n - r] % mod;
        }
        
        // Geometry utilities
        public static class Point {
            long x, y;
            
            Point(long x, long y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
            
            Point subtract(Point other) {
                return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
            }
            
            long cross(Point other) {
                return x * other.y - y * other.x;
            }
            
            long dot(Point other) {
                return x * other.x + y * other.y;
            }
            
            double distance(Point other) {
                return Math.sqrt((x - other.x) * (x - other.x) + (y - other.y) * (y - other.y));
            }
        }
        
        public static long orientation(Point p, Point q, Point r) {
            return q.subtract(p).cross(r.subtract(q));
        }
        
        // String algorithms
        public static int[] computeZ(String s) {
            int n = s.length();
            int[] z = new int[n];
            int l = 0, r = 0;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                if (i <= r) {
                    z[i] = Math.min(r - i + 1, z[i - l]);
                }
                
                while (i + z[i] < n && s.charAt(z[i]) == s.charAt(i + z[i])) {
                    z[i]++;
                }
                
                if (i + z[i] - 1 > r) {
                    l = i;
                    r = i + z[i] - 1;
                }
            }
            
            return z;
        }
        
        public static int[] computeLPS(String pattern) {
            int n = pattern.length();
            int[] lps = new int[n];
            int len = 0;
            int i = 1;
            
            while (i < n) {
                if (pattern.charAt(i) == pattern.charAt(len)) {
                    len++;
                    lps[i] = len;
                    i++;
                } else {
                    if (len != 0) {
                        len = lps[len - 1];
                    } else {
                        lps[i] = 0;
                        i++;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return lps;
        }
        
        // Bit manipulation utilities
        public static int popcount(long x) {
            return Long.bitCount(x);
        }
        
        public static int ctz(long x) {
            return Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(x);
        }
        
        public static int clz(long x) {
            return Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(x);
        }
        
        // Array utilities
        public static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
            while (start < end) {
                int temp = arr[start];
                arr[start] = arr[end];
                arr[end] = temp;
                start++;
                end--;
            }
        }
        
        public static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
            int n = arr.length;
            int i = n - 2;
            
            while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) {
                i--;
            }
            
            if (i < 0) return false;
            
            int j = n - 1;
            while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) {
                j--;
            }
            
            // Swap
            int temp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = temp;
            
            reverse(arr, i + 1, n - 1);
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    // Common contest problem patterns
    public static class ProblemPatterns {
        
        // Two pointers technique
        public static int twoPointers(int[] arr, int target) {
            int left = 0, right = arr.length - 1;
            int count = 0;
            
            while (left < right) {
                int sum = arr[left] + arr[right];
                if (sum == target) {
                    count++;
                    left++;
                    right--;
                } else if (sum < target) {
                    left++;
                } else {
                    right--;
                }
            }
            
            return count;
        }
        
        // Sliding window maximum
        public static int[] slidingWindowMaximum(int[] arr, int k) {
            int n = arr.length;
            int[] result = new int[n - k + 1];
            Deque<Integer> deque = new ArrayDeque<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                // Remove elements outside window
                while (!deque.isEmpty() && deque.peekFirst() <= i - k) {
                    deque.pollFirst();
                }
                
                // Remove smaller elements
                while (!deque.isEmpty() && arr[deque.peekLast()] <= arr[i]) {
                    deque.pollLast();
                }
                
                deque.offerLast(i);
                
                if (i >= k - 1) {
                    result[i - k + 1] = arr[deque.peekFirst()];
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Prefix sum for range queries
        public static class PrefixSum {
            private long[] prefix;
            
            public PrefixSum(int[] arr) {
                prefix = new long[arr.length + 1];
                for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + arr[i];
                }
            }
            
            public long rangeSum(int left, int right) {
                return prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left];
            }
        }
        
        // 2D prefix sum
        public static class PrefixSum2D {
            private long[][] prefix;
            
            public PrefixSum2D(int[][] matrix) {
                int m = matrix.length;
                int n = matrix[0].length;
                prefix = new long[m + 1][n + 1];
                
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                        prefix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 
                                      prefix[i - 1][j] + 
                                      prefix[i][j - 1] - 
                                      prefix[i - 1][j - 1];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            public long rangeSum(int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) {
                return prefix[r2 + 1][c2 + 1] - 
                       prefix[r1][c2 + 1] - 
                       prefix[r2 + 1][c1] + 
                       prefix[r1][c1];
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) for most operations, **Space**: O(n log n) for binary lifting

**Problem**: Concurrent and parallel algorithm design  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class ParallelAlgorithms {
    
    // Parallel Merge Sort
    public static class ParallelMergeSort {
        private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
        
        public static void parallelMergeSort(int[] arr) {
            if (arr.length <= 1) return;
            
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
            try {
                pool.invoke(new MergeSortTask(arr, 0, arr.length - 1));
            } finally {
                pool.shutdown();
            }
        }
        
        static class MergeSortTask extends RecursiveAction {
            private int[] arr;
            private int left, right;
            
            MergeSortTask(int[] arr, int left, int right) {
                this.arr = arr;
                this.left = left;
                this.right = right;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void compute() {
                if (right - left < THRESHOLD) {
                    Arrays.sort(arr, left, right + 1);
                    return;
                }
                
                int mid = (left + right) / 2;
                
                MergeSortTask leftTask = new MergeSortTask(arr, left, mid);
                MergeSortTask rightTask = new MergeSortTask(arr, mid + 1, right);
                
                invokeAll(leftTask, rightTask);
                
                merge(arr, left, mid, right);
            }
            
            private void merge(int[] arr, int left, int mid, int right) {
                int[] temp = new int[right - left + 1];
                int i = left, j = mid + 1, k = 0;
                
                while (i <= mid && j <= right) {
                    if (arr[i] <= arr[j]) {
                        temp[k++] = arr[i++];
                    } else {
                        temp[k++] = arr[j++];
                    }
                }
                
                while (i <= mid) temp[k++] = arr[i++];
                while (j <= right) temp[k++] = arr[j++];
                
                System.arraycopy(temp, 0, arr, left, temp.length);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Quick Sort
    public static class ParallelQuickSort {
        private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
        
        public static void parallelQuickSort(int[] arr) {
            if (arr.length <= 1) return;
            
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
            try {
                pool.invoke(new QuickSortTask(arr, 0, arr.length - 1));
            } finally {
                pool.shutdown();
            }
        }
        
        static class QuickSortTask extends RecursiveAction {
            private int[] arr;
            private int low, high;
            
            QuickSortTask(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
                this.arr = arr;
                this.low = low;
                this.high = high;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void compute() {
                if (high - low < THRESHOLD) {
                    sequentialQuickSort(arr, low, high);
                    return;
                }
                
                if (low < high) {
                    int pivot = partition(arr, low, high);
                    
                    QuickSortTask leftTask = new QuickSortTask(arr, low, pivot - 1);
                    QuickSortTask rightTask = new QuickSortTask(arr, pivot + 1, high);
                    
                    invokeAll(leftTask, rightTask);
                }
            }
            
            private void sequentialQuickSort(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
                if (low < high) {
                    int pivot = partition(arr, low, high);
                    sequentialQuickSort(arr, low, pivot - 1);
                    sequentialQuickSort(arr, pivot + 1, high);
                }
            }
            
            private int partition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
                int pivot = arr[high];
                int i = low - 1;
                
                for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
                    if (arr[j] <= pivot) {
                        i++;
                        swap(arr, i, j);
                    }
                }
                
                swap(arr, i + 1, high);
                return i + 1;
            }
            
            private void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
                int temp = arr[i];
                arr[i] = arr[j];
                arr[j] = temp;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Matrix Multiplication
    public static class ParallelMatrixMultiplication {
        
        public static int[][] parallelMultiply(int[][] A, int[][] B) {
            int n = A.length;
            int[][] C = new int[n][n];
            
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
            try {
                pool.invoke(new MatrixMultiplyTask(A, B, C, 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1));
            } finally {
                pool.shutdown();
            }
            
            return C;
        }
        
        static class MatrixMultiplyTask extends RecursiveAction {
            private static final int THRESHOLD = 64;
            private int[][] A, B, C;
            private int rowStart, rowEnd, colStart, colEnd;
            
            MatrixMultiplyTask(int[][] A, int[][] B, int[][] C, 
                             int rowStart, int rowEnd, int colStart, int colEnd) {
                this.A = A;
                this.B = B;
                this.C = C;
                this.rowStart = rowStart;
                this.rowEnd = rowEnd;
                this.colStart = colStart;
                this.colEnd = colEnd;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void compute() {
                int rows = rowEnd - rowStart + 1;
                int cols = colEnd - colStart + 1;
                
                if (rows <= THRESHOLD && cols <= THRESHOLD) {
                    sequentialMultiply();
                    return;
                }
                
                if (rows >= cols) {
                    int midRow = (rowStart + rowEnd) / 2;
                    invokeAll(
                        new MatrixMultiplyTask(A, B, C, rowStart, midRow, colStart, colEnd),
                        new MatrixMultiplyTask(A, B, C, midRow + 1, rowEnd, colStart, colEnd)
                    );
                } else {
                  );
                }
            }
            
            private void sequentialMultiply() {
                int n = A[0].length;
                for (int i = rowStart; i <= rowEnd; i++) {
                    for (int j = colStart; j <= colEnd; j++) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                            C[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Parallel Prefix Sum (Scan)
    public static class ParallelPrefixSum {
        
        public static long[] parallelPrefixSum(int[] arr) {
            int n = arr.length;
            long[] result = new long[n];
            
            // Copy input to result
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                result[i] = arr[i];
            }
            
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
            try {
                pool.invoke(new PrefixSumTask(result, 0, n - 1));
            } finally {
                pool.shutdown();
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        static class PrefixSumTask extends RecursiveTask<Long> {
            private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
            private long[] arr;
            private int start, end;
            
            PrefixSumTask(long[] arr, int start, int end) {
                this.arr = arr;
                this.start = start;
                this.end = end;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected Long compute() {
                if (end - start < THRESHOLD) {
                    return sequentialPrefixSum();
                }
                
                int mid = (start + end) / 2;
                
                PrefixSumTask leftTask = new PrefixSumTask(arr, start, mid);
                PrefixSumTask rightTask = new PrefixSumTask(arr, mid + 1, end);
                
                rightTask.fork();
                long leftSum = leftTask.compute();
                long rightSum = rightTask.join();
                
                // Add leftSum to all elements in right half
                for (int i = mid + 1; i <= end; i++) {
                    arr[i] += leftSum;
                }
                
                return leftSum + rightSum;
            }
            
            private long sequentialPrefixSum() {
                for (int i = start + 1; i <= end; i++) {
                    arr[i] += arr[i - 1];
                }
                return arr[end] - (start > 0 ? arr[start - 1] : 0);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Graph Algorithms - BFS
    public static class ParallelBFS {
        
        public static int[] parallelBFS(List<List<Integer>> graph, int source) {
            int n = graph.size();
            int[] distance = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(distance, -1);
            distance[source] = 0;
            
            Queue<Integer> currentLevel = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
            currentLevel.offer(source);
            
            int level = 0;
            
            while (!currentLevel.isEmpty()) {
                Queue<Integer> nextLevel = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
                
                // Process current level in parallel
                currentLevel.parallelStream().forEach(vertex -> {
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(vertex)) {
                        if (distance[neighbor] == -1) {
                            synchronized (distance) {
                                if (distance[neighbor] == -1) {
                                    distance[neighbor] = level + 1;
                                    nextLevel.offer(neighbor);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
                
                currentLevel = nextLevel;
                level++;
            }
            
            return distance;
        }
    }
    
    // Lock-free Data Structures
    public static class LockFreeStack<T> {
        private volatile Node<T> top;
        
        private static class Node<T> {
            volatile T data;
            volatile Node<T> next;
            
            Node(T data) {
                this.data = data;
            }
        }
        
        public void push(T item) {
            Node<T> newNode = new Node<>(item);
            Node<T> currentTop;
            
            do {
                currentTop = top;
                newNode.next = currentTop;
            } while (!compareAndSet(newNode, currentTop));
        }
        
        public T pop() {
            Node<T> currentTop;
            Node<T> newTop;
            
            do {
                currentTop = top;
                if (currentTop == null) {
                    return null;
                }
                newTop = currentTop.next;
            } while (!compareAndSet(newTop, currentTop));
            
            return currentTop.data;
        }
        
        private boolean compareAndSet(Node<T> newValue, Node<T> expectedValue) {
            // Simplified CAS operation - in real implementation, use AtomicReference
            synchronized (this) {
                if (top == expectedValue) {
                    top = newValue;
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        public boolean isEmpty() {
            return top == null;
        }
    }
    
    // Producer-Consumer with BlockingQueue
    public static class ProducerConsumer {
        
        static class Producer implements Runnable {
            private BlockingQueue<Integer> queue;
            private int maxItems;
            
            Producer(BlockingQueue<Integer> queue, int maxItems) {
                this.queue = queue;
                this.maxItems = maxItems;
            }
            
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    for (int i = 0; i < maxItems; i++) {
                        queue.put(i);
                        System.out.println("Produced: " + i);
                        Thread.sleep(100);
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
            }
        }
        
        static class Consumer implements Runnable {
            private BlockingQueue<Integer> queue;
            private int maxItems;
            
            Consumer(BlockingQueue<Integer> queue, int maxItems) {
                this.queue = queue;
                this.maxItems = maxItems;
            }
            
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    for (int i = 0; i < maxItems; i++) {
                        Integer item = queue.take();
                        System.out.println("Consumed: " + item);
                        Thread.sleep(150);
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static void runExample() {
            BlockingQueue<Integer> queue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(10);
            int itemCount = 20;
            
            Thread producer = new Thread(new Producer(queue, itemCount));
            Thread consumer = new Thread(new Consumer(queue, itemCount));
            
            producer.start();
            consumer.start();
            
            try {
                producer.join();
                consumer.join();
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
        }
    }
```
