### 158. Algorithmic Game Theory
**Problem**: Strategic algorithm design and game-theoretic concepts  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AlgorithmicGameTheory {
    
    // Nash Equilibrium for 2x2 Games
    public static class NashEquilibrium {
        static class Game2x2 {
            double[][] payoffA; // Player A's payoffs
            double[][] payoffB; // Player B's payoffs
            
            Game2x2(double[][] payoffA, double[][] payoffB) {
                this.payoffA = payoffA;
                this.payoffB = payoffB;
            }
        }
        
        static class MixedStrategy {
            double p1, p2; // Probabilities for player strategies
            
            MixedStrategy(double p1, double p2) {
                this.p1 = p1;
                this.p2 = p2;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<MixedStrategy[]> findNashEquilibria(Game2x2 game) {
            List<MixedStrategy[]> equilibria = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Check pure strategy equilibria
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                    if (isPureNashEquilibrium(game, i, j)) {
                        MixedStrategy stratA = new MixedStrategy(i == 0 ? 1 : 0, i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                        MixedStrategy stratB = new MixedStrategy(j == 0 ? 1 : 0, j == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                        equilibria.add(new MixedStrategy[]{stratA, stratB});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Check mixed strategy equilibrium
            MixedStrategy[] mixedEq = findMixedNashEquilibrium(game);
            if (mixedEq != null) {
                equilibria.add(mixedEq);
            }
            
            return equilibria;
        }
        
        private static boolean isPureNashEquilibrium(Game2x2 game, int i, int j) {
            // Check if (i, j) is a pure strategy Nash equilibrium
            
            // Player A's best response to B playing strategy j
            boolean aBestResponse = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                if (game.payoffA[k][j] > game.payoffA[i][j]) {
                    aBestResponse = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            // Player B's best response to A playing strategy i
            boolean bBestResponse = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                if (game.payoffB[i][k] > game.payoffB[i][j]) {
                    bBestResponse = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            return aBestResponse && bBestResponse;
        }
        
        private static MixedStrategy[] findMixedNashEquilibrium(Game2x2 game) {
            // For mixed strategy equilibrium, each player must be indifferent
            // between their pure strategies
            
            // Player A's indifference condition:
            // p * payoffA[0][0] + (1-p) * payoffA[0][1] = p * payoffA[1][0] + (1-p) * payoffA[1][1]
            // Solve for p (Player B's probability of playing strategy 0)
            
            double denomA = game.payoffA[0][0] - game.payoffA[0][1] - game.payoffA[1][0] + game.payoffA[1][1];
            if (Math.abs(denomA) < 1e-9) return null;
            
            double pB = (game.payoffA[1][1] - game.payoffA[0][1]) / denomA;
            
            // Player B's indifference condition:
            double denomB = game.payoffB[0][0] - game.payoffB[1][0] - game.payoffB[0][1] + game.payoffB[1][1];
            if (Math.abs(denomB) < 1e-9) return null;
            
            double pA = (game.payoffB[1][1] - game.payoffB[1][0]) / denomB;
            
            // Check if probabilities are valid (between 0 and 1)
            if (pA >= 0 && pA <= 1 && pB >= 0 && pB <= 1) {
                MixedStrategy stratA = new MixedStrategy(pA, 1 - pA);
                MixedStrategy stratB = new MixedStrategy(pB, 1 - pB);
                return new MixedStrategy[]{stratA, stratB};
            }
            
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    // Mechanism Design - Auction Algorithms
    public static class AuctionMechanisms {
        static class Bidder {
            int id;
            double valuation;
            double bid;
            
            Bidder(int id, double valuation) {
                this.id = id;
                this.valuation = valuation;
            }
        }
        
        static class AuctionResult {
            int winner;
            double price;
            double revenue;
            
            AuctionResult(int winner, double price, double revenue) {
                this.winner = winner;
                this.price = price;
                this.revenue = revenue;
            }
        }
        
        // First Price Sealed Bid Auction
        public static AuctionResult firstPriceAuction(List<Bidder> bidders) {
            if (bidders.isEmpty()) return new AuctionResult(-1, 0, 0);
            
            Bidder winner = bidders.stream()
                    .max((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.bid, b.bid))
                    .orElse(null);
            
            return new AuctionResult(winner.id, winner.bid, winner.bid);
        }
        
        // Second Price Sealed Bid Auction (Vickrey Auction)
        public static AuctionResult vickreyAuction(List<Bidder> bidders) {
            if (bidders.isEmpty()) return new AuctionResult(-1, 0, 0);
            if (bidders.size() == 1) return new AuctionResult(bidders.get(0).id, 0, 0);
            
            bidders.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.bid, a.bid));
            
            Bidder winner = bidders.get(0);
            double secondHighestBid = bidders.get(1).bid;
            
            return new AuctionResult(winner.id, secondHighestBid, secondHighestBid);
        }
        
        // English Auction (Ascending Bid)
        public static AuctionResult englishAuction(List<Bidder> bidders, double increment) {
            if (bidders.isEmpty()) return new AuctionResult(-1, 0, 0);
            
            List<Bidder> activeBidders = new ArrayList<>(bidders);
            double currentPrice = 0;
            
            while (activeBidders.size() > 1) {
                currentPrice += increment;
                
                // Remove bidders who can't/won't bid at current price
                activeBidders.removeIf(bidder -> bidder.valuation < currentPrice);
            }
            
            if (activeBidders.isEmpty()) {
                return new AuctionResult(-1, 0, 0);
            }
            
            Bidder winner = activeBidders.get(0);
            return new AuctionResult(winner.id, currentPrice, currentPrice);
        }
        
        // Dutch Auction (Descending Price)
        public static AuctionResult dutchAuction(List<Bidder> bidders, double startPrice, double decrement) {
            double currentPrice = startPrice;
            
            while (currentPrice > 0) {
                for (Bidder bidder : bidders) {
                    if (bidder.valuation >= currentPrice) {
                        return new AuctionResult(bidder.id, currentPrice, currentPrice);
                    }
                }
                currentPrice -= decrement;
            }
            
            return new AuctionResult(-1, 0, 0);
        }
    }
    
    // Voting Systems and Social Choice
    public static class VotingSystems {
        static class Candidate {
            int id;
            String name;
            
            Candidate(int id, String name) {
                this.id = id;
                this.name = name;
            }
        }
        
        // Plurality Voting
        public static int pluralityVoting(List<List<Integer>> preferences) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> votes = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (List<Integer> preference : preferences) {
                if (!preference.isEmpty()) {
                    int firstChoice = preference.get(0);
                    votes.put(firstChoice, votes.getOrDefault(firstChoice, 0) + 1);
                }
            }
            
            return votes.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(-1);
        }
        
        // Borda Count
        public static int bordaCount(List<List<Integer>> preferences, int numCandidates) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> scores = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (List<Integer> preference : preferences) {
                for (int i = 0; i < preference.size(); i++) {
                    int candidate = preference.get(i);
                    int points = numCandidates - i - 1;
                    scores.put(candidate, scores.getOrDefault(candidate, 0) + points);
                }
            }
            
            return scores.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(-1);
        }
        
        // Instant Runoff Voting (IRV)
        public static int instantRunoffVoting(List<List<Integer>> preferences) {
            Set<Integer> candidates = new HashSet<>();
            for (List<Integer> pref : preferences) {
                candidates.addAll(pref);
            }
            
            Set<Integer> activeCandidates = new HashSet<>(candidates);
            
            while (activeCandidates.size() > 1) {
                // Count first preferences
                Map<Integer, Integer> votes = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (List<Integer> preference : preferences) {
                    for (int candidate : preference) {
                        if (activeCandidates.contains(candidate)) {
                            votes.put(candidate, votes.getOrDefault(candidate, 0) + 1);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Check if any candidate has majority
                int totalVotes = votes.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : votes.entrySet()) {
                    if (entry.getValue() * 2 > totalVotes) {
                        return entry.getKey();
                    }
                }
                
                // Eliminate candidate with fewest votes
                int minVotes = votes.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).min().orElse(0);
                votes.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
                    if (entry.getValue() == minVotes) {
                        activeCandidates.remove(entry.getKey());
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                });
            }
            
            return activeCandidates.iterator().next();
        }
        
        // Condorcet Winner
        public static Integer condorcetWinner(List<List<Integer>> preferences) {
            Set<Integer> candidates = new HashSet<>();
            for (List<Integer> pref : preferences) {
                candidates.addAll(pref);
            }
            
            // Build pairwise comparison matrix
            Map<String, Integer> pairwiseWins = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int a : candidates) {
                for (int b : candidates) {
                    if (a != b) {
                        int aWins = 0;
                        
                        for (List<Integer> pref : preferences) {
                            int aPos = pref.indexOf(a);
                            int bPos = pref.indexOf(b);
                            
                            if (aPos != -1 && bPos != -1 && aPos < bPos) {
                                aWins++;
                            }
                        }
                        
                        pairwiseWins.put(a + "," + b, aWins);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Check for Condorcet winner
            for (int candidate : candidates) {
                boolean isCondorcetWinner = true;
                
                for (int other : candidates) {
                    if (candidate != other) {
                        int candidateWins = pairwiseWins.getOrDefault(candidate + "," + other, 0);
                        int otherWins = pairwiseWins.getOrDefault(other + "," + candidate, 0);
                        
                        if (candidateWins <= otherWins) {
                            isCondorcetWinner = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (isCondorcetWinner) {
                    return candidate;
                }
            }
            
            return null; // No Condorcet winner
        }
    }
    
    // Stable Matching (Gale-Shapley Algorithm)
    public static class StableMatching {
        
        public static Map<Integer, Integer> galeShapley(int[][] menPrefs, int[][] womenPrefs) {
            int n = menPrefs.length;
            
            // Initialize data structures
            Map<Integer, Integer> menPartner = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Integer, Integer> womenPartner = new HashMap<>();
            Queue<Integer> freeMen = new LinkedList<>();
            int[] nextProposal = new int[n];
            
            // All men start free
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                freeMen.offer(i);
            }
            
            // Create women's preference rankings for quick lookup
            int[][] womenRanking = new int[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    womenRanking[i][womenPrefs[i][j]] = j;
                }
            }
            
            while (!freeMen.isEmpty()) {
                int man = freeMen.poll();
                int woman = menPrefs[man][nextProposal[man]];
                nextProposal[man]++;
                
                if (!womenPartner.containsKey(woman)) {
                    // Woman is free, accept proposal
                    menPartner.put(man, woman);
                    womenPartner.put(woman, man);
                } else {
                    // Woman is engaged, check if she prefers new proposal
                    int currentPartner = womenPartner.get(woman);
                    
                    if (womenRanking[woman][man] < womenRanking[woman][currentPartner]) {
                        // Woman prefers new proposal
                        menPartner.remove(currentPartner);
                        menPartner.put(man, woman);
                        womenPartner.put(woman, man);
                        freeMen.offer(currentPartner);
                    } else {
                        // Woman rejects new proposal
                        freeMen.offer(man);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return menPartner;
        }
        
        // Check if matching is stable
        public static boolean isStableMatching(Map<Integer, Integer> matching, 
                                             int[][] menPrefs, int[][] womenPrefs) {
            int n = menPrefs.length;
            
            // Create preference rankings
            int[][] menRanking = new int[n][n];
            int[][] womenRanking = new int[n][n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    menRanking[i][menPrefs[i][j]] = j;
                    womenRanking[i][womenPrefs[i][j]] = j;
                }
            }
            
            // Check for blocking pairs
            for (int man1 = 0; man1 < n; man1++) {
                for (int woman1 = 0; woman1 < n; woman1++) {
                    int woman2 = matching.get(man1);
                    int man2 = -1;
                    
                    // Find woman1's partner
                    for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : matching.entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getValue() == woman1) {
                            man2 = entry.getKey();
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Check if (man1, woman1) is a blocking pair
                    if (man1 != man2 && woman1 != woman2) {
                        boolean manPrefers = menRanking[man1][woman1] < menRanking[man1][woman2];
                        boolean womanPrefers = womenRanking[woman1][man1] < womenRanking[woman1][man2];
                        
                        if (manPrefers && womanPrefers) {
                            return false; // Blocking pair found
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    // Cooperative Game Theory
    public static class CooperativeGames {
        
        // Shapley Value calculation
        public static double[] shapleyValue(int numPlayers, Map<Set<Integer>, Double> coalitionValues) {
            double[] shapleyValues = new double[numPlayers];
            
            // Generate all permutations of players
            List<List<Integer>> permutations = generatePermutations(numPlayers);
            
            for (List<Integer> permutation : permutations) {
                Set<Integer> coalition = new HashSet<>();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
                    int player = permutation.get(i);
                    Set<Integer> newCoalition = new HashSet<>(coalition);
                    newCoalition.add(player);
                    
                    double marginalContribution = 
                        coalitionValues.getOrDefault(newCoalition, 0.0) - 
                        coalitionValues.getOrDefault(coalition, 0.0);
                    
                    shapleyValues[player] += marginalContribution;
                    coalition.add(player);
                }
            }
            
            // Average over all permutations
            int factorial = factorial(numPlayers);
            for (int i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
                shapleyValues[i] /= factorial;
            }
            
            return shapleyValues;
        }
        
        // Core of cooperative game
        public static boolean isInCore(double[] allocation, int numPlayers, 
                                     Map<Set<Integer>, Double> coalitionValues) {
            // Check individual rationality
            for (int i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
                Set<Integer> singleton = Set.of(i);
                if (allocation[i] < coalitionValues.getOrDefault(singleton, 0.0)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            // Check efficiency
            Set<Integer> grandCoalition = new HashSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < numPlayers; i++) {
                grandCoalition.add(i);
            }
            
            double totalAllocation = Arrays.stream(allocation).sum();
            double grandCoalitionValue = coalitionValues.getOrDefault(grandCoalition, 0.0);
            
            if (Math.abs(totalAllocation - grandCoalitionValue) > 1e-9) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Check group rationality for all coalitions
            for (Set<Integer> coalition : getAllSubsets(numPlayers)) {
                if (coalition.isEmpty() || coalition.equals(grandCoalition)) continue;
                
                double coalitionAllocation = coalition.stream()
                        .mapToDouble(i -> allocation[i])
                        .sum();
                
                double coalitionValue = coalitionValues.getOrDefault(coalition, 0.0);
                
                if (coalitionAllocation < coalitionValue) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private static List<List<Integer>> generatePermutations(int n) {
            List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> current = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean[] used = new boolean[n];
            
            generatePermutationsHelper(n, current, used, result);
            return result;
        }
        
        private static void generatePermutationsHelper(int n, List<Integer> current, 
                                                     boolean[] used, List<List<Integer>> result) {
            if (current.size() == n) {
                result.add(new ArrayList<>(current));
                return;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!used[i]) {
                    used[i] = true;
                    current.add(i);
                    generatePermutationsHelper(n, current, used, result);
                    current.remove(current.size() - 1);
                    used[i] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static List<Set<Integer>> getAllSubsets(int n) {
            List<Set<Integer>> subsets = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                Set<Integer> subset = new HashSet<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        subset.add(i);
                    }
                }
                subsets.add(subset);
            }
            
            return subsets;
        }
        
        private static int factorial(int n) {
            int result = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                result *= i;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n!) for Shapley value, O(2^n) for core verification, **Space**: O(n²)

```java
    // Quantum State representation
    public static class QuantumState {
        private Complex[] amplitudes;
        private int numQubits;
        
        public QuantumState(int numQubits) {
            this.numQubits = numQubits;
            this.amplitudes = new Complex[1 << numQubits];
            
            // Initialize to |0...0⟩ state
            amplitudes[0] = new Complex(1.0, 0.0);
            for (int i = 1; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                amplitudes[i] = new Complex(0.0, 0.0);
            }
        }
        
        public QuantumState(Complex[] amplitudes) {
            this.amplitudes = amplitudes.clone();
            this.numQubits = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(amplitudes.length);
        }
        
        public int getNumQubits() {
            return numQubits;
        }
        
        public Complex getAmplitude(int state) {
            return amplitudes[state];
        }
        
        public void setAmplitude(int state, Complex amplitude) {
            amplitudes[state] = amplitude;
        }
        
        public double getProbability(int state) {
            return amplitudes[state].magnitudeSquared();
        }
        
        // Normalize the quantum state
        public void normalize() {
            double norm = 0;
            for (Complex amp : amplitudes) {
                norm += amp.magnitudeSquared();
            }
            norm = Math.sqrt(norm);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                amplitudes[i] = new Complex(amplitudes[i].real / norm, amplitudes[i].imag / norm);
            }
        }
        
        // Measure a specific qubit
        public int measureQubit(int qubit, Random random) {
            double prob0 = 0;
            
            // Calculate probability of measuring 0
            for (int state = 0; state < amplitudes.length; state++) {
                if ((state & (1 << qubit)) == 0) {
                    prob0 += getProbability(state);
                }
            }
            
            int result = random.nextDouble() < prob0 ? 0 : 1;
            
            // Collapse the state
            for (int state = 0; state < amplitudes.length; state++) {
                if (((state >> qubit) & 1) != result) {
                    amplitudes[state] = new Complex(0, 0);
                }
            }
            
            normalize();
            return result;
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                if (amplitudes[i].magnitude() > 1e-9) {
                    if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(" + ");
                    sb.append(String.format("(%.3f)|%s⟩", amplitudes[i].magnitude(), 
                            Integer.toBinaryString(i)));
                }
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
    }
    
    // Quantum Gates
    public static class QuantumGates {
        
        // Single-qubit gates
        public static void hadamard(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            Complex sqrt2inv = new Complex(1.0 / Math.sqrt(2), 0);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << qubit)) == 0) {
                    int j = i | (1 << qubit);
                    
                    Complex amp0 = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    Complex amp1 = state.getAmplitude(j);
                    
                    Complex newAmp0 = amp0.add(amp1).multiply(sqrt2inv);
                    Complex newAmp1 = amp0.add(amp1.multiply(new Complex(-1, 0))).multiply(sqrt2inv);
                    
                    state.setAmplitude(i, newAmp0);
                    state.setAmplitude(j, newAmp1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static void pauliX(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << qubit)) == 0) {
                    int j = i | (1 << qubit);
                    
                    Complex amp0 = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    Complex amp1 = state.getAmplitude(j);
                    
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp1);
                    state.setAmplitude(j, amp0);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static void pauliY(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            Complex i = new Complex(0, 1);
            Complex negI = new Complex(0, -1);
            
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); k++) {
                if ((k & (1 << qubit)) == 0) {
                    int j = k | (1 << qubit);
                    
                    Complex amp0 = state.getAmplitude(k);
                    Complex amp1 = state.getAmplitude(j);
                    
                    state.setAmplitude(k, amp1.multiply(negI));
                    state.setAmplitude(j, amp0.multiply(i));
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static void pauliZ(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << qubit)) != 0) {
                    Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp.multiply(new Complex(-1, 0)));
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static void phase(QuantumState state, int qubit, double angle) {
            Complex phase = new Complex(Math.cos(angle), Math.sin(angle));
            
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << qubit)) != 0) {
                    Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp.multiply(phase));
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Two-qubit gates
        public static void cnot(QuantumState state, int control, int target) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << control)) != 0 && (i & (1 << target)) == 0) {
                    int j = i | (1 << target);
                    
                    Complex amp0 = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    Complex amp1 = state.getAmplitude(j);
                    
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp1);
                    state.setAmplitude(j, amp0);
                }
            }
        }

            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << control)) != 0 && (i & (1 << target)) != 0) {
                    Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp.multiply(new Complex(-1, 0)));
                }
            }
        }

    // Quantum Fourier Transform
    public static class QuantumFourierTransform {
        
        public static void qft(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.getNumQubits();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
                
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    double angle = 2 * Math.PI / (1 << (j - i + 1));
                    controlledPhase(state, j, i, angle);
                }
            }
            
            // Reverse qubit order
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                swapQubits(state, i, n - 1 - i);
            }
        }
        
        public static void inverseQft(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.getNumQubits();
            
            // Reverse qubit order
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                swapQubits(state, i, n - 1 - i);
            }
            
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                for (int j = n - 1; j > i; j--) {
                    double angle = -2 * Math.PI / (1 << (j - i + 1));
                    controlledPhase(state, j, i, angle);
                }
                
                QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
            }
        }
        
        private static void controlledPhase(QuantumState state, int control, int target, double angle) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << control)) != 0 && (i & (1 << target)) != 0) {
                    Complex phase = new Complex(Math.cos(angle), Math.sin(angle));
                    Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp.multiply(phase));
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static void swapQubits(QuantumState state, int qubit1, int qubit2) {
            if (qubit1 == qubit2) return;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                int bit1 = (i >> qubit1) & 1;
                int bit2 = (i >> qubit2) & 1;
                
                if (bit1 != bit2) {
                    int j = i ^ (1 << qubit1) ^ (1 << qubit2);
                    
                    if (i < j) {
                        Complex amp1 = state.getAmplitude(i);
                        Complex amp2 = state.getAmplitude(j);
                        
                        state.setAmplitude(i, amp2);
                        state.setAmplitude(j, amp1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Grover's Search Algorithm
    public static class GroverSearch {
        
        public static int groverSearch(int numQubits, Set<Integer> targetStates, int maxIterations) {
            QuantumState state = new QuantumState(numQubits);
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // Initialize superposition
            for (int i = 0; i < numQubits; i++) {
                QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
            }
            
            int optimalIterations = (int) Math.round(Math.PI / 4 * Math.sqrt(1 << numQubits) / Math.sqrt(targetStates.size()));
            int iterations = Math.min(optimalIterations, maxIterations);
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
                // Oracle
                oracle(state, targetStates);
                
                // Diffusion operator
                diffusionOperator(state);
            }
            
            // Measure all qubits
            int result = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < numQubits; i++) {
                result |= (state.measureQubit(i, random) << i);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static void oracle(QuantumState state, Set<Integer> targetStates) {
            for (int target : targetStates) {
                Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(target);
                state.setAmplitude(target, amp.multiply(new Complex(-1, 0)));
            }
        }
        
        private static void diffusionOperator(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.getNumQubits();
            
            // Apply Hadamard to all qubits
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
            }
            
            // Flip phase of |0⟩ state
            Complex amp0 = state.getAmplitude(0);
            state.setAmplitude(0, amp0.multiply(new Complex(-1, 0)));
            
            // Apply Hadamard to all qubits again
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Quantum Phase Estimation
    public static class QuantumPhaseEstimation {
        
        public static double estimatePhase(QuantumState eigenstate, int precision) {
            int n = eigenstate.getNumQubits();
            QuantumState fullState = new QuantumState(n + precision);
            
            // Copy eigenstate to target qubits
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
                fullState.setAmplitude(i, eigenstate.getAmplitude(i));
            }
            
            // Initialize precision qubits in superposition
            for (int i = n; i < n + precision; i++) {
                QuantumGates.hadamard(fullState, i);
            }
            
            // Controlled unitary operations
            for (int i = 0; i < precision; i++) {
                int power = 1 << i;
                for (int j = 0; j < power; j++) {
                    // Apply controlled unitary (simplified as phase rotation)
                    controlledUnitaryPower(fullState, n + i, 0, Math.PI / 4); // Example phase
                }
            }
            
            // Apply inverse QFT to precision qubits
            QuantumState precisionState = extractSubstate(fullState, n, precision);
            QuantumFourierTransform.inverseQft(precisionState);
            
            // Measure precision qubits
            Random random = new Random();
            int measurement = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < precision; i++) {
                measurement |= (precisionState.measureQubit(i, random) << i);
            }
            
            // Convert measurement to phase estimate
            return (double) measurement / (1 << precision);
        }
        
        private static void controlledUnitaryPower(QuantumState state, int control, int target, double phase) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << state.getNumQubits()); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << control)) != 0 && (i & (1 << target)) != 0) {
                    Complex phaseComplex = new Complex(Math.cos(phase), Math.sin(phase));
                    Complex amp = state.getAmplitude(i);
                    state.setAmplitude(i, amp.multiply(phaseComplex));
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static QuantumState extractSubstate(QuantumState fullState, int start, int length) {
            QuantumState substate = new QuantumState(length);
            
            // This is a simplified extraction - in practice, this would require
            // more complex quantum state manipulation
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << length); i++) {
                substate.setAmplitude(i, fullState.getAmplitude(i << start));
            }
            
            substate.normalize();
            return substate;
        }
    }
    
    // Quantum Error Correction (simplified)
    public static class QuantumErrorCorrection {
        
        // 3-qubit bit flip code
        public static QuantumState encode3QubitBitFlip(QuantumState logicalQubit) {
            if (logicalQubit.getNumQubits() != 1) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input must be a single qubit");
            }
            
            QuantumState encoded = new QuantumState(3);
            
            // Copy logical qubit to first physical qubit
            encoded.setAmplitude(0, logicalQubit.getAmplitude(0)); // |000⟩
            encoded.setAmplitude(7, logicalQubit.getAmplitude(1)); // |111⟩
            
            return encoded;
        }
        
        public static QuantumState correct3QubitBitFlip(QuantumState encoded) {
            if (encoded.getNumQubits() != 3) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input must be a 3-qubit state");
            }
            
            // Syndrome measurement (simplified)
            Map<Integer, Double> syndromes = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int state = 0; state < 8; state++) {
                double prob = encoded.getProbability(state);
                if (prob > 1e-9) {
                    int syndrome = calculateSyndrome(state);
                    syndromes.put(syndrome, syndromes.getOrDefault(syndrome, 0.0) + prob);
                }
            }
            
            // Find most likely syndrome
            int likelySyndrome = syndromes.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(0);
            
            // Apply correction based on syndrome
            QuantumState corrected = new QuantumState(encoded.getAmplitude(0).magnitude() > 0 ? 
                    encoded.getAmplitude(0) : new Complex(0, 0), 
                    encoded.getAmplitude(7).magnitude() > 0 ? 
                    encoded.getAmplitude(7) : new Complex(0, 0));
            
            if (likelySyndrome == 1) QuantumGates.pauliX(corrected, 0);
            else if (likelySyndrome == 2) QuantumGates.pauliX(corrected, 1);
            else if (likelySyndrome == 3) QuantumGates.pauliX(corrected, 2);
            
            return corrected;
        }
        
        private static int calculateSyndrome(int state) {
            int bit0 = (state >> 0) & 1;
            int bit1 = (state >> 1) & 1;
            int bit2 = (state >> 2) & 1;
            
            int parity01 = bit0 ^ bit1;
            int parity12 = bit1 ^ bit2;
            
            return parity01 | (parity12 << 1);
        }
        
        private QuantumState(Complex amp0, Complex amp1) {
            this.numQubits = 1;
            this.amplitudes = new Complex[]{amp0, amp1};
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(√N) for Grover's search, O(2^n) for state manipulation, **Space**: O(2^n)

### 160. Advanced Optimization Algorithms
**Problem**: Cutting-edge optimization and metaheuristic algorithms  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedOptimization {
    
    // Genetic Algorithm Framework
    public static class GeneticAlgorithm {
        static class Individual {
            double[] genes;
            double fitness;
            
            Individual(int geneLength) {
                genes = new double[geneLength];
                Random random = new Random();
                for (int i = 0; i < geneLength; i++) {
                    genes[i] = random.nextGaussian();
                }
            }
            
            Individual(double[] genes) {
                this.genes = genes.clone();
            }
            
            void mutate(double mutationRate, double mutationStrength) {
                Random random = new Random();
                for (int i = 0; i < genes.length; i++) {
                    if (random.nextDouble() < mutationRate) {
                        genes[i] += random.nextGaussian() * mutationStrength;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static Individual optimize(Function<double[], Double> fitnessFunction,
                                        int populationSize, int generations, 
                                        int geneLength, double mutationRate) {
            Random random = new Random();
            List<Individual> population = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Initialize population
            for (int i = 0; i < populationSize; i++) {
                population.add(new Individual(geneLength));
            }
            
            for (int gen = 0; gen < generations; gen++) {
                // Evaluate fitness
                for (Individual ind : population) {
                    ind.fitness = fitnessFunction.apply(ind.genes);
                }
                
                // Sort by fitness (assuming maximization)
                population.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.fitness, a.fitness));
                
                // Create next generation
                List<Individual> nextGeneration = new ArrayList<>();
                
                // Elitism - keep top individuals
                int eliteCount = populationSize / 10;
                for (int i = 0; i < eliteCount; i++) {
                    nextGeneration.add(new Individual(population.get(i).genes));
                }
                
                // Crossover and mutation
                while (nextGeneration.size() < populationSize) {
                    Individual parent1 = tournamentSelection(population, 3);
                    Individual parent2 = tournamentSelection(population, 3);
                    Individual child = crossover(parent1, parent2);
                    child.mutate(mutationRate, 0.1);
                    nextGeneration.add(child);
                }
                
                population = nextGeneration;
            }
            
            // Return best individual
            for (Individual ind : population) {
                ind.fitness = fitnessFunction.apply(ind.genes);
            }
            return population.stream().max((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.fitness, b.fitness))
                    .orElse(null);
        }
        
        private static Individual tournamentSelection(List<Individual> population, int tournamentSize) {
            Random random = new Random();
            Individual best = null;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < tournamentSize; i++) {
                Individual candidate = population.get(random.nextInt(population.size()));
                if (best == null || candidate.fitness > best.fitness) {
                    best = candidate;
                }
            }
            
            return best;
        }
        
        private static Individual crossover(Individual parent1, Individual parent2) {
            Random random = new Random();
            double[] childGenes = new double[parent1.genes.length];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < childGenes.length; i++) {
                childGenes[i] = random.nextBoolean() ? parent1.genes[i] : parent2.genes[i];
            }
            
            return new Individual(childGenes);
        }
    }
    
    // Simulated Annealing
    public static class SimulatedAnnealing {
        
        public static double[] optimize(Function<double[], Double> objectiveFunction,
                                      double[] initial, double initialTemp, 
                                      double coolingRate, int maxIterations) {
            Random random = new Random();
            double[] current = initial.clone();
            double[] best = initial.clone();
            
            double currentEnergy = objectiveFunction.apply(current);
            double bestEnergy = currentEnergy;
            double temperature = initialTemp;
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                // Generate neighbor solution
                double[] neighbor = current.clone();
                int index = random.nextInt(neighbor.length);
                neighbor[index] += random.nextGaussian() * 0.1;
                
                double neighborEnergy = objectiveFunction.apply(neighbor);
                
                // Accept or reject neighbor
                if (neighborEnergy < currentEnergy || 
                    random.nextDouble() < Math.exp(-(neighborEnergy - currentEnergy) / temperature)) {
                    current = neighbor;
                    currentEnergy = neighborEnergy;
                    
                    if (currentEnergy < bestEnergy) {
                        best = current.clone();
                        bestEnergy = currentEnergy;
                    }
                }
                
                // Cool down
                temperature *= coolingRate;
            }
            
            return best;
        }
    }
    
    // Particle Swarm Optimization
    public static class ParticleSwarmOptimization {
        static class Particle {
            double[] position;
            double[] velocity;
            double[] bestPosition;
            double bestFitness;
            double fitness;
            
            Particle(int dimensions, double[] bounds) {
                Random random = new Random();
                position = new double[dimensions];
                velocity = new double[dimensions];
                bestPosition = new double[dimensions];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < dimensions; i++) {
                    position[i] = bounds[0] + random.nextDouble() * (bounds[1] - bounds[0]);
                    velocity[i] = random.nextGaussian() * 0.1;
                    bestPosition[i] = position[i];
                }
                
                bestFitness = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            }
            
            void updateVelocity(double[] globalBest, double inertia, double c1, double c2) {
                Random random = new Random();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < position.length; i++) {
                    double r1 = random.nextDouble();
                    double r2 = random.nextDouble();
                    
                    velocity[i] = inertia * velocity[i] +
                                c1 * r1 * (bestPosition[i] - position[i]) +
                                c2 * r2 * (globalBest[i] - position[i]);
                }
            }
            
            void updatePosition(double[] bounds) {
                for (int i = 0; i < position.length; i++) {
                    position[i] += velocity[i];
                    
                    // Boundary handling
                    if (position[i] < bounds[0]) position[i] = bounds[0];
                    if (position[i] > bounds[1]) position[i] = bounds[1];
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static double[] optimize(Function<double[], Double> fitnessFunction,
                                      int dimensions, double[] bounds, 
                                      int numParticles, int maxIterations) {
            List<Particle> swarm = new ArrayList<>();
            double[] globalBest = new double[dimensions];
            double globalBestFitness = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            
            // Initialize swarm
            for (int i = 0; i < numParticles; i++) {
                swarm.add(new Particle(dimensions, bounds));
            }
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                for (Particle particle : swarm) {
                    // Evaluate fitness
                    particle.fitness = fitnessFunction.apply(particle.position);
                    
                    // Update personal best
                    if (particle.fitness < particle.bestFitness) {
                        particle.bestFitness = particle.fitness;
                        particle.bestPosition = particle.position.clone();
                    }
                    
                    // Update global best
                    if (particle.fitness < globalBestFitness) {
                        globalBestFitness = particle.fitness;
                        globalBest = particle.position.clone();
                    }
                }
                
                // Update velocities and positions
                double inertia = 0.9 - 0.5 * iter / maxIterations; // Decreasing inertia
                for (Particle particle : swarm) {
                    particle.updateVelocity(globalBest, inertia, 2.0, 2.0);
                    particle.updatePosition(bounds);
                }
            }
            
            return globalBest;
        }
    }
    
    // Ant Colony Optimization
    public static class AntColonyOptimization {
        static class Ant {
            List<Integer> tour;
            double tourLength;
            boolean[] visited;
            
            Ant(int numCities) {
                tour = new ArrayList<>();
                visited = new boolean[numCities];
                tourLength = 0;
            }
            
            void visitCity(int city) {
                tour.add(city);
                visited[city] = true;
            }
            
            boolean hasVisited(int city) {
                return visited[city];
            }
            
            void reset() {
                tour.clear();
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
                tourLength = 0;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Integer> solveTSP(double[][] distances, int numAnts, 
                                           int maxIterations, double alpha, double beta, 
                                           double evaporationRate, double pheromoneDeposit) {
            int numCities = distances.length;
            double[][] pheromones = new double[numCities][numCities];
            
            // Initialize pheromones
            for (int i = 0; i < numCities; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < numCities; j++) {
                    pheromones[i][j] = 1.0;
                }
            }
            
            List<Integer> bestTour = null;
            double bestTourLength = Double.MAX_VALUE;
            Random random = new Random();
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                List<Ant> ants = new ArrayList<>();
                
                // Create ants and construct tours
                for (int antIdx = 0; antIdx < numAnts; antIdx++) {
                    Ant ant = new Ant(numCities);
                    int currentCity = random.nextInt(numCities);
                    ant.visitCity(currentCity);
                    
                    // Construct tour
                    while (ant.tour.size() < numCities) {
                        int nextCity = selectNextCity(ant, currentCity, distances, 
                                                    pheromones, alpha, beta, random);
                        ant.visitCity(nextCity);
                        ant.tourLength += distances[currentCity][nextCity];
                        currentCity = nextCity;
                    }
                    
                    // Complete tour by returning to start
                    ant.tourLength += distances[currentCity][ant.tour.get(0)];
                    ants.add(ant);
                    
                    // Update best tour
                    if (ant.tourLength < bestTourLength) {
                        bestTourLength = ant.tourLength;
                        bestTour = new ArrayList<>(ant.tour);
                    }
                }
                
                // Update pheromones
                updatePheromones(pheromones, ants, evaporationRate, pheromoneDeposit);
            }
            
            return bestTour;
        }
        
        private static int selectNextCity(Ant ant, int currentCity, double[][] distances,
                                        double[][] pheromones, double alpha, double beta,
                                        Random random) {
            int numCities = distances.length;
            double[] probabilities = new double[numCities];
            double totalProbability = 0;
            
            // Calculate probabilities
            for (int city = 0; city < numCities; city++) {
                if (!ant.hasVisited(city)) {
                    double pheromone = Math.pow(pheromones[currentCity][city], alpha);
                    double heuristic = Math.pow(1.0 / distances[currentCity][city], beta);
                    probabilities[city] = pheromone * heuristic;
                    totalProbability += probabilities[city];
                }
            }
            
            // Roulette wheel selection
            double randomValue = random.nextDouble() * totalProbability;
            double cumulativeProbability = 0;
            
            for (int city = 0; city < numCities; city++) {
                if (!ant.hasVisited(city)) {
                    cumulativeProbability += probabilities[city];
                    if (cumulativeProbability >= randomValue) {
                        return city;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Fallback: select first unvisited city
            for (int city = 0; city < numCities; city++) {
                if (!ant.hasVisited(city)) {
                    return city;
                }
            }
            
            return -1; // Should never reach here
        }
        
        private static void updatePheromones(double[][] pheromones, List<Ant> ants,
                                           double evaporationRate, double pheromoneDeposit) {
            int numCities = pheromones.length;
            
            // Evaporation
            for (int i = 0; i < numCities; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < numCities; j++) {
                    pheromones[i][j] *= (1.0 - evaporationRate);
                }
            }
            
            // Deposit pheromones
            for (Ant ant : ants) {
                double pheromoneAmount = pheromoneDeposit / ant.tourLength;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < ant.tour.size(); i++) {
                    int from = ant.tour.get(i);
                    int to = ant.tour.get((i + 1) % ant.tour.size());
                    
                    pheromones[from][to] += pheromoneAmount;
                    pheromones[to][from] += pheromoneAmount;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Differential Evolution
    public static class DifferentialEvolution {
        
        public static double[] optimize(Function<double[], Double> objectiveFunction,
                                      int dimensions, double[] lowerBounds, double[] upperBounds,
                                      int populationSize, int maxGenerations, 
                                      double F, double CR) {
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // Initialize population
            double[][] population = new double[populationSize][dimensions];
            double[] fitness = new double[populationSize];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < populationSize; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < dimensions; j++) {
                    population[i][j] = lowerBounds[j] + 
                        random.nextDouble() * (upperBounds[j] - lowerBounds[j]);
                }
                fitness[i] = objectiveFunction.apply(population[i]);
            }
            
            for (int gen = 0; gen < maxGenerations; gen++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < populationSize; i++) {
                    // Select three random individuals (different from current)
                    int a, b, c;
                    do { a = random.nextInt(populationSize); } while (a == i);
                    do { b = random.nextInt(populationSize); } while (b == i || b == a);
                    do { c = random.nextInt(populationSize); } while (c == i || c == a || c == b);
                    
                    // Mutation
                    double[] mutant = new double[dimensions];
                    for (int j = 0; j < dimensions; j++) {
                        mutant[j] = population[a][j] + F * (population[b][j] - population[c][j]);
                    }
                    
                    // Crossover
                    double[] trial = new double[dimensions];
                    int jrand = random.nextInt(dimensions);
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < dimensions; j++) {
                        if (j == jrand || random.nextDouble() < CR) {
                            trial[j] = mutant[j];
                        } else {
                            trial[j] = population[i][j];
                        }
                        
                        // Boundary constraints
                        trial[j] = Math.max(lowerBounds[j], Math.min(upperBounds[j], trial[j]));
                    }
                    
                    // Selection
                    double trialFitness = objectiveFunction.apply(trial);
                    if (trialFitness < fitness[i]) {
                        population[i] = trial;
                        fitness[i] = trialFitness;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Return best solution
            int bestIndex = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < populationSize; i++) {
                if (fitness[i] < fitness[bestIndex]) {
                    bestIndex = i;
                }
            }
            
            return population[bestIndex];
        }
    }
    
    // Tabu Search
    public static class TabuSearch {
        static class TabuMove {
            int[] move;
            int tabuTenure;
            
            TabuMove(int[] move, int tabuTenure) {
                this.move = move.clone();
                this.tabuTenure = tabuTenure;
            }
        }
        
        public static double[] optimize(Function<double[], Double> objectiveFunction,
                                      double[] initial, int maxIterations, 
                                      int tabuTenure, int neighborhoodSize) {
            double[] current = initial.clone();
            double[] best = initial.clone();
            double currentFitness = objectiveFunction.apply(current);
            double bestFitness = currentFitness;
            
            List<TabuMove> tabuList = new ArrayList<>();
            Random random = new Random();
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                double[] bestNeighbor = null;
                double bestNeighborFitness = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                boolean improvesBest = false;
                
                // Generate neighborhood
                for (int n = 0; n < neighborhoodSize; n++) {
                    double[] neighbor = generateNeighbor(current, random);
                    double neighborFitness = objectiveFunction.apply(neighbor);
                    
                    // Check if move is tabu
                    boolean isTabu = isTabuMove(current, neighbor, tabuList);
                    
                    // Aspiration criteria: accept if better than best known solution
                    if (neighborFitness < bestFitness) {
                        improvesBest = true;
                        isTabu = false;
                    }
                    
                    if (!isTabu && neighborFitness < bestNeighborFitness) {
                        bestNeighbor = neighbor;
                        bestNeighborFitness = neighborFitness;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestNeighbor != null) {
                    // Add move to tabu list
                    int[] move = calculateMove(current, bestNeighbor);
                    tabuList.add(new TabuMove(move, tabuTenure));
                    
                    current = bestNeighbor;
                    currentFitness = bestNeighborFitness;
                    
                    if (currentFitness < bestFitness) {
                        best = current.clone();
                        bestFitness = currentFitness;
                    }
                }
                
                // Update tabu list (decrease tenure)
                tabuList.removeIf(tabuMove -> --tabuMove.tabuTenure <= 0);
            }
            
            return best;
        }
        
        private static double[] generateNeighbor(double[] current, Random random) {
            double[] neighbor = current.clone();
            int index = random.nextInt(neighbor.length);
            neighbor[index] += random.nextGaussian() * 0.1;
            return neighbor;
        }
        
        private static boolean isTabuMove(double[] from, double[] to, List<TabuMove> tabuList) {
            int[] move = calculateMove(from, to);
            
            for (TabuMove tabuMove : tabuList) {
                if (Arrays.equals(tabuMove.move, move)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private static int[] calculateMove(double[] from, double[] to) {
            // Simplified move representation
            int[] move = new int[from.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < from.length; i++) {
                move[i] = to[i] > from[i] ? 1 : (to[i] < from[i] ? -1 : 0);
            }
            return move;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(G×P×F) for genetic algorithms (G=generations, P=population, F=fitness evaluation), **Space**: O(P×n)

### 161. Machine Learning Algorithms
**Problem**: Core machine learning algorithms implementation  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class MachineLearningAlgorithms {
    
    // k-Nearest Neighbors
    public static class KNearestNeighbors {
        static class DataPoint {
            double[] features;
            int label;
            
            DataPoint(double[] features, int label) {
                this.features = features.clone();
                this.label = label;
            }
            
            double distanceTo(DataPoint other) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
                    sum += Math.pow(features[i] - other.features[i], 2);
                }
                return Math.sqrt(sum);
            }
        }
        
        private List<DataPoint> trainingData;
        private int k;
        
        public KNearestNeighbors(int k) {
            this.k = k;
            this.trainingData = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        public void train(double[][] features, int[] labels) {
            trainingData.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
                trainingData.add(new DataPoint(features[i], labels[i]));
            }
        }
        
        public int predict(double[] features) {
            DataPoint query = new DataPoint(features, -1);
            
            // Calculate distances to all training points
            List<DataPoint> distances = new ArrayList<>(trainingData);
            distances.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.distanceTo(query), b.distanceTo(query)));
            
            // Take k nearest neighbors
            Map<Integer, Integer> votes = new HashMap<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(k, distances.size()); i++) {
                int label = distances.get(i).label;
                votes.put(label, votes.getOrDefault(label, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            // Return majority vote
            return votes.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(0);
        }
        
        public double[] predictProbabilities(double[] features) {
            DataPoint query = new DataPoint(features, -1);
            
            List<DataPoint> distances = new ArrayList<>(trainingData);
            distances.sort((a, b) -> Double.compare(a.distanceTo(query), b.distanceTo(query)));
            
            Map<Integer, Double> weights = new HashMap<>();
            double totalWeight = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(k, distances.size()); i++) {
                double distance = distances.get(i).distanceTo(query);
                double weight = distance == 0 ? 1e6 : 1.0 / distance;
                int label = distances.get(i).label;
                
                weights.put(label, weights.getOrDefault(label, 0.0) + weight);
                totalWeight += weight;
            }
            
            // Convert to probabilities
            Set<Integer> uniqueLabels = weights.keySet();
            double[] probabilities = new double[uniqueLabels.size()];
            int idx = 0;
            
            for (int label : uniqueLabels) {
                probabilities[idx++] = weights.get(label) / totalWeight;
            }
            
            return probabilities;
        }
    }
    
    // Linear Regression
    public static class LinearRegression {
        private double[] weights;
        private double bias;
        
        public void train(double[][] X, double[] y, double learningRate, int epochs) {
            int numFeatures = X[0].length;
            int numSamples = X.length;
            
            weights = new double[numFeatures];
            bias = 0;
            
            for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
                double[] gradWeights = new double[numFeatures];
                double gradBias = 0;
                
                // Calculate gradients
                for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
                    double prediction = predict(X[i]);
                    double error = prediction - y[i];
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < numFeatures; j++) {
                        gradWeights[j] += error * X[i][j];
                    }
                    gradBias += error;
                }
                
                // Update parameters
                for (int j = 0; j < numFeatures; j++) {
                    weights[j] -= learningRate * gradWeights[j] / numSamples;
                }
                bias -= learningRate * gradBias / numSamples;
            }
        }
        
        public double predict(double[] features) {
            double result = bias;
            for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
                result += weights[i] * features[i];
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        public double[] predict(double[][] features) {
            double[] predictions = new double[features.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
                predictions[i] = predict(features[i]);
            }
            return predictions;
        }
        
        public double calculateMSE(double[][] X, double[] y) {
            double[] predictions = predict(X);
            double mse = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < y.length; i++) {
                mse += Math.pow(predictions[i] - y[i], 2);
            }
            
            return mse / y.length;
        }
    }
    
    // Logistic Regression
    public static class LogisticRegression {
        private double[] weights;
        private double bias;
        
        public void train(double[][] X, int[] y, double learningRate, int epochs) {
            int numFeatures = X[0].length;
            int numSamples = X.length;
            
            weights = new double[numFeatures];
            bias = 0;
            
            for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
                double[] gradWeights = new double[numFeatures];
                double gradBias = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
                    double probability = predictProbability(X[i]);
                    double error = probability - y[i];
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < numFeatures; j++) {
                        gradWeights[j] += error * X[i][j];
                    }
                    gradBias += error;
                }
                
                // Update parameters
                for (int j = 0; j < numFeatures; j++) {
                    weights[j] -= learningRate * gradWeights[j] / numSamples;
                }
                bias -= learningRate * gradBias / numSamples;
            }
        }
        
        private double sigmoid(double z) {
            return 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-z));
        }
        
        public double predictProbability(double[] features) {
            double z = bias;
            for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) {
                z += weights[i] * features[i];
            }
            return sigmoid(z);
        }
        
        public int predict(double[] features) {
            return predictProbability(features) >= 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
        }
        
        public double calculateAccuracy(double[][] X, int[] y) {
            int correct = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < X.length; i++) {
                if (predict(X[i]) == y[i]) {
                    correct++;
                }
            }
            return (double) correct / X.length;
        }
    }
    
    // Decision Tree
    public static class DecisionTree {
        static class Node {
            int feature;
            double threshold;
            int prediction;
            Node left, right;
            boolean isLeaf;
            
            Node(int prediction) {
                this.prediction = prediction;
                this.isLeaf = true;
            }
            
            Node(int feature, double threshold) {
                this.feature = feature;
                this.threshold = threshold;
                this.isLeaf = false;
            }
        }
        
        private Node root;
        private int maxDepth;
        private int minSamples;
        
        public DecisionTree(int maxDepth, int minSamples) {
            this.maxDepth = maxDepth;
            this.minSamples = minSamples;
        }
        
        public void train(double[][] X, int[] y) {
            root = buildTree(X, y, 0);
        }
        
        private Node buildTree(double[][] X, int[] y, int depth) {
            // Base cases
            if (depth >= maxDepth || X.length <= minSamples || isPure(y)) {
                return new Node(majorityClass(y));
            }
            
            // Find best split
            BestSplit bestSplit = findBestSplit(X, y);
            if (bestSplit == null) {
                return new Node(majorityClass(y));
            }
            
            // Split data
            DataSplit split = splitData(X, y, bestSplit.feature, bestSplit.threshold);
            
            // Create node and recursively build subtrees
            Node node = new Node(bestSplit.feature, bestSplit.threshold);
            node.left = buildTree(split.leftX, split.leftY, depth + 1);
            node.right = buildTree(split.rightX, split.rightY, depth + 1);
            
            return node;
        }
        
        static class BestSplit {
            int feature;
            double threshold;
            double gain;
            
            BestSplit(int feature, double threshold, double gain) {
                this.feature = feature;
                this.threshold = threshold;
                this.gain = gain;
            }
        }
        
        static class DataSplit {
            double[][] leftX, rightX;
            int[] leftY, rightY;
            
            DataSplit(double[][] leftX, int[] leftY, double[][] rightX, int[] rightY) {
                this.leftX = leftX;
                this.leftY = leftY;
                this.rightX = rightX;
                this.rightY = rightY;
            }
        }
        
        private BestSplit findBestSplit(double[][] X, int[] y) {
            double bestGain = -1;
            BestSplit bestSplit = null;
            
            for (int feature = 0; feature < X[0].length; feature++) {
                Set<Double> uniqueValues = new HashSet<>();
                for (double[] row : X) {
                    uniqueValues.add(row[feature]);
                }
                
                for (double threshold : uniqueValues) {
                    DataSplit split = splitData(X, y, feature, threshold);
                    
                    if (split.leftY.length == 0 || split.rightY.length == 0) continue;
                    
                    double gain = calculateInformationGain(y, split.leftY, split.rightY);
                    
                    if (gain > bestGain) {
                        bestGain = gain;
                        bestSplit = new BestSplit(feature, threshold, gain);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return bestSplit;
        }
        
        private DataSplit splitData(double[][] X, int[] y, int feature, double threshold) {
            List<double[]> leftX = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> leftY = new ArrayList<>();
            List<double[]> rightX = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> rightY = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < X.length; i++) {
                if (X[i][feature] <= threshold) {
                    leftX.add(X[i]);
                    leftY.add(y[i]);
                } else {
                    rightX.add(X[i]);
                    rightY.add(y[i]);
                }
            }
            
            return new DataSplit(
                leftX.toArray(new double[0][]),
                leftY.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray(),
                rightX.toArray(new double[0][]),
                rightY.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray()
            );
        }
import java.util.*;
public class AdvancedNetworkingAlgorithms {
    // Dijkstra's Algorithm for Routing
    public static class DijkstraRouting {
        public static int[] dijkstra(int[][] graph, int src) {
            int n = graph.length;
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[src] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int u = -1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (!visited[j] && (u == -1 || dist[j] < dist[u])) u = j;
                }
                if (dist[u] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                visited[u] = true;
                for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                    if (graph[u][v] > 0 && dist[u] + graph[u][v] < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + graph[u][v];
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist;
        }
    }
    // TCP Congestion Control Simulation (AIMD)
    public static class TCPCongestionControl {
        public static List<Integer> simulate(int steps) {
            List<Integer> window = new ArrayList<>();
            int cwnd = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
                window.add(cwnd);
                if (i % 10 == 9) cwnd = Math.max(1, cwnd / 2);
                else cwnd++;
            }
            return window;
        }
    }
    // Network Intrusion Detection (pattern match)
    public static class IntrusionDetection {
        public static boolean detect(String traffic, String pattern) {
            return traffic.contains(pattern);
        }
    }
```
