```java
            double weightedEntropy = (double) left.length / parent.length * leftEntropy +
                                   (double) right.length / parent.length * rightEntropy;
            
            return parentEntropy - weightedEntropy;
        }
        
        private double calculateEntropy(int[] labels) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
            for (int label : labels) {
                counts.put(label, counts.getOrDefault(label, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            double entropy = 0;
            for (int count : counts.values()) {
                double probability = (double) count / labels.length;
                entropy -= probability * Math.log(probability) / Math.log(2);
            }
            
            return entropy;
        }
        
        private boolean isPure(int[] labels) {
            int firstLabel = labels[0];
            for (int label : labels) {
                if (label != firstLabel) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        private int majorityClass(int[] labels) {
            Map<Integer, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
            for (int label : labels) {
                counts.put(label, counts.getOrDefault(label, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            return counts.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(0);
        }
        
        public int predict(double[] features) {
            return predictNode(root, features);
        }
        
        private int predictNode(Node node, double[] features) {
            if (node.isLeaf) {
                return node.prediction;
            }
            
            if (features[node.feature] <= node.threshold) {
                return predictNode(node.left, features);
            } else {
                return predictNode(node.right, features);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // K-Means Clustering
    public static class KMeans {
        static class Point {
            double[] coordinates;
            int cluster;
            
            Point(double[] coordinates) {
                this.coordinates = coordinates.clone();
                this.cluster = -1;
            }
            
            double distanceTo(Point other) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < coordinates.length; i++) {
                    sum += Math.pow(coordinates[i] - other.coordinates[i], 2);
                }
                return Math.sqrt(sum);
            }
        }
        
        private int k;
        private Point[] centroids;
        private List<Point> data;
        
        public KMeans(int k) {
            this.k = k;
        }
        
        public int[] fit(double[][] X, int maxIterations) {
            data = new ArrayList<>();
            for (double[] row : X) {
                data.add(new Point(row));
            }
            
            initializeCentroids();
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                boolean changed = assignClusters();
                updateCentroids();
                
                if (!changed) break;
            }
            
            int[] clusters = new int[data.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
                clusters[i] = data.get(i).cluster;
            }
            
            return clusters;
        }
        
        private void initializeCentroids() {
            centroids = new Point[k];
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // K-means++ initialization
            centroids[0] = new Point(data.get(random.nextInt(data.size())).coordinates);
            
            for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                double[] distances = new double[data.size()];
                double totalDistance = 0;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < data.size(); j++) {
                    double minDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int c = 0; c < i; c++) {
                        minDistance = Math.min(minDistance, data.get(j).distanceTo(centroids[c]));
                    }
                    distances[j] = minDistance * minDistance;
                    totalDistance += distances[j];
                }
                
                double randomValue = random.nextDouble() * totalDistance;
                double cumulativeDistance = 0;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < data.size(); j++) {
                    cumulativeDistance += distances[j];
                    if (cumulativeDistance >= randomValue) {
                        centroids[i] = new Point(data.get(j).coordinates);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        private boolean assignClusters() {
            boolean changed = false;
            
            for (Point point : data) {
                int closestCentroid = 0;
                double minDistance = point.distanceTo(centroids[0]);
                
                for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
                    double distance = point.distanceTo(centroids[i]);
                    if (distance < minDistance) {
                        minDistance = distance;
                        closestCentroid = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (point.cluster != closestCentroid) {
                    point.cluster = closestCentroid;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            
            return changed;
        }
        
        private void updateCentroids() {
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                List<Point> clusterPoints = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Point point : data) {
                    if (point.cluster == i) {
                        clusterPoints.add(point);
                    }
                }
                
                if (!clusterPoints.isEmpty()) {
                    double[] newCentroid = new double[data.get(0).coordinates.length];
                    
                    for (Point point : clusterPoints) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < newCentroid.length; j++) {
                            newCentroid[j] += point.coordinates[j];
                        }
                    }
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < newCentroid.length; j++) {
                        newCentroid[j] /= clusterPoints.size();
                    }
                    
                    centroids[i] = new Point(newCentroid);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public double calculateInertia(double[][] X, int[] clusters) {
            double inertia = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < X.length; i++) {
                Point point = new Point(X[i]);
                inertia += Math.pow(point.distanceTo(centroids[clusters[i]]), 2);
            }
            
            return inertia;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class AdvancedDataMining {
    
    // Apriori Algorithm for Frequent Itemset Mining
    public static class AprioriAlgorithm {
        static class Itemset {
            Set<String> items;
            int support;
            
            Itemset(Set<String> items) {
                this.items = new HashSet<>(items);
                this.support = 0;
            }
            
            @Override
            public boolean equals(Object obj) {
                if (this == obj) return true;
                if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
                Itemset itemset = (Itemset) obj;
                return Objects.equals(items, itemset.items);
            }
            
            @Override
            public int hashCode() {
                return Objects.hash(items);
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return items.toString() + " (support: " + support + ")";
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Itemset> findFrequentItemsets(List<Set<String>> transactions, 
                                                        double minSupport) {
            int minSupportCount = (int) Math.ceil(minSupport * transactions.size());
            List<Itemset> frequentItemsets = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Find frequent 1-itemsets
            Map<String, Integer> itemCounts = new HashMap<>();
            for (Set<String> transaction : transactions) {
                for (String item : transaction) {
                    itemCounts.put(item, itemCounts.getOrDefault(item, 0) + 1);
                }
            }
            
            List<Itemset> currentLevel = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : itemCounts.entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue() >= minSupportCount) {
                    Itemset itemset = new Itemset(Set.of(entry.getKey()));
                    itemset.support = entry.getValue();
                    currentLevel.add(itemset);
                    frequentItemsets.add(itemset);
                }
            }
            
            // Generate higher-level itemsets
            int k = 2;
            while (!currentLevel.isEmpty()) {
                List<Itemset> candidates = generateCandidates(currentLevel, k);
                List<Itemset> frequentCandidates = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (Itemset candidate : candidates) {
                    int support = calculateSupport(candidate, transactions);
                    if (support >= minSupportCount) {
                        candidate.support = support;
                        frequentCandidates.add(candidate);
                        frequentItemsets.add(candidate);
                    }
                }
                
                currentLevel = frequentCandidates;
                k++;
            }
            
            return frequentItemsets;
        }
        
        private static List<Itemset> generateCandidates(List<Itemset> frequentItemsets, int k) {
            List<Itemset> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < frequentItemsets.size(); i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < frequentItemsets.size(); j++) {
                    Set<String> union = new HashSet<>(frequentItemsets.get(i).items);
                    union.addAll(frequentItemsets.get(j).items);
                    
                    if (union.size() == k) {
                        Itemset candidate = new Itemset(union);
                        if (hasFrequentSubsets(candidate, frequentItemsets)) {
                            candidates.add(candidate);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return candidates;
        }
        
        private static boolean hasFrequentSubsets(Itemset candidate, List<Itemset> frequentItemsets) {
            for (String item : candidate.items) {
                Set<String> subset = new HashSet<>(candidate.items);
                subset.remove(item);
                
                boolean found = false;
                for (Itemset frequent : frequentItemsets) {
                    if (frequent.items.equals(subset)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!found) return false;
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private static int calculateSupport(Itemset itemset, List<Set<String>> transactions) {
            int count = 0;
            for (Set<String> transaction : transactions) {
                if (transaction.containsAll(itemset.items)) {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            return count;
        }
        
        // Association Rule Mining
        public static class AssociationRule {
            Set<String> antecedent;
            Set<String> consequent;
            double confidence;
            double lift;
            
            AssociationRule(Set<String> antecedent, Set<String> consequent, 
                          double confidence, double lift) {
                this.antecedent = new HashSet<>(antecedent);
                this.consequent = new HashSet<>(consequent);
                this.confidence = confidence;
                this.lift = lift;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return antecedent + " -> " + consequent + 
                       " (conf: " + String.format("%.2f", confidence) + 
                       ", lift: " + String.format("%.2f", lift) + ")";
            }
        }
        
        public static List<AssociationRule> generateAssociationRules(
                List<Itemset> frequentItemsets, List<Set<String>> transactions, 
                double minConfidence) {
            List<AssociationRule> rules = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Itemset itemset : frequentItemsets) {
                if (itemset.items.size() < 2) continue;
                
                // Generate all possible antecedent-consequent pairs
                for (int i = 1; i < (1 << itemset.items.size()) - 1; i++) {
                    Set<String> antecedent = new HashSet<>();
                    Set<String> consequent = new HashSet<>();
                    
                    List<String> itemList = new ArrayList<>(itemset.items);
                    for (int j = 0; j < itemList.size(); j++) {
                        if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                            antecedent.add(itemList.get(j));
                        } else {
                            consequent.add(itemList.get(j));
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Calculate confidence
                    int antecedentSupport = calculateSupport(new Itemset(antecedent), transactions);
                    double confidence = (double) itemset.support / antecedentSupport;
                    
                    if (confidence >= minConfidence) {
                        // Calculate lift
                        int consequentSupport = calculateSupport(new Itemset(consequent), transactions);
                        double lift = confidence / ((double) consequentSupport / transactions.size());
                        
                        rules.add(new AssociationRule(antecedent, consequent, confidence, lift));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return rules;
        }
    }
    
    // FP-Growth Algorithm (Frequent Pattern Growth)
    public static class FPGrowth {
        static class FPNode {
            String item;
            int count;
            FPNode parent;
            List<FPNode> children;
            FPNode nodeLink;
            
            FPNode(String item, int count, FPNode parent) {
                this.item = item;
                this.count = count;
                this.parent = parent;
                this.children = new ArrayList<>();
                this.nodeLink = null;
            }
            
            void addChild(FPNode child) {
                children.add(child);
            }
            
            FPNode findChild(String item) {
                for (FPNode child : children) {
                    if (child.item.equals(item)) {
                        return child;
                    }
                }
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        static class FPTree {
            FPNode root;
            Map<String, FPNode> headerTable;
            int minSupport;
            
            FPTree(int minSupport) {
                this.root = new FPNode(null, 0, null);
                this.headerTable = new HashMap<>();
                this.minSupport = minSupport;
            }
            
            void addTransaction(List<String> transaction, int count) {
                FPNode currentNode = root;
                
                for (String item : transaction) {
                    FPNode child = currentNode.findChild(item);
                    
                    if (child != null) {
                        child.count += count;
                    } else {
                        child = new FPNode(item, count, currentNode);
                        currentNode.addChild(child);
                        
                        // Update header table
                        if (headerTable.containsKey(item)) {
                            FPNode lastNode = headerTable.get(item);
                            while (lastNode.nodeLink != null) {
                                lastNode = lastNode.nodeLink;
                            }
                            lastNode.nodeLink = child;
                        } else {
                            headerTable.put(item, child);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    currentNode = child;
                }
            }
            
            List<List<String>> getConditionalPatternBase(String item) {
                List<List<String>> patterns = new ArrayList<>();
                FPNode node = headerTable.get(item);
                
                while (node != null) {
                    List<String> pattern = new ArrayList<>();
                    FPNode current = node.parent;
                    
                    while (current != null && current.item != null) {
                        pattern.add(0, current.item);
                        current = current.parent;
                    }
                    
                    if (!pattern.isEmpty()) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < node.count; i++) {
                            patterns.add(new ArrayList<>(pattern));
                        }
                    }
                    
                    node = node.nodeLink;
                }
                
                return patterns;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Set<String>> findFrequentPatterns(List<List<String>> transactions, 
                                                           int minSupport) {
            // Count item frequencies
            Map<String, Integer> itemCounts = new HashMap<>();
            for (List<String> transaction : transactions) {
                for (String item : transaction) {
                    itemCounts.put(item, itemCounts.getOrDefault(item, 0) + 1);
                }
            }
            
            // Filter frequent items
            Map<String, Integer> frequentItems = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : itemCounts.entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue() >= minSupport) {
                    frequentItems.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
                }
            }
            
            // Sort items by frequency (descending)
            List<String> sortedItems = new ArrayList<>(frequentItems.keySet());
            sortedItems.sort((a, b) -> frequentItems.get(b) - frequentItems.get(a));
            
            // Build FP-tree
            FPTree fpTree = new FPTree(minSupport);
            for (List<String> transaction : transactions) {
                List<String> filteredTransaction = new ArrayList<>();
                for (String item : sortedItems) {
                    if (transaction.contains(item)) {
                        filteredTransaction.add(item);
                    }
                }
                
                if (!filteredTransaction.isEmpty()) {
                    fpTree.addTransaction(filteredTransaction, 1);
                }
            }
            
            // Mine frequent patterns
            List<Set<String>> frequentPatterns = new ArrayList<>();
            mineFrequentPatterns(fpTree, new ArrayList<>(), frequentPatterns, minSupport);
            
            return frequentPatterns;
        }
        
        private static void mineFrequentPatterns(FPTree fpTree, List<String> alpha, 
                                               List<Set<String>> frequentPatterns, 
                                               int minSupport) {
            // Add current pattern if not empty
            if (!alpha.isEmpty()) {
                frequentPatterns.add(new HashSet<>(alpha));
            }
            
            // Get items sorted by frequency (ascending for mining)
            List<String> items = new ArrayList<>(fpTree.headerTable.keySet());
            Map<String, Integer> itemCounts = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (String item : items) {
                int count = 0;
                FPNode node = fpTree.headerTable.get(item);
                while (node != null) {
                    count += node.count;
                    node = node.nodeLink;
                }
                itemCounts.put(item, count);
            }
            
            items.sort((a, b) -> itemCounts.get(a) - itemCounts.get(b));
            
            for (String item : items) {
                if (itemCounts.get(item) >= minSupport) {
                    // Create new alpha
                    List<String> newAlpha = new ArrayList<>(alpha);
                    newAlpha.add(item);
                    
                    // Get conditional pattern base
                    List<List<String>> conditionalPatterns = fpTree.getConditionalPatternBase(item);
                    
                    if (!conditionalPatterns.isEmpty()) {
                        // Build conditional FP-tree
                        FPTree conditionalTree = new FPTree(minSupport);
                        
                        // Count items in conditional patterns
                        Map<String, Integer> conditionalCounts = new HashMap<>();
                        for (List<String> pattern : conditionalPatterns) {
                            for (String patternItem : pattern) {
                                conditionalCounts.put(patternItem, 
                                    conditionalCounts.getOrDefault(patternItem, 0) + 1);
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // Filter and sort items
                        List<String> conditionalFrequentItems = new ArrayList<>();
                        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : conditionalCounts.entrySet()) {
                            if (entry.getValue() >= minSupport) {
                                conditionalFrequentItems.add(entry.getKey());
                            }
                        }
                        
                        conditionalFrequentItems.sort((a, b) -> 
                            conditionalCounts.get(b) - conditionalCounts.get(a));
                        
                        // Add filtered patterns to conditional tree
                        for (List<String> pattern : conditionalPatterns) {
                            List<String> filteredPattern = new ArrayList<>();
                            for (String conditionalItem : conditionalFrequentItems) {
                                if (pattern.contains(conditionalItem)) {
                                    filteredPattern.add(conditionalItem);
                                }
                            }
                            
                            if (!filteredPattern.isEmpty()) {
                                conditionalTree.addTransaction(filteredPattern, 1);
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // Recursively mine
                        mineFrequentPatterns(conditionalTree, newAlpha, frequentPatterns, minSupport);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // DBSCAN Clustering Algorithm
    public static class DBSCANAlgorithm {
        static class Point {
            double[] coordinates;
            int clusterId;
            boolean visited;
            boolean isCore;
            
            Point(double[] coordinates) {
                this.coordinates = coordinates.clone();
                this.clusterId = -1; // -1 means noise
                this.visited = false;
                this.isCore = false;
            }
            
            double distanceTo(Point other) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < coordinates.length; i++) {
                    sum += Math.pow(coordinates[i] - other.coordinates[i], 2);
                }
                return Math.sqrt(sum);
            }
        }
        
        public static int[] dbscan(double[][] data, double eps, int minPts) {
            List<Point> points = new ArrayList<>();
            for (double[] row : data) {
                points.add(new Point(row));
            }
            
            int clusterId = 0;
            
            for (Point point : points) {
                if (point.visited) continue;
                
                point.visited = true;
                List<Point> neighbors = getNeighbors(point, points, eps);
                
                if (neighbors.size() < minPts) {
                    point.clusterId = -1; // Mark as noise
                } else {
                    point.isCore = true;
                    expandCluster(point, neighbors, clusterId, points, eps, minPts);
                    clusterId++;
                }
            }
            
            int[] clusters = new int[points.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
                clusters[i] = points.get(i).clusterId;
            }
            
            return clusters;
        }
        
        private static List<Point> getNeighbors(Point point, List<Point> points, double eps) {
            List<Point> neighbors = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Point other : points) {
                if (point.distanceTo(other) <= eps) {
                    neighbors.add(other);
                }
            }
            
            return neighbors;
        }
        
        private static void expandCluster(Point point, List<Point> neighbors, int clusterId,
                                        List<Point> points, double eps, int minPts) {
            point.clusterId = clusterId;
            
            Queue<Point> queue = new LinkedList<>(neighbors);
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                Point current = queue.poll();
                
                if (!current.visited) {
                    current.visited = true;
                    List<Point> currentNeighbors = getNeighbors(current, points, eps);
                    
                    if (currentNeighbors.size() >= minPts) {
                        current.isCore = true;
                        queue.addAll(currentNeighbors);
                    }
                }
                
                if (current.clusterId == -1) {
                    current.clusterId = clusterId;
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static List<List<Integer>> getClusters(int[] clusterAssignments) {
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> clusterMap = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < clusterAssignments.length; i++) {
                int clusterId = clusterAssignments[i];
                clusterMap.computeIfAbsent(clusterId, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(i);
            }
            
            return new ArrayList<>(clusterMap.values());
        }
    }
    
    // Outlier Detection using Isolation Forest
    public static class IsolationForest {
        static class IsolationTree {
            static class Node {
                int splitAttribute;
                double splitValue;
                Node left, right;
                boolean isLeaf;
                int size;
                
                Node() {
                    this.isLeaf = false;
                }
                
                Node(int size) {
                    this.isLeaf = true;
                    this.size = size;
                }
            }
            
            private Node root;
            private int maxDepth;
            
            public IsolationTree(double[][] data, int maxDepth) {
                this.maxDepth = maxDepth;
                this.root = buildTree(data, 0);
            }
            
            private Node buildTree(double[][] data, int depth) {
                if (data.length <= 1 || depth >= maxDepth) {
                    return new Node(data.length);
                }
                
                Random random = new Random();
                int numFeatures = data[0].length;
                int splitAttribute = random.nextInt(numFeatures);
                
                // Find min and max values for the split attribute
                double min = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                double max = Double.MIN_VALUE;
                
                for (double[] row : data) {
                    min = Math.min(min, row[splitAttribute]);
                    max = Math.max(max, row[splitAttribute]);
                }
                
                if (min == max) {
                    return new Node(data.length);
                }
                
                double splitValue = min + random.nextDouble() * (max - min);
                
                // Split data
                List<double[]> leftData = new ArrayList<>();
                List<double[]> rightData = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (double[] row : data) {
                    if (row[splitAttribute] < splitValue) {
                        leftData.add(row);
                    } else {
                        rightData.add(row);
                    }
                }
                
                Node node = new Node();
                node.splitAttribute = splitAttribute;
                node.splitValue = splitValue;
                node.left = buildTree(leftData.toArray(new double[0][]), depth + 1);
                node.right = buildTree(rightData.toArray(new double[0][]), depth + 1);
                
                return node;
            }
            
            public double pathLength(double[] point) {
                return pathLength(point, root, 0);
            }
            
            private double pathLength(double[] point, Node node, int depth) {
                if (node.isLeaf) {
                    return depth + averagePathLength(node.size);
                }
                
                if (point[node.splitAttribute] < node.splitValue) {
                    return pathLength(point, node.left, depth + 1);
                } else {
                    return pathLength(point, node.right, depth + 1);
                }
            }
            
            private double averagePathLength(int n) {
                if (n <= 1) return 0;
                return 2.0 * (Math.log(n - 1) + 0.5772156649) - (2.0 * (n - 1) / n);
            }
        }
        
        private List<IsolationTree> trees;
        private int numTrees;
        private int sampleSize;
        
        public IsolationForest(int numTrees, int sampleSize) {
            this.numTrees = numTrees;
            this.sampleSize = sampleSize;
            this.trees = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        public void fit(double[][] data) {
            trees.clear();
            Random random = new Random();
            int maxDepth = (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(sampleSize) / Math.log(2));
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numTrees; i++) {
                // Sample data
                double[][] sample = new double[Math.min(sampleSize, data.length)][];
                for (int j = 0; j < sample.length; j++) {
                    sample[j] = data[random.nextInt(data.length)];
                }
                
                trees.add(new IsolationTree(sample, maxDepth));
            }
        }
        
        public double[] anomalyScore(double[][] data) {
            double[] scores = new double[data.length];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                double avgPathLength = 0;
                
                for (IsolationTree tree : trees) {
                    avgPathLength += tree.pathLength(data[i]);
                }
                
                avgPathLength /= numTrees;
                double c = averagePathLength(sampleSize);
                scores[i] = Math.pow(2, -avgPathLength / c);
            }
            
            return scores;
        }
        
        private double averagePathLength(int n) {
            if (n <= 1) return 0;
            return 2.0 * (Math.log(n - 1) + 0.5772156649) - (2.0 * (n - 1) / n);
        }
        
        public boolean[] predict(double[][] data, double threshold) {
            double[] scores = anomalyScore(data);
            boolean[] outliers = new boolean[scores.length];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++) {
                outliers[i] = scores[i] > threshold;
            }
            
            return outliers;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n²k) for Apriori, O(n log n) for FP-Growth, O(n²) for DBSCAN, **Space**: O(n×m)

```java
public class CryptographicAlgorithms {
    
    // RSA Encryption/Decryption
    public static class RSAAlgorithm {
        static class RSAKeyPair {
            BigInteger n, e, d;
            
            RSAKeyPair(BigInteger n, BigInteger e, BigInteger d) {
                this.n = n;
                this.e = e;
                this.d = d;
            }
        }
        
        public static RSAKeyPair generateKeyPair(int keySize) {
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // Generate two large prime numbers
            BigInteger p = BigInteger.probablePrime(keySize / 2, random);
            BigInteger q = BigInteger.probablePrime(keySize / 2, random);
            
            // Calculate n = p * q
            BigInteger n = p.multiply(q);
            
            // Calculate φ(n) = (p-1) * (q-1)
            BigInteger phi = p.subtract(BigInteger.ONE).multiply(q.subtract(BigInteger.ONE));
            
            // Choose e such that gcd(e, φ(n)) = 1
            BigInteger e = BigInteger.valueOf(65537); // Common choice
            while (phi.gcd(e).compareTo(BigInteger.ONE) != 0) {
                e = e.add(BigInteger.valueOf(2));
            }
            
            // Calculate d = e^(-1) mod φ(n)
            BigInteger d = e.modInverse(phi);
            
            return new RSAKeyPair(n, e, d);
        }
        
        public static BigInteger encrypt(BigInteger message, BigInteger e, BigInteger n) {
            return message.modPow(e, n);
        }
        
        public static BigInteger decrypt(BigInteger ciphertext, BigInteger d, BigInteger n) {
            return ciphertext.modPow(d, n);
        }
        
        public static byte[] encryptBytes(byte[] data, BigInteger e, BigInteger n) {
            BigInteger message = new BigInteger(1, data);
            BigInteger encrypted = encrypt(message, e, n);
            return encrypted.toByteArray();
        }
        
        public static byte[] decryptBytes(byte[] encryptedData, BigInteger d, BigInteger n) {
            BigInteger encrypted = new BigInteger(1, encryptedData);
            BigInteger decrypted = decrypt(encrypted, d, n);
            return decrypted.toByteArray();
        }
        
        // Digital Signature
        public static BigInteger sign(BigInteger message, BigInteger d, BigInteger n) {
            return message.modPow(d, n);
        }
        
        public static boolean verify(BigInteger message, BigInteger signature, 
                                   BigInteger e, BigInteger n) {
            BigInteger decryptedSignature = signature.modPow(e, n);
            return message.equals(decryptedSignature);
        }
    }

import java.util.*;
public class AdvancedSoftwareEngineeringAlgorithms {
    // Cyclomatic Complexity Calculation
    public static class CyclomaticComplexity {
        public static int calculate(String code) {
            int count = 1;
            String[] keywords = {"if", "for", "while", "case", "catch"};
            for (String kw : keywords) {
                int idx = 0;
                while ((idx = code.indexOf(kw, idx)) != -1) {
                    count++;
                    idx += kw.length();
                }
            }
            return count;
        }
    }
    // Code Refactoring Engine (rename variable)
    public static class RefactoringEngine {
        public static String renameVariable(String code, String oldName, String newName) {
            return code.replaceAll("\\b" + oldName + "\\b", newName);
        }
    }
    // Static Code Analysis (count lines, comments)
    public static class StaticCodeAnalysis {
        public static Map<String, Integer> analyze(String code) {
            int lines = code.split("\\n").length;
            int comments = 0;
            for (String line : code.split("\\n")) {
                if (line.trim().startsWith("//")) comments++;
            }
            Map<String, Integer> result = new HashMap<>();
            result.put("lines", lines);
            result.put("comments", comments);
            return result;
        }
    }

        public static byte[] encrypt(byte[] plaintext, byte[] key) {
            if (plaintext.length != 16 || key.length != 16) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("AES-128 requires 16-byte blocks and keys");
            }
            
            byte[][] roundKeys = keyExpansion(key);
            byte[] state = plaintext.clone();
            
            // Initial round
            addRoundKey(state, roundKeys[0]);
            
            // Main rounds
            for (int round = 1; round < 10; round++) {
                subBytes(state);
                shiftRows(state);
                mixColumns(state);
                addRoundKey(state, roundKeys[round]);
            }
            
            // Final round
            subBytes(state);
            shiftRows(state);
            addRoundKey(state, roundKeys[10]);
            
            return state;
        }
        
        private static byte[][] keyExpansion(byte[] key) {
            byte[][] roundKeys = new byte[11][16];
            System.arraycopy(key, 0, roundKeys[0], 0, 16);
            
            for (int round = 1; round <= 10; round++) {
                byte[] prevKey = roundKeys[round - 1];
                byte[] newKey = new byte[16];
                
                // First 4 bytes
                byte[] temp = {prevKey[13], prevKey[14], prevKey[15], prevKey[12]};
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    temp[i] = (byte) S_BOX[(temp[i] & 0xf0) >> 4][temp[i] & 0x0f];
                }
                temp[0] ^= RCON[round - 1];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    newKey[i] = (byte) (prevKey[i] ^ temp[i]);
                }
                
                // Remaining bytes
                for (int i = 4; i < 16; i++) {
                    newKey[i] = (byte) (prevKey[i] ^ newKey[i - 4]);
                }
                
                roundKeys[round] = newKey;
            }
            
            return roundKeys;
        }
        
        private static void subBytes(byte[] state) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                int row = (state[i] & 0xf0) >> 4;
                int col = state[i] & 0x0f;
                state[i] = (byte) S_BOX[row][col];
            }
        }
        
        private static void shiftRows(byte[] state) {
            byte[] temp = state.clone();
            
            // Row 1: shift left by 1
            state[1] = temp[5];
            state[5] = temp[9];
            state[9] = temp[13];
            state[13] = temp[1];
            
            // Row 2: shift left by 2
            state[2] = temp[10];
            state[6] = temp[14];
            state[10] = temp[2];
            state[14] = temp[6];
            
            // Row 3: shift left by 3
            state[3] = temp[15];
            state[7] = temp[3];
            state[11] = temp[7];
            state[15] = temp[11];
        }
        
        private static void mixColumns(byte[] state) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
                int c0 = state[col * 4] & 0xff;
                int c1 = state[col * 4 + 1] & 0xff;
                int c2 = state[col * 4 + 2] & 0xff;
                int c3 = state[col * 4 + 3] & 0xff;
                
                state[col * 4] = (byte) (gfMul(0x02, c0) ^ gfMul(0x03, c1) ^ c2 ^ c3);
                state[col * 4 + 1] = (byte) (c0 ^ gfMul(0x02, c1) ^ gfMul(0x03, c2) ^ c3);
                state[col * 4 + 2] = (byte) (c0 ^ c1 ^ gfMul(0x02, c2) ^ gfMul(0x03, c3));
                state[col * 4 + 3] = (byte) (gfMul(0x03, c0) ^ c1 ^ c2 ^ gfMul(0x02, c3));
            }
        }
        
        private static int gfMul(int a, int b) {
            int result = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                if ((b & 1) != 0) {
                    result ^= a;
                }
                boolean hiBitSet = (a & 0x80) != 0;
                a <<= 1;
                if (hiBitSet) {
                    a ^= 0x1b;
                }
                b >>= 1;
            }
            return result & 0xff;
        }
        
        private static void addRoundKey(byte[] state, byte[] roundKey) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                state[i] ^= roundKey[i];
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Elliptic Curve Cryptography (simplified)
    public static class EllipticCurveCryptography {
        static class Point {
            BigInteger x, y;
            boolean isInfinity;
            
            Point() {
                this.isInfinity = true;
            }
            
            Point(BigInteger x, BigInteger y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.isInfinity = false;
            }
            
            @Override
            public boolean equals(Object obj) {
                if (!(obj instanceof Point)) return false;
                Point other = (Point) obj;
                if (isInfinity && other.isInfinity) return true;
                if (isInfinity || other.isInfinity) return false;
                return x.equals(other.x) && y.equals(other.y);
            }
        }
        
        static class EllipticCurve {
            BigInteger a, b, p; // y² = x³ + ax + b (mod p)
            Point generator;
            BigInteger order;
            
            EllipticCurve(BigInteger a, BigInteger b, BigInteger p, Point generator, BigInteger order) {
                this.a = a;
                this.b = b;
                this.p = p;
                this.generator = generator;
                this.order = order;
            }
            
            Point add(Point P, Point Q) {
                if (P.isInfinity) return Q;
                if (Q.isInfinity) return P;
                
                if (P.x.equals(Q.x)) {
                    if (P.y.equals(Q.y)) {
                        return doublePoint(P);
                    } else {
                        return new Point(); // Point at infinity
                    }
                }
                
                // λ = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) mod p
                BigInteger numerator = Q.y.subtract(P.y).mod(p);
                BigInteger denominator = Q.x.subtract(P.x).mod(p);
                BigInteger lambda = numerator.multiply(denominator.modInverse(p)).mod(p);
                
                // x3 = λ² - x1 - x2 mod p
                BigInteger x3 = lambda.pow(2).subtract(P.x).subtract(Q.x).mod(p);
                
                // y3 = λ(x1 - x3) - y1 mod p
                BigInteger y3 = lambda.multiply(P.x.subtract(x3)).subtract(P.y).mod(p);
                
                return new Point(x3, y3);
            }
            
            Point doublePoint(Point P) {
                if (P.isInfinity) return P;
                
                // λ = (3x1² + a) / (2y1) mod p
                BigInteger numerator = P.x.pow(2).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(3)).add(a).mod(p);
                BigInteger denominator = P.y.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2)).mod(p);
                BigInteger lambda = numerator.multiply(denominator.modInverse(p)).mod(p);
                
                // x3 = λ² - 2x1 mod p
                BigInteger x3 = lambda.pow(2).subtract(P.x.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2))).mod(p);
                
                // y3 = λ(x1 - x3) - y1 mod p
                BigInteger y3 = lambda.multiply(P.x.subtract(x3)).subtract(P.y).mod(p);
                
                return new Point(x3, y3);
            }
            
            Point multiply(BigInteger k, Point P) {
                if (k.equals(BigInteger.ZERO) || P.isInfinity) {
                    return new Point();
                }
                
                Point result = new Point();
                Point addend = P;
                
                while (k.compareTo(BigInteger.ZERO) > 0) {
                    if (k.testBit(0)) {
                        result = add(result, addend);
                    }
                    addend = doublePoint(addend);
                    k = k.shiftRight(1);
                }
                
                return result;
            }
        }
        
        static class ECKeyPair {
            BigInteger privateKey;
            Point publicKey;
            
            ECKeyPair(BigInteger privateKey, Point publicKey) {
                this.privateKey = privateKey;
                this.publicKey = publicKey;
            }
        }
        
        public static ECKeyPair generateKeyPair(EllipticCurve curve) {
            Random random = new Random();
            BigInteger privateKey;
            
            do {
                privateKey = new BigInteger(curve.order.bitLength(), random);
            } while (privateKey.equals(BigInteger.ZERO) || privateKey.compareTo(curve.order) >= 0);
            
            Point publicKey = curve.multiply(privateKey, curve.generator);
            
            return new ECKeyPair(privateKey, publicKey);
        }
        
        // ECDSA Signature
        static class ECDSASignature {
            BigInteger r, s;
            
            ECDSASignature(BigInteger r, BigInteger s) {
                this.r = r;
                this.s = s;
            }
        }
        
        public static ECDSASignature sign(byte[] message, BigInteger privateKey, EllipticCurve curve) {
            BigInteger hash = new BigInteger(1, hashMessage(message));
            Random random = new Random();
            
            BigInteger k;
            BigInteger r;
            
            do {
                do {
                    k = new BigInteger(curve.order.bitLength(), random);
                } while (k.equals(BigInteger.ZERO) || k.compareTo(curve.order) >= 0);
                
                Point kG = curve.multiply(k, curve.generator);
                r = kG.x.mod(curve.order);
            } while (r.equals(BigInteger.ZERO));
            
            BigInteger s = k.modInverse(curve.order)
                    .multiply(hash.add(privateKey.multiply(r)))
                    .mod(curve.order);
            
            if (s.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) {
                return sign(message, privateKey, curve); // Try again
            }
            
            return new ECDSASignature(r, s);
        }
        
        public static boolean verify(byte[] message, ECDSASignature signature, 
                                   Point publicKey, EllipticCurve curve) {
            BigInteger hash = new BigInteger(1, hashMessage(message));
            
            if (signature.r.equals(BigInteger.ZERO) || signature.r.compareTo(curve.order) >= 0 ||
                signature.s.equals(BigInteger.ZERO) || signature.s.compareTo(curve.order) >= 0) {
                return false;
            }
            
            BigInteger w = signature.s.modInverse(curve.order);
            BigInteger u1 = hash.multiply(w).mod(curve.order);
            BigInteger u2 = signature.r.multiply(w).mod(curve.order);
            
            Point point1 = curve.multiply(u1, curve.generator);
            Point point2 = curve.multiply(u2, publicKey);
            Point result = curve.add(point1, point2);
            
            if (result.isInfinity) return false;
            
            return result.x.mod(curve.order).equals(signature.r);
        }
        
        private static byte[] hashMessage(byte[] message) {
            // Simplified hash function (in practice, use SHA-256)
            MessageDigest digest;
            try {
                digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
                return digest.digest(message);
            } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("SHA-256 not available", e);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange
    public static class DiffieHellmanKeyExchange {
        static class DHParameters {
            BigInteger p; // Prime modulus
            BigInteger g; // Generator
            
            DHParameters(BigInteger p, BigInteger g) {
                this.p = p;
                this.g = g;
            }
        }
        
        static class DHKeyPair {
            BigInteger privateKey;
            BigInteger publicKey;
            
            DHKeyPair(BigInteger privateKey, BigInteger publicKey) {
                this.privateKey = privateKey;
                this.publicKey = publicKey;
            }
        }
        
        public static DHParameters generateParameters(int bitLength) {
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // Generate a safe prime p = 2q + 1 where q is also prime
            BigInteger p;
            do {
                BigInteger q = BigInteger.probablePrime(bitLength - 1, random);
                p = q.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2)).add(BigInteger.ONE);
            } while (!p.isProbablePrime(20));
            
            // Find a generator g
            BigInteger g = BigInteger.valueOf(2);
            while (g.modPow(p.subtract(BigInteger.ONE).divide(BigInteger.valueOf(2)), p)
                    .equals(BigInteger.ONE)) {
                g = g.add(BigInteger.ONE);
            }
            
            return new DHParameters(p, g);
        }
        
        public static DHKeyPair generateKeyPair(DHParameters params) {
            Random random = new Random();
            
            // Generate private key
            BigInteger privateKey = new BigInteger(params.p.bitLength() - 1, random);
            
            // Calculate public key: g^privateKey mod p
            BigInteger publicKey = params.g.modPow(privateKey, params.p);
            
            return new DHKeyPair(privateKey, publicKey);
        }
        
        public static BigInteger computeSharedSecret(BigInteger otherPublicKey, 
                                                   BigInteger myPrivateKey, 
                                                   DHParameters params) {
            return otherPublicKey.modPow(myPrivateKey, params.p);
        }
        
        // Example usage
        public static void demonstrateKeyExchange() {
            // Generate parameters
            DHParameters params = generateParameters(1024);
            
            // Alice generates her key pair
            DHKeyPair aliceKeys = generateKeyPair(params);
            
            // Bob generates his key pair
            DHKeyPair bobKeys = generateKeyPair(params);
            
            // Alice computes shared secret using Bob's public key
            BigInteger aliceSharedSecret = computeSharedSecret(bobKeys.publicKey, 
                                                              aliceKeys.privateKey, params);
            
            // Bob computes shared secret using Alice's public key
            BigInteger bobSharedSecret = computeSharedSecret(aliceKeys.publicKey, 
                                                            bobKeys.privateKey, params);
            
            // Both should be equal
            assert aliceSharedSecret.equals(bobSharedSecret);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) for modular exponentiation, O(n³) for key generation, **Space**: O(n)
