```java
public class ComputerVisionAlgorithms {
    
    // Image representation and basic operations
    public static class Image {
        private int[][] pixels;
        private int width, height;
        
        public Image(int width, int height) {
            this.width = width;
            this.height = height;
            this.pixels = new int[height][width];
        }
        
        public Image(int[][] pixels) {
            this.height = pixels.length;
            this.width = pixels[0].length;
            this.pixels = new int[height][width];
            for (int i = 0; i < height; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(pixels[i], 0, this.pixels[i], 0, width);
            }
        }
        
        public int getPixel(int x, int y) {
            if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                return pixels[y][x];
            }
            return 0; // Border handling
        }
        
        public void setPixel(int x, int y, int value) {
            if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                pixels[y][x] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, value));
            }
        }
        
        public int getWidth() { return width; }
        public int getHeight() { return height; }
        
        public Image copy() {
            return new Image(pixels);
        }
    }
    
    // Edge Detection Algorithms
    public static class EdgeDetection {
        
        // Sobel Edge Detection
        public static Image sobelEdgeDetection(Image image) {
            int[][] sobelX = {{-1, 0, 1}, {-2, 0, 2}, {-1, 0, 1}};
            int[][] sobelY = {{-1, -2, -1}, {0, 0, 0}, {1, 2, 1}};
            
            Image result = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            for (int y = 1; y < image.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                for (int x = 1; x < image.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                    int gx = 0, gy = 0;
                    
                    for (int ky = -1; ky <= 1; ky++) {
                        for (int kx = -1; kx <= 1; kx++) {
                            int pixel = image.getPixel(x + kx, y + ky);
                            gx += pixel * sobelX[ky + 1][kx + 1];
                            gy += pixel * sobelY[ky + 1][kx + 1];
                        }
                    }
                    
                    int magnitude = (int) Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
                    result.setPixel(x, y, magnitude);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Canny Edge Detection
        public static Image cannyEdgeDetection(Image image, double lowThreshold, 
                                             double highThreshold) {
            // Step 1: Gaussian blur
            Image blurred = gaussianBlur(image, 1.4);
            
            // Step 2: Gradient calculation
            Image gradientMag = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            Image gradientDir = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            int[][] sobelX = {{-1, 0, 1}, {-2, 0, 2}, {-1, 0, 1}};
            int[][] sobelY = {{-1, -2, -1}, {0, 0, 0}, {1, 2, 1}};
            
            for (int y = 1; y < blurred.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                for (int x = 1; x < blurred.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                    int gx = 0, gy = 0;
                    
                    for (int ky = -1; ky <= 1; ky++) {
                        for (int kx = -1; kx <= 1; kx++) {
                            int pixel = blurred.getPixel(x + kx, y + ky);
                            gx += pixel * sobelX[ky + 1][kx + 1];
                            gy += pixel * sobelY[ky + 1][kx + 1];
                        }
                    }
                    
                    int magnitude = (int) Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
                    int direction = (int) (Math.atan2(gy, gx) * 180 / Math.PI);
                    if (direction < 0) direction += 180;
                    
                    gradientMag.setPixel(x, y, magnitude);
                    gradientDir.setPixel(x, y, direction);
                }
            }
            
            // Step 3: Non-maximum suppression
            Image suppressed = nonMaximumSuppression(gradientMag, gradientDir);
            
            // Step 4: Double thresholding and edge tracking
            return doubleThresholding(suppressed, lowThreshold, highThreshold);
        }
        
        private static Image gaussianBlur(Image image, double sigma) {
            int kernelSize = (int) (6 * sigma + 1);
            if (kernelSize % 2 == 0) kernelSize++;
            
            double[][] kernel = new double[kernelSize][kernelSize];
            double sum = 0;
            int center = kernelSize / 2;
            
            for (int y = 0; y < kernelSize; y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < kernelSize; x++) {
                    double value = Math.exp(-((x - center) * (x - center) + 
                                            (y - center) * (y - center)) / (2 * sigma * sigma));
                    kernel[y][x] = value;
                    sum += value;
                }
            }
            
            // Normalize kernel
            for (int y = 0; y < kernelSize; y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < kernelSize; x++) {
                    kernel[y][x] /= sum;
                }
            }
            
            return applyKernel(image, kernel);
        }
        
        private static Image applyKernel(Image image, double[][] kernel) {
            Image result = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            int center = kernel.length / 2;
            
            for (int y = center; y < image.getHeight() - center; y++) {
                for (int x = center; x < image.getWidth() - center; x++) {
                    double sum = 0;
                    
                    for (int ky = 0; ky < kernel.length; ky++) {
                        for (int kx = 0; kx < kernel[0].length; kx++) {
                            int px = x + kx - center;
                            int py = y + ky - center;
                            sum += image.getPixel(px, py) * kernel[ky][kx];
                        }
                    }
                    
                    result.setPixel(x, y, (int) sum);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static Image nonMaximumSuppression(Image magnitude, Image direction) {
            Image result = new Image(magnitude.getWidth(), magnitude.getHeight());
            
            for (int y = 1; y < magnitude.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                for (int x = 1; x < magnitude.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                    int dir = direction.getPixel(x, y);
                    int mag = magnitude.getPixel(x, y);
                    
                    int neighbor1, neighbor2;
                    
                    if (dir >= 0 && dir < 45 || dir >= 135 && dir <= 180) {
                        neighbor1 = magnitude.getPixel(x - 1, y);
                        neighbor2 = magnitude.getPixel(x + 1, y);
                    } else if (dir >= 45 && dir < 90) {
                        neighbor1 = magnitude.getPixel(x - 1, y - 1);
                        neighbor2 = magnitude.getPixel(x + 1, y + 1);
                    } else {
                        neighbor1 = magnitude.getPixel(x - 1, y + 1);
                        neighbor2 = magnitude.getPixel(x + 1, y - 1);
                    }
                    
                    if (mag >= neighbor1 && mag >= neighbor2) {
                        result.setPixel(x, y, mag);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static Image doubleThresholding(Image image, double lowThreshold, 
                                              double highThreshold) {
            Image result = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            // Apply thresholds
            for (int y = 0; y < image.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < image.getWidth(); x++) {
                    int pixel = image.getPixel(x, y);
                    
                    if (pixel >= highThreshold) {
                        result.setPixel(x, y, 255); // Strong edge
                    } else if (pixel >= lowThreshold) {
                        result.setPixel(x, y, 128); // Weak edge
                    } else {
                        result.setPixel(x, y, 0); // Not an edge
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Edge tracking by hysteresis
            boolean changed = true;
            while (changed) {
                changed = false;
                
                for (int y = 1; y < result.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                    for (int x = 1; x < result.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                        if (result.getPixel(x, y) == 128) {
                            boolean hasStrongNeighbor = false;
                            
                            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                                    if (result.getPixel(x + dx, y + dy) == 255) {
                                        hasStrongNeighbor = true;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (hasStrongNeighbor) break;
                            }
                            
                            if (hasStrongNeighbor) {
                                result.setPixel(x, y, 255);
                                changed = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Clean up weak edges that weren't connected
            for (int y = 0; y < result.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < result.getWidth(); x++) {
                    if (result.getPixel(x, y) == 128) {
                        result.setPixel(x, y, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    // Corner Detection
    public static class CornerDetection {
        
        // Harris Corner Detection
        public static List<Point> harrisCornerDetection(Image image, double k, 
                                                       double threshold) {
            List<Point> corners = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Compute gradients
            Image gradX = computeGradientX(image);
            Image gradY = computeGradientY(image);
            
            // Compute products of gradients
            Image gradXX = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            Image gradYY = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            Image gradXY = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            for (int y = 0; y < image.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < image.getWidth(); x++) {
                    int gx = gradX.getPixel(x, y);
                    int gy = gradY.getPixel(x, y);
                    
                    gradXX.setPixel(x, y, gx * gx);
                    gradYY.setPixel(x, y, gy * gy);
                    gradXY.setPixel(x, y, gx * gy);
                }
            }
            
            // Apply Gaussian smoothing
            gradXX = EdgeDetection.gaussianBlur(gradXX, 1.0);
            gradYY = EdgeDetection.gaussianBlur(gradYY, 1.0);
            gradXY = EdgeDetection.gaussianBlur(gradXY, 1.0);
            
            // Compute Harris response
            for (int y = 1; y < image.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                for (int x = 1; x < image.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                    double sxx = gradXX.getPixel(x, y);
                    double syy = gradYY.getPixel(x, y);
                    double sxy = gradXY.getPixel(x, y);
                    
                    double det = sxx * syy - sxy * sxy;
                    double trace = sxx + syy;
                    double response = det - k * trace * trace;
                    
                    if (response > threshold && isLocalMaximum(x, y, gradXX, gradYY, gradXY, k)) {
                        corners.add(new Point(x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return corners;
        }
        
        private static Image computeGradientX(Image image) {
            Image result = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            for (int y = 0; y < image.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 1; x < image.getWidth() - 1; x++) {
                    int grad = image.getPixel(x + 1, y) - image.getPixel(x - 1, y);
                    result.setPixel(x, y, grad / 2);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static Image computeGradientY(Image image) {
            Image result = new Image(image.getWidth(), image.getHeight());
            
            for (int y = 1; y < image.getHeight() - 1; y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < image.getWidth(); x++) {
                    int grad = image.getPixel(x, y + 1) - image.getPixel(x, y - 1);
                    result.setPixel(x, y, grad / 2);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static boolean isLocalMaximum(int x, int y, Image gradXX, Image gradYY, 
                                            Image gradXY, double k) {
            double sxx = gradXX.getPixel(x, y);
            double syy = gradYY.getPixel(x, y);
            double sxy = gradXY.getPixel(x, y);
            
            double det = sxx * syy - sxy * sxy;
            double trace = sxx + syy;
            double response = det - k * trace * trace;
            
            // Check if this is a local maximum
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue;
                    
                    double nsxx = gradXX.getPixel(x + dx, y + dy);
                    double nsyy = gradYY.getPixel(x + dx, y + dy);
                    double nsxy = gradXY.getPixel(x + dx, y + dy);
                    
                    double ndet = nsxx * nsyy - nsxy * nsxy;
                    double ntrace = nsxx + nsyy;
                    double nresponse = ndet - k * ntrace * ntrace;
                    
                    if (nresponse >= response) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        static class Point {
            int x, y;
            
            Point(int x, int y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return "(" + x + ", " + y + ")";
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Feature Matching
    public static class FeatureMatching {
        
        // SIFT-like feature descriptor (simplified)
        static class Feature {
            CornerDetection.Point location;
            double[] descriptor;
            double orientation;
            double scale;
            
            Feature(CornerDetection.Point location, double[] descriptor, 
                   double orientation, double scale) {
                this.location = location;
                this.descriptor = descriptor.clone();
                this.orientation = orientation;
                this.scale = scale;
            }
            
            double distanceTo(Feature other) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < descriptor.length; i++) {
                    sum += Math.pow(descriptor[i] - other.descriptor[i], 2);
                }
                return Math.sqrt(sum);
            }
        }
        
        static class Match {
            Feature feature1, feature2;
            double distance;
            
            Match(Feature feature1, Feature feature2, double distance) {
                this.feature1 = feature1;
                this.feature2 = feature2;
                this.distance = distance;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Feature> extractFeatures(Image image, 
                                                   List<CornerDetection.Point> keypoints) {
            List<Feature> features = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (CornerDetection.Point point : keypoints) {
                double[] descriptor = computeDescriptor(image, point);
                double orientation = computeOrientation(image, point);
                double scale = 1.0; // Simplified
                
                features.add(new Feature(point, descriptor, orientation, scale));
            }
            
            return features;
        }
        
        private static double[] computeDescriptor(Image image, CornerDetection.Point point) {
            // Simplified descriptor: 8x8 patch around the point
            double[] descriptor = new double[64];
            int idx = 0;
            
            for (int dy = -4; dy < 4; dy++) {
                for (int dx = -4; dx < 4; dx++) {
                    int x = point.x + dx;
                    int y = point.y + dy;
                    descriptor[idx++] = image.getPixel(x, y) / 255.0;
                }
            }
            
            // Normalize descriptor
            double norm = 0;
            for (double value : descriptor) {
                norm += value * value;
            }
            norm = Math.sqrt(norm);
            
            if (norm > 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < descriptor.length; i++) {
                    descriptor[i] /= norm;
                }
            }
            
            return descriptor;
        }
        
        private static double computeOrientation(Image image, CornerDetection.Point point) {
            // Compute dominant orientation using gradient
            double[] histogram = new double[36]; // 36 bins, 10 degrees each
            
            for (int dy = -8; dy <= 8; dy++) {
                for (int dx = -8; dx <= 8; dx++) {
                    int x = point.x + dx;
                    int y = point.y + dy;
                    
                    if (x > 0 && x < image.getWidth() - 1 && y > 0 && y < image.getHeight() - 1) {
                        int gx = image.getPixel(x + 1, y) - image.getPixel(x - 1, y);
                        int gy = image.getPixel(x, y + 1) - image.getPixel(x, y - 1);
                        
                        double magnitude = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
                        double angle = Math.atan2(gy, gx) * 180 / Math.PI;
                        if (angle < 0) angle += 360;
                        
                        int bin = (int) (angle / 10) % 36;
                        histogram[bin] += magnitude;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Find dominant orientation
            int maxBin = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < histogram.length; i++) {
                if (histogram[i] > histogram[maxBin]) {
                    maxBin = i;
                }
            }
            
            return maxBin * 10; // Convert back to degrees
        }
        
        public static List<Match> matchFeatures(List<Feature> features1, 
                                              List<Feature> features2, 
                                              double maxDistance) {
            List<Match> matches = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Feature f1 : features1) {
                Feature bestMatch = null;
                double bestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                double secondBestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                
                for (Feature f2 : features2) {
                    double distance = f1.distanceTo(f2);
                    
                    if (distance < bestDistance) {
                        secondBestDistance = bestDistance;
                        bestDistance = distance;
                        bestMatch = f2;
                    } else if (distance < secondBestDistance) {
                        secondBestDistance = distance;
                    }
                }
                
                // Lowe's ratio test
                if (bestMatch != null && bestDistance < maxDistance && 
                    bestDistance / secondBestDistance < 0.8) {
                    matches.add(new Match(f1, bestMatch, bestDistance));
                }
            }
            
            return matches;
        }
    }
    
    // Hough Transform for Line Detection
    public static class HoughTransform {
        
        static class Line {
            double rho, theta;
            
            Line(double rho, double theta) {
                this.rho = rho;
                this.theta = theta;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("Line: rho=%.2f, theta=%.2f", rho, Math.toDegrees(theta));
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Line> detectLines(Image edges, int threshold) {
            List<Line> lines = new ArrayList<>();
            
            int maxRho = (int) Math.sqrt(edges.getWidth() * edges.getWidth() + 
                                       edges.getHeight() * edges.getHeight());
            int thetaSteps = 180;
            
            // Accumulator array
            int[][] accumulator = new int[2 * maxRho][thetaSteps];
            
            // Fill accumulator
            for (int y = 0; y < edges.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < edges.getWidth(); x++) {
                    if (edges.getPixel(x, y) > 0) { // Edge pixel
                        for (int t = 0; t < thetaSteps; t++) {
                            double theta = Math.PI * t / thetaSteps;
                            int rho = (int) (x * Math.cos(theta) + y * Math.sin(theta));
                            
                            if (rho >= -maxRho && rho < maxRho) {
                                accumulator[rho + maxRho][t]++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Find peaks in accumulator
            for (int r = 1; r < 2 * maxRho - 1; r++) {
                for (int t = 1; t < thetaSteps - 1; t++) {
                    if (accumulator[r][t] > threshold && 
                        isLocalMaximumHough(accumulator, r, t)) {
                        
                        double rho = r - maxRho;
                        double theta = Math.PI * t / thetaSteps;
                        lines.add(new Line(rho, theta));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return lines;
        }
        
        private static boolean isLocalMaximumHough(int[][] accumulator, int r, int t) {
            int value = accumulator[r][t];
            
            for (int dr = -1; dr <= 1; dr++) {
                for (int dt = -1; dt <= 1; dt++) {
                    if (dr == 0 && dt == 0) continue;
                    
                    int nr = r + dr;
                    int nt = t + dt;
                    
                    if (nr >= 0 && nr < accumulator.length && 
                        nt >= 0 && nt < accumulator[0].length) {
                        if (accumulator[nr][nt] >= value) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        // Circle detection using Hough Transform
        static class Circle {
            int x, y, radius;
            
            Circle(int x, int y, int radius) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.radius = radius;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("Circle: center=(%d,%d), radius=%d", x, y, radius);
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Circle> detectCircles(Image edges, int minRadius, int maxRadius, 
                                               int threshold) {
            List<Circle> circles = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // 3D accumulator: [x][y][radius]
            int[][][] accumulator = new int[edges.getWidth()][edges.getHeight()][maxRadius - minRadius + 1];
            
            // Fill accumulator
            for (int y = 0; y < edges.getHeight(); y++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < edges.getWidth(); x++) {
                    if (edges.getPixel(x, y) > 0) { // Edge pixel
                        for (int r = minRadius; r <= maxRadius; r++) {
                            // Vote for all possible circle centers
                            for (int theta = 0; theta < 360; theta += 5) {
                                double rad = Math.toRadians(theta);
                                int cx = (int) (x - r * Math.cos(rad));
                                int cy = (int) (y - r * Math.sin(rad));
                                
                                if (cx >= 0 && cx < edges.getWidth() && 
                                    cy >= 0 && cy < edges.getHeight()) {
                                    accumulator[cx][cy][r - minRadius]++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Find peaks
            for (int x = 0; x < edges.getWidth(); x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < edges.getHeight(); y++) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < maxRadius - minRadius + 1; r++) {
                        if (accumulator[x][y][r] > threshold) {
                            circles.add(new Circle(x, y, r + minRadius));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return circles;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n²) for edge detection, O(n³) for Hough transform, **Space**: O(n²)

### 165. Network Analysis Algorithms
**Problem**: Complex network analysis and graph mining techniques  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class NetworkAnalysisAlgorithms {
    
    // PageRank Algorithm
    public static class PageRankAlgorithm {
        
        public static double[] pageRank(List<List<Integer>> graph, double dampingFactor, 
                                      double epsilon, int maxIterations) {
            int n = graph.size();
            double[] pagerank = new double[n];
            double[] newPagerank = new double[n];
            
            // Initialize with equal probability
            Arrays.fill(pagerank, 1.0 / n);
            
            // Calculate out-degrees
            int[] outDegree = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                outDegree[i] = graph.get(i).size();
                if (outDegree[i] == 0) outDegree[i] = 1; // Handle dangling nodes
            }
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                // Calculate new PageRank values
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    newPagerank[i] = (1.0 - dampingFactor) / n;
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        if (graph.get(j).contains(i)) {
                            newPagerank[i] += dampingFactor * pagerank[j] / outDegree[j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Check for convergence
                double diff = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    diff += Math.abs(newPagerank[i] - pagerank[i]);
                }
                
                if (diff < epsilon) {
                    break;
                }
                
                // Copy new values
                System.arraycopy(newPagerank, 0, pagerank, 0, n);
            }
            
            return pagerank;
        }
        
        // Personalized PageRank
        public static double[] personalizedPageRank(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                   Set<Integer> personalizedNodes,
                                                   double dampingFactor, double epsilon) {
            int n = graph.size();
            double[] pagerank = new double[n];
            double[] newPagerank = new double[n];
            
            // Initialize
            Arrays.fill(pagerank, 1.0 / n);
            
            int[] outDegree = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                outDegree[i] = Math.max(1, graph.get(i).size());
            }
            
            while (true) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    newPagerank[i] = 0;
                    
                    // Random jump component
                    if (personalizedNodes.contains(i)) {
                        newPagerank[i] += (1.0 - dampingFactor) / personalizedNodes.size();
                    }
                    
                    // Link component
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        if (graph.get(j).contains(i)) {
                            newPagerank[i] += dampingFactor * pagerank[j] / outDegree[j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Check convergence
                double diff = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    diff += Math.abs(newPagerank[i] - pagerank[i]);
                }
                
                if (diff < epsilon) break;
                
                System.arraycopy(newPagerank, 0, pagerank, 0, n);
            }
            
            return pagerank;
        }
    }
    
    // Community Detection using Modularity
    public static class CommunityDetection {
        
        static class Community {
            Set<Integer> nodes;
            double modularity;
            
            Community() {
                this.nodes = new HashSet<>();
                this.modularity = 0.0;
            }
            
            Community(Set<Integer> nodes) {
                this.nodes = new HashSet<>(nodes);
                this.modularity = 0.0;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Community> louvainMethod(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            
            // Initialize each node as its own community
            List<Community> communities = new ArrayList<>();
            int[] nodeToComm = new int[n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Community comm = new Community();
                comm.nodes.add(i);
                communities.add(comm);
                nodeToComm[i] = i;
            }
            
            // Calculate total edges
            int totalEdges = 0;
            for (List<Integer> neighbors : graph) {
                totalEdges += neighbors.size();
            }
            
            boolean improved = true;
            while (improved) {
                improved = false;
                
                for (int node = 0; node < n; node++) {
                    int currentComm = nodeToComm[node];
                    double currentModularity = calculateModularity(graph, communities, totalEdges);
                    
                    // Try moving node to each neighbor's community
                    Set<Integer> neighborComms = new HashSet<>();
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(node)) {
                        neighborComms.add(nodeToComm[neighbor]);
                    }
                    
                    double bestModularity = currentModularity;
                    int bestComm = currentComm;
                    
                    for (int targetComm : neighborComms) {
                        if (targetComm != currentComm) {
                            // Move node temporarily
                            communities.get(currentComm).nodes.remove(node);
                            communities.get(targetComm).nodes.add(node);
                            nodeToComm[node] = targetComm;
                            
                            double newModularity = calculateModularity(graph, communities, totalEdges);
                            
                            if (newModularity > bestModularity) {
                                bestModularity = newModularity;
                                bestComm = targetComm;
                            }
                            
                            // Move back
                            communities.get(targetComm).nodes.remove(node);
                            communities.get(currentComm).nodes.add(node);
                            nodeToComm[node] = currentComm;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Make the best move if it improves modularity
                    if (bestComm != currentComm) {
                        communities.get(currentComm).nodes.remove(node);
                        communities.get(bestComm).nodes.add(node);
                        nodeToComm[node] = bestComm;
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Remove empty communities
            communities.removeIf(comm -> comm.nodes.isEmpty());
            
            // Calculate final modularity for each community
            for (Community comm : communities) {
                comm.modularity = calculateCommunityModularity(graph, comm, totalEdges);
            }
            
            return communities;
        }
        
        private static double calculateModularity(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                List<Community> communities, int totalEdges) {
            double modularity = 0.0;
            
            for (Community comm : communities) {
                if (!comm.nodes.isEmpty()) {
                    modularity += calculateCommunityModularity(graph, comm, totalEdges);
                }
            }
            
            return modularity;
        }
        
        private static double calculateCommunityModularity(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                         Community comm, int totalEdges) {
            int internalEdges = 0;
            int totalDegree = 0;
            
            for (int node : comm.nodes) {
                totalDegree += graph.get(node).size();
                
                for (int neighbor : graph.get(node)) {
                    if (comm.nodes.contains(neighbor)) {
                        internalEdges++;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            internalEdges /= 2; // Each edge counted twice
            
            double expected = (double) totalDegree * totalDegree / (4.0 * totalEdges);
            return (internalEdges - expected) / totalEdges;
        }
        
        // Girvan-Newman Algorithm
        public static List<Community> girvanNewman(List<List<Integer>> graph, int numCommunities) {
            // Convert to edge list format for easier manipulation
            Set<String> edges = new HashSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                for (int j : graph.get(i)) {
                    if (i < j) {
                        edges.add(i + "," + j);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            while (getConnectedComponents(graph).size() < numCommunities && !edges.isEmpty()) {
                // Calculate edge betweenness for all edges
                Map<String, Double> betweenness = calculateEdgeBetweenness(graph);
                
                // Find edge with highest betweenness
                String edgeToRemove = betweenness.entrySet().stream()
                        .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                        .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                        .orElse(null);
                
                if (edgeToRemove != null) {
                    // Remove edge from graph
                    String[] vertices = edgeToRemove.split(",");
                    int u = Integer.parseInt(vertices[0]);
                    int v = Integer.parseInt(vertices[1]);
                    
                    graph.get(u).remove((Integer) v);
                    graph.get(v).remove((Integer) u);
                    edges.remove(edgeToRemove);
                }
            }
            
            // Return connected components as communities
            List<Set<Integer>> components = getConnectedComponents(graph);
            List<Community> communities = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Set<Integer> component : components) {
                communities.add(new Community(component));
            }
            
            return communities;
        }
        
        private static Map<String, Double> calculateEdgeBetweenness(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            Map<String, Double> betweenness = new HashMap<>();
            
            // Initialize all edges with 0 betweenness
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                for (int j : graph.get(i)) {
                    if (i < j) {
                        betweenness.put(i + "," + j, 0.0);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Calculate betweenness for each node pair
            for (int source = 0; source < graph.size(); source++) {
                for (int target = source + 1; target < graph.size(); target++) {
                    List<List<Integer>> paths = findAllShortestPaths(graph, source, target);
                    
                    if (!paths.isEmpty()) {
                        double pathWeight = 1.0 / paths.size();
                        
                        for (List<Integer> path : paths) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < path.size() - 1; i++) {
                                int u = path.get(i);
                                int v = path.get(i + 1);
                                String edge = u < v ? u + "," + v : v + "," + u;
                                
                                betweenness.put(edge, betweenness.getOrDefault(edge, 0.0) + pathWeight);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return betweenness;
        }
        
        private static List<List<Integer>> findAllShortestPaths(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                               int source, int target) {
            List<List<Integer>> paths = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // BFS to find shortest path length
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            Map<Integer, Integer> distance = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> predecessors = new HashMap<>();
            
            queue.offer(source);
            distance.put(source, 0);
            predecessors.put(source, new ArrayList<>());
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int current = queue.poll();
                int currentDist = distance.get(current);
                
                for (int neighbor : graph.get(current)) {
                    if (!distance.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                        distance.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
                        predecessors.put(neighbor, new ArrayList<>());
                        queue.offer(neighbor);
                    }
                    
                    if (distance.get(neighbor) == currentDist + 1) {
                        predecessors.get(neighbor).add(current);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Reconstruct all shortest paths
            if (distance.containsKey(target)) {
                reconstructPaths(target, source, predecessors, new ArrayList<>(), paths);
            }
            
            return paths;
        }
        
        private static void reconstructPaths(int current, int source, 
                                           Map<Integer, List<Integer>> predecessors,
                                           List<Integer> currentPath, 
                                           List<List<Integer>> allPaths) {
            currentPath.add(0, current);
            
            if (current == source) {
                allPaths.add(new ArrayList<>(currentPath));
            } else {
                for (int pred : predecessors.get(current)) {
                    reconstructPaths(pred, source, predecessors, currentPath, allPaths);
                }
            }
            
            currentPath.remove(0);
        }
        
        private static List<Set<Integer>> getConnectedComponents(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            List<Set<Integer>> components = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[graph.size()];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    Set<Integer> component = new HashSet<>();
                    dfsComponent(graph, i, visited, component);
                    components.add(component);
                }
            }
            
            return components;
        }
        
        private static void dfsComponent(List<List<Integer>> graph, int node, 
                                       boolean[] visited, Set<Integer> component) {
            visited[node] = true;
            component.add(node);
            
            for (int neighbor : graph.get(node)) {
                if (!visited[neighbor]) {
                    dfsComponent(graph, neighbor, visited, component);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Centrality Measures
    public static class CentralityMeasures {
        
        // Betweenness Centrality
        public static double[] betweennessCentrality(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            double[] centrality = new double[n];
            
            for (int s = 0; s < n; s++) {
                // Single source shortest paths
                Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
                Map<Integer, List<Integer>> predecessors = new HashMap<>();
                double[] distance = new double[n];
                double[] sigma = new double[n];
                double[] delta = new double[n];
                
                Arrays.fill(distance, -1);
                Arrays.fill(sigma, 0);
                Arrays.fill(delta, 0);
                
                distance[s] = 0;
                sigma[s] = 1;
                
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                queue.offer(s);
                
                while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                    int v = queue.poll();
                    stack.push(v);
                    
                    for (int w : graph.get(v)) {
                        // Path discovery
                        if (distance[w] < 0) {
                            queue.offer(w);
                            distance[w] = distance[v] + 1;
                        }
                        
                        // Path counting
                        if (distance[w] == distance[v] + 1) {
                            sigma[w] += sigma[v];
                            predecessors.computeIfAbsent(w, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(v);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Accumulation
                while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                    int w = stack.pop();
                    
                    if (predecessors.containsKey(w)) {
                        for (int v : predecessors.get(w)) {
                            delta[v] += (sigma[v] / sigma[w]) * (1 + delta[w]);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (w != s) {
                        centrality[w] += delta[w];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Normalize
            double normalizationFactor = 2.0 / ((n - 1) * (n - 2));
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                centrality[i] *= normalizationFactor;
            }
            
            return centrality;
        }
        
        // Closeness Centrality
        public static double[] closenessCentrality(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            double[] centrality = new double[n];
            
            for (int source = 0; source < n; source++) {
                // BFS from source
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                int[] distance = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(distance, -1);
                
                queue.offer(source);
                distance[source] = 0;
                
                while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                    int current = queue.poll();
                    
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(current)) {
                        if (distance[neighbor] == -1) {
                            distance[neighbor] = distance[current] + 1;
                            queue.offer(neighbor);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Calculate closeness
                double totalDistance = 0;
                int reachableNodes = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (i != source && distance[i] > 0) {
                        totalDistance += distance[i];
                        reachableNodes++;
                    }
                }
                
                if (reachableNodes > 0) {
                    centrality[source] = reachableNodes / totalDistance;
                }
            }
            
            return centrality;
        }
        
        // Eigenvector Centrality
        public static double[] eigenvectorCentrality(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                   double epsilon, int maxIterations) {
            int n = graph.size();
            double[] centrality = new double[n];
            double[] newCentrality = new double[n];
            
            // Initialize with equal values
            Arrays.fill(centrality, 1.0 / Math.sqrt(n));
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                Arrays.fill(newCentrality, 0);
                
                // Matrix multiplication: A * centrality
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j : graph.get(i)) {
                        newCentrality[i] += centrality[j];
                    }
                }
                
                // Normalize
                double norm = 0;
                for (double value : newCentrality) {
                    norm += value * value;
                }
                norm = Math.sqrt(norm);
                
                if (norm > 0) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        newCentrality[i] /= norm;
                    }
                }
                
                // Check convergence
                double diff = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    diff += Math.abs(newCentrality[i] - centrality[i]);
                }
                
                if (diff < epsilon) {
                    break;
                }
                
                System.arraycopy(newCentrality, 0, centrality, 0, n);
            }
            
            return centrality;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(VE) for PageRank, O(V³) for betweenness centrality, **Space**: O(V²)

### 166. Distributed Algorithms
**Problem**: Consensus, leader election, and distributed computing patterns  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class DistributedAlgorithms {
    
    // Byzantine Fault Tolerance (simplified simulation)
    public static class ByzantineFaultTolerance {
        static class Node {
            int id;
            boolean isByzantine;
            int value;
            Map<Integer, Integer> receivedValues;
            
            Node(int id, boolean isByzantine, int value) {
                this.id = id;
                this.isByzantine = isByzantine;
                this.value = value;
                this.receivedValues = new HashMap<>();
            }
            
            void receiveValue(int senderId, int value) {
                if (!isByzantine) {
                    receivedValues.put(senderId, value);
                }
            }
            
            int decide(int totalNodes, int byzantineNodes) {
                if (isByzantine) {
                    return -1; // Byzantine nodes may send arbitrary values
                }
                
                Map<Integer, Integer> valueCounts = new HashMap<>();
                valueCounts.put(value, 1); // Count own value
                
                for (int receivedValue : receivedValues.values()) {
                    valueCounts.put(receivedValue, valueCounts.getOrDefault(receivedValue, 0) + 1);
                }
                
                // Find majority (requires > (n + f) / 2 votes where f is byzantine nodes)
                int requiredVotes = (totalNodes + byzantineNodes) / 2 + 1;
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : valueCounts.entrySet()) {
                    if (entry.getValue() >= requiredVotes) {
                        return entry.getKey();
                    }
                }
                
                return -1; // No consensus
            }
        }
        
        public static int reachConsensus(List<Node> nodes, int byzantineNodes) {
            // Phase 1: All nodes broadcast their values
            for (Node sender : nodes) {
                for (Node receiver : nodes) {
                    if (sender.id != receiver.id) {
                        int valueToSend = sender.isByzantine ? 
                            new Random().nextInt(10) : sender.value; // Byzantine nodes send random
                        receiver.receiveValue(sender.id, valueToSend);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Phase 2: Each honest node decides
            Map<Integer, Integer> decisions = new HashMap<>();
            for (Node node : nodes) {
                if (!node.isByzantine) {
                    int decision = node.decide(nodes.size(), byzantineNodes);
                    if (decision != -1) {
                        decisions.put(decision, decisions.getOrDefault(decision, 0) + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Return consensus value if achieved
            int honestNodes = nodes.size() - byzantineNodes;
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : decisions.entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue() >= (honestNodes + 1) / 2) {
                    return entry.getKey();
                }
            }
            
            return -1; // No consensus achieved
        }
    }
    
    // Leader Election (Bully Algorithm)
    public static class LeaderElection {
        static class Process implements Comparable<Process> {
            int id;
            boolean isAlive;
            boolean isLeader;
            
            Process(int id) {
                this.id = id;
                this.isAlive = true;
                this.isLeader = false;
            }
            
            @Override
            public int compareTo(Process other) {
                return Integer.compare(this.id, other.id);
            }
        }
        
        public static Process bullyAlgorithm(List<Process> processes, int initiatorId) {
            Process initiator = processes.stream()
                .filter(p -> p.id == initiatorId && p.isAlive)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
            
            if (initiator == null) return null;
            
            // Step 1: Send election message to all higher-numbered processes
            List<Process> higherProcesses = processes.stream()
                .filter(p -> p.id > initiatorId && p.isAlive)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            
            boolean receivedResponse = false;
            for (Process p : higherProcesses) {
                if (p.isAlive) {
                    receivedResponse = true;
                    // Higher process will start its own election
                    Process leader = bullyAlgorithm(processes, p.id);
                    if (leader != null) return leader;
                }
            }
            
            // Step 2: If no response from higher processes, become leader
            if (!receivedResponse) {
                initiator.isLeader = true;
                
                // Step 3: Announce leadership to all lower processes
                for (Process p : processes) {
                    if (p.id < initiatorId && p.isAlive) {
                        p.isLeader = false; // Clear any previous leadership
                    }
                }
                
                return initiator;
            }
            
            return null;
        }
        
        // Ring-based leader election
        public static Process ringElection(List<Process> processes) {
            if (processes.isEmpty()) return null;
            
            // Arrange processes in ring
            Collections.sort(processes);
            
            // Start election from first active process
            Process starter = processes.stream()
                .filter(p -> p.isAlive)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
            
            if (starter == null) return null;
            
            // Pass election message around the ring
            Set<Integer> candidates = new HashSet<>();
            candidates.add(starter.id);
            
            Process current = starter;
            do {
                // Find next alive process in ring
                Process next = getNextAliveProcess(processes, current);
                if (next == null) break;
                
                candidates.add(next.id);
                current = next;
            } while (current.id != starter.id);
            
            // Leader is the process with highest ID
            int leaderId = candidates.stream().max(Integer::compare).orElse(-1);
            
            // Set leader
            for (Process p : processes) {
                p.isLeader = (p.id == leaderId);
            }
            
            return processes.stream()
                .filter(p -> p.id == leaderId)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
        }
        
        private static Process getNextAliveProcess(List<Process> processes, Process current) {
            int currentIndex = processes.indexOf(current);
            
            for (int i = 1; i < processes.size(); i++) {
                int nextIndex = (currentIndex + i) % processes.size();
                Process next = processes.get(nextIndex);
                if (next.isAlive) {
                    return next;
                }
            }
            
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    // Distributed Mutual Exclusion (Lamport's Algorithm)
    public static class DistributedMutualExclusion {
        static class LamportNode {
            int id;
            int logicalClock;
            PriorityQueue<Request> requestQueue;
            Set<Integer> receivedReplies;
            boolean inCriticalSection;
            
            static class Request implements Comparable<Request> {
                int nodeId;
                int timestamp;
                
                Request(int nodeId, int timestamp) {
                    this.nodeId = nodeId;
                    this.timestamp = timestamp;
                }
                
                @Override
                public int compareTo(Request other) {
                    if (this.timestamp != other.timestamp) {
                        return Integer.compare(this.timestamp, other.timestamp);
                    }
                    return Integer.compare(this.nodeId, other.nodeId);
                }
            }
            
            LamportNode(int id) {
                this.id = id;
                this.logicalClock = 0;
                this.requestQueue = new PriorityQueue<>();
                this.receivedReplies = new HashSet<>();
                this.inCriticalSection = false;
            }
            
            void requestCriticalSection(List<LamportNode> allNodes) {
                logicalClock++;
                Request myRequest = new Request(id, logicalClock);
                requestQueue.offer(myRequest);
                
                // Send request to all other nodes
                for (LamportNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        node.receiveRequest(myRequest);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            void receiveRequest(Request request) {
                logicalClock = Math.max(logicalClock, request.timestamp) + 1;
                requestQueue.offer(request);
                
                // Send reply back to requesting node
                // (In actual implementation, this would be a network message)
            }
            
            void receiveReply(int fromNodeId) {
                receivedReplies.add(fromNodeId);
            }
            
            boolean canEnterCriticalSection(int totalNodes) {
                if (requestQueue.isEmpty()) return false;
                
                Request topRequest = requestQueue.peek();
                if (topRequest.nodeId != this.id) return false;
                
                // Must have received replies from all other nodes
                return receivedReplies.size() >= totalNodes - 1;
            }
            
            void enterCriticalSection() {
                inCriticalSection = true;
                requestQueue.poll(); // Remove own request
            }
            
            void exitCriticalSection(List<LamportNode> allNodes) {
                inCriticalSection = false;
                receivedReplies.clear();
                
                // Send release message to all nodes
                for (LamportNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        node.receiveRelease(this.id);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            void receiveRelease(int fromNodeId) {
                // Remove the request from the releasing node
                requestQueue.removeIf(req -> req.nodeId == fromNodeId);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Vector Clocks for Distributed Systems
    public static class VectorClock {
        private int[] clock;
        private int nodeId;
        private int numNodes;
        
        public VectorClock(int nodeId, int numNodes) {
            this.nodeId = nodeId;
            this.numNodes = numNodes;
            this.clock = new int[numNodes];
        }
        
        public VectorClock(VectorClock other) {
            this.nodeId = other.nodeId;
            this.numNodes = other.numNodes;
            this.clock = other.clock.clone();
        }
        
        public void tick() {
            clock[nodeId]++;
        }
        
        public void update(VectorClock other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numNodes; i++) {
                if (i != nodeId) {
                    clock[i] = Math.max(clock[i], other.clock[i]);
                }
            }
            tick(); // Increment own clock
        }
        
        public boolean happensBefore(VectorClock other) {
            boolean strictlyLess = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < numNodes; i++) {
                if (this.clock[i] > other.clock[i]) {
                    return false;
                }
                if (this.clock[i] < other.clock[i]) {
                    strictlyLess = true;
                }
            }
            return strictlyLess;
        }
        
        public boolean isConcurrent(VectorClock other) {
            return !this.happensBefore(other) && !other.happensBefore(this);
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Arrays.toString(clock);
        }
    }
    
    // Consensus Algorithm (simplified Raft)
    public static class RaftConsensus {
        enum NodeState { FOLLOWER, CANDIDATE, LEADER }
        
        static class RaftNode {
            int id;
            NodeState state;
            int currentTerm;
            int votedFor;
            List<String> log;
            int commitIndex;
            int lastApplied;
            
            // Leader state
            Map<Integer, Integer> nextIndex;
            Map<Integer, Integer> matchIndex;
            
            RaftNode(int id) {
                this.id = id;
                this.state = NodeState.FOLLOWER;
                this.currentTerm = 0;
                this.votedFor = -1;
                this.log = new ArrayList<>();
                this.commitIndex = -1;
                this.lastApplied = -1;
                this.nextIndex = new HashMap<>();
                this.matchIndex = new HashMap<>();
            }
            
            // Start election
            void startElection(List<RaftNode> allNodes) {
                state = NodeState.CANDIDATE;
                currentTerm++;
                votedFor = id;
                
                int votes = 1; // Vote for self
                
                for (RaftNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        if (node.requestVote(this.currentTerm, this.id, 
                                           this.log.size() - 1, 
                                           this.log.isEmpty() ? 0 : this.currentTerm)) {
                            votes++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (votes > allNodes.size() / 2) {
                    becomeLeader(allNodes);
                } else {
                    state = NodeState.FOLLOWER;
                }
            }
            
            boolean requestVote(int term, int candidateId, int lastLogIndex, int lastLogTerm) {
                if (term < currentTerm) {
                    return false;
                }
                
                if (term > currentTerm) {
                    currentTerm = term;
                    votedFor = -1;
                    state = NodeState.FOLLOWER;
                }
                
                if (votedFor == -1 || votedFor == candidateId) {
                    // Check if candidate's log is at least as up-to-date
                    int myLastLogTerm = log.isEmpty() ? 0 : currentTerm;
                    int myLastLogIndex = log.size() - 1;
                    
                    if (lastLogTerm > myLastLogTerm || 
                        (lastLogTerm == myLastLogTerm && lastLogIndex >= myLastLogIndex)) {
                        votedFor = candidateId;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                
                return false;
            }
            
            void becomeLeader(List<RaftNode> allNodes) {
                state = NodeState.LEADER;
                
                // Initialize leader state
                for (RaftNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        nextIndex.put(node.id, log.size());
                        matchIndex.put(node.id, -1);
                    }
                }
                
                // Send heartbeats to maintain leadership
                sendHeartbeats(allNodes);
            }
            
            void sendHeartbeats(List<RaftNode> allNodes) {
                for (RaftNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        node.receiveHeartbeat(this.currentTerm, this.id);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            void receiveHeartbeat(int term, int leaderId) {
                if (term >= currentTerm) {
                    currentTerm = term;
                    state = NodeState.FOLLOWER;
                    votedFor = -1;
                }
            }
            
            // Append entry to log (leader only)
            boolean appendEntry(String entry, List<RaftNode> allNodes) {
                if (state != NodeState.LEADER) {
                    return false;
                }
                
                log.add(entry);
                int successCount = 1; // Leader's own log
                
                // Replicate to followers
                for (RaftNode node : allNodes) {
                    if (node.id != this.id) {
                        if (node.appendEntries(currentTerm, id, log.size() - 2, 
                                             currentTerm, Arrays.asList(entry), commitIndex)) {
                            successCount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Commit if majority agrees
                if (successCount > allNodes.size() / 2) {
                    commitIndex = log.size() - 1;
                    return true;
                }
                
                return false;
            }
            
            boolean appendEntries(int term, int leaderId, int prevLogIndex, 
                                int prevLogTerm, List<String> entries, int leaderCommit) {
                if (term < currentTerm) {
                    return false;
                }
                
                if (term > currentTerm) {
                    currentTerm = term;
                    votedFor = -1;
                }
                
                state = NodeState.FOLLOWER;
                
                // Check log consistency
                if (prevLogIndex >= 0 && 
                    (prevLogIndex >= log.size() || 
                     (prevLogIndex < log.size() && currentTerm != prevLogTerm))) {
                    return false;
                }
                
                // Append new entries
                int index = prevLogIndex + 1;
                for (String entry : entries) {
                    if (index < log.size()) {
                        log.set(index, entry);
                    } else {
                        log.add(entry);
                    }
                    index++;
                }
                
                // Update commit index
                if (leaderCommit > commitIndex) {
                    commitIndex = Math.min(leaderCommit, log.size() - 1);
                }
                
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n²) for consensus algorithms, O(n) for vector clocks, **Space**: O(n×log)

        }
        
        public Sequence complement() {
            StringBuilder comp = new StringBuilder();
            for (char c : sequence.toCharArray()) {
                switch (c) {
                    case 'A': comp.append('T'); break;
                    case 'T': comp.append('A'); break;
                    case 'G': comp.append('C'); break;
                    case 'C': comp.append('G'); break;
                    case 'U': comp.append('A'); break; // RNA
                    default: comp.append('N'); break; // Unknown
                }
            }
            return new Sequence(name + "_complement", comp.toString());
        }
        
        public Sequence reverseComplement() {

    // Needleman-Wunsch Global Alignment
    public static class NeedlemanWunsch {
        private int matchScore;
        private int mismatchScore;
        private int gapPenalty;
        
        public NeedlemanWunsch(int matchScore, int mismatchScore, int gapPenalty) {
            this.matchScore = matchScore;
            this.mismatchScore = mismatchScore;
            this.gapPenalty = gapPenalty;
        }
        
        public AlignmentResult align(Sequence seq1, Sequence seq2) {
            int m = seq1.length();
            int n = seq2.length();
            
            // DP table
            int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
            
            // Initialize first row and column
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                dp[i][0] = i * gapPenalty;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[0][j] = j * gapPenalty;
            }
            
            // Fill DP table
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    int match = dp[i-1][j-1] + 
                        (seq1.charAt(i-1) == seq2.charAt(j-1) ? matchScore : mismatchScore);
                    int delete = dp[i-1][j] + gapPenalty;
                    int insert = dp[i][j-1] + gapPenalty;
                    
                    dp[i][j] = Math.max(Math.max(match, delete), insert);
                }
            }
            
            // Traceback
            StringBuilder align1 = new StringBuilder();
            StringBuilder align2 = new StringBuilder();
            
            int i = m, j = n;
            while (i > 0 || j > 0) {
                if (i > 0 && j > 0 && 
                    dp[i][j] == dp[i-1][j-1] + 
                    (seq1.charAt(i-1) == seq2.charAt(j-1) ? matchScore : mismatchScore)) {
                    align1.append(seq1.charAt(i-1));
                    align2.append(seq2.charAt(j-1));
                    i--; j--;
                } else if (i > 0 && dp[i][j] == dp[i-1][j] + gapPenalty) {
                    align1.append(seq1.charAt(i-1));
                    align2.append('-');
                    i--;
                } else {
                    align1.append('-');
                    align2.append(seq2.charAt(j-1));
                    j--;
                }
            }
            
            return new AlignmentResult(
                align1.reverse().toString(),
                align2.reverse().toString(),
                dp[m][n]
            );
        }
import java.util.*;
public class AdvancedTheoreticalCS {
    // Turing Machine Simulation (binary incrementer)
    public static class TuringMachine {
        public static String incrementBinary(String input) {
            char[] tape = input.toCharArray();
            int i = tape.length - 1;
            while (i >= 0 && tape[i] == '1') {
                tape[i] = '0';
                i--;
            }
            if (i >= 0) tape[i] = '1';
            else return "1" + new String(tape);
            return new String(tape);
        }
    }
    // Pushdown Automaton (PDA) for balanced parentheses
    public static class PushdownAutomaton {
        public static boolean isBalanced(String s) {
            Deque<Character> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
            for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
                if (c == '(') stack.push(c);
                else if (c == ')') {
                    if (stack.isEmpty()) return false;
                    stack.pop();
                }
            }
            return stack.isEmpty();
        }
    }
    // Context-Free Grammar (CFG) Parser (a^n b^n)
    public static class CFGParser {
        public static boolean parseAnBn(String s) {
            int n = s.length() / 2;
            if (s.length() % 2 != 0) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (s.charAt(i) != 'a') return false;
            for (int i = n; i < 2 * n; i++) if (s.charAt(i) != 'b') return false;
            return true;
        }
    }
