```java
    // Smith-Waterman Local Alignment
    public static class SmithWaterman {
        private int matchScore;
        private int mismatchScore;
        private int gapPenalty;
        
        public SmithWaterman(int matchScore, int mismatchScore, int gapPenalty) {
            this.matchScore = matchScore;
            this.mismatchScore = mismatchScore;
            this.gapPenalty = gapPenalty;
        }
        
        public NeedlemanWunsch.AlignmentResult align(Sequence seq1, Sequence seq2) {
            int m = seq1.length();
            int n = seq2.length();
            
            int[][] dp = new int[m + 1][n + 1];
            int maxScore = 0;
            int maxI = 0, maxJ = 0;
            
            // Fill DP table (no negative values)
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    int match = dp[i-1][j-1] + 
                        (seq1.charAt(i-1) == seq2.charAt(j-1) ? matchScore : mismatchScore);
                    int delete = dp[i-1][j] + gapPenalty;
                    int insert = dp[i][j-1] + gapPenalty;
                    
                    dp[i][j] = Math.max(0, Math.max(Math.max(match, delete), insert));
                    
                    if (dp[i][j] > maxScore) {
                        maxScore = dp[i][j];
                        maxI = i;
                        maxJ = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Traceback from maximum score position
            StringBuilder align1 = new StringBuilder();
            StringBuilder align2 = new StringBuilder();
            
            int i = maxI, j = maxJ;
            while (i > 0 && j > 0 && dp[i][j] > 0) {
                if (dp[i][j] == dp[i-1][j-1] + 
                    (seq1.charAt(i-1) == seq2.charAt(j-1) ? matchScore : mismatchScore)) {
                    align1.append(seq1.charAt(i-1));
                    align2.append(seq2.charAt(j-1));
                    i--; j--;
                } else if (dp[i][j] == dp[i-1][j] + gapPenalty) {
                    align1.append(seq1.charAt(i-1));
                    align2.append('-');
                    i--;
                } else {
                    align1.append('-');
                    align2.append(seq2.charAt(j-1));
                    j--;
                }
            }
            
            return new NeedlemanWunsch.AlignmentResult(
                align1.reverse().toString(),
                align2.reverse().toString(),
                maxScore
            );
        }
    }
    
    // Knuth-Morris-Pratt for Biological Sequences
    public static class BiologicalKMP {
        
        public static List<Integer> findPattern(Sequence text, Sequence pattern) {
            return findPattern(text.getSequence(), pattern.getSequence());
        }
        
        public static List<Integer> findPattern(String text, String pattern) {
            List<Integer> matches = new ArrayList<>();
            
            if (pattern.length() == 0) return matches;
            
            // Build failure function
            int[] failure = buildFailureFunction(pattern);
            
            int i = 0; // text index
            int j = 0; // pattern index
            
            while (i < text.length()) {
                if (pattern.charAt(j) == text.charAt(i)) {
                    i++;
                    j++;
                }
                
                if (j == pattern.length()) {
                    matches.add(i - j);
                    j = failure[j - 1];
                } else if (i < text.length() && pattern.charAt(j) != text.charAt(i)) {
                    if (j != 0) {
                        j = failure[j - 1];
                    } else {
                        i++;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return matches;
        }
        
        private static int[] buildFailureFunction(String pattern) {
            int[] failure = new int[pattern.length()];
            int j = 0;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < pattern.length(); i++) {
                while (j > 0 && pattern.charAt(i) != pattern.charAt(j)) {
                    j = failure[j - 1];
                }
                
                if (pattern.charAt(i) == pattern.charAt(j)) {
                    j++;
                }
                
                failure[i] = j;
            }
            
            return failure;
        }
        
        // Find approximate matches with at most k mismatches
        public static List<ApproximateMatch> findApproximateMatches(
                Sequence text, Sequence pattern, int maxMismatches) {
            List<ApproximateMatch> matches = new ArrayList<>();
            String textStr = text.getSequence();
            String patternStr = pattern.getSequence();
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= textStr.length() - patternStr.length(); i++) {
                int mismatches = 0;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < patternStr.length(); j++) {
                    if (textStr.charAt(i + j) != patternStr.charAt(j)) {
                        mismatches++;
                        if (mismatches > maxMismatches) break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (mismatches <= maxMismatches) {
                    matches.add(new ApproximateMatch(i, mismatches));
                }
            }
            
            return matches;
        }
        
        public static class ApproximateMatch {
            public final int position;
            public final int mismatches;
            
            public ApproximateMatch(int position, int mismatches) {
                this.position = position;
                this.mismatches = mismatches;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("Position: %d, Mismatches: %d", position, mismatches);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Suffix Tree for Pattern Matching
    public static class SuffixTree {
        static class SuffixNode {
            Map<Character, SuffixNode> children;
            List<Integer> indices;
            boolean isLeaf;
            
            SuffixNode() {
                children = new HashMap<>();
                indices = new ArrayList<>();
                isLeaf = false;
            }
        }
        
        private SuffixNode root;
        private String text;
        
        public SuffixTree(String text) {
            this.text = text + "$"; // Add terminator
            this.root = new SuffixNode();
            buildSuffixTree();
        }
        
        public SuffixTree(Sequence sequence) {
            this(sequence.getSequence());
        }
        
        private void buildSuffixTree() {
            for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
                insertSuffix(i);
            }
        }
        
        private void insertSuffix(int suffixIndex) {
            SuffixNode current = root;
            
            for (int i = suffixIndex; i < text.length(); i++) {
                char c = text.charAt(i);
                
                if (!current.children.containsKey(c)) {
                    current.children.put(c, new SuffixNode());
                }
                
                current = current.children.get(c);
                current.indices.add(suffixIndex);
            }
            
            current.isLeaf = true;
        }
        
        public List<Integer> search(String pattern) {
            SuffixNode current = root;
            
            for (char c : pattern.toCharArray()) {
                if (!current.children.containsKey(c)) {
                    return new ArrayList<>(); // Pattern not found
                }
                current = current.children.get(c);
            }
            
            return new ArrayList<>(current.indices);
        }
        
        public List<Integer> search(Sequence pattern) {
            return search(pattern.getSequence());
        }
        
        // Find longest common substring
        public String longestCommonSubstring(String other) {
            SuffixTree otherTree = new SuffixTree(other);
            return findLongestCommon(this.root, otherTree.root, "");
        }
        
        private String findLongestCommon(SuffixNode node1, SuffixNode node2, String current) {
            String longest = current;
            
            for (char c : node1.children.keySet()) {
                if (node2.children.containsKey(c)) {
                    String candidate = findLongestCommon(
                        node1.children.get(c),
                        node2.children.get(c),
                        current + c
                    );
                    
                    if (candidate.length() > longest.length()) {
                        longest = candidate;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return longest;
        }
    }
    
    // Basic Gene Finding (ORF Detection)
    public static class GeneFinding {
        private static final Set<String> START_CODONS = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("ATG"));
        private static final Set<String> STOP_CODONS = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("TAA", "TAG", "TGA"));
        
        public static class OpenReadingFrame {
            public final int start;
            public final int end;
            public final int frame;
            public final String sequence;
            
            public OpenReadingFrame(int start, int end, int frame, String sequence) {
                this.start = start;
                this.end = end;
                this.frame = frame;
                this.sequence = sequence;
            }
            
            public int length() {
                return end - start + 1;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("ORF[%d-%d] Frame:%d Length:%d", 
                    start, end, frame, length());
            }
        }
        
        public static List<OpenReadingFrame> findORFs(Sequence dnaSequence, int minLength) {
            List<OpenReadingFrame> orfs = new ArrayList<>();
            String sequence = dnaSequence.getSequence();
            
            // Check all 6 reading frames (3 forward, 3 reverse)
            for (int frame = 0; frame < 3; frame++) {
                // Forward strand
                orfs.addAll(findORFsInFrame(sequence, frame, minLength, false));
                
                // Reverse complement strand
                String revComp = dnaSequence.reverseComplement().getSequence();
                orfs.addAll(findORFsInFrame(revComp, frame, minLength, true));
            }
            
            return orfs;
        }
        
        private static List<OpenReadingFrame> findORFsInFrame(String sequence, int frame, 
                                                              int minLength, boolean isReverse) {
            List<OpenReadingFrame> orfs = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = frame; i < sequence.length() - 2; i += 3) {
                String codon = sequence.substring(i, i + 3);
                
                if (START_CODONS.contains(codon)) {
                    // Found start codon, look for stop codon
                    for (int j = i + 3; j < sequence.length() - 2; j += 3) {
                        String stopCodon = sequence.substring(j, j + 3);
                        
                        if (STOP_CODONS.contains(stopCodon)) {
                            // Found ORF
                            if (j - i + 3 >= minLength) {
                                String orfSeq = sequence.substring(i, j + 3);
                                int actualFrame = isReverse ? -(frame + 1) : frame + 1;
                                
                                orfs.add(new OpenReadingFrame(i, j + 2, actualFrame, orfSeq));
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return orfs;
        }
        
        // Translate DNA to protein
        public static String translateToProtein(String dna) {
            Map<String, Character> geneticCode = createGeneticCode();
            StringBuilder protein = new StringBuilder();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < dna.length() - 2; i += 3) {
                String codon = dna.substring(i, i + 3);
                Character aminoAcid = geneticCode.get(codon);
                
                if (aminoAcid != null) {
                    if (aminoAcid == '*') break; // Stop codon
                    protein.append(aminoAcid);
                }
            }
            
            return protein.toString();
        }
        
        private static Map<String, Character> createGeneticCode() {
            Map<String, Character> code = new HashMap<>();
            
            // Standard genetic code
            code.put("TTT", 'F'); code.put("TTC", 'F'); code.put("TTA", 'L'); code.put("TTG", 'L');
            code.put("TCT", 'S'); code.put("TCC", 'S'); code.put("TCA", 'S'); code.put("TCG", 'S');
            code.put("TAT", 'Y'); code.put("TAC", 'Y'); code.put("TAA", '*'); code.put("TAG", '*');
            code.put("TGT", 'C'); code.put("TGC", 'C'); code.put("TGA", '*'); code.put("TGG", 'W');
            
            code.put("CTT", 'L'); code.put("CTC", 'L'); code.put("CTA", 'L'); code.put("CTG", 'L');
            code.put("CCT", 'P'); code.put("CCC", 'P'); code.put("CCA", 'P'); code.put("CCG", 'P');
            code.put("CAT", 'H'); code.put("CAC", 'H'); code.put("CAA", 'Q'); code.put("CAG", 'Q');
            code.put("CGT", 'R'); code.put("CGC", 'R'); code.put("CGA", 'R'); code.put("CGG", 'R');
            
            code.put("ATT", 'I'); code.put("ATC", 'I'); code.put("ATA", 'I'); code.put("ATG", 'M');
            code.put("ACT", 'T'); code.put("ACC", 'T'); code.put("ACA", 'T'); code.put("ACG", 'T');
            code.put("AAT", 'N'); code.put("AAC", 'N'); code.put("AAA", 'K'); code.put("AAG", 'K');
            code.put("AGT", 'S'); code.put("AGC", 'S'); code.put("AGA", 'R'); code.put("AGG", 'R');
            
            code.put("GTT", 'V'); code.put("GTC", 'V'); code.put("GTA", 'V'); code.put("GTG", 'V');
            code.put("GCT", 'A'); code.put("GCC", 'A'); code.put("GCA", 'A'); code.put("GCG", 'A');
            code.put("GAT", 'D'); code.put("GAC", 'D'); code.put("GAA", 'E'); code.put("GAG", 'E');
            code.put("GGT", 'G'); code.put("GGC", 'G'); code.put("GGA", 'G'); code.put("GGG", 'G');
            
            return code;
        }
    }
}
```

### 168. Advanced Signal Processing
**Problem**: Digital signal processing and Fourier analysis  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedSignalProcessing {
    
    // Complex number for FFT calculations
    public static class Complex {
        public double real, imag;
        
        public Complex(double real, double imag) {
            this.real = real;
            this.imag = imag;
        }
        
        public Complex add(Complex other) {
            return new Complex(real + other.real, imag + other.imag);
        }
        
        public Complex subtract(Complex other) {
            return new Complex(real - other.real, imag - other.imag);
        }
        
        public Complex multiply(Complex other) {
            return new Complex(
                real * other.real - imag * other.imag,
                real * other.imag + imag * other.real
            );
        }
        
        public Complex multiply(double scalar) {
            return new Complex(real * scalar, imag * scalar);
        }
        
        public double magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(real * real + imag * imag);
        }
        
        public double phase() {
            return Math.atan2(imag, real);
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("%.3f + %.3fi", real, imag);
        }
    }
    
    // Fast Fourier Transform
    public static class FastFourierTransform {
        
        public static Complex[] fft(Complex[] input) {
            int n = input.length;
            
            // Base case
            if (n <= 1) return input.clone();
            
            // Ensure n is power of 2
            if ((n & (n - 1)) != 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input length must be power of 2");
            }
            
            // Divide
            Complex[] even = new Complex[n / 2];
            Complex[] odd = new Complex[n / 2];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                even[i] = input[2 * i];
                odd[i] = input[2 * i + 1];
            }
            
            // Conquer
            Complex[] fftEven = fft(even);
            Complex[] fftOdd = fft(odd);
            
            // Combine
            Complex[] result = new Complex[n];
            for (int k = 0; k < n / 2; k++) {
                double angle = -2 * Math.PI * k / n;
                Complex w = new Complex(Math.cos(angle), Math.sin(angle));
                Complex wOdd = w.multiply(fftOdd[k]);
                
                result[k] = fftEven[k].add(wOdd);
                result[k + n / 2] = fftEven[k].subtract(wOdd);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        public static Complex[] ifft(Complex[] input) {
            int n = input.length;
            
            // Conjugate the complex numbers
            Complex[] conjugated = new Complex[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                conjugated[i] = new Complex(input[i].real, -input[i].imag);
            }
            
            // Apply FFT
            Complex[] result = fft(conjugated);
            
            // Conjugate again and scale
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                result[i] = new Complex(result[i].real / n, -result[i].imag / n);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Real-valued FFT for efficiency
        public static Complex[] realFFT(double[] realInput) {
            Complex[] complexInput = new Complex[realInput.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < realInput.length; i++) {
                complexInput[i] = new Complex(realInput[i], 0);
            }
            return fft(complexInput);
        }
        
        // Power spectrum
        public static double[] powerSpectrum(Complex[] fftResult) {
            double[] power = new double[fftResult.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < fftResult.length; i++) {
                power[i] = fftResult[i].magnitude() * fftResult[i].magnitude();
            }
            return power;
        }
    }
    
    // Digital Filters
    public static class DigitalFilters {
        
        // Low-pass filter (simple moving average)
        public static double[] movingAverageFilter(double[] signal, int windowSize) {
            double[] filtered = new double[signal.length];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
                double sum = 0;
                int count = 0;
                
                for (int j = Math.max(0, i - windowSize / 2); 
                     j <= Math.min(signal.length - 1, i + windowSize / 2); j++) {
                    sum += signal[j];
                    count++;
                }
                
                filtered[i] = sum / count;
            }
            
            return filtered;
        }
        
        // Butterworth low-pass filter (2nd order)
        public static class ButterworthFilter {
            private double a0, a1, a2, b1, b2;
            private double x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0;
            
            public ButterworthFilter(double cutoffFreq, double sampleRate) {
                double omega = 2 * Math.PI * cutoffFreq / sampleRate;
                double sin = Math.sin(omega);
                double cos = Math.cos(omega);
                double alpha = sin / Math.sqrt(2);
                
                double b0 = (1 - cos) / 2;
                double b1 = 1 - cos;
                double b2 = (1 - cos) / 2;
                double a0_temp = 1 + alpha;
                double a1_temp = -2 * cos;
                double a2_temp = 1 - alpha;
                
                // Normalize coefficients
                this.a0 = b0 / a0_temp;
                this.a1 = b1 / a0_temp;
                this.a2 = b2 / a0_temp;
                this.b1 = a1_temp / a0_temp;
                this.b2 = a2_temp / a0_temp;
            }
            
            public double filter(double input) {
                double output = a0 * input + a1 * x1 + a2 * x2 - b1 * y1 - b2 * y2;
                
                // Update delay elements
                x2 = x1;
                x1 = input;
                y2 = y1;
                y1 = output;
                
                return output;
            }
            
            public double[] filter(double[] signal) {
                double[] filtered = new double[signal.length];
                
                // Reset filter state
                x1 = x2 = y1 = y2 = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
                    filtered[i] = filter(signal[i]);
                }
                
                return filtered;
            }
        }
        
        // High-pass filter
        public static double[] highPassFilter(double[] signal, double cutoffFreq, double sampleRate) {
            // Simple high-pass: y[n] = α(y[n-1] + x[n] - x[n-1])
            double alpha = 1.0 / (1.0 + 2.0 * Math.PI * cutoffFreq / sampleRate);
            double[] filtered = new double[signal.length];
            
            filtered[0] = signal[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < signal.length; i++) {
                filtered[i] = alpha * (filtered[i-1] + signal[i] - signal[i-1]);
            }
            
            return filtered;
        }
        
        // Band-pass filter
        public static double[] bandPassFilter(double[] signal, double lowCutoff, 
                                            double highCutoff, double sampleRate) {
            // Apply high-pass then low-pass
            double[] highPassed = highPassFilter(signal, lowCutoff, sampleRate);
            ButterworthFilter lowPass = new ButterworthFilter(highCutoff, sampleRate);
            return lowPass.filter(highPassed);
        }
    }
    
    // Signal Analysis
    public static class SignalAnalysis {
        
        // Autocorrelation
        public static double[] autocorrelation(double[] signal) {
            int n = signal.length;
            double[] autocorr = new double[n];
            
            for (int lag = 0; lag < n; lag++) {
                double sum = 0;
                int count = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n - lag; i++) {
                    sum += signal[i] * signal[i + lag];
                    count++;
                }
                
                autocorr[lag] = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0;
            }
            
            return autocorr;
        }
        
        // Cross-correlation
        public static double[] crossCorrelation(double[] signal1, double[] signal2) {
            int n = Math.min(signal1.length, signal2.length);
            double[] crossCorr = new double[2 * n - 1];
            
            for (int lag = -(n-1); lag < n; lag++) {
                double sum = 0;
                int count = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    int j = i + lag;
                    if (j >= 0 && j < n) {
                        sum += signal1[i] * signal2[j];
                        count++;
                    }
                }
                
                crossCorr[lag + n - 1] = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0;
            }
            
            return crossCorr;
        }
        
        // Peak detection
        public static List<Integer> findPeaks(double[] signal, double threshold) {
            List<Integer> peaks = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 1; i < signal.length - 1; i++) {
                if (signal[i] > signal[i-1] && 
                    signal[i] > signal[i+1] && 
                    signal[i] > threshold) {
                    peaks.add(i);
                }
            }
            
            return peaks;
        }
        
        // Signal energy
        public static double calculateEnergy(double[] signal) {
            double energy = 0;
            for (double sample : signal) {
                energy += sample * sample;
            }
            return energy;
        }
        
        // RMS (Root Mean Square)
        public static double calculateRMS(double[] signal) {
            return Math.sqrt(calculateEnergy(signal) / signal.length);
        }
        
        // Zero-crossing rate
        public static double zeroCrossingRate(double[] signal) {
            int crossings = 0;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < signal.length; i++) {
                if ((signal[i-1] >= 0 && signal[i] < 0) || 
                    (signal[i-1] < 0 && signal[i] >= 0)) {
                    crossings++;
                }
            }
            
            return (double) crossings / (signal.length - 1);
        }
    }
    
    // Windowing functions
    public static class WindowFunctions {
        
        public static double[] hamming(int length) {
            double[] window = new double[length];
            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                window[i] = 0.54 - 0.46 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (length - 1));
            }
            return window;
        }
        
        public static double[] hanning(int length) {
            double[] window = new double[length];
            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                window[i] = 0.5 * (1 - Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (length - 1)));
            }
            return window;
        }
        
        public static double[] blackman(int length) {
            double[] window = new double[length];
            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                window[i] = 0.42 - 0.5 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * i / (length - 1)) + 
                           0.08 * Math.cos(4 * Math.PI * i / (length - 1));
            }
            return window;
        }
        
        public static double[] applyWindow(double[] signal, double[] window) {
            if (signal.length != window.length) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Signal and window must have same length");
            }
            
            double[] windowed = new double[signal.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
                windowed[i] = signal[i] * window[i];
            }
            return windowed;
        }
    }
    
    // Spectral analysis
    public static class SpectralAnalysis {
        
        public static class SpectrogramResult {
            public double[][] magnitude;
            public double[] frequencies;
            public double[] times;
            
            SpectrogramResult(double[][] magnitude, double[] frequencies, double[] times) {
                this.magnitude = magnitude;
                this.frequencies = frequencies;
                this.times = times;
            }
        }
        
        public static SpectrogramResult spectrogram(double[] signal, int windowSize, 
                                                   int hopSize, double sampleRate) {
            int numFrames = (signal.length - windowSize) / hopSize + 1;
            int numFreqs = windowSize / 2 + 1;
            
            double[][] magnitude = new double[numFrames][numFreqs];
            double[] frequencies = new double[numFreqs];
            double[] times = new double[numFrames];
            
            // Generate frequency bins
            for (int i = 0; i < numFreqs; i++) {
                frequencies[i] = i * sampleRate / windowSize;
            }
            
            // Generate time stamps
            for (int i = 0; i < numFrames; i++) {
                times[i] = i * hopSize / sampleRate;
            }
            
            // Generate window
            double[] window = WindowFunctions.hanning(windowSize);
            
            // Process each frame
            for (int frame = 0; frame < numFrames; frame++) {
                // Extract windowed segment
                double[] segment = new double[windowSize];
                int startIndex = frame * hopSize;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < windowSize; i++) {
                    if (startIndex + i < signal.length) {
                        segment[i] = signal[startIndex + i] * window[i];
                    }
                }
                
                // Compute FFT
                Complex[] fftResult = FastFourierTransform.realFFT(segment);
                
                // Extract magnitude for positive frequencies
                for (int i = 0; i < numFreqs; i++) {
                    magnitude[frame][i] = fftResult[i].magnitude();
                }
            }
            
            return new SpectrogramResult(magnitude, frequencies, times);
        }
        
        // Mel-scale conversion
        public static double hzToMel(double hz) {
            return 2595 * Math.log10(1 + hz / 700);
        }
        
        public static double melToHz(double mel) {
            return 700 * (Math.pow(10, mel / 2595) - 1);
        }
        
        // MFCC (Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients)
        public static double[] mfcc(double[] signal, double sampleRate, int numCoeffs) {
            // This is a simplified MFCC implementation
            // 1. Pre-emphasis
            double[] preEmphasized = new double[signal.length];
            preEmphasized[0] = signal[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < signal.length; i++) {
                preEmphasized[i] = signal[i] - 0.97 * signal[i-1];
            }
            
            // 2. Windowing
            double[] window = WindowFunctions.hamming(signal.length);
            double[] windowed = WindowFunctions.applyWindow(preEmphasized, window);
            
            // 3. FFT
            Complex[] fftResult = FastFourierTransform.realFFT(windowed);
            double[] powerSpectrum = FastFourierTransform.powerSpectrum(fftResult);
            
            // 4. Mel filter bank (simplified)
            int numFilters = 26;
            double[] melFiltered = new double[numFilters];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numFilters; i++) {
                double sum = 0;
                int startBin = i * powerSpectrum.length / (2 * numFilters);
                int endBin = (i + 1) * powerSpectrum.length / (2 * numFilters);
                
                for (int j = startBin; j < endBin && j < powerSpectrum.length / 2; j++) {
                    sum += powerSpectrum[j];
                }
                
                melFiltered[i] = Math.log(Math.max(sum, 1e-10));
            }
            
            // 5. DCT (simplified)
            double[] mfccCoeffs = new double[numCoeffs];
            for (int i = 0; i < numCoeffs; i++) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < numFilters; j++) {
                    sum += melFiltered[j] * Math.cos(Math.PI * i * (j + 0.5) / numFilters);
                }
                mfccCoeffs[i] = sum;
            }
            
            return mfccCoeffs;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n) for FFT, O(n²) for correlation, **Space**: O(n)

### 169. Computational Geometry Advanced
**Problem**: Advanced geometric algorithms and computational geometry  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class ComputationalGeometryAdvanced {
    
    // Advanced Point class with more operations
    public static class Point {
        public double x, y;
        
        public Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
        
        public Point add(Point other) {
            return new Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
        }
        
        public Point subtract(Point other) {
            return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
        }
        
        public Point multiply(double scalar) {
            return new Point(x * scalar, y * scalar);
        }
        
        public double dot(Point other) {
            return x * other.x + y * other.y;
        }
        
        public double cross(Point other) {
            return x * other.y - y * other.x;
        }
        
        public double magnitude() {
            return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        }
        
        public Point normalize() {
            double mag = magnitude();
            return mag > 0 ? new Point(x / mag, y / mag) : new Point(0, 0);
        }
        
        public double distanceTo(Point other) {
            return subtract(other).magnitude();
        }
        
        public double angleTo(Point other) {
            return Math.atan2(other.y - y, other.x - x);
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("(%.3f, %.3f)", x, y);
        }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof Point)) return false;
            Point other = (Point) obj;
            return Math.abs(x - other.x) < 1e-9 && Math.abs(y - other.y) < 1e-9;
        }
    }
    
    // Delaunay Triangulation
    public static class DelaunayTriangulation {
        
        public static class Triangle {
            public Point a, b, c;
            public Point circumcenter;
            public double circumradius;
            
            public Triangle(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
                this.a = a;
                this.b = b;
                this.c = c;
                calculateCircumcircle();
            }
            
            private void calculateCircumcircle() {
                double d = 2 * (a.x * (b.y - c.y) + b.x * (c.y - a.y) + c.x * (a.y - b.y));
                
                if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-10) {
                    // Degenerate triangle
                    circumcenter = new Point(0, 0);
                    circumradius = Double.MAX_VALUE;
                    return;
                }
                
                double ux = ((a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y) * (b.y - c.y) + 
                            (b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y) * (c.y - a.y) + 
                            (c.x * c.x + c.y * c.y) * (a.y - b.y)) / d;
                            
                double uy = ((a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y) * (c.x - b.x) + 
                            (b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y) * (a.x - c.x) + 
                            (c.x * c.x + c.y * c.y) * (b.x - a.x)) / d;
                
                circumcenter = new Point(ux, uy);
                circumradius = circumcenter.distanceTo(a);
            }
            
            public boolean containsPoint(Point p) {
                return circumcenter.distanceTo(p) <= circumradius + 1e-10;
            }
            
            public boolean hasVertex(Point p) {
                return a.equals(p) || b.equals(p) || c.equals(p);
            }
            
            public boolean sharesEdge(Triangle other) {
                int sharedVertices = 0;
                if (hasVertex(other.a)) sharedVertices++;
                if (hasVertex(other.b)) sharedVertices++;
                if (hasVertex(other.c)) sharedVertices++;
                return sharedVertices == 2;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<Triangle> triangulate(List<Point> points) {
            if (points.size() < 3) return new ArrayList<>();
            
            List<Triangle> triangles = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Find bounding triangle
            double minX = points.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.x).min().orElse(0) - 1;
            double maxX = points.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
            double minY = points.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.y).min().orElse(0) - 1;
            double maxY = points.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
            
            double dx = maxX - minX;
            double dy = maxY - minY;
            double deltaMax = Math.max(dx, dy) * 2;
            
            Point p1 = new Point(minX - 1, minY - 1);
            Point p2 = new Point(minX - 1, maxY + deltaMax);
            Point p3 = new Point(maxX + deltaMax, minY - 1);
            
            triangles.add(new Triangle(p1, p2, p3));
            
            // Add points one by one
            for (Point point : points) {
                List<Triangle> badTriangles = new ArrayList<>();
                
                // Find triangles that contain the point in their circumcircle
                for (Triangle triangle : triangles) {
                    if (triangle.containsPoint(point)) {
                        badTriangles.add(triangle);
                    }
                }
                
                // Find the boundary of the polygonal hole
                List<Point[]> polygon = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Triangle badTriangle : badTriangles) {
                    Point[] edges = {
                        new Point[]{badTriangle.a, badTriangle.b},
                        new Point[]{badTriangle.b, badTriangle.c},
                        new Point[]{badTriangle.c, badTriangle.a}
                    };
                    
                    for (Point[] edge : edges) {
                        boolean isShared = false;
                        for (Triangle otherBad : badTriangles) {
                            if (otherBad != badTriangle && 
                                ((otherBad.hasVertex(edge[0]) && otherBad.hasVertex(edge[1])))) {
                                isShared = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!isShared) {
                            polygon.add(edge);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Remove bad triangles
                triangles.removeAll(badTriangles);
                
                // Create new triangles
                for (Point[] edge : polygon) {
                    triangles.add(new Triangle(edge[0], edge[1], point));
                }
            }
            
            // Remove triangles with super-triangle vertices
            triangles.removeIf(triangle -> 
                triangle.hasVertex(p1) || triangle.hasVertex(p2) || triangle.hasVertex(p3));
            
            return triangles;
        }
    }
    
    // Voronoi Diagram
    public static class VoronoiDiagram {
        
        public static class VoronoiCell {
            public Point site;
            public List<Point> vertices;
            public List<VoronoiCell> neighbors;
            
            public VoronoiCell(Point site) {
                this.site = site;
                this.vertices = new ArrayList<>();
                this.neighbors = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            
            public double area() {
                if (vertices.size() < 3) return 0;
                
                double area = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < vertices.size(); i++) {
                    Point p1 = vertices.get(i);
                    Point p2 = vertices.get((i + 1) % vertices.size());
                    area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
                }
                return Math.abs(area) / 2;
            }
        }
        
        public static List<VoronoiCell> generateVoronoi(List<Point> sites) {
            // Use Delaunay triangulation to construct Voronoi diagram
            List<DelaunayTriangulation.Triangle> triangles = 
                DelaunayTriangulation.triangulate(sites);
            
            Map<Point, VoronoiCell> cellMap = new HashMap<>();
            for (Point site : sites) {
                cellMap.put(site, new VoronoiCell(site));
            }
            
            // Voronoi vertices are circumcenters of Delaunay triangles
            for (DelaunayTriangulation.Triangle triangle : triangles) {
                Point circumcenter = triangle.circumcenter;
                
                // Add circumcenter to cells of triangle vertices
                if (cellMap.containsKey(triangle.a)) {
                    cellMap.get(triangle.a).vertices.add(circumcenter);
                }
                if (cellMap.containsKey(triangle.b)) {
                    cellMap.get(triangle.b).vertices.add(circumcenter);
                }
                if (cellMap.containsKey(triangle.c)) {
                    cellMap.get(triangle.c).vertices.add(circumcenter);
                }
            }
            
            // Sort vertices for each cell
            for (VoronoiCell cell : cellMap.values()) {
                sortVerticesClockwise(cell);
            }
            
            // Find neighbors
            for (DelaunayTriangulation.Triangle triangle : triangles) {
                addNeighbor(cellMap, triangle.a, triangle.b);
                addNeighbor(cellMap, triangle.b, triangle.c);
                addNeighbor(cellMap, triangle.c, triangle.a);
            }
            
            return new ArrayList<>(cellMap.values());
        }
        
        private static void sortVerticesClockwise(VoronoiCell cell) {
            Point center = cell.site;
            
            cell.vertices.sort((p1, p2) -> {
                double angle1 = Math.atan2(p1.y - center.y, p1.x - center.x);
                double angle2 = Math.atan2(p2.y - center.y, p2.x - center.x);
                return Double.compare(angle1, angle2);
            });
        }
        
        private static void addNeighbor(Map<Point, VoronoiCell> cellMap, Point p1, Point p2) {
            VoronoiCell cell1 = cellMap.get(p1);
            VoronoiCell cell2 = cellMap.get(p2);
            
            if (cell1 != null && cell2 != null) {
                if (!cell1.neighbors.contains(cell2)) {
                    cell1.neighbors.add(cell2);
                }
                if (!cell2.neighbors.contains(cell1)) {
                    cell2.neighbors.add(cell1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Minimum Enclosing Circle (Welzl's Algorithm)
    public static class MinimumEnclosingCircle {
        
        public static class Circle {
            public Point center;
            public double radius;
            
            public Circle(Point center, double radius) {
                this.center = center;
                this.radius = radius;
            }
            
            public boolean contains(Point p) {
                return center.distanceTo(p) <= radius + 1e-10;
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("Circle[center=%s, radius=%.3f]", center, radius);
            }
        }
        
        public static Circle welzl(List<Point> points) {
            return welzlRecursive(new ArrayList<>(points), new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        private static Circle welzlRecursive(List<Point> P, List<Point> R) {
            if (P.isEmpty() || R.size() == 3) {
                return trivialCircle(R);
            }
            
            Point p = P.remove(P.size() - 1);
            Circle circle = welzlRecursive(P, R);
            
            if (circle != null && circle.contains(p)) {
                P.add(p);
                return circle;
            }
            
            R.add(p);
            circle = welzlRecursive(P, R);
            R.remove(R.size() - 1);
            P.add(p);
            
            return circle;
        }
        
        private static Circle trivialCircle(List<Point> R) {
            if (R.isEmpty()) {
                return new Circle(new Point(0, 0), 0);
            } else if (R.size() == 1) {
                return new Circle(R.get(0), 0);
            } else if (R.size() == 2) {
                Point a = R.get(0);
                Point b = R.get(1);
                Point center = new Point((a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2);
                return new Circle(center, center.distanceTo(a));
            } else {
                // Three points - find circumcircle
                Point a = R.get(0);
                Point b = R.get(1);
                Point c = R.get(2);
                
                double d = 2 * (a.x * (b.y - c.y) + b.x * (c.y - a.y) + c.x * (a.y - b.y));
                
                if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-10) {
                    return null; // Collinear points
                }
                
                double ux = ((a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y) * (b.y - c.y) + 
                            (b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y) * (c.y - a.y) + 
                            (c.x * c.x + c.y * c.y) * (a.y - b.y)) / d;
                            
                double uy = ((a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y) * (c.x - b.x) + 
                            (b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y) * (a.x - c.x) + 
                            (c.x * c.x + c.y * c.y) * (b.x - a.x)) / d;
                
                Point center = new Point(ux, uy);
                return new Circle(center, center.distanceTo(a));
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Range Trees for 2D Range Queries
    public static class RangeTree2D {
        
        private static class Node {
            Point point;
            Node left, right;
            RangeTree1D yTree;
            
            Node(Point point) {
                this.point = point;
            }
        }
        
        private static class RangeTree1D {
            private static class Node1D {
                double y;
                Node1D left, right;
                
                Node1D(double y) {
                    this.y = y;
                }
            }
            
            private Node1D root;
            
            public RangeTree1D(List<Point> points) {
                List<Double> yCoords = points.stream()
                    .map(p -> p.y)
                    .sorted()
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
                root = buildTree1D(yCoords, 0, yCoords.size() - 1);
            }
            
            private Node1D buildTree1D(List<Double> coords, int left, int right) {
                if (left > right) return null;
                
                int mid = (left + right) / 2;
                Node1D node = new Node1D(coords.get(mid));
                node.left = buildTree1D(coords, left, mid - 1);
                node.right = buildTree1D(coords, mid + 1, right);
                return node;
            }
            
            public int countInRange(double y1, double y2) {
                return countInRange(root, y1, y2);
            }
            
            private int countInRange(Node1D node, double y1, double y2) {
                if (node == null) return 0;
                
                int count = 0;
                if (node.y >= y1 && node.y <= y2) count = 1;
                
                if (y1 <= node.y) count += countInRange(node.left, y1, y2);
                if (y2 >= node.y) count += countInRange(node.right, y1, y2);
                
                return count;
            }
        }
        
        private Node root;
        
        public RangeTree2D(List<Point> points) {
            List<Point> sortedPoints = points.stream()
                .sorted((p1, p2) -> Double.compare(p1.x, p2.x))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            root = buildTree(sortedPoints, 0, sortedPoints.size() - 1);
        }
        
        private Node buildTree(List<Point> points, int left, int right) {
            if (left > right) return null;
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            Node node = new Node(points.get(mid));
            
            // Build subtrees
            node.left = buildTree(points, left, mid - 1);
            node.right = buildTree(points, mid + 1, right);
            
            // Build y-coordinate tree for this subtree
            List<Point> subtreePoints = points.subList(left, right + 1);
            node.yTree = new RangeTree1D(subtreePoints);
            
            return node;
        }
        
        public int countPointsInRange(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {
            return countPointsInRange(root, x1, y1, x2, y2);
        }
        
        private int countPointsInRange(Node node, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {
            if (node == null) return 0;
            
            if (node.point.x >= x1 && node.point.x <= x2) {
                // This subtree is completely within x-range
                return node.yTree.countInRange(y1, y2);
            } else if (node.point.x < x1) {
                // Search right subtree
                return countPointsInRange(node.right, x1, y1, x2, y2);
            } else {
                // Search left subtree
                return countPointsInRange(node.left, x1, y1, x2, y2);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class AdvancedSortingSearching {
    
    // Timsort (hybrid stable sorting algorithm)
    public static class Timsort {
        private static final int MIN_MERGE = 32;
        private static final int MIN_GALLOP = 7;
        
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> void sort(T[] array) {
            sort(array, 0, array.length, null);
        }
        
        public static <T> void sort(T[] array, Comparator<T> comparator) {
            sort(array, 0, array.length, comparator);
        }
        
        private static <T> void sort(T[] array, int low, int high, Comparator<T> comparator) {
            int remaining = high - low;
            if (remaining < 2) return;
            
            if (remaining < MIN_MERGE) {
                int initRunLen = countRunAndMakeAscending(array, low, high, comparator);
                binarySort(array, low, high, low + initRunLen, comparator);
                return;
            }
            
            TimsortState<T> state = new TimsortState<>(array, comparator);
            int minRun = minRunLength(remaining);
            
            do {
                int runLen = countRunAndMakeAscending(array, low, high, comparator);
                
                if (runLen < minRun) {
                    int force = Math.min(remaining, minRun);
                    binarySort(array, low, low + force, low + runLen, comparator);
                    runLen = force;
                }
                
                state.pushRun(low, runLen);
                state.mergeCollapse();
                
                low += runLen;
                remaining -= runLen;
            } while (remaining != 0);
            
            state.mergeForceCollapse();
        }
        
        private static <T> int countRunAndMakeAscending(T[] array, int low, int high, 
                                                       Comparator<T> comparator) {
            int runHi = low + 1;
            if (runHi == high) return 1;
            
            if (compare(array[low], array[runHi], comparator) > 0) {
                // Descending run
                while (runHi < high && compare(array[runHi - 1], array[runHi], comparator) > 0) {
                    runHi++;
                }
                reverseRange(array, low, runHi);
            } else {
                // Ascending run
                while (runHi < high && compare(array[runHi - 1], array[runHi], comparator) <= 0) {
                    runHi++;
                }
            }
            
            return runHi - low;
        }
        
        private static <T> void binarySort(T[] array, int low, int high, int start, 
                                          Comparator<T> comparator) {
            if (start == low) start++;
            
            for (; start < high; start++) {
                T pivot = array[start];
                int left = low;
                int right = start;
                
                while (left < right) {
                    int mid = (left + right) >>> 1;
                    if (compare(pivot, array[mid], comparator) < 0) {
                        right = mid;
                    } else {
                        left = mid + 1;
                    }
                }
                
                int n = start - left;
                if (n > 0) {
                    System.arraycopy(array, left, array, left + 1, n);
                    array[left] = pivot;
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static <T> int minRunLength(int n) {
            int r = 0;
            while (n >= MIN_MERGE) {
                r |= (n & 1);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return n + r;
        }
        
        private static <T> void reverseRange(T[] array, int low, int high) {
            high--;
            while (low < high) {
                T temp = array[low];
                array[low++] = array[high];
                array[high--] = temp;
            }
        }
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        private static <T> int compare(T a, T b, Comparator<T> comparator) {
            if (comparator != null) {
                return comparator.compare(a, b);
            } else {
                return ((Comparable<T>) a).compareTo(b);
            }
        }
        
        private static class TimsortState<T> {
            private T[] array;
            private Comparator<T> comparator;
            private int[] runBase;
            private int[] runLen;
            private int stackSize;
            
            TimsortState(T[] array, Comparator<T> comparator) {
                this.array = array;
                this.comparator = comparator;
                int len = array.length;
                int stackLen = (len < 120 ? 5 : len < 1542 ? 10 : len < 119151 ? 24 : 49);
                runBase = new int[stackLen];
                runLen = new int[stackLen];
                stackSize = 0;
            }
            
            void pushRun(int runBase, int runLen) {
                this.runBase[stackSize] = runBase;
                this.runLen[stackSize] = runLen;
                stackSize++;
            }
            
            void mergeCollapse() {
                while (stackSize > 1) {
                    int n = stackSize - 2;
                    if (n > 0 && runLen[n-1] <= runLen[n] + runLen[n+1]) {
                        if (runLen[n-1] < runLen[n+1]) n--;
                        mergeAt(n);
                    } else if (runLen[n] <= runLen[n+1]) {
                        mergeAt(n);
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            void mergeForceCollapse() {
                while (stackSize > 1) {
                    int n = stackSize - 2;
                    if (n > 0 && runLen[n-1] < runLen[n+1]) n--;
                    mergeAt(n);
                }
            }
            
            void mergeAt(int i) {
                int base1 = runBase[i];
                int len1 = runLen[i];
                int base2 = runBase[i + 1];
                int len2 = runLen[i + 1];
                
                runLen[i] = len1 + len2;
                if (i == stackSize - 3) {
                    runBase[i + 1] = runBase[i + 2];
                    runLen[i + 1] = runLen[i + 2];
                }
                stackSize--;
                
                // Merge the runs
                mergeRuns(base1, len1, base2, len2);
            }
            
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            private void mergeRuns(int base1, int len1, int base2, int len2) {
                T[] temp = (T[]) new Object[len1];
                System.arraycopy(array, base1, temp, 0, len1);
                
                int cursor1 = 0;
                int cursor2 = base2;
                int dest = base1;
                
                array[dest++] = array[cursor2++];
                if (--len2 == 0) {
                    System.arraycopy(temp, cursor1, array, dest, len1);
                    return;
                }
                if (len1 == 1) {
                    System.arraycopy(array, cursor2, array, dest, len2);
                    array[dest + len2] = temp[cursor1];
                    return;
                }
                
                while (true) {
                    int count1 = 0;
                    int count2 = 0;
                    
                    do {
                        if (compare(array[cursor2], temp[cursor1], comparator) < 0) {
                            array[dest++] = array[cursor2++];
                            count2++;
                            count1 = 0;
                            if (--len2 == 0) break;
                        } else {
                            array[dest++] = temp[cursor1++];
                            count1++;
                            count2 = 0;
                            if (--len1 == 1) break;
                        }
                    } while ((count1 | count2) < MIN_GALLOP);
                    
                    if (len1 == 1 || len2 == 0) break;
                }
                
                if (len1 == 1) {
                    System.arraycopy(array, cursor2, array, dest, len2);
                    array[dest + len2] = temp[cursor1];
                } else if (len1 == 0) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Comparison method violates contract");
                } else {
                    System.arraycopy(temp, cursor1, array, dest, len1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Introspective Sort (hybrid of quicksort, heapsort, insertion sort)
    public static class Introsort {
        private static final int INSERTION_SORT_THRESHOLD = 16;
        
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> void sort(T[] array) {
            if (array.length <= 1) return;
            
            int depthLimit = 2 * (int) Math.floor(Math.log(array.length) / Math.log(2));
            introsortUtil(array, 0, array.length - 1, depthLimit);
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> void introsortUtil(T[] array, int low, int high, 
                                                                   int depthLimit) {
            while (high - low > INSERTION_SORT_THRESHOLD) {
                if (depthLimit == 0) {
                    heapsort(array, low, high);
                    return;
                }
                
                int pivotIndex = partition(array, low, high);
                
                // Recur on smaller partition, iterate on larger
                if (pivotIndex - low < high - pivotIndex) {
                    introsortUtil(array, low, pivotIndex - 1, depthLimit - 1);
                    low = pivotIndex + 1;
                } else {
                    introsortUtil(array, pivotIndex + 1, high, depthLimit - 1);
                    high = pivotIndex - 1;
                }
                depthLimit--;
            }
            
            insertionSort(array, low, high);
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> int partition(T[] array, int low, int high) {
            // Median-of-three pivot selection
            int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
            if (array[mid].compareTo(array[low]) < 0) swap(array, low, mid);
            if (array[high].compareTo(array[low]) < 0) swap(array, low, high);
            if (array[high].compareTo(array[mid]) < 0) swap(array, mid, high);
            swap(array, mid, high);
            
            T pivot = array[high];
            int i = low - 1;
            
            for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
                if (array[j].compareTo(pivot) <= 0) {
                    i++;
                    swap(array, i, j);
                }
            }
            
            swap(array, i + 1, high);
            return i + 1;
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> void heapsort(T[] array, int low, int high) {
            // Build heap
            for (int i = low + (high - low) / 2; i >= low; i--) {
                heapify(array, i, high, low);
            }
            
            // Extract elements
            for (int i = high; i > low; i--) {
                swap(array, low, i);
                heapify(array, low, i - 1, low);
            }
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> void heapify(T[] array, int root, int end, 
                                                             int start) {
            while (true) {
                int largest = root;
                int left = 2 * (root - start) + 1 + start;
                int right = 2 * (root - start) + 2 + start;
                
                if (left <= end && array[left].compareTo(array[largest]) > 0) {
                    largest = left;
                }
                
                if (right <= end && array[right].compareTo(array[largest]) > 0) {
                    largest = right;
                }
                
                if (largest == root) break;
                
                swap(array, root, largest);
                root = largest;
            }
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> void insertionSort(T[] array, int low, int high) {
            for (int i = low + 1; i <= high; i++) {
                T key = array[i];
                int j = i - 1;
                
                while (j >= low && array[j].compareTo(key) > 0) {
                    array[j + 1] = array[j];
                    j--;
                }
                
                array[j + 1] = key;
            }
        }
        
        private static <T> void swap(T[] array, int i, int j) {
            T temp = array[i];
            array[i] = array[j];
            array[j] = temp;
        }
    }
    
    // Exponential Search
    public static class ExponentialSearch {
        
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> int search(T[] array, T target) {
            if (array.length == 0) return -1;
            if (array[0].equals(target)) return 0;
            
            // Find range for binary search
            int bound = 1;
            while (bound < array.length && array[bound].compareTo(target) <= 0) {
                bound *= 2;
            }
            
            // Binary search in found range
            return binarySearch(array, target, bound / 2, Math.min(bound, array.length - 1));
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> int binarySearch(T[] array, T target, 
                                                                 int left, int right) {
            while (left <= right) {
                int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
                int comparison = array[mid].compareTo(target);
                
                if (comparison == 0) return mid;
                if (comparison < 0) left = mid + 1;
                else right = mid - 1;
            }
            
            return -1;
        }
    }
    
    // Jump Search
    public static class JumpSearch {
        
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> int search(T[] array, T target) {
            int n = array.length;
            int step = (int) Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n));
            int prev = 0;
            
            // Jump search
            while (array[Math.min(step, n) - 1].compareTo(target) < 0) {
                prev = step;
                step += (int) Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n));
                if (prev >= n) return -1;
            }
            
            // Linear search in found block
            while (array[prev].compareTo(target) < 0) {
                prev++;
                if (prev == Math.min(step, n)) return -1;
            }
            
            if (array[prev].equals(target)) return prev;
            return -1;
        }
    }
    
    // Interpolation Search
    public static class InterpolationSearch {
        
        public static int search(int[] array, int target) {
            int low = 0;
            int high = array.length - 1;
            
            while (low <= high && target >= array[low] && target <= array[high]) {
                if (low == high) {
                    return array[low] == target ? low : -1;
                }
                
                // Interpolation formula
                int pos = low + (int) (((double) (target - array[low]) / 
                                       (array[high] - array[low])) * (high - low));
                
                if (array[pos] == target) {
                    return pos;
                } else if (array[pos] < target) {
                    low = pos + 1;
                } else {
                    high = pos - 1;
                }
            }
            
            return -1;
        }
    }
    
    // Ternary Search
    public static class TernarySearch {
        
        // For discrete arrays
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> int search(T[] array, T target) {
            return ternarySearchRecursive(array, target, 0, array.length - 1);
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> int ternarySearchRecursive(T[] array, T target, 
                                                                           int left, int right) {
            if (right >= left) {
                int mid1 = left + (right - left) / 3;
                int mid2 = right - (right - left) / 3;
                
                if (array[mid1].equals(target)) return mid1;
                if (array[mid2].equals(target)) return mid2;
                
                if (target.compareTo(array[mid1]) < 0) {
                    return ternarySearchRecursive(array, target, left, mid1 - 1);
                } else if (target.compareTo(array[mid2]) > 0) {
                    return ternarySearchRecursive(array, target, mid2 + 1, right);
                } else {
                    return ternarySearchRecursive(array, target, mid1 + 1, mid2 - 1);
                }
            }
            
            return -1;
        }
        
        // For continuous functions (finding maximum)
        public static double findMaximum(Function<Double, Double> function, 
                                       double left, double right, double epsilon) {
            while (right - left > epsilon) {
                double mid1 = left + (right - left) / 3;
                double mid2 = right - (right - left) / 3;
                
                if (function.apply(mid1) < function.apply(mid2)) {
                    left = mid1;
                } else {
                    right = mid2;
                }
            }
            
            return (left + right) / 2;
        }
    }
    
    // Fibonacci Search
    public static class FibonacciSearch {
        
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> int search(T[] array, T target) {
            int n = array.length;
            
            // Generate Fibonacci numbers
            int fib2 = 0; // (m-2)th Fibonacci number
            int fib1 = 1; // (m-1)th Fibonacci number
            int fib = fib2 + fib1; // mth Fibonacci number
            
            // Find smallest Fibonacci number >= n
            while (fib < n) {
                fib2 = fib1;
                fib1 = fib;
                fib = fib2 + fib1;
            }
            
            int offset = -1;
            
            while (fib > 1) {
                int i = Math.min(offset + fib2, n - 1);
                
                if (array[i].compareTo(target) < 0) {
                    fib = fib1;
                    fib1 = fib2;
                    fib2 = fib - fib1;
                    offset = i;
                } else if (array[i].compareTo(target) > 0) {
                    fib = fib2;
                    fib1 = fib1 - fib2;
                    fib2 = fib - fib1;
                } else {
                    return i;
                }
            }
            
            if (fib1 == 1 && offset + 1 < n && array[offset + 1].equals(target)) {
                return offset + 1;
            }
            
            return -1;
        }
    }
    
    // External Merge Sort (for large datasets)
    public static class ExternalMergeSort {
        
        public static void sort(String inputFile, String outputFile, int memoryLimit) 
                throws IOException {
            // Phase 1: Create sorted runs
            List<String> tempFiles = createSortedRuns(inputFile, memoryLimit);
            
            // Phase 2: Merge runs
            mergeRuns(tempFiles, outputFile);
            
            // Cleanup temp files
            for (String tempFile : tempFiles) {
                new File(tempFile).delete();
            }
        }
        
        private static List<String> createSortedRuns(String inputFile, int memoryLimit) 
                throws IOException {
            List<String> tempFiles = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
            int runNumber = 0;
            
            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(inputFile))) {
                String line;
                
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                    buffer.add(Integer.parseInt(line.trim()));
                    
                    if (buffer.size() >= memoryLimit) {
                        // Sort buffer and write to temp file
                        Collections.sort(buffer);
                        String tempFile = "temp_run_" + runNumber + ".txt";
                        writeRun(buffer, tempFile);
                        tempFiles.add(tempFile);
                        buffer.clear();
                        runNumber++;
                    }
                }
                
                // Handle remaining data
                if (!buffer.isEmpty()) {
                    Collections.sort(buffer);
                    String tempFile = "temp_run_" + runNumber + ".txt";
                    writeRun(buffer, tempFile);
                    tempFiles.add(tempFile);
                }
            }
            
            return tempFiles;
        }
        
        private static void writeRun(List<Integer> data, String filename) throws IOException {
            try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(filename))) {
                for (Integer value : data) {
                    writer.println(value);
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static void mergeRuns(List<String> tempFiles, String outputFile) 
                throws IOException {
            PriorityQueue<FileIterator> minHeap = new PriorityQueue<>();
            
            // Initialize iterators for each temp file
            for (String tempFile : tempFiles) {
                FileIterator iterator = new FileIterator(tempFile);
                if (iterator.hasNext()) {
                    minHeap.offer(iterator);
                }
            }
            
            try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(outputFile))) {
                while (!minHeap.isEmpty()) {
                    FileIterator smallest = minHeap.poll();
                    writer.println(smallest.current());
                    
                    if (smallest.next()) {
                        minHeap.offer(smallest);
                    } else {
                        smallest.close();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static class FileIterator implements Comparable<FileIterator> {
            private BufferedReader reader;
            private Integer currentValue;
            
            FileIterator(String filename) throws IOException {
                reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(filename));
                next();
            }
            
            boolean hasNext() {
                return currentValue != null;
            }
            
            boolean next() throws IOException {
                String line = reader.readLine();
                if (line != null) {
                    currentValue = Integer.parseInt(line.trim());
                    return true;
                } else {
                    currentValue = null;
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            Integer current() {
                return currentValue;
            }
            
            void close() throws IOException {
                reader.close();
            }
            
            @Override
            public int compareTo(FileIterator other) {
                return Integer.compare(this.currentValue, other.currentValue);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
