```java
public class MathematicalAlgorithmsAdvanced {
    
    // Matrix Operations and Linear Algebra
    public static class MatrixOperations {
        
        public static class Matrix {
            public double[][] data;
            public int rows, cols;
            
            public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
                this.rows = rows;
                this.cols = cols;
                this.data = new double[rows][cols];
            }
            
            public Matrix(double[][] data) {
                this.rows = data.length;
                this.cols = data[0].length;
                this.data = new double[rows][cols];
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    System.arraycopy(data[i], 0, this.data[i], 0, cols);
                }
            }
            
            public Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
                if (this.cols != other.rows) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix dimensions incompatible for multiplication");
                }
                
                Matrix result = new Matrix(this.rows, other.cols);
                
                for (int i = 0; i < this.rows; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < other.cols; j++) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < this.cols; k++) {
                            result.data[i][j] += this.data[i][k] * other.data[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            public Matrix add(Matrix other) {
                if (this.rows != other.rows || this.cols != other.cols) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix dimensions must match for addition");
                }
                
                Matrix result = new Matrix(rows, cols);
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                        result.data[i][j] = this.data[i][j] + other.data[i][j];
                    }
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            public Matrix transpose() {
                Matrix result = new Matrix(cols, rows);
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                        result.data[j][i] = this.data[i][j];
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            
            public double determinant() {
                if (rows != cols) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix must be square to compute determinant");
                }
                
                return determinantRecursive(data, rows);
            }
            
            private double determinantRecursive(double[][] matrix, int n) {
                if (n == 1) return matrix[0][0];
                if (n == 2) return matrix[0][0] * matrix[1][1] - matrix[0][1] * matrix[1][0];
                
                double det = 0;
                for (int col = 0; col < n; col++) {
                    double[][] subMatrix = new double[n-1][n-1];
                    
                    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                        int subCol = 0;
                        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                            if (j != col) {
                                subMatrix[i-1][subCol++] = matrix[i][j];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    det += Math.pow(-1, col) * matrix[0][col] * determinantRecursive(subMatrix, n-1);
                }
                
                return det;
            }
            
            public Matrix inverse() {
                double det = determinant();
                if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-10) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix is not invertible (determinant = 0)");
                }
                
                return adjugate().scalarMultiply(1.0 / det);
            }
            
            public Matrix adjugate() {
                if (rows != cols) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix must be square");
                }
                
                Matrix result = new Matrix(rows, cols);
                
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                        result.data[j][i] = Math.pow(-1, i + j) * cofactor(i, j);
                    }
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            private double cofactor(int row, int col) {
                double[][] subMatrix = new double[rows-1][cols-1];
                int subRow = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    if (i != row) {
                        int subCol = 0;
                        for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                            if (j != col) {
                                subMatrix[subRow][subCol++] = data[i][j];
                            }
                        }
                        subRow++;
                    }
                }
                
                return determinantRecursive(subMatrix, rows - 1);
            }
            
            public Matrix scalarMultiply(double scalar) {
                Matrix result = new Matrix(rows, cols);
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                        result.data[i][j] = this.data[i][j] * scalar;
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            
            // LU Decomposition
            public LUDecomposition luDecomposition() {
                if (rows != cols) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Matrix must be square for LU decomposition");
                }
                
                Matrix L = new Matrix(rows, cols);
                Matrix U = new Matrix(rows, cols);
                
                // Initialize L as identity matrix
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    L.data[i][i] = 1.0;
                }
                
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    // Upper triangular matrix U
                    for (int k = i; k < cols; k++) {
                        double sum = 0;
                        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                            sum += L.data[i][j] * U.data[j][k];
                        }
                        U.data[i][k] = this.data[i][k] - sum;
                    }
                    
                    // Lower triangular matrix L
                    for (int k = i + 1; k < rows; k++) {
                        double sum = 0;
                        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                            sum += L.data[k][j] * U.data[j][i];
                        }
                        L.data[k][i] = (this.data[k][i] - sum) / U.data[i][i];
                    }
                }
                
                return new LUDecomposition(L, U);
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                    sb.append("[");
                    for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                        sb.append(String.format("%8.3f", data[i][j]));
                        if (j < cols - 1) sb.append(" ");
                    }
                    sb.append("]\n");
                }
                return sb.toString();
            }
        }
        
        public static class LUDecomposition {
            public Matrix L, U;
            
            LUDecomposition(Matrix L, Matrix U) {
                this.L = L;
                this.U = U;
            }
            
            // Solve Ax = b using LU decomposition
            public double[] solve(double[] b) {
                int n = L.rows;
                double[] y = new double[n];
                double[] x = new double[n];
                
                // Forward substitution: Ly = b
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    y[i] = b[i];
                    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                        y[i] -= L.data[i][j] * y[j];
                    }
                }
                
                // Backward substitution: Ux = y
                for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    x[i] = y[i];
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                        x[i] -= U.data[i][j] * x[j];
                    }
                    x[i] /= U.data[i][i];
                }
                
                return x;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Fast Fourier Transform for Polynomial Multiplication
    public static class PolynomialFFT {
        
        public static class Complex {
            public double real, imag;
            
            public Complex(double real, double imag) {
                this.real = real;
                this.imag = imag;
            }
            
            public Complex add(Complex other) {
                return new Complex(real + other.real, imag + other.imag);
            }
            
            public Complex subtract(Complex other) {
                return new Complex(real - other.real, imag - other.imag);
            }
            
            public Complex multiply(Complex other) {
                return new Complex(
                    real * other.real - imag * other.imag,
                    real * other.imag + imag * other.real
                );
            }
        }
        
        public static double[] multiplyPolynomials(double[] poly1, double[] poly2) {
            int n = 1;
            while (n < poly1.length + poly2.length) n <<= 1;
            
            Complex[] a = new Complex[n];
            Complex[] b = new Complex[n];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = new Complex(i < poly1.length ? poly1[i] : 0, 0);
                b[i] = new Complex(i < poly2.length ? poly2[i] : 0, 0);
            }
            
            fft(a, false);
            fft(b, false);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = a[i].multiply(b[i]);
            }
            
            fft(a, true);
            
            double[] result = new double[poly1.length + poly2.length - 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
                result[i] = a[i].real;
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static void fft(Complex[] a, boolean invert) {
            int n = a.length;
            
            for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int bit = n >> 1;
                for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
                    j ^= bit;
                }
                j ^= bit;
                
                if (i < j) {
                    Complex temp = a[i];
                    a[i] = a[j];
                    a[j] = temp;
                }
            }
            
            for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
                double ang = 2 * Math.PI / len * (invert ? -1 : 1);
                Complex wlen = new Complex(Math.cos(ang), Math.sin(ang));
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                    Complex w = new Complex(1, 0);
                    for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                        Complex u = a[i + j];
                        Complex v = a[i + j + len / 2].multiply(w);
                        a[i + j] = u.add(v);
                        a[i + j + len / 2] = u.subtract(v);
                        w = w.multiply(wlen);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (invert) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    a[i] = new Complex(a[i].real / n, a[i].imag / n);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Number Theoretic Transform (for modular polynomial multiplication)
    public static class NumberTheoreticTransform {
        private static final long MOD = 998244353; // Prime with primitive root
        private static final long ROOT = 3; // Primitive root of MOD
        
        public static long[] multiplyPolynomials(long[] a, long[] b) {
            int n = 1;
            while (n < a.length + b.length) n <<= 1;
            
            long[] fa = new long[n];
            long[] fb = new long[n];
            
            System.arraycopy(a, 0, fa, 0, a.length);
            System.arraycopy(b, 0, fb, 0, b.length);
            
            ntt(fa, false);
            ntt(fb, false);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                fa[i] = (fa[i] * fb[i]) % MOD;
            }
            
            ntt(fa, true);
            
            long[] result = new long[a.length + b.length - 1];
            System.arraycopy(fa, 0, result, 0, result.length);
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static void ntt(long[] a, boolean invert) {
            int n = a.length;
            
            for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int bit = n >> 1;
                for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) {
                    j ^= bit;
                }
                j ^= bit;
                
                if (i < j) {
                    long temp = a[i];
                    a[i] = a[j];
                    a[j] = temp;
                }
            }
            
            for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
                long wlen = modPow(ROOT, (MOD - 1) / len, MOD);
                if (invert) {
                    wlen = modPow(wlen, MOD - 2, MOD);
                }
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                    long w = 1;
                    for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                        long u = a[i + j];
                        long v = (a[i + j + len / 2] * w) % MOD;
                        a[i + j] = (u + v) % MOD;
                        a[i + j + len / 2] = (u - v + MOD) % MOD;
                        w = (w * wlen) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (invert) {
                long n_inv = modPow(n, MOD - 2, MOD);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    a[i] = (a[i] * n_inv) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
            long result = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = (result * base) % mod;
                }
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    // Advanced Prime Number Algorithms
    public static class AdvancedPrimes {
        
        // Miller-Rabin Primality Test
        public static boolean millerRabinTest(long n, int k) {
            if (n < 2) return false;
            if (n == 2 || n == 3) return true;
            if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
            
            // Write n-1 as d * 2^r
            long d = n - 1;
            int r = 0;
            while (d % 2 == 0) {
                d /= 2;
                r++;
            }
            
            Random random = new Random();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                long a = 2 + (long) (random.nextDouble() * (n - 4));
                long x = modPow(a, d, n);
                
                if (x == 1 || x == n - 1) continue;
                
                boolean composite = true;
                for (int j = 0; j < r - 1; j++) {
                    x = modMul(x, x, n);
                    if (x == n - 1) {
                        composite = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (composite) return false;
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private static long modMul(long a, long b, long mod) {
            return ((a % mod) * (b % mod)) % mod;
        }
        
        private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
            long result = 1;
            base %= mod;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = modMul(result, base, mod);
                }
                base = modMul(base, base, mod);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        // Sieve of Atkin
        public static List<Integer> sieveOfAtkin(int limit) {
            boolean[] isPrime = new boolean[limit + 1];
            List<Integer> primes = new ArrayList<>();
            
            if (limit > 2) primes.add(2);
            if (limit > 3) primes.add(3);
            
            for (int x = 1; x * x <= limit; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y * y <= limit; y++) {
                    int n = 4 * x * x + y * y;
                    if (n <= limit && (n % 12 == 1 || n % 12 == 5)) {
                        isPrime[n] = !isPrime[n];
                    }
                    
                    n = 3 * x * x + y * y;
                    if (n <= limit && n % 12 == 7) {
                        isPrime[n] = !isPrime[n];
                    }
                    
                    n = 3 * x * x - y * y;
                    if (x > y && n <= limit && n % 12 == 11) {
                        isPrime[n] = !isPrime[n];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int r = 5; r * r <= limit; r++) {
                if (isPrime[r]) {
                    for (int i = r * r; i <= limit; i += r * r) {
                        isPrime[i] = false;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int a = 5; a <= limit; a++) {
                if (isPrime[a]) {
                    primes.add(a);
                }
            }
            
            return primes;
        }
        
        // Pollard's Rho Factorization
        public static long pollardRho(long n) {
            if (n % 2 == 0) return 2;
            
            long x = 2, y = 2, d = 1;
            
            while (d == 1) {
                x = f(x, n);
                y = f(f(y, n), n);
                d = gcd(Math.abs(x - y), n);
            }
            
            return d;
        }
        
        private static long f(long x, long n) {
            return (modMul(x, x, n) + 1) % n;
        }
        
        private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
            while (b != 0) {
                long temp = b;
                b = a % b;
                a = temp;
            }
            return a;
        }
        
        // Prime counting function π(x) approximation
        public static long primeCountingFunction(long x) {
            if (x < 2) return 0;
            if (x < 3) return 1;
            
            // Using the improved logarithmic integral approximation
            double logX = Math.log(x);
            return Math.round(x / (logX - 1.045));
        }
    }
}
```

### 172. Streaming Algorithms and Data Sketches
**Problem**: Algorithms for processing large data streams with limited memory  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class StreamingAlgorithms {
    
    // Count-Min Sketch for frequency estimation
    public static class CountMinSketch {
        private int[][] table;
        private int width, depth;
        private long[] hashA, hashB;
        private static final long LARGE_PRIME = 1000000007L;
        
        public CountMinSketch(int width, int depth) {
            this.width = width;
            this.depth = depth;
            this.table = new int[depth][width];
            this.hashA = new long[depth];
            this.hashB = new long[depth];
            
            Random random = new Random();
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                hashA[i] = random.nextInt(Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                hashB[i] = random.nextInt(Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }
        
        private int hash(int item, int hashIndex) {
            return (int) ((hashA[hashIndex] * item + hashB[hashIndex]) % LARGE_PRIME % width);
        }
        
        public void add(int item) {
            add(item, 1);
        }
        
        public void add(int item, int count) {
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                int index = hash(item, i);
                table[i][index] += count;
            }
        }
        
        public int estimate(int item) {
            int min = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                int index = hash(item, i);
                min = Math.min(min, table[i][index]);
            }
            return min;
        }
        
        public void merge(CountMinSketch other) {
            if (this.width != other.width || this.depth != other.depth) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sketches must have same dimensions");
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < width; j++) {
                    this.table[i][j] += other.table[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Bloom Filter for membership testing
    public static class BloomFilter {
        private boolean[] bitArray;
        private int numHashFunctions;
        private int expectedElements;
        
        public BloomFilter(int expectedElements, double falsePositiveRate) {
            this.expectedElements = expectedElements;
            
            // Calculate optimal bit array size
            int bitArraySize = (int) (-expectedElements * Math.log(falsePositiveRate) / (Math.log(2) * Math.log(2)));
            this.bitArray = new boolean[bitArraySize];
            
            // Calculate optimal number of hash functions
            this.numHashFunctions = (int) (bitArraySize * Math.log(2) / expectedElements);
            this.numHashFunctions = Math.max(1, this.numHashFunctions);
        }
        
        public void add(String item) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashFunctions; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                bitArray[Math.abs(hash) % bitArray.length] = true;
            }
        }
        
        public boolean mightContain(String item) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashFunctions; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                if (!bitArray[Math.abs(hash) % bitArray.length]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        private int hash(String item, int hashNumber) {
            return (item.hashCode() + hashNumber * item.length()) ^ (hashNumber << 16);
        }
        
        public double estimatedFalsePositiveRate() {
            int setBits = 0;
            for (boolean bit : bitArray) {
                if (bit) setBits++;
            }
            
            double ratio = (double) setBits / bitArray.length;
            return Math.pow(ratio, numHashFunctions);
        }
    }
    
    // HyperLogLog for cardinality estimation
    public static class HyperLogLog {
        private int[] buckets;
        private int numBuckets;
        private int bucketBits;
        
        public HyperLogLog(int precision) {
            this.bucketBits = precision;
            this.numBuckets = 1 << precision;
            this.buckets = new int[numBuckets];
        }
        
        public void add(String item) {
            long hash = murmurHash(item);
            
            // Use first bucketBits for bucket selection
            int bucket = (int) (hash >>> (64 - bucketBits));
            
            // Count leading zeros in remaining bits
            long remainingBits = hash << bucketBits;
            int leadingZeros = Long.numberOfLeadingZeros(remainingBits) + 1;
            
            buckets[bucket] = Math.max(buckets[bucket], leadingZeros);
        }
        
        public long estimate() {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (int bucket : buckets) {
                sum += Math.pow(2, -bucket);
            }
            
            double estimate = getAlpha() * numBuckets * numBuckets / sum;
            
            // Small range correction
            if (estimate <= 2.5 * numBuckets) {
                int zeros = 0;
                for (int bucket : buckets) {
                    if (bucket == 0) zeros++;
                }
                if (zeros != 0) {
                    estimate = numBuckets * Math.log((double) numBuckets / zeros);
                }
            }
            
            // Large range correction
            if (estimate > (1.0/30.0) * (1L << 32)) {
                estimate = -1 * (1L << 32) * Math.log(1 - estimate / (1L << 32));
            }
            
            return Math.round(estimate);
        }
        
        private double getAlpha() {
            switch (numBuckets) {
                case 16: return 0.673;
                case 32: return 0.697;
                case 64: return 0.709;
                default: return 0.7213 / (1 + 1.079 / numBuckets);
            }
        }
        
        private long murmurHash(String key) {
            byte[] data = key.getBytes();
            int seed = 0x1234ABCD;
            
            final int m = 0x5bd1e995;
            final int r = 24;
            
            int h = seed ^ data.length;
            
            int len_4 = data.length >> 2;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < len_4; i++) {
                int i_4 = i << 2;
                int k = data[i_4 + 3];
                k = k << 8;
                k = k | (data[i_4 + 2] & 0xff);
                k = k << 8;
                k = k | (data[i_4 + 1] & 0xff);
                k = k << 8;
                k = k | (data[i_4 + 0] & 0xff);
                k *= m;
                k ^= k >>> r;
                k *= m;
                h *= m;
                h ^= k;
            }
            
            int len_m = len_4 << 2;
            int left = data.length - len_m;
            
            if (left != 0) {
                if (left >= 3) h ^= (int) data[data.length - 3] << 16;
                if (left >= 2) h ^= (int) data[data.length - 2] << 8;
                if (left >= 1) h ^= (int) data[data.length - 1];
                h *= m;
            }
            
            h ^= h >>> 13;
            h *= m;
            h ^= h >>> 15;
            
            return h & 0xffffffffL;
        }
        
        public void merge(HyperLogLog other) {
            if (this.numBuckets != other.numBuckets) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot merge HyperLogLog with different precision");
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numBuckets; i++) {
                this.buckets[i] = Math.max(this.buckets[i], other.buckets[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Reservoir Sampling
    public static class ReservoirSampling<T> {
        private T[] reservoir;
        private int count;
        private int capacity;
        private Random random;
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public ReservoirSampling(int capacity) {
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.reservoir = (T[]) new Object[capacity];
            this.count = 0;
            this.random = new Random();
        }
        
        public void add(T item) {
            if (count < capacity) {
                reservoir[count] = item;
            } else {
                int randomIndex = random.nextInt(count + 1);
                if (randomIndex < capacity) {
                    reservoir[randomIndex] = item;
                }
            }
            count++;
        }
        
        public T[] getSample() {
            if (count < capacity) {
                T[] result = Arrays.copyOf(reservoir, count);
                return result;
            }
            return reservoir.clone();
        }
        
        public int getCount() {
            return count;
        }
    }
    
    // Count Distinct Elements (Flajolet-Martin Algorithm)
    public static class FlajoletMartin {
        private Set<Integer> maxTrailingZeros;
        private int numHashFunctions;
        
        public FlajoletMartin(int numHashFunctions) {
            this.numHashFunctions = numHashFunctions;
            this.maxTrailingZeros = new HashSet<>();
        }
        
        public void add(String item) {
            for (int i = 0; i < numHashFunctions; i++) {
                int hash = hash(item, i);
                int trailingZeros = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(hash);
                maxTrailingZeros.add(trailingZeros);
            }
        }
        
        public long estimateCardinality() {
            if (maxTrailingZeros.isEmpty()) return 0;
            
            double sum = 0;
            for (int zeros : maxTrailingZeros) {
                sum += Math.pow(2, zeros);
            }
            
            return Math.round(sum / numHashFunctions * 0.77351);
        }
        
        private int hash(String item, int hashNumber) {
            return (item.hashCode() + hashNumber * 31) ^ (hashNumber << 8);
        }
    }
    
    // Heavy Hitters Detection (Misra-Gries Algorithm)
    public static class MisraGries {
        private Map<Integer, Integer> counters;
        private int k;
        
        public MisraGries(int k) {
            this.k = k;
            this.counters = new HashMap<>();
        }
        
        public void process(int item) {
            if (counters.containsKey(item)) {
                counters.put(item, counters.get(item) + 1);
            } else if (counters.size() < k - 1) {
                counters.put(item, 1);
            } else {
                // Decrement all counters
                List<Integer> toRemove = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : counters.entrySet()) {
                    int newCount = entry.getValue() - 1;
                    if (newCount == 0) {
                        toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
                    } else {
                        entry.setValue(newCount);
                    }
                }
                
                for (int key : toRemove) {
                    counters.remove(key);
                }
            }
        }
        
        public Map<Integer, Integer> getHeavyHitters() {
            return new HashMap<>(counters);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(1) for most streaming operations, O(k) for heavy hitters, **Space**: O(w×d) for sketches

### 173. Information Theory and Compression
**Problem**: Data compression algorithms and information theory applications  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class InformationTheoryCompression {
    
    // Huffman Coding
    public static class HuffmanCoding {
        
        static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
            char character;
            int frequency;
            Node left, right;
            
            Node(char character, int frequency) {
                this.character = character;
                this.frequency = frequency;
            }
            
            Node(int frequency, Node left, Node right) {
                this.frequency = frequency;
                this.left = left;
                this.right = right;
            }
            
            boolean isLeaf() {
                return left == null && right == null;
            }
            
            @Override
            public int compareTo(Node other) {
                return Integer.compare(this.frequency, other.frequency);
            }
        }
        
        public static class CompressionResult {
            public String compressedData;
            public Map<Character, String> codes;
            public Node huffmanTree;
            
            CompressionResult(String compressedData, Map<Character, String> codes, Node huffmanTree) {
                this.compressedData = compressedData;
                this.codes = codes;
                this.huffmanTree = huffmanTree;
            }
        }
        
        public static CompressionResult compress(String text) {
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                return new CompressionResult("", new HashMap<>(), null);
            }
            
            // Count frequencies
            Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                frequencies.put(c, frequencies.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            // Build Huffman tree
            Node root = buildHuffmanTree(frequencies);
            
            // Generate codes
            Map<Character, String> codes = new HashMap<>();
            if (root.isLeaf()) {
                // Special case: single character
                codes.put(root.character, "0");
            } else {
                generateCodes(root, "", codes);
            }
            
            // Encode text
            StringBuilder compressed = new StringBuilder();
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                compressed.append(codes.get(c));
            }
            
            return new CompressionResult(compressed.toString(), codes, root);
        }
        
        private static Node buildHuffmanTree(Map<Character, Integer> frequencies) {
            PriorityQueue<Node> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
            
            for (Map.Entry<Character, Integer> entry : frequencies.entrySet()) {
                pq.offer(new Node(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()));
            }
            
            while (pq.size() > 1) {
                Node left = pq.poll();
                Node right = pq.poll();
                Node merged = new Node(left.frequency + right.frequency, left, right);
                pq.offer(merged);
            }
            
            return pq.poll();
        }
        
        private static void generateCodes(Node node, String code, Map<Character, String> codes) {
            if (node.isLeaf()) {
                codes.put(node.character, code);
                return;
            }
            
            generateCodes(node.left, code + "0", codes);
            generateCodes(node.right, code + "1", codes);
        }
        
        public static String decompress(String compressedData, Node huffmanTree) {
            if (compressedData.isEmpty() || huffmanTree == null) {
                return "";
            }
            
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            Node current = huffmanTree;
            
            for (char bit : compressedData.toCharArray()) {
                if (huffmanTree.isLeaf()) {
                    result.append(huffmanTree.character);
                } else {
                    if (bit == '0') {
                        current = current.left;
                    } else {
                        current = current.right;
                    }
                    
                    if (current.isLeaf()) {
                        result.append(current.character);
                        current = huffmanTree;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return result.toString();
        }
        
        // Calculate compression ratio
        public static double calculateCompressionRatio(String original, String compressed) {
            if (original.isEmpty()) return 0;
            return (double) compressed.length() / (original.length() * 8);
        }
        
        // Calculate entropy
        public static double calculateEntropy(String text) {
            Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                frequencies.put(c, frequencies.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            double entropy = 0;
            int totalChars = text.length();
            
            for (int freq : frequencies.values()) {
                double probability = (double) freq / totalChars;
                entropy -= probability * (Math.log(probability) / Math.log(2));
            }
            
            return entropy;
        }
    }
    
    // Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) Compression
    public static class LZWCompression {
        
        public static List<Integer> compress(String text) {
            Map<String, Integer> dictionary = new HashMap<>();
            List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Initialize dictionary with single characters
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
                dictionary.put(String.valueOf((char) i), i);
            }
            
            String current = "";
            int nextCode = 256;
            
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                String next = current + c;
                
                if (dictionary.containsKey(next)) {
                    current = next;
                } else {
                    result.add(dictionary.get(current));
                    dictionary.put(next, nextCode++);
                    current = String.valueOf(c);
                }
            }
            
            if (!current.isEmpty()) {
                result.add(dictionary.get(current));
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        public static String decompress(List<Integer> compressed) {
            Map<Integer, String> dictionary = new HashMap<>();
            
            // Initialize dictionary
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
                dictionary.put(i, String.valueOf((char) i));
            }
            
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            int nextCode = 256;
            
            int prevCode = compressed.get(0);
            result.append(dictionary.get(prevCode));
            
            for (int i = 1; i < compressed.size(); i++) {
                int code = compressed.get(i);
                String entry;
                
                if (dictionary.containsKey(code)) {
                    entry = dictionary.get(code);
                } else if (code == nextCode) {
                    entry = dictionary.get(prevCode) + dictionary.get(prevCode).charAt(0);
                } else {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid compressed data");
                }
                
                result.append(entry);
                
                dictionary.put(nextCode++, dictionary.get(prevCode) + entry.charAt(0));
                prevCode = code;
            }
            
            return result.toString();
        }
    }
    
    // Run Length Encoding
    public static class RunLengthEncoding {
        
        public static String compress(String text) {
            if (text.isEmpty()) return "";
            
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            char currentChar = text.charAt(0);
            int count = 1;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < text.length(); i++) {
                if (text.charAt(i) == currentChar) {
                    count++;
                } else {
                    result.append(count).append(currentChar);
                    currentChar = text.charAt(i);
                    count = 1;
                }
            }
            
            result.append(count).append(currentChar);
            return result.toString();
        }
        
        public static String decompress(String compressed) {
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < compressed.length(); i += 2) {
                int count = Character.getNumericValue(compressed.charAt(i));
                char character = compressed.charAt(i + 1);
                
                for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                    result.append(character);
                }
            }
            
            return result.toString();
        }
    }
    
    // Arithmetic Coding (simplified implementation)
    public static class ArithmeticCoding {
        
        static class Symbol {
            char character;
            double probability;
            double cumulativeProbability;
            
            Symbol(char character, double probability, double cumulativeProbability) {
                this.character = character;
                this.probability = probability;
                this.cumulativeProbability = cumulativeProbability;
            }
        }
        
        public static class CompressionResult {
            public double encodedValue;
            public List<Symbol> symbolTable;
            public int originalLength;
            
            CompressionResult(double encodedValue, List<Symbol> symbolTable, int originalLength) {
                this.encodedValue = encodedValue;
                this.symbolTable = symbolTable;
                this.originalLength = originalLength;
            }
        }
        
        public static CompressionResult compress(String text) {
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                return new CompressionResult(0, new ArrayList<>(), 0);
            }
            
            // Calculate symbol probabilities
            Map<Character, Integer> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                frequencies.put(c, frequencies.getOrDefault(c, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            List<Symbol> symbolTable = new ArrayList<>();
            double cumulative = 0;
            
            for (Map.Entry<Character, Integer> entry : frequencies.entrySet()) {
                double probability = (double) entry.getValue() / text.length();
                symbolTable.add(new Symbol(entry.getKey(), probability, cumulative));
                cumulative += probability;
            }
            
            // Encoding
            double low = 0.0;
            double high = 1.0;
            
            for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
                Symbol symbol = findSymbol(symbolTable, c);
                double range = high - low;
                
                high = low + range * (symbol.cumulativeProbability + symbol.probability);
                low = low + range * symbol.cumulativeProbability;
            }
            
            double encodedValue = (low + high) / 2;
            return new CompressionResult(encodedValue, symbolTable, text.length());
        }
        
        private static Symbol findSymbol(List<Symbol> symbolTable, char c) {
            return symbolTable.stream()
                .filter(s -> s.character == c)
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
        }
        
        public static String decompress(CompressionResult result) {
            if (result.originalLength == 0) return "";
            
            StringBuilder decoded = new StringBuilder();
            double value = result.encodedValue;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < result.originalLength; i++) {
                Symbol symbol = findSymbolByValue(result.symbolTable, value);
                decoded.append(symbol.character);
                
                // Update value for next symbol
                value = (value - symbol.cumulativeProbability) / symbol.probability;
            }
            
            return decoded.toString();
        }
        
        private static Symbol findSymbolByValue(List<Symbol> symbolTable, double value) {
            for (Symbol symbol : symbolTable) {
                if (value >= symbol.cumulativeProbability && 
                    value < symbol.cumulativeProbability + symbol.probability) {
                    return symbol;
                }
            }
            return symbolTable.get(symbolTable.size() - 1); // Fallback
        }
    }
    
    // Burrows-Wheeler Transform
    public static class BurrowsWheelerTransform {
        
        public static class BWTResult {
            public String transformedString;
            public int originalIndex;
            
            BWTResult(String transformedString, int originalIndex) {
                this.transformedString = transformedString;
                this.originalIndex = originalIndex;
            }
        }
        
        public static BWTResult transform(String text) {
            if (text.isEmpty()) return new BWTResult("", 0);
            
            // Add end-of-string marker
            text += "$";
            
            // Generate all rotations
            List<String> rotations = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
                rotations.add(text.substring(i) + text.substring(0, i));
            }
            
            // Sort rotations
            Collections.sort(rotations);
            
            // Extract last column and find original string index
            StringBuilder lastColumn = new StringBuilder();
            int originalIndex = -1;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < rotations.size(); i++) {
                String rotation = rotations.get(i);
                lastColumn.append(rotation.charAt(rotation.length() - 1));
                
                if (rotation.equals(text)) {
                    originalIndex = i;
                }
            }
            
            return new BWTResult(lastColumn.toString(), originalIndex);
        }
        
        public static String inverseTransform(BWTResult bwtResult) {
            String lastColumn = bwtResult.transformedString;
            int originalIndex = bwtResult.originalIndex;
            
            if (lastColumn.isEmpty()) return "";
            
            int n = lastColumn.length();
            
            // Create first column by sorting last column
            char[] firstColumn = lastColumn.toCharArray();
            Arrays.sort(firstColumn);
            
            // Build next array
            int[] next = new int[n];
            int[] count = new int[256];
            
            // Count characters in first column
            for (char c : firstColumn) {
                count[c]++;
            }
            
            // Convert to cumulative counts
            for (int i = 1; i < 256; i++) {
                count[i] += count[i - 1];
            }
            
            // Build next array
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                char c = lastColumn.charAt(i);
                next[--count[c]] = i;
            }
            
            // Reconstruct original string
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
            int current = originalIndex;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { // -1 to exclude '$'
                current = next[current];
                result.append(lastColumn.charAt(current));
            }
            
            return result.toString();
        }
    }
    
    // Information Theory Measures
    public static class InformationMeasures {
        
        public static double calculateMutualInformation(String x, String y) {
            if (x.length() != y.length()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Strings must have equal length");
            }
            
            Map<Character, Integer> xCounts = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Character, Integer> yCounts = new HashMap<>();
            Map<String, Integer> jointCounts = new HashMap<>();
            
            int n = x.length();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                char xChar = x.charAt(i);
                char yChar = y.charAt(i);
                String joint = xChar + "," + yChar;
                
                xCounts.put(xChar, xCounts.getOrDefault(xChar, 0) + 1);
                yCounts.put(yChar, yCounts.getOrDefault(yChar, 0) + 1);
                jointCounts.put(joint, jointCounts.getOrDefault(joint, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            double mutualInfo = 0.0;
            
            for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : jointCounts.entrySet()) {
                String[] parts = entry.getKey().split(",");
                char xChar = parts[0].charAt(0);
                char yChar = parts[1].charAt(0);
                
                double pXY = (double) entry.getValue() / n;
                double pX = (double) xCounts.get(xChar) / n;
                double pY = (double) yCounts.get(yChar) / n;
                
                mutualInfo += pXY * Math.log(pXY / (pX * pY)) / Math.log(2);
            }
            
            return mutualInfo;
        }
        
        public static double calculateKLDivergence(double[] p, double[] q) {
            if (p.length != q.length) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Distributions must have same length");
            }
            
            double kl = 0.0;
            for (int i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
                if (p[i] > 0) {
                    if (q[i] == 0) {
                        return Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                    }
                    kl += p[i] * Math.log(p[i] / q[i]) / Math.log(2);
                }
            }
            
            return kl;
        }
        
        public static double calculateJSDistance(double[] p, double[] q) {
            if (p.length != q.length) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Distributions must have same length");
            }
            
            double[] m = new double[p.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
                m[i] = (p[i] + q[i]) / 2;
            }
            
            double js = (calculateKLDivergence(p, m) + calculateKLDivergence(q, m)) / 2;
            return Math.sqrt(js);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n) for Huffman coding, O(n²) for BWT, **Space**: O(n)

### 174. Advanced Graph Theory
**Problem**: Specialized graph algorithms and advanced graph properties  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedGraphTheory {
    
    // Graph Isomorphism Testing
    public static class GraphIsomorphism {
        
        public static class Graph {
            private int vertices;
            private List<List<Integer>> adjList;
            
            public Graph(int vertices) {
                this.vertices = vertices;
                this.adjList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < vertices; i++) {
                    adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            
            public void addEdge(int u, int v) {
                adjList.get(u).add(v);
                adjList.get(v).add(u);
            }
            
            public List<Integer> getNeighbors(int vertex) {
                return adjList.get(vertex);
            }
            
            public int getVertices() {
                return vertices;
            }
            
            public int getDegree(int vertex) {
                return adjList.get(vertex).size();
            }
        }
        
        // Simple isomorphism test using degree sequence and DFS
        public static boolean areIsomorphic(Graph g1, Graph g2) {
            if (g1.getVertices() != g2.getVertices()) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Check degree sequences
            if (!haveSameDegreeSequence(g1, g2)) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Try all possible vertex mappings (brute force for small graphs)
            int n = g1.getVertices();
            if (n > 8) {
                // For larger graphs, use more sophisticated methods
                return nautyIsomorphism(g1, g2);
            }
            
            List<Integer> permutation = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                permutation.add(i);
            }
            
            return checkAllPermutations(g1, g2, permutation, 0);
        }
        
        private static boolean haveSameDegreeSequence(Graph g1, Graph g2) {
            List<Integer> degrees1 = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> degrees2 = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < g1.getVertices(); i++) {
                degrees1.add(g1.getDegree(i));
                degrees2.add(g2.getDegree(i));
            }
            
            Collections.sort(degrees1);
            Collections.sort(degrees2);
            
            return degrees1.equals(degrees2);
        }
        
        private static boolean checkAllPermutations(Graph g1, Graph g2, 
                                                   List<Integer> permutation, int index) {
            if (index == permutation.size()) {
                return isValidMapping(g1, g2, permutation);
            }
            
            for (int i = index; i < permutation.size(); i++) {
                Collections.swap(permutation, index, i);
                if (checkAllPermutations(g1, g2, permutation, index + 1)) {
                    return true;
                }
                Collections.swap(permutation, index, i);
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private static boolean isValidMapping(Graph g1, Graph g2, List<Integer> mapping) {
            for (int u = 0; u < g1.getVertices(); u++) {
                for (int v : g1.getNeighbors(u)) {
                    int mappedU = mapping.get(u);
                    int mappedV = mapping.get(v);
                    
                    if (!g2.getNeighbors(mappedU).contains(mappedV)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        // Simplified Nauty-like algorithm for larger graphs
        private static boolean nautyIsomorphism(Graph g1, Graph g2) {
            // This is a simplified version - real Nauty is much more complex
            
            // Color vertices by degree
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> degreeClasses1 = groupByDegree(g1);
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> degreeClasses2 = groupByDegree(g2);
            
            // Refine coloring iteratively
            return refineColoring(g1, g2, degreeClasses1, degreeClasses2);
        }
        
        private static Map<Integer, List<Integer>> groupByDegree(Graph g) {
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> groups = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < g.getVertices(); i++) {
                int degree = g.getDegree(i);
                groups.computeIfAbsent(degree, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(i);
            }
            
            return groups;
        }
        
        private static boolean refineColoring(Graph g1, Graph g2,
                                            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> classes1,
                                            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> classes2) {
            // Check if class sizes match
            if (!classes1.keySet().equals(classes2.keySet())) {
                return false;
            }
            
            for (int degree : classes1.keySet()) {
                if (classes1.get(degree).size() != classes2.get(degree).size()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            // More sophisticated refinement would go here
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    // Maximum Flow Algorithms
    public static class MaxFlowAlgorithms {
        
        // Push-Relabel Algorithm
        public static class PushRelabel {
            private int n;
            private int[][] capacity;
            private int[][] flow;
            private int[] height;
            private int[] excess;
            
            public PushRelabel(int n) {
                this.n = n;
                this.capacity = new int[n][n];
                this.flow = new int[n][n];
                this.height = new int[n];
                this.excess = new int[n];
            }
            
            public void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
                capacity[from][to] += cap;
            }
            
            public int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
                preflow(source);
                
                while (hasActiveVertex(source, sink)) {
                    int vertex = findActiveVertex(source, sink);
                    if (!push(vertex)) {
                        relabel(vertex);
                    }
                }
                
                return excess[sink];
            }
            
            private void preflow(int source) {
                height[source] = n;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (capacity[source][i] > 0) {
                        flow[source][i] = capacity[source][i];
                        flow[i][source] = -capacity[source][i];
                        excess[i] = capacity[source][i];
                        excess[source] -= capacity[source][i];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            private boolean hasActiveVertex(int source, int sink) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (i != source && i != sink && excess[i] > 0) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
            
            private int findActiveVertex(int source, int sink) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (i != source && i != sink && excess[i] > 0) {
                        return i;
                    }
                }
                return -1;
            }
            
            private boolean push(int vertex) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (capacity[vertex][i] - flow[vertex][i] > 0 && 
                        height[vertex] == height[i] + 1) {
                        
                        int pushFlow = Math.min(excess[vertex], 
                                              capacity[vertex][i] - flow[vertex][i]);
                        
                        flow[vertex][i] += pushFlow;
                        flow[i][vertex] -= pushFlow;
                        excess[vertex] -= pushFlow;
                        excess[i] += pushFlow;
                        
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
            
            private void relabel(int vertex) {
                int minHeight = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (capacity[vertex][i] - flow[vertex][i] > 0) {
                        minHeight = Math.min(minHeight, height[i]);
                    }
                }
                
                if (minHeight != Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    height[vertex] = minHeight + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Min-Cost Max-Flow
        public static class MinCostMaxFlow {
            private static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            
            static class Edge {
                int to, capacity, cost, flow;
                
                Edge(int to, int capacity, int cost) {
                    this.to = to;
                    this.capacity = capacity;
                    this.cost = cost;
                    this.flow = 0;
                }
            }
            
            private int n;
            private List<List<Integer>> graph;
            private List<Edge> edges;
            
            public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
                this.n = n;
                this.graph = new ArrayList<>();
                this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            
            public void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
                graph.get(from).add(edges.size());
                edges.add(new Edge(to, capacity, cost));
                
                graph.get(to).add(edges.size());
                edges.add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost));
            }
            
            public int[] minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
                int maxFlow = 0;
                int minCost = 0;
                
                while (true) {
                    int[] dist = new int[n];
                    int[] parent = new int[n];
                    int[] parentEdge = new int[n];
                    
                    Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                    Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
                    
                    dist[source] = 0;
                    
                    // SPFA algorithm
                    Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                    boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];
                    
                    queue.offer(source);
                    inQueue[source] = true;
                    
                    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                        int v = queue.poll();
                        inQueue[v] = false;
                        
                        for (int edgeId : graph.get(v)) {
                            Edge edge = edges.get(edgeId);
                            
                            if (edge.capacity > edge.flow && 
                                dist[v] + edge.cost < dist[edge.to]) {
                                
                                dist[edge.to] = dist[v] + edge.cost;
                                parent[edge.to] = v;
                                parentEdge[edge.to] = edgeId;
                                
                                if (!inQueue[edge.to]) {
                                    queue.offer(edge.to);
                                    inQueue[edge.to] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (dist[sink] == INF) break;
                    
                    // Find bottleneck capacity
                    int pushFlow = INF;
                    int current = sink;
                    
                    while (current != source) {
                        int edgeId = parentEdge[current];
                        Edge edge = edges.get(edgeId);
                        pushFlow = Math.min(pushFlow, edge.capacity - edge.flow);
                        current = parent[current];
                    }
                    
                    // Update flow
                    current = sink;
                    while (current != source) {
                        int edgeId = parentEdge[current];
                        edges.get(edgeId).flow += pushFlow;
                        edges.get(edgeId ^ 1).flow -= pushFlow;
                        current = parent[current];
                    }
                    
                    maxFlow += pushFlow;
                    minCost += pushFlow * dist[sink];
                }
                
                return new int[]{maxFlow, minCost};
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Graph Coloring Algorithms
    public static class GraphColoring {
        
        // Welsh-Powell Algorithm
        public static Map<Integer, Integer> welshPowell(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            int n = graph.size();
            Map<Integer, Integer> coloring = new HashMap<>();
            
            // Sort vertices by degree (descending)
            List<Integer> vertices = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                vertices.add(i);
            }
            
            vertices.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(graph.get(b).size(), graph.get(a).size()));
            
            int currentColor = 0;
            boolean[] colored = new boolean[n];
            
            while (!allColored(colored)) {
                Set<Integer> independentSet = new HashSet<>();
                
                for (int vertex : vertices) {
                    if (!colored[vertex] && canColor(vertex, independentSet, graph)) {
                        independentSet.add(vertex);
                        coloring.put(vertex, currentColor);
                        colored[vertex] = true;
                    }
                }
                
                currentColor++;
            }
            
            return coloring;
        }
        
        private static boolean allColored(boolean[] colored) {
            for (boolean c : colored) {
                if (!c) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        private static boolean canColor(int vertex, Set<Integer> independentSet, 
                                      List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            for (int neighbor : graph.get(vertex)) {
                if (independentSet.contains(neighbor)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        // Backtracking Graph Coloring
        public static Map<Integer, Integer> backtrackColoring(List<List<Integer>> graph, int colors) {
            int n = graph.size();
            Map<Integer, Integer> coloring = new HashMap<>();
            
            if (coloringBacktrack(graph, coloring, 0, colors)) {
                return coloring;
            }
            
            return null; // No valid coloring found
        }
        
        private static boolean coloringBacktrack(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                               Map<Integer, Integer> coloring, 
                                               int vertex, int maxColors) {
            if (vertex == graph.size()) {
                return true; // All vertices colored
            }
            
            for (int color = 0; color < maxColors; color++) {
                if (isSafeColor(graph, coloring, vertex, color)) {
                    coloring.put(vertex, color);
                    
                    if (coloringBacktrack(graph, coloring, vertex + 1, maxColors)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                    
                    coloring.remove(vertex);
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private static boolean isSafeColor(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                         Map<Integer, Integer> coloring, 
                                         int vertex, int color) {
            for (int neighbor : graph.get(vertex)) {
                if (coloring.containsKey(neighbor) && coloring.get(neighbor) == color) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        // Chromatic Polynomial calculation (for small graphs)
        public static long chromaticPolynomial(List<List<Integer>> graph, int colors) {
            if (graph.isEmpty()) return 1;
            
            // Find an edge to contract/delete
            int u = -1, v = -1;
            boolean edgeFound = false;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size() && !edgeFound; i++) {
                for (int neighbor : graph.get(i)) {
                    if (neighbor > i) {
                        u = i;
                        v = neighbor;
                        edgeFound = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!edgeFound) {
                // No edges - independent set
                long result = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                    result *= Math.max(0, colors - i);
                }
                return result;
            }
            
            // G - e (delete edge)
            List<List<Integer>> graphMinusEdge = copyGraph(graph);
            graphMinusEdge.get(u).remove(Integer.valueOf(v));
            graphMinusEdge.get(v).remove(Integer.valueOf(u));
            
            // G / e (contract edge)
            List<List<Integer>> graphContractEdge = contractEdge(graph, u, v);
            
            return chromaticPolynomial(graphMinusEdge, colors) - 
                   chromaticPolynomial(graphContractEdge, colors);
        }
        
        private static List<List<Integer>> copyGraph(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            List<List<Integer>> copy = new ArrayList<>();
            for (List<Integer> neighbors : graph) {
                copy.add(new ArrayList<>(neighbors));
            }
            return copy;
        }
        
        private static List<List<Integer>> contractEdge(List<List<Integer>> graph, int u, int v) {
            List<List<Integer>> contracted = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Create mapping (merge v into u)
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                if (i != v) {
                    contracted.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                if (i == v) continue;
                
                int newIndex = i > v ? i - 1 : i;
                
                for (int neighbor : graph.get(i)) {
                    if (neighbor == v) {
                        // Connect to u instead
                        if (i != u) {
                            int uIndex = u > v ? u - 1 : u;
                            contracted.get(newIndex).add(uIndex);
                        }
                    } else if (neighbor != u || i != v) {
                        int neighborIndex = neighbor > v ? neighbor - 1 : neighbor;
                        if (!contracted.get(newIndex).contains(neighborIndex)) {
                            contracted.get(newIndex).add(neighborIndex);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return contracted;
        }
    }
}
```
