```java
public class ComputationalComplexityTheory {
    
    // Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) Solver
    public static class SATSolver {
        
        static class Clause {
            List<Integer> literals; // Positive for variable, negative for negation
            
            Clause(List<Integer> literals) {
                this.literals = new ArrayList<>(literals);
            }
            
            boolean isSatisfied(Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
                for (int literal : literals) {
                    int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                    boolean value = assignment.getOrDefault(variable, false);
                    
                    if (literal > 0 && value) return true;
                    if (literal < 0 && !value) return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            
            boolean hasUnassignedLiteral(Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
                for (int literal : literals) {
                    int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                    if (!assignment.containsKey(variable)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        static class CNFFormula {
            List<Clause> clauses;
            Set<Integer> variables;
            
            CNFFormula() {
                this.clauses = new ArrayList<>();
                this.variables = new HashSet<>();
            }
            
            void addClause(List<Integer> literals) {
                clauses.add(new Clause(literals));
                for (int literal : literals) {
                    variables.add(Math.abs(literal));
                }
            }
            
            boolean isSatisfied(Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
                for (Clause clause : clauses) {
                    if (!clause.isSatisfied(assignment)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        // DPLL Algorithm
        public static Map<Integer, Boolean> dpllSolve(CNFFormula formula) {
            Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment = new HashMap<>();
            return dpllBacktrack(formula, assignment) ? assignment : null;
        }
        
        private static boolean dpllBacktrack(CNFFormula formula, Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
            // Unit propagation
            boolean changed = true;
            while (changed) {
                changed = false;
                
                for (Clause clause : formula.clauses) {
                    if (clause.isSatisfied(assignment)) continue;
                    
                    List<Integer> unassigned = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int literal : clause.literals) {
                        int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                        if (!assignment.containsKey(variable)) {
                            unassigned.add(literal);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (unassigned.isEmpty()) {
                        return false; // Unsatisfiable clause
                    }
                    
                    if (unassigned.size() == 1) {
                        // Unit clause
                        int literal = unassigned.get(0);
                        int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                        assignment.put(variable, literal > 0);
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Pure literal elimination
            Map<Integer, Boolean> pureLiterals = findPureLiterals(formula, assignment);
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Boolean> entry : pureLiterals.entrySet()) {
                assignment.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            }
            
            // Check if formula is satisfied
            if (formula.isSatisfied(assignment)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            // Choose next variable to branch on
            Integer nextVar = chooseNextVariable(formula, assignment);
            if (nextVar == null) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // Try assigning true
            assignment.put(nextVar, true);
            if (dpllBacktrack(formula, assignment)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            // Try assigning false
            assignment.put(nextVar, false);
            if (dpllBacktrack(formula, assignment)) {
                return true;
            }
            
            // Backtrack
            assignment.remove(nextVar);
            return false;
        }
        
        private static Map<Integer, Boolean> findPureLiterals(CNFFormula formula, 
                                                            Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
            Map<Integer, Boolean> pureLiterals = new HashMap<>();
            Map<Integer, Set<Boolean>> occurrences = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (Clause clause : formula.clauses) {
                if (clause.isSatisfied(assignment)) continue;
                
                for (int literal : clause.literals) {
                    int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                    if (assignment.containsKey(variable)) continue;
                    
                    occurrences.computeIfAbsent(variable, k -> new HashSet<>())
                              .add(literal > 0);
                }
            }
            
            for (Map.Entry<Integer, Set<Boolean>> entry : occurrences.entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue().size() == 1) {
                    pureLiterals.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue().iterator().next());
                }
            }
            
            return pureLiterals;
        }
        
        private static Integer chooseNextVariable(CNFFormula formula, Map<Integer, Boolean> assignment) {
            // Choose variable that appears in most unsatisfied clauses
            Map<Integer, Integer> frequency = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (Clause clause : formula.clauses) {
                if (clause.isSatisfied(assignment)) continue;
                
                for (int literal : clause.literals) {
                    int variable = Math.abs(literal);
                    if (!assignment.containsKey(variable)) {
                        frequency.put(variable, frequency.getOrDefault(variable, 0) + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return frequency.entrySet().stream()
                .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                .orElse(null);
        }
    }
    
    // Traveling Salesman Problem (Exact Algorithms)
    public static class TSPExact {
        
        // Held-Karp Algorithm (Dynamic Programming)
        public static class HeldKarp {
            
            static class TSPResult {
                double minCost;
                List<Integer> path;
                
                TSPResult(double minCost, List<Integer> path) {
                    this.minCost = minCost;
                    this.path = path;
                }
            }
            
            public static TSPResult solveTSP(double[][] distances) {
                int n = distances.length;
                if (n <= 1) return new TSPResult(0, Arrays.asList(0));
                
                // dp[mask][i] = minimum cost to visit all cities in mask, ending at city i
                double[][] dp = new double[1 << n][n];
                int[][] parent = new int[1 << n][n];
                
                // Initialize
                for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dp[i], Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
                    Arrays.fill(parent[i], -1);
                }
                
                dp[1][0] = 0; // Start at city 0
                
                // Fill DP table
                for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                    for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                        if ((mask & (1 << u)) == 0 || dp[mask][u] == Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                            if (mask & (1 << v)) continue;
                            
                            int newMask = mask | (1 << v);
                            double newCost = dp[mask][u] + distances[u][v];
                            
                            if (newCost < dp[newMask][v]) {
                                dp[newMask][v] = newCost;
                                parent[newMask][v] = u;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Find minimum cost to return to start
                double minCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                int lastCity = -1;
                int allVisited = (1 << n) - 1;
                
                for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                    double cost = dp[allVisited][i] + distances[i][0];
                    if (cost < minCost) {
                        minCost = cost;
                        lastCity = i;
                    }
                }
                
                // Reconstruct path
                List<Integer> path = reconstructPath(parent, allVisited, lastCity);
                Collections.reverse(path);
                path.add(0); // Return to start
                
                return new TSPResult(minCost, path);
            }
            
            private static List<Integer> reconstructPath(int[][] parent, int mask, int lastCity) {
                List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
                int currentMask = mask;
                int currentCity = lastCity;
                
                while (currentCity != -1) {
                    path.add(currentCity);
                    int nextCity = parent[currentMask][currentCity];
                    currentMask ^= (1 << currentCity);
                    currentCity = nextCity;
                }
                
                return path;
            }
        }
        
        // Branch and Bound TSP
        public static class BranchAndBound {
            
            static class Node {
                double cost;
                double bound;
                List<Integer> path;
                boolean[] visited;
                
                Node(double cost, double bound, List<Integer> path, boolean[] visited) {
                    this.cost = cost;
                    this.bound = bound;
                    this.path = new ArrayList<>(path);
                    this.visited = visited.clone();
                }
            }
            
            public static TSPExact.HeldKarp.TSPResult solveTSP(double[][] distances) {
                int n = distances.length;
                
                PriorityQueue<Node> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingDouble(a -> a.bound));
                
                boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
                visited[0] = true;
                
                List<Integer> initialPath = Arrays.asList(0);
                double initialBound = calculateBound(distances, visited, 0);
                
                pq.offer(new Node(0, initialBound, initialPath, visited));
                
                double bestCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                List<Integer> bestPath = null;
                
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    Node current = pq.poll();
                    
                    if (current.bound >= bestCost) {
                        continue; // Prune
                    }
                    
                    if (current.path.size() == n) {
                        // Complete tour
                        int lastCity = current.path.get(n - 1);
                        double totalCost = current.cost + distances[lastCity][0];
                        
                        if (totalCost < bestCost) {
                            bestCost = totalCost;
                            bestPath = new ArrayList<>(current.path);
                            bestPath.add(0);
                        }
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    // Branch on next cities
                    int lastCity = current.path.get(current.path.size() - 1);
                    
                    for (int nextCity = 0; nextCity < n; nextCity++) {
                        if (current.visited[nextCity]) continue;
                        
                        boolean[] newVisited = current.visited.clone();
                        newVisited[nextCity] = true;
                        
                        List<Integer> newPath = new ArrayList<>(current.path);
                        newPath.add(nextCity);
                        
                        double newCost = current.cost + distances[lastCity][nextCity];
                        double newBound = newCost + calculateBound(distances, newVisited, nextCity);
                        
                        if (newBound < bestCost) {
                            pq.offer(new Node(newCost, newBound, newPath, newVisited));
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return new TSPExact.HeldKarp.TSPResult(bestCost, bestPath);
            }
            
            private static double calculateBound(double[][] distances, boolean[] visited, int currentCity) {
                int n = distances.length;
                double bound = 0;
                
                // Add minimum outgoing edge from current city
                double minOut = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!visited[i] || i == 0) {
                        minOut = Math.min(minOut, distances[currentCity][i]);
                    }
                }
                if (minOut != Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY) {
                    bound += minOut;
                }
                
                // Add minimum edges for unvisited cities
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (visited[i] && i != currentCity) continue;
                    
                    double min1 = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                    double min2 = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                    
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        if (i == j) continue;
                        
                        if (distances[i][j] < min1) {
                            min2 = min1;
                            min1 = distances[i][j];
                        } else if (distances[i][j] < min2) {
                            min2 = distances[i][j];
                        }
                    }
                    
                    bound += (min1 + min2) / 2;
                }
                
                return bound;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Graph Isomorphism Problem
    public static class GraphIsomorphismProblem {
        
        // Weisfeiler-Lehman Test
        public static class WeisfeilerLehman {
            
            public static boolean areIsomorphic(List<List<Integer>> g1, List<List<Integer>> g2, int iterations) {
                if (g1.size() != g2.size()) return false;
                
                Map<Integer, Integer> labels1 = initializeLabels(g1);
                Map<Integer, Integer> labels2 = initializeLabels(g2);
                
                for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
                    labels1 = refineLabels(g1, labels1);
                    labels2 = refineLabels(g2, labels2);
                    
                    if (!haveSameLabelDistribution(labels1, labels2)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            
            private static Map<Integer, Integer> initializeLabels(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
                Map<Integer, Integer> labels = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                    labels.put(i, graph.get(i).size()); // Initialize with degree
                }
                
                return labels;
            }
            
            private static Map<Integer, Integer> refineLabels(List<List<Integer>> graph, 
                                                            Map<Integer, Integer> labels) {
                Map<Integer, Integer> newLabels = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (int v = 0; v < graph.size(); v++) {
                    List<Integer> neighborLabels = new ArrayList<>();
                    
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(v)) {
                        neighborLabels.add(labels.get(neighbor));
                    }
                    
                    Collections.sort(neighborLabels);
                    
                    // Create hash from current label and sorted neighbor labels
                    int hash = Objects.hash(labels.get(v), neighborLabels);
                    newLabels.put(v, hash);
                }
                
                return newLabels;
            }
            
            private static boolean haveSameLabelDistribution(Map<Integer, Integer> labels1, 
                                                           Map<Integer, Integer> labels2) {
                Map<Integer, Integer> dist1 = new HashMap<>();
                Map<Integer, Integer> dist2 = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (int label : labels1.values()) {
                    dist1.put(label, dist1.getOrDefault(label, 0) + 1);
                }
                
                for (int label : labels2.values()) {
                    dist2.put(label, dist2.getOrDefault(label, 0) + 1);
                }
                
                return dist1.equals(dist2);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Polynomial-Time Reductions
    public static class PolynomialReductions {
        
        // 3-SAT to Independent Set Reduction
        public static class ThreeSATToIndependentSet {
            
            static class IndependentSetInstance {
                List<List<Integer>> graph;
                int targetSize;
                
                IndependentSetInstance(List<List<Integer>> graph, int targetSize) {
                    this.graph = graph;
                    this.targetSize = targetSize;
                }
            }
            
            public static IndependentSetInstance reduce(SATSolver.CNFFormula formula) {
                List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
                int numClauses = formula.clauses.size();
                int vertexCount = 0;
                
                // Create vertices: 3 per clause (one for each literal)
                Map<String, Integer> literalToVertex = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (int clauseIdx = 0; clauseIdx < numClauses; clauseIdx++) {
                    SATSolver.Clause clause = formula.clauses.get(clauseIdx);
                    
                    for (int litIdx = 0; litIdx < clause.literals.size(); litIdx++) {
                        String key = clauseIdx + "," + litIdx;
                        literalToVertex.put(key, vertexCount++);
                        graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    }
                }
                
                // Add edges within each clause (triangle)
                for (int clauseIdx = 0; clauseIdx < numClauses; clauseIdx++) {
                    List<Integer> clauseVertices = new ArrayList<>();
                    
                    for (int litIdx = 0; litIdx < formula.clauses.get(clauseIdx).literals.size(); litIdx++) {
                        String key = clauseIdx + "," + litIdx;
                        clauseVertices.add(literalToVertex.get(key));
                    }
                    
                    // Add edges between all pairs in this clause
                    for (int i = 0; i < clauseVertices.size(); i++) {
                        for (int j = i + 1; j < clauseVertices.size(); j++) {
                            int u = clauseVertices.get(i);
                            int v = clauseVertices.get(j);
                            graph.get(u).add(v);
                            graph.get(v).add(u);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Add edges between contradictory literals
                for (int clause1 = 0; clause1 < numClauses; clause1++) {
                    for (int lit1 = 0; lit1 < formula.clauses.get(clause1).literals.size(); lit1++) {
                        int literal1 = formula.clauses.get(clause1).literals.get(lit1);
                        
                        for (int clause2 = clause1 + 1; clause2 < numClauses; clause2++) {
                            for (int lit2 = 0; lit2 < formula.clauses.get(clause2).literals.size(); lit2++) {
                                int literal2 = formula.clauses.get(clause2).literals.get(lit2);
                                
                                if (literal1 == -literal2) {
                                    String key1 = clause1 + "," + lit1;
                                    String key2 = clause2 + "," + lit2;
                                    
                                    int u = literalToVertex.get(key1);
                                    int v = literalToVertex.get(key2);
                                    
                                    graph.get(u).add(v);
                                    graph.get(v).add(u);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return new IndependentSetInstance(graph, numClauses);
            }
        }
        
        // Vertex Cover to Set Cover Reduction
        public static class VertexCoverToSetCover {
            
            static class SetCoverInstance {
                List<Set<Integer>> sets;
                Set<Integer> universe;
                int targetSize;
                
                SetCoverInstance(List<Set<Integer>> sets, Set<Integer> universe, int targetSize) {
                    this.sets = sets;
                    this.universe = universe;
                    this.targetSize = targetSize;
                }
            }
            
            public static SetCoverInstance reduce(List<List<Integer>> graph, int vertexCoverSize) {
                List<Set<Integer>> sets = new ArrayList<>();
                Set<Integer> universe = new HashSet<>();
                
                // Universe consists of all edges
                int edgeId = 0;
                Map<String, Integer> edgeToId = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                    for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                        if (u < v) { // Avoid duplicate edges
                            String edge = u + "," + v;
                            edgeToId.put(edge, edgeId);
                            universe.add(edgeId);
                            edgeId++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Each vertex corresponds to a set containing all incident edges
                for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                    Set<Integer> vertexSet = new HashSet<>();
                    
                    for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                        String edge = u < v ? u + "," + v : v + "," + u;
                        if (edgeToId.containsKey(edge)) {
                            vertexSet.add(edgeToId.get(edge));
                        }
                    }
                    
                    sets.add(vertexSet);
                }
                
                return new SetCoverInstance(sets, universe, vertexCoverSize);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(2^n) for exact TSP, O(n^k) for k-SAT, **Space**: O(2^n)

```java
public class AdvancedDataStructures {
    
    // Persistent Data Structures
    public static class PersistentArray<T> {
        
        private static class Node<T> {
            T value;
            Node<T> left, right;
            
            Node(T value) {
                this.value = value;
            }
            
            Node(T value, Node<T> left, Node<T> right) {
                this.value = value;
                this.left = left;
                this.right = right;
            }
        }
        
        private Node<T> root;
        private int size;
        
        public PersistentArray(T[] array) {
            this.size = array.length;
            this.root = buildTree(array, 0, size - 1);
        }
        
        private PersistentArray(Node<T> root, int size) {
            this.root = root;
            this.size = size;
        }
        
        private Node<T> buildTree(T[] array, int left, int right) {
            if (left == right) {
                return new Node<>(array[left]);
            }
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            Node<T> leftChild = buildTree(array, left, mid);
            Node<T> rightChild = buildTree(array, mid + 1, right);
            
            return new Node<>(null, leftChild, rightChild);
        }
        
        public T get(int index) {
            return get(root, 0, size - 1, index);
        }
        
        private T get(Node<T> node, int left, int right, int index) {
            if (left == right) {
                return node.value;
            }
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (index <= mid) {
                return get(node.left, left, mid, index);
            } else {
                return get(node.right, mid + 1, right, index);
            }
        }
        
        public PersistentArray<T> set(int index, T value) {
            Node<T> newRoot = set(root, 0, size - 1, index, value);
            return new PersistentArray<>(newRoot, size);
        }
        
        private Node<T> set(Node<T> node, int left, int right, int index, T value) {
            if (left == right) {
                return new Node<>(value);
            }
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (index <= mid) {
                Node<T> newLeft = set(node.left, left, mid, index, value);
                return new Node<>(null, newLeft, node.right);
            } else {
                Node<T> newRight = set(node.right, mid + 1, right, index, value);
                return new Node<>(null, node.left, newRight);
            }
        }
        
        public int size() {
            return size;
        }
    }
    
    // Link-Cut Tree
    public static class LinkCutTree {
        
        private static class Node {
            int value;
            Node left, right, parent;
            boolean reversed;
            
            Node(int value) {
                this.value = value;
            }
            
            boolean isRoot() {
                return parent == null || (parent.left != this && parent.right != this);
            }
            
            void push() {
                if (reversed) {
                    Node temp = left;
                    left = right;
                    right = temp;
                    
                    if (left != null) left.reversed ^= true;
                    if (right != null) right.reversed ^= true;
                    
                    reversed = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        private Map<Integer, Node> nodes;
        
        public LinkCutTree() {
            this.nodes = new HashMap<>();
        }
        
        public void makeTree(int v) {
            nodes.put(v, new Node(v));
        }
        
        public void link(int u, int v) {
            Node nodeU = nodes.get(u);
            Node nodeV = nodes.get(v);
            
            makeRoot(nodeU);
            nodeU.parent = nodeV;
        }
        
        public void cut(int u, int v) {
            Node nodeU = nodes.get(u);
            Node nodeV = nodes.get(v);
            
            makeRoot(nodeU);
            access(nodeV);
            
            if (nodeV.left == nodeU && nodeU.right == null) {
                nodeV.left = null;
                nodeU.parent = null;
            }
        }
        
        public boolean connected(int u, int v) {
            if (!nodes.containsKey(u) || !nodes.containsKey(v)) {
                return false;
            }
            
            Node nodeU = nodes.get(u);
            Node nodeV = nodes.get(v);
            
            access(nodeU);
            access(nodeV);
            
            return nodeU.parent != null;
        }
        
        private void makeRoot(Node node) {
            access(node);
            node.reversed ^= true;
        }
        
        private void access(Node node) {
            Node last = null;
            Node current = node;
            
            while (current != null) {
                splay(current);
                current.right = last;
                last = current;
                current = current.parent;
            }
            
            splay(node);
        }
        
        private void splay(Node node) {
            while (!node.isRoot()) {
                Node parent = node.parent;
                Node grandparent = parent.parent;
                
                if (grandparent != null && !parent.isRoot()) {
                    grandparent.push();
                }
                parent.push();
                node.push();
                
                if (parent.isRoot()) {
                    rotate(node);
                } else if ((parent.left == node) == (grandparent.left == parent)) {
                    rotate(parent);
                    rotate(node);
                } else {
                    rotate(node);
                    rotate(node);
                }
            }
            
            node.push();
        }
        
        private void rotate(Node node) {
            Node parent = node.parent;
            Node grandparent = parent.parent;
            
            if (parent.left == node) {
                parent.left = node.right;
                if (node.right != null) node.right.parent = parent;
                node.right = parent;
            } else {
                parent.right = node.left;
                if (node.left != null) node.left.parent = parent;
                node.left = parent;
            }
            
            parent.parent = node;
            node.parent = grandparent;
            
            if (grandparent != null) {
                if (grandparent.left == parent) {
                    grandparent.left = node;
                } else if (grandparent.right == parent) {
                    grandparent.right = node;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Treap (Randomized Binary Search Tree)
    public static class Treap<T extends Comparable<T>> {
        
        private static class Node<T> {
            T key;
            int priority;
            Node<T> left, right;
            
            Node(T key) {
                this.key = key;
                this.priority = new Random().nextInt();
            }
        }
        
        private Node<T> root;
        private Random random;
        
        public Treap() {
            this.random = new Random();
        }
        
        public void insert(T key) {
            root = insert(root, key);
        }
        
        private Node<T> insert(Node<T> node, T key) {
            if (node == null) {
                return new Node<>(key);
            }
            
            int cmp = key.compareTo(node.key);
            if (cmp < 0) {
                node.left = insert(node.left, key);
                if (node.left.priority > node.priority) {
                    node = rotateRight(node);
                }
            } else if (cmp > 0) {
                node.right = insert(node.right, key);
                if (node.right.priority > node.priority) {
                    node = rotateLeft(node);
                }
            }
            
            return node;
        }
        
        public void delete(T key) {
            root = delete(root, key);
        }
        
        private Node<T> delete(Node<T> node, T key) {
            if (node == null) return null;
            
            int cmp = key.compareTo(node.key);
            if (cmp < 0) {
                node.left = delete(node.left, key);
            } else if (cmp > 0) {
                node.right = delete(node.right, key);
            } else {
                if (node.left == null) return node.right;
                if (node.right == null) return node.left;
                
                if (node.left.priority > node.right.priority) {
                    node = rotateRight(node);
                    node.right = delete(node.right, key);
                } else {
                    node = rotateLeft(node);
                    node.left = delete(node.left, key);
                }
            }
            
            return node;
        }
        
        public boolean contains(T key) {
            return contains(root, key);
        }
        
        private boolean contains(Node<T> node, T key) {
            if (node == null) return false;
            
            int cmp = key.compareTo(node.key);
            if (cmp < 0) return contains(node.left, key);
            if (cmp > 0) return contains(node.right, key);
            return true;
        }
        
        private Node<T> rotateLeft(Node<T> node) {
            Node<T> newRoot = node.right;
            node.right = newRoot.left;
            newRoot.left = node;
            return newRoot;
        }
        
        private Node<T> rotateRight(Node<T> node) {
            Node<T> newRoot = node.left;
            node.left = newRoot.right;
            newRoot.right = node;
            return newRoot;
        }
        
        // Split treap into two treaps: (≤ key, > key)
        public Treap<T>[] split(T key) {
            Node<T>[] result = split(root, key);
            
            Treap<T> left = new Treap<>();
            Treap<T> right = new Treap<>();
            left.root = result[0];
            right.root = result[1];
            
            return new Treap[]{left, right};
        }
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        private Node<T>[] split(Node<T> node, T key) {
            if (node == null) {
                return new Node[]{null, null};
            }
            
            if (key.compareTo(node.key) < 0) {
                Node<T>[] leftSplit = split(node.left, key);
                node.left = leftSplit[1];
                return new Node[]{leftSplit[0], node};
            } else {
                Node<T>[] rightSplit = split(node.right, key);
                node.right = rightSplit[0];
                return new Node[]{node, rightSplit[1]};
            }
        }
        
        // Merge two treaps (all keys in left ≤ all keys in right)
        public static <T extends Comparable<T>> Treap<T> merge(Treap<T> left, Treap<T> right) {
            Treap<T> result = new Treap<>();
            result.root = merge(left.root, right.root);
            return result;
        }
        
        private static <T extends Comparable<T>> Node<T> merge(Node<T> left, Node<T> right) {
            if (left == null) return right;
            if (right == null) return left;
            
            if (left.priority > right.priority) {
                left.right = merge(left.right, right);
                return left;
            } else {
                right.left = merge(left, right.left);
                return right;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Rope Data Structure (for efficient string operations)
    public static class Rope {
        
        private static class Node {
            String data;
            int weight; // Length of left subtree
            Node left, right;
            
            Node(String data) {
                this.data = data;
                this.weight = data.length();
            }
            
            Node(Node left, Node right) {
                this.left = left;
                this.right = right;
                this.weight = left != null ? left.totalLength() : 0;
            }
            
            int totalLength() {
                if (data != null) return data.length();
                return weight + (right != null ? right.totalLength() : 0);
            }
            
            boolean isLeaf() {
                return data != null;
            }
        }
        
        private Node root;
        
        public Rope(String s) {
            this.root = new Node(s);
        }
        
        private Rope(Node root) {
            this.root = root;
        }
        
        public char charAt(int index) {
            return charAt(root, index);
        }
        
        private char charAt(Node node, int index) {
            if (node.isLeaf()) {
                return node.data.charAt(index);
            }
            
            if (index < node.weight) {
                return charAt(node.left, index);
            } else {
                return charAt(node.right, index - node.weight);
            }
        }
        
        public Rope concat(Rope other) {
            return new Rope(new Node(this.root, other.root));
        }
        
        public Rope[] split(int index) {
            Node[] result = split(root, index);
            return new Rope[]{new Rope(result[0]), new Rope(result[1])};
        }
        
        private Node[] split(Node node, int index) {
            if (node.isLeaf()) {
                if (index == 0) {
                    return new Node[]{null, node};
                } else if (index >= node.data.length()) {
                    return new Node[]{node, null};
                } else {
                    String left = node.data.substring(0, index);
                    String right = node.data.substring(index);
                    return new Node[]{new Node(left), new Node(right)};
                }
            }
            
            if (index <= node.weight) {
                Node[] leftSplit = split(node.left, index);
                Node rightPart = leftSplit[1] != null ? 
                    new Node(leftSplit[1], node.right) : node.right;
                return new Node[]{leftSplit[0], rightPart};
            } else {
                Node[] rightSplit = split(node.right, index - node.weight);
                Node leftPart = rightSplit[0] != null ? 
                    new Node(node.left, rightSplit[0]) : node.left;
                return new Node[]{leftPart, rightSplit[1]};
            }
        }
        
        public Rope insert(int index, String s) {
            Rope[] parts = split(index);
            Rope newRope = new Rope(s);
            return parts[0].concat(newRope).concat(parts[1]);
        }
        
        public Rope delete(int start, int end) {
            Rope[] firstSplit = split(start);
            Rope[] secondSplit = firstSplit[1].split(end - start);
            return firstSplit[0].concat(secondSplit[1]);
        }
        
        public String substring(int start, int end) {
            Rope[] firstSplit = split(start);
            Rope[] secondSplit = firstSplit[1].split(end - start);
            return toString(secondSplit[0].root);
        }
        
        public int length() {
            return root != null ? root.totalLength() : 0;
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return toString(root);
        }
        
        private String toString(Node node) {
            if (node == null) return "";
            if (node.isLeaf()) return node.data;
            
            String left = node.left != null ? toString(node.left) : "";
            String right = node.right != null ? toString(node.right) : "";
            return left + right;
        }
    }
    
    // Skip List
    public static class SkipList<T extends Comparable<T>> {
        
        private static class Node<T> {
            T value;
            Node<T>[] forward;
            
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Node(T value, int level) {
                this.value = value;
                this.forward = new Node[level + 1];
            }
        }
        
        private static final int MAX_LEVEL = 16;
        private static final double P = 0.5;
        
        private Node<T> header;
        private int level;
        private Random random;
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public SkipList() {
            this.header = new Node<>(null, MAX_LEVEL);
            this.level = 0;
            this.random = new Random();
        }
        
        private int randomLevel() {
            int level = 0;
            while (random.nextDouble() < P && level < MAX_LEVEL) {
                level++;
            }
            return level;
        }
        
        public void insert(T value) {
            Node<T>[] update = new Node[MAX_LEVEL + 1];
            Node<T> current = header;
            
            // Find insertion point
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && 
                       current.forward[i].value.compareTo(value) < 0) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
                update[i] = current;
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            
            if (current == null || !current.value.equals(value)) {
                int newLevel = randomLevel();
                
                if (newLevel > level) {
                    for (int i = level + 1; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                        update[i] = header;
                    }
                    level = newLevel;
                }
                
                Node<T> newNode = new Node<>(value, newLevel);
                
                for (int i = 0; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                    newNode.forward[i] = update[i].forward[i];
                    update[i].forward[i] = newNode;
                }
            }
        }
        
        public boolean search(T value) {
            Node<T> current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && 
                       current.forward[i].value.compareTo(value) < 0) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            return current != null && current.value.equals(value);
        }
        
        public void delete(T value) {
            Node<T>[] update = new Node[MAX_LEVEL + 1];
            Node<T> current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && 
                       current.forward[i].value.compareTo(value) < 0) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
                update[i] = current;
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            
            if (current != null && current.value.equals(value)) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= level; i++) {
                    if (update[i].forward[i] != current) break;
                    update[i].forward[i] = current.forward[i];
                }
                
                while (level > 0 && header.forward[level] == null) {
                    level--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class ApproximationAlgorithms {
    
    // Vertex Cover Approximation
    public static class VertexCoverApproximation {
        
        // 2-approximation algorithm
        public static Set<Integer> vertexCover2Approx(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            Set<Integer> cover = new HashSet<>();
            Set<String> edges = new HashSet<>();
            
            // Create edge set
            for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (u < v) {
                        edges.add(u + "," + v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Greedily pick edges and add both endpoints
            while (!edges.isEmpty()) {
                String edge = edges.iterator().next();
                String[] parts = edge.split(",");
                int u = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                int v = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                
                cover.add(u);
                cover.add(v);
                
                // Remove all edges incident to u or v
                edges.removeIf(e -> {
                    String[] edgeParts = e.split(",");
                    int x = Integer.parseInt(edgeParts[0]);
                    int y = Integer.parseInt(edgeParts[1]);
                    return x == u || x == v || y == u || y == v;
                });
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
        
        // Greedy approximation (log n approximation)
        public static Set<Integer> vertexCoverGreedy(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
            Set<Integer> cover = new HashSet<>();
            Set<String> uncoveredEdges = new HashSet<>();
            
            // Initialize uncovered edges
            for (int u = 0; u < graph.size(); u++) {
                for (int v : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (u < v) {
                        uncoveredEdges.add(u + "," + v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            while (!uncoveredEdges.isEmpty()) {
                // Find vertex that covers most uncovered edges
                Map<Integer, Integer> coverage = new HashMap<>();
                
                for (String edge : uncoveredEdges) {
                    String[] parts = edge.split(",");
                    int u = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                    int v = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                    
                    coverage.put(u, coverage.getOrDefault(u, 0) + 1);
                    coverage.put(v, coverage.getOrDefault(v, 0) + 1);
                }
                
                // Select vertex with maximum coverage
                int bestVertex = coverage.entrySet().stream()
                    .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                    .orElse(0);
                
                cover.add(bestVertex);
                
                // Remove edges covered by this vertex
                uncoveredEdges.removeIf(edge -> {
                    String[] parts = edge.split(",");
                    int u = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                    int v = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                    return u == bestVertex || v == bestVertex;
                });
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
    }
    
    // Set Cover Approximation
    public static class SetCoverApproximation {
        
        // Greedy approximation (H_n approximation where H_n is harmonic number)
        public static List<Integer> setCoverGreedy(List<Set<Integer>> sets, Set<Integer> universe) {
            List<Integer> cover = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> uncovered = new HashSet<>(universe);
            
            while (!uncovered.isEmpty()) {
                int bestSet = -1;
                int maxCoverage = 0;
                
                // Find set that covers most uncovered elements
                for (int i = 0; i < sets.size(); i++) {
                    Set<Integer> intersection = new HashSet<>(sets.get(i));
                    intersection.retainAll(uncovered);
                    
                    if (intersection.size() > maxCoverage) {
                        maxCoverage = intersection.size();
                        bestSet = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestSet == -1) break;
                
                cover.add(bestSet);
                uncovered.removeAll(sets.get(bestSet));
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
        
        // Randomized rounding approximation
        public static List<Integer> setCoverRandomizedRounding(List<Set<Integer>> sets, 
                                                              Set<Integer> universe, 
                                                              double[] fractionalSolution) {
            Random random = new Random();
            List<Integer> cover = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Integer> uncovered = new HashSet<>(universe);
            
            // Round fractional solution
            for (int i = 0; i < sets.size(); i++) {
                if (random.nextDouble() < fractionalSolution[i]) {
                    cover.add(i);
                    uncovered.removeAll(sets.get(i));
                }
            }
            
            // Use greedy to cover remaining elements
            while (!uncovered.isEmpty()) {
                int bestSet = -1;
                int maxCoverage = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < sets.size(); i++) {
                    if (cover.contains(i)) continue;
                    
                    Set<Integer> intersection = new HashSet<>(sets.get(i));
                    intersection.retainAll(uncovered);
                    
                    if (intersection.size() > maxCoverage) {
                        maxCoverage = intersection.size();
                        bestSet = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestSet == -1) break;
                
                cover.add(bestSet);
                uncovered.removeAll(sets.get(bestSet));
            }
            
            return cover;
        }
    }
    
    // Traveling Salesman Approximation
    public static class TSPApproximation {
        
        // Christofides Algorithm (1.5-approximation for metric TSP)
        public static class ChristofidesAlgorithm {
            
            static class Edge implements Comparable<Edge> {
                int u, v;
                double weight;
                
                Edge(int u, int v, double weight) {
                    this.u = u;
                    this.v = v;
                    this.weight = weight;
                }
                
                @Override
                public int compareTo(Edge other) {
                    return Double.compare(this.weight, other.weight);
                }
            }
            
            public static List<Integer> christofides(double[][] distances) {
                int n = distances.length;
                
                // Step 1: Find MST
                List<Edge> mst = findMST(distances);
                
                // Step 2: Find vertices with odd degree in MST
                List<Integer> oddDegreeVertices = findOddDegreeVertices(mst, n);
                
                // Step 3: Find minimum weight perfect matching on odd degree vertices
                List<Edge> matching = findMinWeightPerfectMatching(oddDegreeVertices, distances);
                
                // Step 4: Combine MST and matching to form Eulerian multigraph
                List<List<Integer>> multigraph = buildMultigraph(mst, matching, n);
                
                // Step 5: Find Eulerian tour
                List<Integer> eulerianTour = findEulerianTour(multigraph);
                
                // Step 6: Convert to Hamiltonian tour by shortcutting
                return shortcutToHamiltonianTour(eulerianTour);
            }
            
            private static List<Edge> findMST(double[][] distances) {
                int n = distances.length;
                List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
                
                // Create all edges
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                        edges.add(new Edge(i, j, distances[i][j]));
                    }
                }
                
                Collections.sort(edges);
                
                // Kruskal's algorithm
                UnionFind uf = new UnionFind(n);
                List<Edge> mst = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (Edge edge : edges) {
                    if (uf.union(edge.u, edge.v)) {
                        mst.add(edge);
                        if (mst.size() == n - 1) break;
                    }
                }
                
                return mst;
            }
            
            private static List<Integer> findOddDegreeVertices(List<Edge> mst, int n) {
                int[] degree = new int[n];
                
                for (Edge edge : mst) {
                    degree[edge.u]++;
                    degree[edge.v]++;
                }
                
                List<Integer> oddVertices = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (degree[i] % 2 == 1) {
                        oddVertices.add(i);
                    }
                }
                
                return oddVertices;
            }
            
            private static List<Edge> findMinWeightPerfectMatching(List<Integer> vertices, 
                                                                  double[][] distances) {
                // Simplified: use greedy matching (not optimal but polynomial)
                List<Edge> matching = new ArrayList<>();
                Set<Integer> matched = new HashSet<>();
                
                vertices.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a, b));
                
                for (int i = 0; i < vertices.size(); i++) {
                    if (matched.contains(vertices.get(i))) continue;
                    
                    int u = vertices.get(i);
                    int bestV = -1;
                    double minWeight = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                    
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < vertices.size(); j++) {
                        int v = vertices.get(j);
                        if (matched.contains(v)) continue;
                        
                        if (distances[u][v] < minWeight) {
                            minWeight = distances[u][v];
                            bestV = v;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (bestV != -1) {
                        matching.add(new Edge(u, bestV, minWeight));
                        matched.add(u);
                        matched.add(bestV);
                    }
                }
                
                return matching;
            }
            
            private static List<List<Integer>> buildMultigraph(List<Edge> mst, 
                                                              List<Edge> matching, int n) {
                List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                }
                
                // Add MST edges
                for (Edge edge : mst) {
                    graph.get(edge.u).add(edge.v);
                    graph.get(edge.v).add(edge.u);
                }
                
                // Add matching edges
                for (Edge edge : matching) {
                    graph.get(edge.u).add(edge.v);
                    graph.get(edge.v).add(edge.u);
                }
                
                return graph;
            }
            
            private static List<Integer> findEulerianTour(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
                List<Integer> tour = new ArrayList<>();
                Stack<Integer> stack = new Stack<>();
                
                // Create copy of adjacency lists
                List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
                for (List<Integer> neighbors : graph) {
                    adj.add(new ArrayList<>(neighbors));
                }
                
                stack.push(0);
                
                while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                    int v = stack.peek();
                    
                    if (adj.get(v).isEmpty()) {
                        tour.add(stack.pop());
                    } else {
                        int u = adj.get(v).remove(adj.get(v).size() - 1);
                        adj.get(u).remove(Integer.valueOf(v));
                        stack.push(u);
                    }
                }
                
                Collections.reverse(tour);
                return tour;
            }
            
            private static List<Integer> shortcutToHamiltonianTour(List<Integer> eulerianTour) {
                List<Integer> hamiltonianTour = new ArrayList<>();
                Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
                
                for (int vertex : eulerianTour) {
                    if (!visited.contains(vertex)) {
                        hamiltonianTour.add(vertex);
                        visited.add(vertex);
                    }
                }
                
                return hamiltonianTour;
            }
        }
        
        // Nearest Neighbor Algorithm (2-approximation for metric TSP)
        public static List<Integer> nearestNeighbor(double[][] distances) {
            int n = distances.length;
            List<Integer> tour = new ArrayList<>();
            boolean[] visited = new boolean[n];
            
            int current = 0;
            tour.add(current);
            visited[current] = true;
            
            for (int step = 1; step < n; step++) {
                int nearest = -1;
                double minDistance = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                
                for (int next = 0; next < n; next++) {
                    if (!visited[next] && distances[current][next] < minDistance) {
                        minDistance = distances[current][next];
                        nearest = next;
                    }
                }
                
                if (nearest != -1) {
                    tour.add(nearest);
                    visited[nearest] = true;
                    current = nearest;
                }
            }
            
            tour.add(0); // Return to start
            return tour;
        }
    }
    
    // Bin Packing Approximation
    public static class BinPackingApproximation {
        
        // First Fit Decreasing (11/9 OPT + 6/9)
        public static List<List<Double>> firstFitDecreasing(List<Double> items, double binCapacity) {
            List<List<Double>> bins = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> binUsed = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Sort items in decreasing order
            List<Double> sortedItems = new ArrayList<>(items);
            sortedItems.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
            
            for (double item : sortedItems) {
                boolean placed = false;
                
                // Try to place in existing bin
                for (int i = 0; i < bins.size(); i++) {
                    if (binUsed.get(i) + item <= binCapacity) {
                        bins.get(i).add(item);
                        binUsed.set(i, binUsed.get(i) + item);
                        placed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                // Create new bin if necessary
                if (!placed) {
                    List<Double> newBin = new ArrayList<>();
                    newBin.add(item);
                    bins.add(newBin);
                    binUsed.add(item);
                }
            }
            
            return bins;
        }
        
        // Best Fit Decreasing
        public static List<List<Double>> bestFitDecreasing(List<Double> items, double binCapacity) {
            List<List<Double>> bins = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> binUsed = new ArrayList<>();
            
            List<Double> sortedItems = new ArrayList<>(items);
            sortedItems.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
            
            for (double item : sortedItems) {
                int bestBin = -1;
                double minRemainingSpace = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                
                // Find best fitting bin
                for (int i = 0; i < bins.size(); i++) {
                    double remainingSpace = binCapacity - binUsed.get(i);
                    if (remainingSpace >= item && remainingSpace < minRemainingSpace) {
                        minRemainingSpace = remainingSpace;
                        bestBin = i;
                    }
                }
                
                if (bestBin != -1) {
                    bins.get(bestBin).add(item);
                    binUsed.set(bestBin, binUsed.get(bestBin) + item);
                } else {
                    List<Double> newBin = new ArrayList<>();
                    newBin.add(item);
                    bins.add(newBin);
                    binUsed.add(item);
                }
            }
            
            return bins;
        }
    }
    
    // Load Balancing Approximation
    public static class LoadBalancingApproximation {
        
        // List Scheduling (2-approximation)
        public static Map<Integer, List<Integer>> listScheduling(List<Integer> jobs, int machines) {
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> assignment = new HashMap<>();
            List<Integer> machineLoad = new ArrayList<>();
            
            // Initialize machines
            for (int i = 0; i < machines; i++) {
                assignment.put(i, new ArrayList<>());
                machineLoad.add(0);
            }
            
            // Assign each job to least loaded machine
            for (int job : jobs) {
                int leastLoadedMachine = 0;
                for (int i = 1; i < machines; i++) {
                    if (machineLoad.get(i) < machineLoad.get(leastLoadedMachine)) {
                        leastLoadedMachine = i;
                    }
                }
                
                assignment.get(leastLoadedMachine).add(job);
                machineLoad.set(leastLoadedMachine, machineLoad.get(leastLoadedMachine) + job);
            }
            
            return assignment;
        }
        
        // Longest Processing Time (LPT) - (4/3-approximation)
        public static Map<Integer, List<Integer>> longestProcessingTime(List<Integer> jobs, int machines) {
            Map<Integer, List<Integer>> assignment = new HashMap<>();
            List<Integer> machineLoad = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < machines; i++) {
                assignment.put(i, new ArrayList<>());
                machineLoad.add(0);
            }
            
            // Sort jobs in decreasing order
            List<Integer> sortedJobs = new ArrayList<>(jobs);
            sortedJobs.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
            
            for (int job : sortedJobs) {
                int leastLoadedMachine = 0;
                for (int i = 1; i < machines; i++) {
                    if (machineLoad.get(i) < machineLoad.get(leastLoadedMachine)) {
                        leastLoadedMachine = i;
                    }
                }
                
                assignment.get(leastLoadedMachine).add(job);
                machineLoad.set(leastLoadedMachine, machineLoad.get(leastLoadedMachine) + job);
            }
            
            return assignment;
        }
    }
    
    // Union-Find helper class
    private static class UnionFind {
        int[] parent, rank;
        
        UnionFind(int n) {
            parent = new int[n];
            rank = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                parent[i] = i;
            }
        }
        
        int find(int x) {
            if (parent[x] != x) {
                parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
            }
            return parent[x];
        }
        
        boolean union(int x, int y) {
            int px = find(x), py = find(y);
            if (px == py) return false;
            
            if (rank[px] < rank[py]) {
                parent[px] = py;
            } else if (rank[px] > rank[py]) {
                parent[py] = px;
            } else {
                parent[py] = px;
                rank[px]++;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n log n) to O(n²) depending on algorithm, **Space**: O(n)
