```java
public class RandomizedAlgorithms {
    
    // Randomized Quicksort
    public static class RandomizedQuickSort {
        private static Random random = new Random();
        
        public static void quickSort(int[] arr) {
            quickSort(arr, 0, arr.length - 1);
        }
        
        private static void quickSort(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
            if (low < high) {
                int pivotIndex = randomizedPartition(arr, low, high);
                quickSort(arr, low, pivotIndex - 1);
                quickSort(arr, pivotIndex + 1, high);
            }
        }
        
        private static int randomizedPartition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
            // Randomly choose pivot
            int randomIndex = low + random.nextInt(high - low + 1);
            swap(arr, randomIndex, high);
            
            return partition(arr, low, high);
        }
        
        private static int partition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
            int pivot = arr[high];
            int i = low - 1;
            
            for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
                if (arr[j] <= pivot) {
                    i++;
                    swap(arr, i, j);
                }
            }
            
            swap(arr, i + 1, high);
            return i + 1;
        }
        
        private static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
            int temp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = temp;
        }
    }
    
    // Randomized Selection (QuickSelect)
    public static class RandomizedSelect {
        private static Random random = new Random();
        
        public static int select(int[] arr, int k) {
            return select(arr, 0, arr.length - 1, k - 1);
        }
        
        private static int select(int[] arr, int low, int high, int k) {
            if (low == high) return arr[low];
            
            int pivotIndex = randomizedPartition(arr, low, high);
            
            if (k == pivotIndex) {
                return arr[pivotIndex];
            } else if (k < pivotIndex) {
                return select(arr, low, pivotIndex - 1, k);
            } else {
                return select(arr, pivotIndex + 1, high, k);
            }
        }
        
        private static int randomizedPartition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
            int randomIndex = low + random.nextInt(high - low + 1);
            swap(arr, randomIndex, high);
            return partition(arr, low, high);
        }
        
        private static int partition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
            int pivot = arr[high];
            int i = low - 1;
            
            for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
                if (arr[j] <= pivot) {
                    i++;
                    swap(arr, i, j);
                }
            }
            
            swap(arr, i + 1, high);
            return i + 1;
        }
        
        private static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
            int temp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = temp;
        }
    }
    
    // Monte Carlo Algorithms
    public static class MonteCarloAlgorithms {
        
        // Monte Carlo method for π estimation
        public static double estimatePi(int numSamples) {
            Random random = new Random();
            int pointsInCircle = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
                double x = random.nextDouble() * 2 - 1; // [-1, 1]
                double y = random.nextDouble() * 2 - 1; // [-1, 1]
                
                if (x * x + y * y <= 1) {
                    pointsInCircle++;
                }
            }
            
            return 4.0 * pointsInCircle / numSamples;
        }
        
        // Monte Carlo integration
        public static double integrate(Function<Double, Double> f, double a, double b, int numSamples) {
            Random random = new Random();
            double sum = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
                double x = a + random.nextDouble() * (b - a);
                sum += f.apply(x);
            }
            
            return (b - a) * sum / numSamples;
        }
        
        // Monte Carlo for matrix multiplication verification
        public static boolean verifyMatrixMultiplication(int[][] A, int[][] B, int[][] C, int numTests) {
            Random random = new Random();
            int n = A.length;
            
            for (int test = 0; test < numTests; test++) {
                // Generate random vector
                int[] r = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    r[i] = random.nextInt(2); // 0 or 1
                }
                
                // Compute A(Br)
                int[] Br = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        Br[i] += B[i][j] * r[j];
                    }
                }
                
                int[] ABr = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        ABr[i] += A[i][j] * Br[j];
                    }
                }
                
                // Compute Cr
                int[] Cr = new int[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        Cr[i] += C[i][j] * r[j];
                    }
                }
                
                // Check if ABr == Cr
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (ABr[i] != Cr[i]) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    // Las Vegas Algorithms
    public static class LasVegasAlgorithms {
        
        // Randomized primality testing (Miller-Rabin)
        public static class MillerRabinPrimality {
            private static Random random = new Random();
            
            public static boolean isPrime(long n, int k) {
                if (n < 2) return false;
                if (n == 2 || n == 3) return true;
                if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
                
                // Write n-1 as d * 2^r
                long d = n - 1;
                int r = 0;
                while (d % 2 == 0) {
                    d /= 2;
                    r++;
                }
                
                // Perform k rounds of testing
                for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                    long a = 2 + (long)(random.nextDouble() * (n - 4));
                    if (!millerRabinTest(n, d, r, a)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            
            private static boolean millerRabinTest(long n, long d, int r, long a) {
                long x = modPow(a, d, n);
                
                if (x == 1 || x == n - 1) {
                    return true;
                }
                
                for (int i = 0; i < r - 1; i++) {
                    x = modMul(x, x, n);
                    if (x == n - 1) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                
                return false;
            }
            
            private static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
                long result = 1;
                base %= mod;
                
                while (exp > 0) {
                    if (exp % 2 == 1) {
                        result = modMul(result, base, mod);
                    }
                    exp /= 2;
                    base = modMul(base, base, mod);
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            private static long modMul(long a, long b, long mod) {
                return ((a % mod) * (b % mod)) % mod;
            }
        }
        
        // Randomized polynomial identity testing
        public static class PolynomialIdentityTesting {
            
            static class Polynomial {
                Map<List<Integer>, Integer> terms; // exponents -> coefficient
                
                Polynomial() {
                    this.terms = new HashMap<>();
                }
                
                void addTerm(int coefficient, int... exponents) {
                    List<Integer> key = Arrays.stream(exponents).boxed().collect(Collectors.toList());
                    terms.put(key, terms.getOrDefault(key, 0) + coefficient);
                }
                
                int evaluate(int... values) {
                    int result = 0;
                    
                    for (Map.Entry<List<Integer>, Integer> term : terms.entrySet()) {
                        int termValue = term.getValue();
                        List<Integer> exponents = term.getKey();
                        
                        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(exponents.size(), values.length); i++) {
                            termValue *= Math.pow(values[i], exponents.get(i));
                        }
                        
                        result += termValue;
                    }
                    
                    return result;
                }
                
                boolean isZero() {
                    return terms.isEmpty() || terms.values().stream().allMatch(c -> c == 0);
                }
            }
            
            public static boolean areIdentical(Polynomial p1, Polynomial p2, int numTests, int bound) {
                Random random = new Random();
                
                for (int test = 0; test < numTests; test++) {
                    // Generate random evaluation point
                    int[] values = new int[10]; // Assuming max 10 variables
                    for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                        values[i] = random.nextInt(bound);
                    }
                    
                    if (p1.evaluate(values) != p2.evaluate(values)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Skip List with Randomization
    public static class RandomizedSkipList<T extends Comparable<T>> {
        
        private static class Node<T> {
            T value;
            Node<T>[] forward;
            
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            Node(T value, int level) {
                this.value = value;
                this.forward = new Node[level + 1];
            }
        }
        
        private static final int MAX_LEVEL = 16;
        private static final double P = 0.5;
        
        private Node<T> header;
        private int level;
        private Random random;
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public RandomizedSkipList() {
            this.header = new Node<>(null, MAX_LEVEL);
            this.level = 0;
            this.random = new Random();
        }
        
        private int randomLevel() {
            int level = 0;
            while (random.nextDouble() < P && level < MAX_LEVEL) {
                level++;
            }
            return level;
        }
        
        public void insert(T value) {
            Node<T>[] update = new Node[MAX_LEVEL + 1];
            Node<T> current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && 
                       current.forward[i].value.compareTo(value) < 0) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
                update[i] = current;
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            
            if (current == null || !current.value.equals(value)) {
                int newLevel = randomLevel();
                
                if (newLevel > level) {
                    for (int i = level + 1; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                        update[i] = header;
                    }
                    level = newLevel;
                }
                
                Node<T> newNode = new Node<>(value, newLevel);
                
                for (int i = 0; i <= newLevel; i++) {
                    newNode.forward[i] = update[i].forward[i];
                    update[i].forward[i] = newNode;
                }
            }
        }
        
        public boolean search(T value) {
            Node<T> current = header;
            
            for (int i = level; i >= 0; i--) {
                while (current.forward[i] != null && 
                       current.forward[i].value.compareTo(value) < 0) {
                    current = current.forward[i];
                }
            }
            
            current = current.forward[0];
            return current != null && current.value.equals(value);
        }
    }
    
    // Randomized Incremental Construction
    public static class RandomizedIncrementalConstruction {
        
        // Randomized incremental convex hull
        public static class RandomizedConvexHull {
            
            static class Point {
                double x, y;
                
                Point(double x, double y) {
                    this.x = x;
                    this.y = y;
                }
                
                @Override
                public String toString() {
                    return "(" + x + ", " + y + ")";
                }
            }
            
            public static List<Point> convexHull(List<Point> points) {
                if (points.size() < 3) return new ArrayList<>(points);
                
                // Randomize point order
                List<Point> randomizedPoints = new ArrayList<>(points);
                Collections.shuffle(randomizedPoints);
                
                // Start with first three points
                List<Point> hull = new ArrayList<>();
                hull.addAll(randomizedPoints.subList(0, 3));
                
                // Sort initial triangle
                sortConvexHull(hull);
                
                // Add remaining points incrementally
                for (int i = 3; i < randomizedPoints.size(); i++) {
                    Point newPoint = randomizedPoints.get(i);
                    
                    if (isInsideConvexHull(newPoint, hull)) {
                        continue; // Point is inside, skip
                    }
                    
                    // Find tangent points and update hull
                    hull = addPointToConvexHull(newPoint, hull);
                }
                
                return hull;
            }
            
            private static void sortConvexHull(List<Point> hull) {
                // Sort points counter-clockwise around centroid
                Point centroid = new Point(
                    hull.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.x).average().orElse(0),
                    hull.stream().mapToDouble(p -> p.y).average().orElse(0)
                );
                
                hull.sort((p1, p2) -> {
                    double angle1 = Math.atan2(p1.y - centroid.y, p1.x - centroid.x);
                    double angle2 = Math.atan2(p2.y - centroid.y, p2.x - centroid.x);
                    return Double.compare(angle1, angle2);
                });
            }
            
            private static boolean isInsideConvexHull(Point point, List<Point> hull) {
                int n = hull.size();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    Point p1 = hull.get(i);
                    Point p2 = hull.get((i + 1) % n);
                    
                    if (crossProduct(p1, p2, point) < 0) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            
            private static List<Point> addPointToConvexHull(Point newPoint, List<Point> hull) {
                List<Point> newHull = new ArrayList<>();
                int n = hull.size();
                
                // Find visible edges and add point
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    Point curr = hull.get(i);
                    Point next = hull.get((i + 1) % n);
                    
                    if (crossProduct(curr, next, newPoint) >= 0) {
                        newHull.add(curr);
                    } else {
                        if (newHull.isEmpty() || !newHull.get(newHull.size() - 1).equals(newPoint)) {
                            newHull.add(newPoint);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return newHull;
            }
            
            private static double crossProduct(Point a, Point b, Point c) {
                return (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x);
            }
        }
    }
    
    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface Function<T, R> {
        R apply(T t);
    }
}
```

### 179. Parallel and Concurrent Algorithms
**Problem**: Algorithms designed for parallel and concurrent execution  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class ParallelConcurrentAlgorithms {
    
    // Parallel Merge Sort
    public static class ParallelMergeSort {
        private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
        
        public static void parallelMergeSort(int[] arr) {
            parallelMergeSort(arr, 0, arr.length - 1);
        }
        
        private static void parallelMergeSort(int[] arr, int left, int right) {
            if (right - left <= THRESHOLD) {
                Arrays.sort(arr, left, right + 1);
                return;
            }
            
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            
            // Create tasks for parallel execution
            CompletableFuture<Void> leftTask = CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> 
                parallelMergeSort(arr, left, mid));
            CompletableFuture<Void> rightTask = CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> 
                parallelMergeSort(arr, mid + 1, right));
            
            // Wait for both tasks to complete
            CompletableFuture.allOf(leftTask, rightTask).join();
            
            // Merge the sorted halves
            merge(arr, left, mid, right);
        }
        
        private static void merge(int[] arr, int left, int mid, int right) {
            int[] temp = new int[right - left + 1];
            int i = left, j = mid + 1, k = 0;
            
            while (i <= mid && j <= right) {
                if (arr[i] <= arr[j]) {
                    temp[k++] = arr[i++];
                } else {
                    temp[k++] = arr[j++];
                }
            }
            
            while (i <= mid) temp[k++] = arr[i++];
            while (j <= right) temp[k++] = arr[j++];
            
            System.arraycopy(temp, 0, arr, left, temp.length);
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Quick Sort
    public static class ParallelQuickSort {
        private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
        private static final ForkJoinPool forkJoinPool = new ForkJoinPool();
        
        static class QuickSortTask extends RecursiveAction {
            private final int[] array;
            private final int low, high;
            
            QuickSortTask(int[] array, int low, int high) {
                this.array = array;
                this.low = low;
                this.high = high;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected void compute() {
                if (high - low <= THRESHOLD) {
                    Arrays.sort(array, low, high + 1);
                    return;
                }
                
                int pivotIndex = partition(array, low, high);
                
                QuickSortTask leftTask = new QuickSortTask(array, low, pivotIndex - 1);
                QuickSortTask rightTask = new QuickSortTask(array, pivotIndex + 1, high);
                
                invokeAll(leftTask, rightTask);
            }
            
            private int partition(int[] arr, int low, int high) {
                int pivot = arr[high];
                int i = low - 1;
                
                for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
                    if (arr[j] <= pivot) {
                        i++;
                        swap(arr, i, j);
                    }
                }
                
                swap(arr, i + 1, high);
                return i + 1;
            }
            
            private void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
                int temp = arr[i];
                arr[i] = arr[j];
                arr[j] = temp;
            }
        }
        
        public static void parallelQuickSort(int[] array) {
            forkJoinPool.invoke(new QuickSortTask(array, 0, array.length - 1));
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Reduction Operations
    public static class ParallelReductions {
        
        // Parallel sum using Fork-Join
        static class SumTask extends RecursiveTask<Long> {
            private static final int THRESHOLD = 1000;
            private final int[] array;
            private final int start, end;
            
            SumTask(int[] array, int start, int end) {
                this.array = array;
                this.start = start;
                this.end = end;
            }
            
            @Override
            protected Long compute() {
                if (end - start <= THRESHOLD) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                        sum += array[i];
                    }
                    return sum;
                }
                
                int mid = start + (end - start) / 2;
                SumTask leftTask = new SumTask(array, start, mid);
                SumTask rightTask = new SumTask(array, mid, end);
                
                leftTask.fork();
                long rightResult = rightTask.compute();
                long leftResult = leftTask.join();
                
                return leftResult + rightResult;
            }
        }
        
        public static long parallelSum(int[] array) {
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
            return pool.invoke(new SumTask(array, 0, array.length));
        }
        
        // Parallel prefix sum (scan)
        public static class ParallelPrefixSum {
            
            static class PrefixSumTask extends RecursiveTask<Void> {
                private final long[] array;
                private final int start, end;
                private final long offset;
                
                PrefixSumTask(long[] array, int start, int end, long offset) {
                    this.array = array;
                    this.start = start;
                    this.end = end;
                    this.offset = offset;
                }
                
                @Override
                protected Void compute() {
                    if (end - start == 1) {
                        array[start] += offset;
                        return null;
                    }
                    
                    int mid = start + (end - start) / 2;
                    
                    // Compute sum of left half
                    long leftSum = 0;
                    for (int i = start; i < mid; i++) {
                        leftSum += array[i];
                    }
                    
                    PrefixSumTask leftTask = new PrefixSumTask(array, start, mid, offset);
                    PrefixSumTask rightTask = new PrefixSumTask(array, mid, end, offset + leftSum);
                    
                    invokeAll(leftTask, rightTask);
                    return null;
                }
            }
            
            public static void parallelPrefixSum(long[] array) {
                ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool();
                pool.invoke(new PrefixSumTask(array, 0, array.length, 0));
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Concurrent Data Structures
    public static class ConcurrentDataStructures {
        
        // Lock-free Stack
        public static class LockFreeStack<T> {
            private final AtomicReference<Node<T>> head = new AtomicReference<>();
            
            private static class Node<T> {
                final T data;
                final Node<T> next;
                
                Node(T data, Node<T> next) {
                    this.data = data;
                    this.next = next;
                }
            }
            
            public void push(T item) {
                Node<T> newNode;
                Node<T> currentHead;
                
                do {
                    currentHead = head.get();
                    newNode = new Node<>(item, currentHead);
                } while (!head.compareAndSet(currentHead, newNode));
            }
            
            public T pop() {
                Node<T> currentHead;
                Node<T> newHead;
                
                do {
                    currentHead = head.get();
                    if (currentHead == null) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    newHead = currentHead.next;
                } while (!head.compareAndSet(currentHead, newHead));
                
                return currentHead.data;
            }
            
            public boolean isEmpty() {
                return head.get() == null;
            }
        }
        
        // Lock-free Queue
        public static class LockFreeQueue<T> {
            private final AtomicReference<Node<T>> head;
            private final AtomicReference<Node<T>> tail;
            
            private static class Node<T> {
                volatile T data;
                final AtomicReference<Node<T>> next = new AtomicReference<>();
                
                Node(T data) {
                    this.data = data;
                }
            }
            
            public LockFreeQueue() {
                Node<T> dummy = new Node<>(null);
                head = new AtomicReference<>(dummy);
                tail = new AtomicReference<>(dummy);
            }
            
            public void enqueue(T item) {
                Node<T> newNode = new Node<>(item);
                
                while (true) {
                    Node<T> currentTail = tail.get();
                    Node<T> tailNext = currentTail.next.get();
                    
                    if (currentTail == tail.get()) {
                        if (tailNext == null) {
                            if (currentTail.next.compareAndSet(null, newNode)) {
                                break;
                            }
                        } else {
                            tail.compareAndSet(currentTail, tailNext);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                tail.compareAndSet(tail.get(), newNode);
            }
            
            public T dequeue() {
                while (true) {
                    Node<T> currentHead = head.get();
                    Node<T> currentTail = tail.get();
                    Node<T> headNext = currentHead.next.get();
                    
                    if (currentHead == head.get()) {
                        if (currentHead == currentTail) {
                            if (headNext == null) {
                                return null; // Queue is empty
                            }
                            tail.compareAndSet(currentTail, headNext);
                        } else {
                            if (headNext == null) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            
                            T data = headNext.data;
                            if (head.compareAndSet(currentHead, headNext)) {
                                return data;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Concurrent Hash Map implementation
        public static class ConcurrentHashMap<K, V> {
            private static final int DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 16;
            private static final double LOAD_FACTOR = 0.75;
            
            private volatile Bucket<K, V>[] buckets;
            private final AtomicInteger size = new AtomicInteger(0);
            private final Object resizeLock = new Object();
            
            private static class Bucket<K, V> {
                final Object lock = new Object();
                volatile Node<K, V> head;
                
                static class Node<K, V> {
                    final K key;
                    volatile V value;
                    volatile Node<K, V> next;
                    
                    Node(K key, V value, Node<K, V> next) {
                        this.key = key;
                        this.value = value;
                        this.next = next;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            public ConcurrentHashMap() {
                buckets = new Bucket[DEFAULT_CAPACITY];
                for (int i = 0; i < DEFAULT_CAPACITY; i++) {
                    buckets[i] = new Bucket<>();
                }
            }
            
            public V put(K key, V value) {
                int hash = key.hashCode();
                Bucket<K, V> bucket = getBucket(hash);
                
                synchronized (bucket.lock) {
                    Bucket.Node<K, V> current = bucket.head;
                    
                    while (current != null) {
                        if (current.key.equals(key)) {
                            V oldValue = current.value;
                            current.value = value;
                            return oldValue;
                        }
                        current = current.next;
                    }
                    
                    bucket.head = new Bucket.Node<>(key, value, bucket.head);
                    size.incrementAndGet();
                    
                    if (size.get() > buckets.length * LOAD_FACTOR) {
                        resize();
                    }
                    
                    return null;
                }
            }
            
            public V get(K key) {
                int hash = key.hashCode();
                Bucket<K, V> bucket = getBucket(hash);
                
                synchronized (bucket.lock) {
                    Bucket.Node<K, V> current = bucket.head;
                    
                    while (current != null) {
                        if (current.key.equals(key)) {
                            return current.value;
                        }
                        current = current.next;
                    }
                    
                    return null;
                }
            }
            
            private Bucket<K, V> getBucket(int hash) {
                return buckets[Math.abs(hash) % buckets.length];
            }
            
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            private void resize() {
                synchronized (resizeLock) {
                    if (size.get() <= buckets.length * LOAD_FACTOR) {
                        return; // Another thread already resized
                    }
                    
                    Bucket<K, V>[] oldBuckets = buckets;
                    buckets = new Bucket[oldBuckets.length * 2];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
                        buckets[i] = new Bucket<>();
                    }
                    
                    size.set(0);
                    
                    // Rehash all elements
                    for (Bucket<K, V> oldBucket : oldBuckets) {
                        synchronized (oldBucket.lock) {
                            Bucket.Node<K, V> current = oldBucket.head;
                            while (current != null) {
                                put(current.key, current.value);
                                current = current.next;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Producer-Consumer with BlockingQueue
    public static class ProducerConsumer {
        
        public static class BoundedBuffer<T> {
            private final BlockingQueue<T> queue;
            private final AtomicBoolean stopped = new AtomicBoolean(false);
            
            public BoundedBuffer(int capacity) {
                this.queue = new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(capacity);
            }
            
            public void put(T item) throws InterruptedException {
                if (!stopped.get()) {
                    queue.put(item);
                }
            }
            
            public T take() throws InterruptedException {
                return queue.take();
            }
            
            public void stop() {
                stopped.set(true);
            }
            
            public boolean isStopped() {
                return stopped.get() && queue.isEmpty();
            }
        }
        
        public static class Producer<T> implements Runnable {
            private final BoundedBuffer<T> buffer;
            private final Supplier<T> itemSupplier;
            private final int itemCount;
            
            public Producer(BoundedBuffer<T> buffer, Supplier<T> itemSupplier, int itemCount) {
                this.buffer = buffer;
                this.itemSupplier = itemSupplier;
                this.itemCount = itemCount;
            }
            
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++) {
                        T item = itemSupplier.get();
                        buffer.put(item);
                        Thread.sleep(10); // Simulate work
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                } finally {
                    buffer.stop();
                }
            }
        }
        
        public static class Consumer<T> implements Runnable {
            private final BoundedBuffer<T> buffer;
            private final Consumer<T> itemProcessor;
            
            public Consumer(BoundedBuffer<T> buffer, Consumer<T> itemProcessor) {
                this.buffer = buffer;
                this.itemProcessor = itemProcessor;
            }
            
            @Override
            public void run() {
                try {
                    while (!buffer.isStopped()) {
                        T item = buffer.take();
                        if (item != null) {
                            itemProcessor.accept(item);
                            Thread.sleep(15); // Simulate processing
                        }
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Parallel Graph Algorithms
    public static class ParallelGraphAlgorithms {
        
        // Parallel BFS
        public static class ParallelBFS {
            
            public static Map<Integer, Integer> parallelBFS(List<List<Integer>> graph, int start) {
                Map<Integer, Integer> distances = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
                Queue<Integer> currentLevel = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
                Queue<Integer> nextLevel = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
                
                distances.put(start, 0);
                currentLevel.offer(start);
                
                int distance = 0;
                
                while (!currentLevel.isEmpty()) {
                    distance++;
                    final int currentDistance = distance;
                    
                    // Process current level in parallel
                    List<CompletableFuture<Void>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
                    
                    while (!currentLevel.isEmpty()) {
                        Integer vertex = currentLevel.poll();
                        if (vertex != null) {
                            CompletableFuture<Void> future = CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
                                for (int neighbor : graph.get(vertex)) {
                                    if (distances.putIfAbsent(neighbor, currentDistance) == null) {
                                        nextLevel.offer(neighbor);
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                            futures.add(future);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Wait for all tasks to complete
                    CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0])).join();
                    
                    // Swap levels
                    Queue<Integer> temp = currentLevel;
                    currentLevel = nextLevel;
                    nextLevel = temp;
                }
                
                return distances;
            }
        }
        
        // Parallel Connected Components
        public static class ParallelConnectedComponents {
            
            public static Map<Integer, Integer> findConnectedComponents(List<List<Integer>> graph) {
                int n = graph.size();
                AtomicIntegerArray parent = new AtomicIntegerArray(n);
                
                // Initialize parent array
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    parent.set(i, i);
                }
                
                // Process edges in parallel
                List<CompletableFuture<Void>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    final int vertex = u;
                    CompletableFuture<Void> future = CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
                        for (int v : graph.get(vertex)) {
                            union(parent, vertex, v);
                        }
                    });
                    futures.add(future);
                }
                
                CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0])).join();
                
                // Path compression
                Map<Integer, Integer> components = new HashMap<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    int root = find(parent, i);
                    components.put(i, root);
                }
                
                return components;
            }
            
            private static int find(AtomicIntegerArray parent, int x) {
                int root = x;
                while (parent.get(root) != root) {
                    root = parent.get(root);
                }
                
                // Path compression
                while (parent.get(x) != root) {
                    int next = parent.get(x);
                    parent.compareAndSet(x, next, root);
                    x = next;
                }
                
                return root;
            }
            
            private static void union(AtomicIntegerArray parent, int x, int y) {
                int rootX = find(parent, x);
                int rootY = find(parent, y);
                
                if (rootX != rootY) {
                    parent.compareAndSet(rootX, rootX, rootY);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface Supplier<T> {
        T get();
    }
    
    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface Consumer<T> {
        void accept(T t);
    }
}
```

```java
public class ComputationalGeometryAdvanced {
    
    // Advanced Point and Vector Operations
    public static class GeometryBase {
        
        static class Point {
            double x, y;
            
            Point(double x, double y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
            
            Point add(Point other) {
                return new Point(x + other.x, y + other.y);
            }
            
            Point subtract(Point other) {
                return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y);
            }
            
            Point multiply(double scalar) {
                return new Point(x * scalar, y * scalar);
            }
            
            double dot(Point other) {
                return x * other.x + y * other.y;
            }
            
            double cross(Point other) {
                return x * other.y - y * other.x;
            }
            
            double magnitude() {
                return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
            }
            
            Point normalize() {
                double mag = magnitude();
                return mag > 0 ? new Point(x / mag, y / mag) : new Point(0, 0);
            }
            
            double distanceTo(Point other) {
                return subtract(other).magnitude();
            }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return String.format("(%.2f, %.2f)", x, y);
            }
        }
        
        static class Line {
            Point start, end;
            
            Line(Point start, Point end) {
                this.start = start;
                this.end = end;
            }
            
            Point direction() {
                return end.subtract(start);
            }
            
            double length() {
                return start.distanceTo(end);
            }
            
            Point pointAt(double t) {
                return start.add(direction().multiply(t));
            }
        }
        
        static class Polygon {
            List<Point> vertices;
            
            Polygon(List<Point> vertices) {
                this.vertices = new ArrayList<>(vertices);
            }
            
            double area() {
                double area = 0;
                int n = vertices.size();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    Point curr = vertices.get(i);
                    Point next = vertices.get((i + 1) % n);
                    area += curr.cross(next);
                }
                
                return Math.abs(area) / 2.0;
            }
            
            boolean isConvex() {
                int n = vertices.size();
                if (n < 3) return false;
                
                boolean positive = false, negative = false;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    Point a = vertices.get(i);
                    Point b = vertices.get((i + 1) % n);
                    Point c = vertices.get((i + 2) % n);
                    
                    double cross = b.subtract(a).cross(c.subtract(b));
                    
                    if (cross > 0) positive = true;
                    if (cross < 0) negative = true;
                    
                    if (positive && negative) return false;
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            
            boolean containsPoint(Point point) {
                int n = vertices.size();
                boolean inside = false;
                
                for (int i = 0, j = n - 1; i < n; j = i++) {
                    Point vi = vertices.get(i);
                    Point vj = vertices.get(j);
                    
                    if (((vi.y > point.y) != (vj.y > point.y)) &&
                        (point.x < (vj.x - vi.x) * (point.y - vi.y) / (vj.y - vi.y) + vi.x)) {
                        inside = !inside;
                    }
                }
                
                return inside;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Voronoi Diagram using Fortune's Algorithm
    public static class VoronoiDiagram {
        
        static class Site extends GeometryBase.Point {
            int id;
            
            Site(double x, double y, int id) {
                super(x, y);
                this.id = id;
            }
        }
        
        static class VoronoiEdge {
            GeometryBase.Point start, end;
            Site leftSite, rightSite;
            
            VoronoiEdge(Site leftSite, Site rightSite) {
                this.leftSite = leftSite;
                this.rightSite = rightSite;
            }
        }
        
        static class VoronoiCell {
            Site site;
            List<VoronoiEdge> edges;
            
            VoronoiCell(Site site) {
                this.site = site;
                this.edges = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        // Simplified Voronoi diagram construction
        public static List<VoronoiCell> constructVoronoi(List<Site> sites) {
            List<VoronoiCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (Site site : sites) {
                VoronoiCell cell = new VoronoiCell(site);
                
                // For each pair of sites, create potential edge
                for (Site other : sites) {
                    if (site.id != other.id) {
                        // Perpendicular bisector
                        GeometryBase.Point midpoint = new GeometryBase.Point(
                            (site.x + other.x) / 2, (site.y + other.y) / 2);
                        
                        VoronoiEdge edge = new VoronoiEdge(site, other);
                        // Simplified: add midpoint as both start and end
                        edge.start = edge.end = midpoint;
                        
                        cell.edges.add(edge);
                    }
                }
                
                cells.add(cell);
            }
            
            return cells;
        }
        
        // Delaunay Triangulation (dual of Voronoi)
        public static class DelaunayTriangulation {
            
            static class Triangle {
                Site a, b, c;
                GeometryBase.Point circumcenter;
                double circumradius;
                
                Triangle(Site a, Site b, Site c) {
                    this.a = a;
                    this.b = b;
                    this.c = c;
                    calculateCircumcircle();
                }
                
                private void calculateCircumcircle() {
                    double ax = a.x, ay = a.y;
                    double bx = b.x, by = b.y;
                    double cx = c.x, cy = c.y;
                    
                    double d = 2 * (ax * (by - cy) + bx * (cy - ay) + cx * (ay - by));
                    
                    if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-10) {
                        // Collinear points
                        circumcenter = new GeometryBase.Point(0, 0);
                        circumradius = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    double ux = ((ax * ax + ay * ay) * (by - cy) + 
                                 (bx * bx + by * by) * (cy - ay) + 
                                 (cx * cx + cy * cy) * (ay - by)) / d;
                    
                    double uy = ((ax * ax + ay * ay) * (cx - bx) + 
                                 (bx * bx + by * by) * (ax - cx) + 
                                 (cx * cx + cy * cy) * (bx - ax)) / d;
                    
                    circumcenter = new GeometryBase.Point(ux, uy);
                    circumradius = circumcenter.distanceTo(a);
                }
                
                boolean containsInCircumcircle(Site point) {
                    return circumcenter.distanceTo(point) < circumradius;
                }
            }
            
            public static List<Triangle> delaunayTriangulation(List<Site> sites) {
                if (sites.size() < 3) return new ArrayList<>();
                
                List<Triangle> triangles = new ArrayList<>();
                
                // Create super triangle
                double minX = sites.stream().mapToDouble(s -> s.x).min().orElse(0);
                double maxX = sites.stream().mapToDouble(s -> s.x).max().orElse(0);
                double minY = sites.stream().mapToDouble(s -> s.y).min().orElse(0);
                double maxY = sites.stream().mapToDouble(s -> s.y).max().orElse(0);
                
                double dx = maxX - minX;
                double dy = maxY - minY;
                double deltaMax = Math.max(dx, dy);
                double midx = (minX + maxX) / 2;
                double midy = (minY + maxY) / 2;
                
                Site p1 = new Site(midx - 20 * deltaMax, midy - deltaMax, -1);
                Site p2 = new Site(midx, midy + 20 * deltaMax, -2);
                Site p3 = new Site(midx + 20 * deltaMax, midy - deltaMax, -3);
                
                triangles.add(new Triangle(p1, p2, p3));
                
                // Add sites one by one
                for (Site site : sites) {
                    List<Triangle> badTriangles = new ArrayList<>();
                    
                    // Find triangles whose circumcircle contains the new site
                    for (Triangle triangle : triangles) {
                        if (triangle.containsInCircumcircle(site)) {
                            badTriangles.add(triangle);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Find boundary of polygonal hole
                    List<GeometryBase.Line> polygon = new ArrayList<>();
                    
                    for (Triangle triangle : badTriangles) {
                        addUniqueEdge(polygon, new GeometryBase.Line(triangle.a, triangle.b));
                        addUniqueEdge(polygon, new GeometryBase.Line(triangle.b, triangle.c));
                        addUniqueEdge(polygon, new GeometryBase.Line(triangle.c, triangle.a));
                    }
                    
                    // Remove bad triangles
                    triangles.removeAll(badTriangles);
                    
                    // Retriangulate polygonal hole
                    for (GeometryBase.Line edge : polygon) {
                        triangles.add(new Triangle((Site)edge.start, (Site)edge.end, site));
                    }
                }
                
                // Remove triangles containing super triangle vertices
                triangles.removeIf(triangle -> 
                    triangle.a.id < 0 || triangle.b.id < 0 || triangle.c.id < 0);
                
                return triangles;
            }
            
            private static void addUniqueEdge(List<GeometryBase.Line> edges, GeometryBase.Line edge) {
                // Remove edge if it already exists (not on boundary)
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    GeometryBase.Line existing = edges.get(i);
                    if ((existing.start.equals(edge.start) && existing.end.equals(edge.end)) ||
                        (existing.start.equals(edge.end) && existing.end.equals(edge.start))) {
                        edges.remove(i);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                edges.add(edge);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Polygon Triangulation
    public static class PolygonTriangulation {
        
        // Ear clipping algorithm
        public static List<int[]> triangulatePolygon(List<GeometryBase.Point> polygon) {
            List<int[]> triangles = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> vertices = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < polygon.size(); i++) {
                vertices.add(i);
            }
            
            while (vertices.size() > 3) {
                boolean foundEar = false;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < vertices.size(); i++) {
                    int prev = vertices.get((i - 1 + vertices.size()) % vertices.size());
                    int curr = vertices.get(i);
                    int next = vertices.get((i + 1) % vertices.size());
                    
                    if (isEar(polygon, vertices, prev, curr, next)) {
                        triangles.add(new int[]{prev, curr, next});
                        vertices.remove(i);
                        foundEar = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!foundEar) break; // Prevent infinite loop
            }
            
            if (vertices.size() == 3) {
                triangles.add(new int[]{vertices.get(0), vertices.get(1), vertices.get(2)});
            }
            
            return triangles;
        }
        
        private static boolean isEar(List<GeometryBase.Point> polygon, List<Integer> vertices,
                                   int prev, int curr, int next) {
            GeometryBase.Point a = polygon.get(prev);
            GeometryBase.Point b = polygon.get(curr);
            GeometryBase.Point c = polygon.get(next);
            
            // Check if angle is convex
            if (isReflex(a, b, c)) return false;
            
            // Check if any other vertex is inside triangle
            for (int vertex : vertices) {
                if (vertex != prev && vertex != curr && vertex != next) {
                    GeometryBase.Point p = polygon.get(vertex);
                    if (pointInTriangle(p, a, b, c)) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private static boolean isReflex(GeometryBase.Point a, GeometryBase.Point b, GeometryBase.Point c) {
            return b.subtract(a).cross(c.subtract(b)) <= 0;
        }
        
        private static boolean pointInTriangle(GeometryBase.Point p, GeometryBase.Point a, 
                                             GeometryBase.Point b, GeometryBase.Point c) {
            double w1 = ((b.x - a.x) * (p.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (p.x - a.x)) /
                       ((b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x));
            
            double w2 = (p.y - a.y - w1 * (c.y - a.y)) / (b.y - a.y);
            
            return w1 >= 0 && w2 >= 0 && (w1 + w2) <= 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Range Trees for 2D Range Queries
    public static class RangeTree2D {
        
        static class Node {
            GeometryBase.Point point;
            Node left, right;
            RangeTree1D yTree; // Secondary structure for y-coordinates
            
            Node(GeometryBase.Point point) {
                this.point = point;
            }
        }
        
        static class RangeTree1D {
            static class Node1D {
                double value;
                Node1D left, right;
                List<GeometryBase.Point> points;
                
                Node1D(double value) {
                    this.value = value;
                    this.points = new ArrayList<>();
                }
            }
            
            Node1D root;
            
            public RangeTree1D(List<GeometryBase.Point> points) {
                List<Double> yValues = points.stream()
                    .map(p -> p.y)
                    .sorted()
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
                
                root = buildTree(yValues, points, 0, yValues.size() - 1);
            }
            
            private Node1D buildTree(List<Double> values, List<GeometryBase.Point> points, 
                                   int left, int right) {
                if (left > right) return null;
                
                int mid = (left + right) / 2;
                Node1D node = new Node1D(values.get(mid));
                
                // Add all points with y-coordinate in range
                for (GeometryBase.Point point : points) {
                    if (point.y >= values.get(left) && point.y <= values.get(right)) {
                        node.points.add(point);
                    }
                }
                
                node.left = buildTree(values, points, left, mid - 1);
                node.right = buildTree(values, points, mid + 1, right);
                
                return node;
            }
            
            public List<GeometryBase.Point> rangeQuery(double y1, double y2) {
                List<GeometryBase.Point> result = new ArrayList<>();
                rangeQuery(root, y1, y2, result);
                return result;
            }
            
            private void rangeQuery(Node1D node, double y1, double y2, 
                                  List<GeometryBase.Point> result) {
                if (node == null) return;
                
                if (node.value >= y1 && node.value <= y2) {
                    result.addAll(node.points);
                }
                
                if (y1 <= node.value) {
                    rangeQuery(node.left, y1, y2, result);
                }
                
                if (y2 >= node.value) {
                    rangeQuery(node.right, y1, y2, result);
                }
            }
        }
        
        private Node root;
        
        public RangeTree2D(List<GeometryBase.Point> points) {
            List<GeometryBase.Point> sortedPoints = points.stream()
                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(p -> p.x))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            
            root = buildTree(sortedPoints, 0, sortedPoints.size() - 1);
        }
        
        private Node buildTree(List<GeometryBase.Point> points, int left, int right) {
            if (left > right) return null;
            
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            Node node = new Node(points.get(mid));
            
            List<GeometryBase.Point> leftPoints = points.subList(left, mid);
            List<GeometryBase.Point> rightPoints = points.subList(mid + 1, right + 1);
            
            List<GeometryBase.Point> allPoints = new ArrayList<>();
            allPoints.addAll(leftPoints);
            allPoints.add(points.get(mid));
            allPoints.addAll(rightPoints);
            
            node.yTree = new RangeTree1D(allPoints);
            node.left = buildTree(points, left, mid - 1);
            node.right = buildTree(points, mid + 1, right);
            
            return node;
        }
        
        public List<GeometryBase.Point> rangeQuery(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2) {
            List<GeometryBase.Point> result = new ArrayList<>();
            rangeQuery(root, x1, y1, x2, y2, result);
            return result;
        }
        
        private void rangeQuery(Node node, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2,
                              List<GeometryBase.Point> result) {
            if (node == null) return;
            
            if (node.point.x >= x1 && node.point.x <= x2) {
                List<GeometryBase.Point> yResults = node.yTree.rangeQuery(y1, y2);
                for (GeometryBase.Point point : yResults) {
                    if (point.x >= x1 && point.x <= x2) {
                        result.add(point);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (x1 <= node.point.x) {
                rangeQuery(node.left, x1, y1, x2, y2, result);
            }
            
            if (x2 >= node.point.x) {
                rangeQuery(node.right, x1, y1, x2, y2, result);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log² n) for range queries, O(n log n) for construction, **Space**: O(n log n)
