### 181. Quantum Computing Algorithms
**Problem**: Quantum algorithms and quantum computing simulation  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class QuantumComputingAlgorithms {
    
    // Quantum State Representation
    public static class QuantumState {
        private Complex[] amplitudes;
        private int numQubits;
        
        public QuantumState(int numQubits) {
            this.numQubits = numQubits;
            this.amplitudes = new Complex[1 << numQubits];
            // Initialize |0...0⟩ state
            amplitudes[0] = new Complex(1.0, 0.0);
            for (int i = 1; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                amplitudes[i] = new Complex(0.0, 0.0);
            }
        }
        
        public QuantumState(Complex[] amplitudes) {
            this.amplitudes = amplitudes.clone();
            this.numQubits = (int) (Math.log(amplitudes.length) / Math.log(2));
        }
        
        public Complex getAmplitude(int state) {
            return amplitudes[state];
        }
        
        public void setAmplitude(int state, Complex amplitude) {
            amplitudes[state] = amplitude;
        }
        
        public double getProbability(int state) {
            return amplitudes[state].magnitudeSquared();
        }
        
        public QuantumState tensorProduct(QuantumState other) {
            Complex[] newAmplitudes = new Complex[amplitudes.length * other.amplitudes.length];
            int index = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < other.amplitudes.length; j++) {
                    newAmplitudes[index++] = amplitudes[i].multiply(other.amplitudes[j]);
                }
            }
            
            return new QuantumState(newAmplitudes);
        }
        
        public void normalize() {
            double norm = 0;
            for (Complex amplitude : amplitudes) {
                norm += amplitude.magnitudeSquared();
            }
            norm = Math.sqrt(norm);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                amplitudes[i] = amplitudes[i].divide(norm);
            }
        }
        
        public int measure() {
            double random = Math.random();
            double cumulative = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < amplitudes.length; i++) {
                cumulative += getProbability(i);
                if (random <= cumulative) {
                    // Collapse to measured state
                    for (int j = 0; j < amplitudes.length; j++) {
                        amplitudes[j] = (j == i) ? new Complex(1.0, 0.0) : new Complex(0.0, 0.0);
                    }
                    return i;
                }
            }
            
            return amplitudes.length - 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Complex Number Implementation
    public static class Complex {
        private final double real, imaginary;
        
        public Complex(double real, double imaginary) {
            this.real = real;
            this.imaginary = imaginary;
        }
        
        public Complex add(Complex other) {
            return new Complex(real + other.real, imaginary + other.imaginary);
        }
        
        public Complex multiply(Complex other) {
            return new Complex(
                real * other.real - imaginary * other.imaginary,
                real * other.imaginary + imaginary * other.real
            );
        }
        
        public Complex divide(double scalar) {
            return new Complex(real / scalar, imaginary / scalar);
        }
        
        public double magnitudeSquared() {
            return real * real + imaginary * imaginary;
        }
        
        public Complex conjugate() {
            return new Complex(real, -imaginary);
        }
    }
    
    // Quantum Gates
    public static class QuantumGates {
        
        // Pauli-X Gate (NOT gate)
        public static QuantumState pauliX(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            int numStates = 1 << state.numQubits;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                int flipped = i ^ (1 << qubit);
                Complex temp = result.amplitudes[i];
                result.amplitudes[i] = result.amplitudes[flipped];
                result.amplitudes[flipped] = temp;
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Hadamard Gate
        public static QuantumState hadamard(QuantumState state, int qubit) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.numQubits);
            int numStates = 1 << state.numQubits;
            Complex sqrt2inv = new Complex(1.0 / Math.sqrt(2), 0);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                int bit = (i >> qubit) & 1;
                int flipped = i ^ (1 << qubit);
                
                if (bit == 0) {
                    result.amplitudes[i] = state.amplitudes[i].add(state.amplitudes[flipped]).multiply(sqrt2inv);
                } else {
                    result.amplitudes[i] = state.amplitudes[flipped].add(state.amplitudes[i].multiply(new Complex(-1, 0))).multiply(sqrt2inv);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Controlled-NOT Gate
        public static QuantumState cnot(QuantumState state, int control, int target) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            int numStates = 1 << state.numQubits;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                if ((i >> control) & 1) { // Control bit is 1
                    int flipped = i ^ (1 << target);
                    Complex temp = result.amplitudes[i];
                    result.amplitudes[i] = result.amplitudes[flipped];
                    result.amplitudes[flipped] = temp;
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // Phase Gate
        public static QuantumState phase(QuantumState state, int qubit, double theta) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            int numStates = 1 << state.numQubits;
            Complex phase = new Complex(Math.cos(theta), Math.sin(theta));
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                if ((i >> qubit) & 1) { // Apply phase to |1⟩ component
                    result.amplitudes[i] = result.amplitudes[i].multiply(phase);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    // Quantum Fourier Transform
    public static class QuantumFourierTransform {
        
        public static QuantumState qft(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.numQubits;
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                // Apply Hadamard to qubit i
                result = QuantumGates.hadamard(result, i);
                
                // Apply controlled phase gates
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    double theta = Math.PI / (1 << (j - i));
                    result = controlledPhase(result, j, i, theta);
                }
            }
            
            // Reverse qubit order
            return reverseQubits(result);
        }
        
        public static QuantumState inverseQft(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.numQubits;
            QuantumState result = reverseQubits(state);
            
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                // Apply controlled phase gates (inverse)
                for (int j = n - 1; j > i; j--) {
                    double theta = -Math.PI / (1 << (j - i));
                    result = controlledPhase(result, j, i, theta);
                }
                
                // Apply Hadamard to qubit i
                result = QuantumGates.hadamard(result, i);
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static QuantumState controlledPhase(QuantumState state, int control, int target, double theta) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            int numStates = 1 << state.numQubits;
            Complex phase = new Complex(Math.cos(theta), Math.sin(theta));
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                if (((i >> control) & 1) && ((i >> target) & 1)) {
                    result.amplitudes[i] = result.amplitudes[i].multiply(phase);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static QuantumState reverseQubits(QuantumState state) {
            int n = state.numQubits;
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(n);
            int numStates = 1 << n;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < numStates; i++) {
                int reversed = 0;
                for (int bit = 0; bit < n; bit++) {
                    if ((i >> bit) & 1) {
                        reversed |= (1 << (n - 1 - bit));
                    }
                }
                result.amplitudes[reversed] = state.amplitudes[i];
            }
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    // Grover's Search Algorithm
    public static class GroversAlgorithm {
        
        public static int groversSearch(int[] database, int target) {
            int n = (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(database.length) / Math.log(2));
            QuantumState state = createSuperposition(n);
            
            int iterations = (int) Math.round(Math.PI * Math.sqrt(database.length) / 4);
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
                // Oracle: mark target states
                state = oracle(state, database, target);
                
                // Diffusion operator (amplitude amplification)
                state = diffusionOperator(state);
            }
            
            return state.measure();
        }
        
        private static QuantumState createSuperposition(int numQubits) {
            QuantumState state = new QuantumState(numQubits);
            
            // Apply Hadamard to all qubits
            for (int i = 0; i < numQubits; i++) {
                state = QuantumGates.hadamard(state, i);
            }
            
            return state;
        }
        
        private static QuantumState oracle(QuantumState state, int[] database, int target) {
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.amplitudes);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < database.length && i < result.amplitudes.length; i++) {
                if (database[i] == target) {
                    // Flip phase of target states
                    result.amplitudes[i] = result.amplitudes[i].multiply(new Complex(-1, 0));
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static QuantumState diffusionOperator(QuantumState state) {
            // Reflect about average amplitude
            Complex sum = new Complex(0, 0);
            for (Complex amplitude : state.amplitudes) {
                sum = sum.add(amplitude);
            }
            
            Complex average = sum.divide(state.amplitudes.length);
            QuantumState result = new QuantumState(state.numQubits);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < state.amplitudes.length; i++) {
                result.amplitudes[i] = average.multiply(new Complex(2, 0)).add(
                    state.amplitudes[i].multiply(new Complex(-1, 0))
                );
            }
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    // Shor's Factoring Algorithm (Simplified)
    public static class ShorsAlgorithm {
        
        public static List<Integer> factor(int N) {
            if (N <= 1) return Arrays.asList(N);
            if (isPrime(N)) return Arrays.asList(N);
            
            // Try classical methods first for small numbers
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (N % i == 0) {
                    List<Integer> factors = new ArrayList<>();
                    factors.addAll(factor(i));
                    factors.addAll(factor(N / i));
                    return factors;
                }
            }
            
            // Quantum period finding (simulated)
            int a = findCoprime(N);
            int period = quantumPeriodFinding(a, N);
            
            if (period > 0 && period % 2 == 0) {
                long factor1 = gcd((long)Math.pow(a, period / 2) - 1, N);
                long factor2 = gcd((long)Math.pow(a, period / 2) + 1, N);
                
                if (factor1 > 1 && factor1 < N) {
                    List<Integer> factors = new ArrayList<>();
                    factors.addAll(factor((int)factor1));
                    factors.addAll(factor((int)(N / factor1)));
                    return factors;
                }
                
                if (factor2 > 1 && factor2 < N) {
                    List<Integer> factors = new ArrayList<>();
                    factors.addAll(factor((int)factor2));
                    factors.addAll(factor((int)(N / factor2)));
                    return factors;
                }
            }
            
            return Arrays.asList(N);
        }
        
        private static int quantumPeriodFinding(int a, int N) {
            // Simplified simulation of quantum period finding
            // In a real quantum computer, this would use QFT and superposition
            
            for (int r = 1; r < N; r++) {
                if (modularExponentiation(a, r, N) == 1) {
                    return r;
                }
            }
            
            return 0;
        }
        
        private static long modularExponentiation(long base, long exp, long mod) {
            long result = 1;
            base %= mod;
            
            while (exp > 0) {
                if (exp % 2 == 1) {
                    result = (result * base) % mod;
                }
                exp >>= 1;
                base = (base * base) % mod;
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static int findCoprime(int N) {
            Random random = new Random();
            
            for (int attempts = 0; attempts < 100; attempts++) {
                int a = 2 + random.nextInt(N - 2);
                if (gcd(a, N) == 1) {
                    return a;
                }
            }
            
            return 2; // Fallback
        }
        
        private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
            while (b != 0) {
                long temp = b;
                b = a % b;
                a = temp;
            }
            return a;
        }
        
        private static boolean isPrime(int n) {
            if (n < 2) return false;
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
                if (n % i == 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(√N) for Grover's search, O((log N)³) for Shor's algorithm, **Space**: O(2^n) for quantum states

### 182. Advanced Machine Learning Algorithms
**Problem**: Core machine learning algorithms and neural network implementations  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class AdvancedMachineLearningAlgorithms {
    
    // Neural Network Implementation
    public static class NeuralNetwork {
        private List<Layer> layers;
        private double learningRate;
        
        public NeuralNetwork(double learningRate) {
            this.layers = new ArrayList<>();
            this.learningRate = learningRate;
        }
        
        public void addLayer(int neurons, int inputSize, ActivationFunction activation) {
            layers.add(new Layer(neurons, inputSize, activation));
        }
        
        public double[] forward(double[] input) {
            double[] output = input;
            
            for (Layer layer : layers) {
                output = layer.forward(output);
            }
            
            return output;
        }
        
        public void train(double[][] inputs, double[][] targets, int epochs) {
            for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
                for (int i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
                    // Forward pass
                    double[] prediction = forward(inputs[i]);
                    
                    // Backward pass
                    backward(prediction, targets[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        
        private void backward(double[] prediction, double[] target) {
            // Calculate output layer error
            double[] error = new double[prediction.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < error.length; i++) {
                error[i] = target[i] - prediction[i];
            }
            
            // Backpropagate error
            for (int i = layers.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                error = layers.get(i).backward(error, learningRate);
            }
        }
        
        static class Layer {
            private double[][] weights;
            private double[] biases;
            private double[] lastInput;
            private double[] lastOutput;
            private ActivationFunction activation;
            
            public Layer(int neurons, int inputSize, ActivationFunction activation) {
                this.weights = new double[neurons][inputSize];
                this.biases = new double[neurons];
                this.activation = activation;
                
                // Initialize weights randomly
                Random random = new Random();
                for (int i = 0; i < neurons; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < inputSize; j++) {
                        weights[i][j] = random.nextGaussian() * 0.1;
                    }
                    biases[i] = random.nextGaussian() * 0.1;
                }
            }
            
            public double[] forward(double[] input) {
                lastInput = input.clone();
                double[] output = new double[weights.length];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
                    double sum = biases[i];
                    for (int j = 0; j < input.length; j++) {
                        sum += weights[i][j] * input[j];
                    }
                    output[i] = activation.activate(sum);
                }
                
                lastOutput = output.clone();
                return output;
            }
            
            public double[] backward(double[] outputError, double learningRate) {
                double[] inputError = new double[lastInput.length];
                
                for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
                    double gradient = outputError[i] * activation.derivative(lastOutput[i]);
                    
                    // Update weights and biases
                    for (int j = 0; j < weights[i].length; j++) {
                        weights[i][j] += learningRate * gradient * lastInput[j];
                        inputError[j] += weights[i][j] * gradient;
                    }
                    biases[i] += learningRate * gradient;
                }
                
                return inputError;
            }
        }
        
        interface ActivationFunction {
            double activate(double x);
            double derivative(double x);
        }
        
        public static class SigmoidActivation implements ActivationFunction {
            @Override
            public double activate(double x) {
                return 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-x));
            }
            
            @Override
            public double derivative(double x) {
                return x * (1 - x);
            }
        }
        
        public static class TanhActivation implements ActivationFunction {
            @Override
            public double activate(double x) {
                return Math.tanh(x);
            }
            
            @Override
            public double derivative(double x) {
                return 1 - x * x;
            }
        }
        
        public static class ReLUActivation implements ActivationFunction {
            @Override
            public double activate(double x) {
                return Math.max(0, x);
            }
            
            @Override
            public double derivative(double x) {
                return x > 0 ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Support Vector Machine
    public static class SupportVectorMachine {
        private double[][] supportVectors;
        private double[] alphas;
        private double[] labels;
        private double bias;
        private KernelFunction kernel;
        
        public SupportVectorMachine(KernelFunction kernel) {
            this.kernel = kernel;
        }
        
        public void train(double[][] X, double[] y, double C, double tolerance, int maxIterations) {
            int n = X.length;
            alphas = new double[n];
            bias = 0;
            
            // Simplified SMO algorithm
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                boolean changed = false;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    double Ei = decision(X[i]) - y[i];
                    
                    if ((y[i] * Ei < -tolerance && alphas[i] < C) || 
                        (y[i] * Ei > tolerance && alphas[i] > 0)) {
                        
                        // Select second alpha
                        int j = selectSecondAlpha(i, n);
                        double Ej = decision(X[j]) - y[j];
                        
                        double alphaIOld = alphas[i];
                        double alphaJOld = alphas[j];
                        
                        // Calculate bounds
                        double L, H;
                        if (y[i] != y[j]) {
                            L = Math.max(0, alphas[j] - alphas[i]);
                            H = Math.min(C, C + alphas[j] - alphas[i]);
                        } else {
                            L = Math.max(0, alphas[i] + alphas[j] - C);
                            H = Math.min(C, alphas[i] + alphas[j]);
                        }
                        
                        if (L == H) continue;
                        
                        // Calculate eta
                        double eta = 2 * kernel.compute(X[i], X[j]) - 
                                   kernel.compute(X[i], X[i]) - 
                                   kernel.compute(X[j], X[j]);
                        
                        if (eta >= 0) continue;
                        
                        // Update alphas
                        alphas[j] = alphas[j] - (y[j] * (Ei - Ej)) / eta;
                        alphas[j] = Math.max(L, Math.min(H, alphas[j]));
                        
                        if (Math.abs(alphas[j] - alphaJOld) < 1e-5) continue;
                        
                        alphas[i] = alphas[i] + y[i] * y[j] * (alphaJOld - alphas[j]);
                        
                        // Update bias
                        double b1 = bias - Ei - y[i] * (alphas[i] - alphaIOld) * kernel.compute(X[i], X[i]) -
                                   y[j] * (alphas[j] - alphaJOld) * kernel.compute(X[i], X[j]);
                        
                        double b2 = bias - Ej - y[i] * (alphas[i] - alphaIOld) * kernel.compute(X[i], X[j]) -
                                   y[j] * (alphas[j] - alphaJOld) * kernel.compute(X[j], X[j]);
                        
                        if (0 < alphas[i] && alphas[i] < C) {
                            bias = b1;
                        } else if (0 < alphas[j] && alphas[j] < C) {
                            bias = b2;
                        } else {
                            bias = (b1 + b2) / 2;
                        }
                        
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!changed) break;
            }
            
            // Extract support vectors
            List<double[]> svList = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> alphaList = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> labelList = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (alphas[i] > 0) {
                    svList.add(X[i]);
                    alphaList.add(alphas[i]);
                    labelList.add(y[i]);
                }
            }
            
            supportVectors = svList.toArray(new double[0][]);
            alphas = alphaList.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).toArray();
            labels = labelList.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).toArray();
        }
        
        private double decision(double[] x) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < supportVectors.length; i++) {
                sum += alphas[i] * labels[i] * kernel.compute(supportVectors[i], x);
            }
            return sum + bias;
        }
        
        public double predict(double[] x) {
            return Math.signum(decision(x));
        }
        
        private int selectSecondAlpha(int i, int n) {
            return (i + 1) % n; // Simplified selection
        }
        
        interface KernelFunction {
            double compute(double[] x1, double[] x2);
        }
        
        public static class LinearKernel implements KernelFunction {
            @Override
            public double compute(double[] x1, double[] x2) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < x1.length; i++) {
                    sum += x1[i] * x2[i];
                }
                return sum;
            }
        }
        
        public static class RBFKernel implements KernelFunction {
            private double gamma;
            
            public RBFKernel(double gamma) {
                this.gamma = gamma;
            }
            
            @Override
            public double compute(double[] x1, double[] x2) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < x1.length; i++) {
                    double diff = x1[i] - x2[i];
                    sum += diff * diff;
                }
                return Math.exp(-gamma * sum);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // K-Means Clustering
    public static class KMeansClustering {
        private double[][] centroids;
        private int k;
        
        public KMeansClustering(int k) {
            this.k = k;
        }
        
        public int[] cluster(double[][] data, int maxIterations) {
            int n = data.length;
            int dimensions = data[0].length;
            
            // Initialize centroids randomly
            centroids = new double[k][dimensions];
            Random random = new Random();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                int randomIndex = random.nextInt(n);
                System.arraycopy(data[randomIndex], 0, centroids[i], 0, dimensions);
            }
            
            int[] assignments = new int[n];
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                boolean changed = false;
                
                // Assign points to nearest centroid
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    int nearestCentroid = 0;
                    double minDistance = distance(data[i], centroids[0]);
                    
                    for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                        double dist = distance(data[i], centroids[j]);
                        if (dist < minDistance) {
                            minDistance = dist;
                            nearestCentroid = j;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (assignments[i] != nearestCentroid) {
                        assignments[i] = nearestCentroid;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!changed) break;
                
                // Update centroids
                updateCentroids(data, assignments);
            }
            
            return assignments;
        }
        
        private void updateCentroids(double[][] data, int[] assignments) {
            int[] counts = new int[k];
            
            // Reset centroids
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(centroids[i], 0);
            }
            
            // Sum points assigned to each centroid
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                int cluster = assignments[i];
                counts[cluster]++;
                
                for (int j = 0; j < data[i].length; j++) {
                    centroids[cluster][j] += data[i][j];
                }
            }
            
            // Average to get new centroids
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                if (counts[i] > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < centroids[i].length; j++) {
                        centroids[i][j] /= counts[i];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        private double distance(double[] a, double[] b) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                double diff = a[i] - b[i];
                sum += diff * diff;
            }
            return Math.sqrt(sum);
        }
        
        public double[][] getCentroids() {
            return centroids;
        }
    }
    
    // Decision Tree
    public static class DecisionTree {
        
        static class TreeNode {
            int feature;
            double threshold;
            double value; // For leaf nodes
            TreeNode left, right;
            boolean isLeaf;
            
            TreeNode() {
                this.isLeaf = false;
            }
            
            TreeNode(double value) {
                this.value = value;
                this.isLeaf = true;
            }
        }
        
        private TreeNode root;
        
        public void train(double[][] X, double[] y, int maxDepth, int minSamples) {
            root = buildTree(X, y, 0, maxDepth, minSamples);
        }
        
        private TreeNode buildTree(double[][] X, double[] y, int depth, int maxDepth, int minSamples) {
            // Base cases
            if (depth >= maxDepth || X.length <= minSamples || isPure(y)) {
                return new TreeNode(average(y));
            }
            
            // Find best split
            Split bestSplit = findBestSplit(X, y);
            
            if (bestSplit == null) {
                return new TreeNode(average(y));
            }
            
            // Split data
            List<Integer> leftIndices = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> rightIndices = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < X.length; i++) {
                if (X[i][bestSplit.feature] <= bestSplit.threshold) {
                    leftIndices.add(i);
                } else {
                    rightIndices.add(i);
                }
            }
            
            double[][] leftX = extractRows(X, leftIndices);
            double[] leftY = extractElements(y, leftIndices);
            double[][] rightX = extractRows(X, rightIndices);
            double[] rightY = extractElements(y, rightIndices);
            
            TreeNode node = new TreeNode();
            node.feature = bestSplit.feature;
            node.threshold = bestSplit.threshold;
            node.left = buildTree(leftX, leftY, depth + 1, maxDepth, minSamples);
            node.right = buildTree(rightX, rightY, depth + 1, maxDepth, minSamples);
            
            return node;
        }
        
        private Split findBestSplit(double[][] X, double[] y) {
            Split bestSplit = null;
            double bestGain = 0;
            
            for (int feature = 0; feature < X[0].length; feature++) {
                Set<Double> uniqueValues = new HashSet<>();
                for (double[] x : X) {
                    uniqueValues.add(x[feature]);
                }
                
                for (double threshold : uniqueValues) {
                    double gain = calculateInformationGain(X, y, feature, threshold);
                    
                    if (gain > bestGain) {
                        bestGain = gain;
                        bestSplit = new Split(feature, threshold);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return bestSplit;
        }
        
        private double calculateInformationGain(double[][] X, double[] y, int feature, double threshold) {
            double parentEntropy = calculateEntropy(y);
            
            List<Double> leftY = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Double> rightY = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < X.length; i++) {
                if (X[i][feature] <= threshold) {
                    leftY.add(y[i]);
                } else {
                    rightY.add(y[i]);
                }
            }
            
            if (leftY.isEmpty() || rightY.isEmpty()) {
                return 0;
            }
            
            double leftWeight = (double) leftY.size() / y.length;
            double rightWeight = (double) rightY.size() / y.length;
            
            double leftEntropy = calculateEntropy(leftY.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).toArray());
            double rightEntropy = calculateEntropy(rightY.stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).toArray());
            
            return parentEntropy - (leftWeight * leftEntropy + rightWeight * rightEntropy);
        }
        
        private double calculateEntropy(double[] y) {
            Map<Double, Integer> counts = new HashMap<>();
            
            for (double value : y) {
                counts.put(value, counts.getOrDefault(value, 0) + 1);
            }
            
            double entropy = 0;
            for (int count : counts.values()) {
                double probability = (double) count / y.length;
                if (probability > 0) {
                    entropy -= probability * Math.log(probability) / Math.log(2);
                }
            }
            
            return entropy;
        }
        
        public double predict(double[] x) {
            return predict(root, x);
        }
        
        private double predict(TreeNode node, double[] x) {
            if (node.isLeaf) {
                return node.value;
            }
            
            if (x[node.feature] <= node.threshold) {
                return predict(node.left, x);
            } else {
                return predict(node.right, x);
            }
        }
        
        private boolean isPure(double[] y) {
            double first = y[0];
            for (double value : y) {
                if (value != first) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        
        private double average(double[] y) {
            return Arrays.stream(y).average().orElse(0);
        }
        
        private double[][] extractRows(double[][] X, List<Integer> indices) {
            double[][] result = new double[indices.size()][];
            for (int i = 0; i < indices.size(); i++) {
                result[i] = X[indices.get(i)];
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        private double[] extractElements(double[] y, List<Integer> indices) {
            double[] result = new double[indices.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < indices.size(); i++) {
                result[i] = y[indices.get(i)];
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        static class Split {
            int feature;
            double threshold;
            
            Split(int feature, double threshold) {
                this.feature = feature;
                this.threshold = threshold;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class BlockchainCryptocurrencyAlgorithms {
    
    // Blockchain Implementation
    public static class SimpleBlockchain {
```
