```java
    // Proof of Work Consensus
    public static class ProofOfWork {
        
        static class MiningResult {
            private String hash;
            private int nonce;
            private long timestamp;
            private boolean success;
            
            public MiningResult(String hash, int nonce, long timestamp, boolean success) {
                this.hash = hash;
                this.nonce = nonce;
                this.timestamp = timestamp;
                this.success = success;
            }
            
            // Getters
            public String getHash() { return hash; }
            public int getNonce() { return nonce; }
            public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
            public boolean isSuccess() { return success; }
        }
        
        public static MiningResult mine(String data, String previousHash, int difficulty, long maxAttempts) {
            String target = new String(new char[difficulty]).replace('\0', '0');
            long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            
            for (int nonce = 0; nonce < maxAttempts; nonce++) {
                long timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
                String hash = SHA256Hash.hash(previousHash + timestamp + nonce + data);
                
                if (hash.substring(0, difficulty).equals(target)) {
                    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    System.out.println("Mining successful! Time: " + (endTime - startTime) + "ms");
                    return new MiningResult(hash, nonce, timestamp, true);
                }
                
                // Check timeout every 10000 attempts
                if (nonce % 10000 == 0 && System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime > 30000) {
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            return new MiningResult("", 0, 0, false);
        }
        
        public static boolean verifyProofOfWork(String hash, int difficulty) {
            String target = new String(new char[difficulty]).replace('\0', '0');
            return hash.substring(0, difficulty).equals(target);
        }
        
        public static double calculateHashRate(int attempts, long timeMs) {
            return (double) attempts / (timeMs / 1000.0); // Hashes per second
        }
    }
    
    // Merkle Tree Implementation
    public static class MerkleTree {
        
        static class MerkleNode {
            private String hash;
            private MerkleNode left;
            private MerkleNode right;
            
            public MerkleNode(String hash) {
                this.hash = hash;
            }
            
            public MerkleNode(MerkleNode left, MerkleNode right) {
                this.left = left;
                this.right = right;
                this.hash = SHA256Hash.hash(left.hash + right.hash);
            }
            
            public String getHash() { return hash; }
            public MerkleNode getLeft() { return left; }
            public MerkleNode getRight() { return right; }
            public boolean isLeaf() { return left == null && right == null; }
        }
        
        private MerkleNode root;
        private List<String> transactions;
        
        public MerkleTree(List<String> transactions) {
            this.transactions = new ArrayList<>(transactions);
            this.root = buildTree(transactions);
        }
        
        private MerkleNode buildTree(List<String> data) {
            if (data.isEmpty()) {
                return new MerkleNode(SHA256Hash.hash(""));
            }
            
            // Hash all transactions
            List<MerkleNode> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String transaction : data) {
                nodes.add(new MerkleNode(SHA256Hash.hash(transaction)));
            }
            
            // Build tree bottom-up
            while (nodes.size() > 1) {
                List<MerkleNode> nextLevel = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i += 2) {
                    MerkleNode left = nodes.get(i);
                    MerkleNode right = (i + 1 < nodes.size()) ? nodes.get(i + 1) : left;
                    
                    nextLevel.add(new MerkleNode(left, right));
                }
                
                nodes = nextLevel;
            }
            
            return nodes.get(0);
        }
        
        public String getRootHash() {
            return root != null ? root.getHash() : "";
        }
        
        public List<String> getMerkleProof(String transaction) {
            int index = transactions.indexOf(transaction);
            if (index == -1) {
                return new ArrayList<>();
            }
            
            List<String> proof = new ArrayList<>();
            getMerkleProofRecursive(root, index, transactions.size(), proof);
            return proof;
        }
        
        private void getMerkleProofRecursive(MerkleNode node, int index, int totalLeaves, List<String> proof) {
            if (node.isLeaf()) {
                return;
            }
            
            int leftSize = getLeftSubtreeSize(totalLeaves);
            
            if (index < leftSize) {
                // Transaction is in left subtree, add right sibling to proof
                proof.add(node.getRight().getHash());
                getMerkleProofRecursive(node.getLeft(), index, leftSize, proof);
            } else {
                // Transaction is in right subtree, add left sibling to proof
                proof.add(node.getLeft().getHash());
                getMerkleProofRecursive(node.getRight(), index - leftSize, totalLeaves - leftSize, proof);
            }
        }
        
        private int getLeftSubtreeSize(int totalSize) {
            if (totalSize <= 1) return totalSize;
            
            int height = (int) Math.ceil(Math.log(totalSize) / Math.log(2));
            int maxSize = 1 << (height - 1);
            
            return Math.min(maxSize, totalSize - maxSize / 2);
        }
        
        public static boolean verifyMerkleProof(String transaction, String rootHash, List<String> proof) {
            String currentHash = SHA256Hash.hash(transaction);
            
            for (String siblingHash : proof) {
                // Try both left and right combinations
                String leftHash = SHA256Hash.hash(currentHash + siblingHash);
                String rightHash = SHA256Hash.hash(siblingHash + currentHash);
                
                // Use lexicographically smaller combination for consistency
                currentHash = currentHash.compareTo(siblingHash) < 0 ? leftHash : rightHash;
            }
            
            return currentHash.equals(rootHash);
        }
    }
    
    // Digital Signature Implementation
    public static class DigitalSignature {
        
        static class KeyPair {
            private final BigInteger privateKey;
            private final ECPoint publicKey;
            
            public KeyPair(BigInteger privateKey, ECPoint publicKey) {
                this.privateKey = privateKey;
                this.publicKey = publicKey;
            }
            
            public BigInteger getPrivateKey() { return privateKey; }
            public ECPoint getPublicKey() { return publicKey; }
        }
        
        static class ECPoint {
            private final BigInteger x;
            private final BigInteger y;
            
            public ECPoint(BigInteger x, BigInteger y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
            
            public BigInteger getX() { return x; }
            public BigInteger getY() { return y; }
            
            @Override
            public String toString() {
                return "(" + x + ", " + y + ")";
            }
        }
        
        static class Signature {
            private final BigInteger r;
            private final BigInteger s;
            
            public Signature(BigInteger r, BigInteger s) {
                this.r = r;
                this.s = s;
            }
            
            public BigInteger getR() { return r; }
            public BigInteger getS() { return s; }
        }
        
        // Simplified ECDSA (using small prime for demonstration)
        private static final BigInteger P = new BigInteger("23"); // Prime modulus
        private static final BigInteger N = new BigInteger("23"); // Order of base point
        private static final ECPoint G = new ECPoint(BigInteger.valueOf(5), BigInteger.valueOf(7)); // Base point
        
        public static KeyPair generateKeyPair() {
            Random random = new Random();
            BigInteger privateKey = new BigInteger(4, random).mod(N.subtract(BigInteger.ONE)).add(BigInteger.ONE);
            ECPoint publicKey = scalarMultiply(G, privateKey);
            
            return new KeyPair(privateKey, publicKey);
        }
        
        public static Signature sign(String message, BigInteger privateKey) {
            byte[] messageBytes = message.getBytes();
            BigInteger messageHash = new BigInteger(1, messageBytes).mod(N);
            
            Random random = new Random();
            BigInteger k = new BigInteger(4, random).mod(N.subtract(BigInteger.ONE)).add(BigInteger.ONE);
            
            ECPoint kG = scalarMultiply(G, k);
            BigInteger r = kG.getX().mod(N);
            
            BigInteger kInverse = modInverse(k, N);
            BigInteger s = kInverse.multiply(messageHash.add(r.multiply(privateKey))).mod(N);
            
            return new Signature(r, s);
        }
        
        public static boolean verify(String message, Signature signature, ECPoint publicKey) {
            byte[] messageBytes = message.getBytes();
            BigInteger messageHash = new BigInteger(1, messageBytes).mod(N);
            
            BigInteger r = signature.getR();
            BigInteger s = signature.getS();
            
            if (r.compareTo(BigInteger.ONE) < 0 || r.compareTo(N) >= 0) return false;
            if (s.compareTo(BigInteger.ONE) < 0 || s.compareTo(N) >= 0) return false;
            
            BigInteger sInverse = modInverse(s, N);
            BigInteger u1 = messageHash.multiply(sInverse).mod(N);
            BigInteger u2 = r.multiply(sInverse).mod(N);
            
            ECPoint point1 = scalarMultiply(G, u1);
            ECPoint point2 = scalarMultiply(publicKey, u2);
            ECPoint result = pointAdd(point1, point2);
            
            return result.getX().mod(N).equals(r);
        }
        
        private static ECPoint scalarMultiply(ECPoint point, BigInteger scalar) {
            if (scalar.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) {
                return null; // Point at infinity
            }
            
            ECPoint result = point;
            ECPoint addend = point;
            
            for (int i = 1; i < scalar.bitLength(); i++) {
                addend = pointDouble(addend);
                if (scalar.testBit(i)) {
                    result = pointAdd(result, addend);
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private static ECPoint pointAdd(ECPoint p1, ECPoint p2) {
            if (p1 == null) return p2;
            if (p2 == null) return p1;
            
            if (p1.getX().equals(p2.getX())) {
                if (p1.getY().equals(p2.getY())) {
                    return pointDouble(p1);
                } else {
                    return null; // Point at infinity
                }
            }
            
            BigInteger slope = p2.getY().subtract(p1.getY())
                .multiply(modInverse(p2.getX().subtract(p1.getX()), P)).mod(P);
            
            BigInteger x3 = slope.multiply(slope).subtract(p1.getX()).subtract(p2.getX()).mod(P);
            BigInteger y3 = slope.multiply(p1.getX().subtract(x3)).subtract(p1.getY()).mod(P);
            
            return new ECPoint(x3, y3);
        }
        
        private static ECPoint pointDouble(ECPoint point) {
            BigInteger slope = point.getX().multiply(point.getX()).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(3))
                .multiply(modInverse(point.getY().multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2)), P)).mod(P);
            
            BigInteger x3 = slope.multiply(slope).subtract(point.getX().multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(2))).mod(P);
            BigInteger y3 = slope.multiply(point.getX().subtract(x3)).subtract(point.getY()).mod(P);
            
            return new ECPoint(x3, y3);
        }
        
        private static BigInteger modInverse(BigInteger a, BigInteger m) {
            return a.modPow(m.subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(2)), m);
        }
    }
    
    // Proof of Stake Consensus (Simplified)
    public static class ProofOfStake {
        
        static class Validator {
            private String address;
            private BigInteger stake;
            private double reputation;
            
            public Validator(String address, BigInteger stake) {
                this.address = address;
                this.stake = stake;
                this.reputation = 1.0;
            }
            
            public String getAddress() { return address; }
            public BigInteger getStake() { return stake; }
            public double getReputation() { return reputation; }
            
            public void updateStake(BigInteger newStake) {
                this.stake = newStake;
            }
            
            public void updateReputation(double delta) {
                this.reputation = Math.max(0, this.reputation + delta);
            }
        }
        
        static class ValidatorPool {
            private List<Validator> validators;
            private Random random;
            
            public ValidatorPool() {
                this.validators = new ArrayList<>();
                this.random = new Random();
            }
            
            public void addValidator(Validator validator) {
                validators.add(validator);
            }
            
            public Validator selectValidator() {
                if (validators.isEmpty()) return null;
                
                // Calculate total weighted stake
                BigInteger totalStake = BigInteger.ZERO;
                for (Validator validator : validators) {
                    BigInteger weightedStake = validator.getStake()
                        .multiply(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(validator.getReputation() * 100)));
                    totalStake = totalStake.add(weightedStake);
                }
                
                if (totalStake.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) {
                    return validators.get(random.nextInt(validators.size()));
                }
                
                // Select validator based on weighted probability
                BigInteger randomValue = new BigInteger(totalStake.bitLength(), random).mod(totalStake);
                BigInteger currentSum = BigInteger.ZERO;
                
                for (Validator validator : validators) {
                    BigInteger weightedStake = validator.getStake()
                        .multiply(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(validator.getReputation() * 100)));
                    currentSum = currentSum.add(weightedStake);
                    
                    if (randomValue.compareTo(currentSum) < 0) {
                        return validator;
                    }
                }
                
                return validators.get(validators.size() - 1);
            }
            
            public void slash(String validatorAddress, double penaltyRate) {
                for (Validator validator : validators) {
                    if (validator.getAddress().equals(validatorAddress)) {
                        BigInteger penalty = validator.getStake()
                            .multiply(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(penaltyRate * 100)))
                            .divide(BigInteger.valueOf(100));
                        
                        validator.updateStake(validator.getStake().subtract(penalty));
                        validator.updateReputation(-0.1);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            public List<Validator> getValidators() {
                return new ArrayList<>(validators);
            }
        }
        
        public static Validator selectBlockProducer(ValidatorPool pool) {
            return pool.selectValidator();
        }
        
        public static boolean validateBlock(SimpleBlockchain.Block block, Validator producer) {
            // Simplified validation: check if producer has sufficient stake
            return producer.getStake().compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(1000)) >= 0;
        }
    }
    
    // Simple SHA-256 Hash Implementation
    public static class SHA256Hash {
        
        public static String hash(String input) {
            try {
                MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
                byte[] hashBytes = digest.digest(input.getBytes("UTF-8"));
                
                StringBuilder hexString = new StringBuilder();
                for (byte b : hashBytes) {
                    String hex = Integer.toHexString(0xff & b);
                    if (hex.length() == 1) {
                        hexString.append('0');
                    }
                    hexString.append(hex);
                }
                
                return hexString.toString();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Error computing SHA-256 hash", e);
            }
        }
        
        public static String hashWithNonce(String data, int nonce) {
            return hash(data + nonce);
        }
        
        public static boolean verifyHash(String data, String expectedHash) {
            return hash(data).equals(expectedHash);
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n) for blockchain validation, O(log n) for Merkle proofs, O(1) for digital signatures, **Space**: O(n)

### 184. Game Theory and Algorithmic Game Theory
**Problem**: Strategic algorithms and equilibrium computation  
**Difficulty**: Expert

```java
public class GameTheoryAlgorithms {
    
    // Game Representation and Nash Equilibrium
    public static class GameTheory {
        
        static class Game {
            private double[][][] payoffMatrix; // [player][strategy1][strategy2]
            private int numPlayers;
            private int[] numStrategies;
            
            public Game(int numPlayers, int[] numStrategies) {
                this.numPlayers = numPlayers;
                this.numStrategies = numStrategies.clone();
                this.payoffMatrix = new double[numPlayers][][];
                
                for (int p = 0; p < numPlayers; p++) {
                    payoffMatrix[p] = new double[numStrategies[0]][numStrategies[1]];
                }
            }
            
            public void setPayoff(int player, int strategy1, int strategy2, double payoff) {
                payoffMatrix[player][strategy1][strategy2] = payoff;
            }
            
            public double getPayoff(int player, int strategy1, int strategy2) {
                return payoffMatrix[player][strategy1][strategy2];
            }
            
            public int getNumPlayers() { return numPlayers; }
            public int[] getNumStrategies() { return numStrategies.clone(); }
        }
        
        static class Strategy {
            private double[] probabilities;
            
            public Strategy(double[] probabilities) {
                this.probabilities = probabilities.clone();
                normalize();
            }
            
            public Strategy(int numStrategies) {
                this.probabilities = new double[numStrategies];
                // Initialize to uniform distribution
                Arrays.fill(probabilities, 1.0 / numStrategies);
            }
            
            private void normalize() {
                double sum = Arrays.stream(probabilities).sum();
                if (sum > 0) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < probabilities.length; i++) {
                        probabilities[i] /= sum;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            public double getProbability(int strategy) {
                return probabilities[strategy];
            }
            
            public void setProbability(int strategy, double probability) {
                probabilities[strategy] = probability;
            }
            
            public double[] getProbabilities() {
                return probabilities.clone();
            }
            
            public int size() {
                return probabilities.length;
            }
        }
        
        static class NashEquilibrium {
            private Strategy[] strategies;
            private double[] expectedPayoffs;
            
            public NashEquilibrium(Strategy[] strategies, double[] expectedPayoffs) {
                this.strategies = strategies.clone();
                this.expectedPayoffs = expectedPayoffs.clone();
            }
            
            public Strategy getStrategy(int player) {
                return strategies[player];
            }
            
            public double getExpectedPayoff(int player) {
                return expectedPayoffs[player];
            }
            
            public Strategy[] getStrategies() {
                return strategies.clone();
            }
        }
        
        // Find Nash Equilibrium using iterative best response
        public static NashEquilibrium findNashEquilibrium(Game game, int maxIterations) {
            int numPlayers = game.getNumPlayers();
            int[] numStrategies = game.getNumStrategies();
            
            Strategy[] strategies = new Strategy[numPlayers];
            for (int p = 0; p < numPlayers; p++) {
                strategies[p] = new Strategy(numStrategies[p]);
            }
            
            for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
                boolean converged = true;
                
                for (int player = 0; player < numPlayers; player++) {
                    Strategy bestResponse = findBestResponse(game, strategies, player);
                    
                    // Check convergence
                    double distance = calculateDistance(strategies[player], bestResponse);
                    if (distance > 1e-6) {
                        converged = false;
                    }
                    
                    // Update strategy with dampening
                    double alpha = 0.1; // Learning rate
                    for (int s = 0; s < bestResponse.size(); s++) {
                        double newProb = (1 - alpha) * strategies[player].getProbability(s) + 
                                       alpha * bestResponse.getProbability(s);
                        strategies[player].setProbability(s, newProb);
                    }
                    strategies[player].normalize();
                }
                
                if (converged) break;
            }
            
            double[] expectedPayoffs = calculateExpectedPayoffs(game, strategies);
            return new NashEquilibrium(strategies, expectedPayoffs);
        }
        
        private static Strategy findBestResponse(Game game, Strategy[] strategies, int player) {
            int numStrategies = game.getNumStrategies()[player];
            double[] expectedPayoffs = new double[numStrategies];
            
            // Calculate expected payoff for each pure strategy
            for (int s = 0; s < numStrategies; s++) {
                expectedPayoffs[s] = calculateExpectedPayoff(game, strategies, player, s);
            }
            
            // Find best response (strategy with highest expected payoff)
            int bestStrategy = 0;
            for (int s = 1; s < numStrategies; s++) {
                if (expectedPayoffs[s] > expectedPayoffs[bestStrategy]) {
                    bestStrategy = s;
                }
            }
            
            // Create pure strategy for best response
            double[] probabilities = new double[numStrategies];
            probabilities[bestStrategy] = 1.0;
            
            return new Strategy(probabilities);
        }
        
        private static double calculateExpectedPayoff(Game game, Strategy[] strategies, 
                                                    int player, int playerStrategy) {
            double expectedPayoff = 0;
            int opponent = 1 - player; // Assumes 2-player game
            
            for (int opponentStrategy = 0; opponentStrategy < strategies[opponent].size(); opponentStrategy++) {
                double probability = strategies[opponent].getProbability(opponentStrategy);
                double payoff;
                
                if (player == 0) {
                    payoff = game.getPayoff(player, playerStrategy, opponentStrategy);
                } else {
                    payoff = game.getPayoff(player, opponentStrategy, playerStrategy);
                }
                
                expectedPayoff += probability * payoff;
            }
            
            return expectedPayoff;
        }
        
        private static double[] calculateExpectedPayoffs(Game game, Strategy[] strategies) {
            int numPlayers = game.getNumPlayers();
            double[] expectedPayoffs = new double[numPlayers];
            
            for (int player = 0; player < numPlayers; player++) {
                for (int s1 = 0; s1 < strategies[0].size(); s1++) {
                    for (int s2 = 0; s2 < strategies[1].size(); s2++) {
                        double probability = strategies[0].getProbability(s1) * 
                                           strategies[1].getProbability(s2);
                        double payoff = game.getPayoff(player, s1, s2);
                        expectedPayoffs[player] += probability * payoff;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return expectedPayoffs;
        }
        
        private static double calculateDistance(Strategy s1, Strategy s2) {
            double distance = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < s1.size(); i++) {
                double diff = s1.getProbability(i) - s2.getProbability(i);
                distance += diff * diff;
            }
            return Math.sqrt(distance);
        }
    }
    
    // Auction Algorithms
    public static class AuctionAlgorithms {
        
        static class Bid {
            private String bidder;
            private double amount;
            private Object item;
            
            public Bid(String bidder, double amount, Object item) {
                this.bidder = bidder;
                this.amount = amount;
                this.item = item;
            }
            
            public String getBidder() { return bidder; }
            public double getAmount() { return amount; }
            public Object getItem() { return item; }
        }
        
        static class AuctionResult {
            private Map<String, Object> allocations;
            private Map<String, Double> payments;
            private double revenue;
            
            public AuctionResult() {
                this.allocations = new HashMap<>();
                this.payments = new HashMap<>();
                this.revenue = 0;
            }
            
            public void addAllocation(String bidder, Object item, double payment) {
                allocations.put(bidder, item);
                payments.put(bidder, payment);
                revenue += payment;
            }
            
            public Map<String, Object> getAllocations() { return new HashMap<>(allocations); }
            public Map<String, Double> getPayments() { return new HashMap<>(payments); }
            public double getRevenue() { return revenue; }
        }
        
        // Vickrey Auction (Second-price sealed-bid)
        public static AuctionResult vickreyAuction(List<Bid> bids) {
            if (bids.isEmpty()) {
                return new AuctionResult();
            }
            
            // Sort bids by amount in descending order
            List<Bid> sortedBids = new ArrayList<>(bids);
            sortedBids.sort((b1, b2) -> Double.compare(b2.getAmount(), b1.getAmount()));
            
            AuctionResult result = new AuctionResult();
            
            // Winner pays second-highest bid
            Bid winner = sortedBids.get(0);
            double payment = sortedBids.size() > 1 ? sortedBids.get(1).getAmount() : winner.getAmount();
            
            result.addAllocation(winner.getBidder(), winner.getItem(), payment);
            
            return result;
        }
        
        // English Auction (Ascending-bid)
        public static AuctionResult englishAuction(List<Bid> initialBids, double reservePrice, 
                                                  double increment, int maxRounds) {
            if (initialBids.isEmpty()) {
                return new AuctionResult();
            }
            
            Map<String, Double> currentBids = new HashMap<>();
            for (Bid bid : initialBids) {
                currentBids.put(bid.getBidder(), Math.max(bid.getAmount(), reservePrice));
            }
            
            Object item = initialBids.get(0).getItem();
            
            for (int round = 0; round < maxRounds; round++) {
                // Find current highest bid
                String highestBidder = "";
                double highestBid = 0;
                
                for (Map.Entry<String, Double> entry : currentBids.entrySet()) {
                    if (entry.getValue() > highestBid) {
                        highestBid = entry.getValue();
                        highestBidder = entry.getKey();
                    }
                }
                
                // Simulate other bidders dropping out or increasing bids
                Set<String> activeBidders = new HashSet<>(currentBids.keySet());
                double nextBid = highestBid + increment;
                
                // Remove bidders who won't bid higher (simplified simulation)
                activeBidders.removeIf(bidder -> {
                    if (bidder.equals(highestBidder)) return false;
                    return Math.random() < 0.3; // 30% chance of dropping out
                });
                
                if (activeBidders.size() <= 1) {
                    // Only one bidder left
                    AuctionResult result = new AuctionResult();
                    result.addAllocation(highestBidder, item, highestBid);
                    return result;
                }
                
                // Update bids for remaining bidders
                for (String bidder : activeBidders) {
                    if (!bidder.equals(highestBidder) && Math.random() < 0.7) {
                        currentBids.put(bidder, nextBid);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Return result with highest bidder
            String winner = currentBids.entrySet().stream()
                .max(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
                .orElse("");
            
            double winningBid = currentBids.getOrDefault(winner, 0.0);
            
            AuctionResult result = new AuctionResult();
            result.addAllocation(winner, item, winningBid);
            return result;
        }
        
        // Combinatorial Auction (simplified)
        public static AuctionResult combinatorialAuction(List<Set<Object>> bundles, 
                                                        List<Double> bundleBids, 
                                                        List<String> bidders) {
            // Simplified implementation: find non-overlapping bundles with maximum total value
            AuctionResult result = new AuctionResult();
            
            if (bundles.isEmpty() || bundleBids.isEmpty() || bidders.isEmpty()) {
                return result;
            }
            
            // Create bundle objects
            List<Bundle> bundleObjects = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < bundles.size(); i++) {
                bundleObjects.add(new Bundle(i, bundles.get(i), bundleBids.get(i), bidders.get(i % bidders.size())));
            }
            
            // Sort by value density (bid per item)
            bundleObjects.sort((b1, b2) -> Double.compare(
                b2.getBid() / b2.getItems().size(),
                b1.getBid() / b1.getItems().size()
            ));
            
            Set<Object> allocatedItems = new HashSet<>();
            
            for (Bundle bundle : bundleObjects) {
                // Check if bundle items are available
                boolean canAllocate = true;
                for (Object item : bundle.getItems()) {
                    if (allocatedItems.contains(item)) {
                        canAllocate = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (canAllocate) {
                    result.addAllocation(bundle.getBidder(), bundle.getItems(), bundle.getBid());
                    allocatedItems.addAll(bundle.getItems());
                }
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        static class Bundle {
            private int id;
            private Set<Object> items;
            private double bid;
            private String bidder;
            
            public Bundle(int id, Set<Object> items, double bid, String bidder) {
                this.id = id;
                this.items = new HashSet<>(items);
                this.bid = bid;
                this.bidder = bidder;
            }
            
            public int getId() { return id; }
            public Set<Object> getItems() { return new HashSet<>(items); }
            public double getBid() { return bid; }
            public String getBidder() { return bidder; }
        }
    }
    
    // Mechanism Design
    public static class MechanismDesign {
        
        // Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) Mechanism
        public static class VCGMechanism {
            
            static class Agent {
                private String id;
                private Map<Set<Object>, Double> valuations;
                
                public Agent(String id) {
                    this.id = id;
                    this.valuations = new HashMap<>();
                }
                
                public void addValuation(Set<Object> bundle, double value) {
                    valuations.put(new HashSet<>(bundle), value);
                }
                
                public double getValuation(Set<Object> bundle) {
                    return valuations.getOrDefault(bundle, 0.0);
                }
                
                public String getId() { return id; }
                public Map<Set<Object>, Double> getValuations() { return new HashMap<>(valuations); }
            }
            
            static class VCGResult {
                private Map<String, Set<Object>> allocation;
                private Map<String, Double> payments;
                private double socialWelfare;
                
                public VCGResult() {
                    this.allocation = new HashMap<>();
                    this.payments = new HashMap<>();
                    this.socialWelfare = 0;
                }
                
                public void setAllocation(String agent, Set<Object> items) {
                    allocation.put(agent, new HashSet<>(items));
                }
                
                public void setPayment(String agent, double payment) {
                    payments.put(agent, payment);
                }
                
                public void setSocialWelfare(double welfare) {
                    this.socialWelfare = welfare;
                }
                
                public Map<String, Set<Object>> getAllocation() { return new HashMap<>(allocation); }
                public Map<String, Double> getPayments() { return new HashMap<>(payments); }
                public double getSocialWelfare() { return socialWelfare; }
            }
            
            public static VCGResult runVCGAuction(List<Agent> agents, Set<Object> items) {
                VCGResult result = new VCGResult();
                
                // Find optimal allocation (maximize social welfare)
                Map<String, Set<Object>> optimalAllocation = findOptimalAllocation(agents, items);
                double maxSocialWelfare = calculateSocialWelfare(agents, optimalAllocation);
                
                result.setSocialWelfare(maxSocialWelfare);
                
                // Calculate VCG payments
                for (Agent agent : agents) {
                    // Social welfare without this agent
                    List<Agent> otherAgents = new ArrayList<>(agents);
                    otherAgents.remove(agent);
                    
                    Map<String, Set<Object>> allocationWithoutAgent = findOptimalAllocation(otherAgents, items);
                    double welfareWithoutAgent = calculateSocialWelfare(otherAgents, allocationWithoutAgent);
                    
                    // Social welfare of others in current allocation
                    double othersWelfareInCurrentAllocation = 0;
                    for (Agent other : otherAgents) {
                        Set<Object> allocation = optimalAllocation.getOrDefault(other.getId(), new HashSet<>());
                        othersWelfareInCurrentAllocation += other.getValuation(allocation);
                    }
                    
                    // VCG payment = welfare others lose due to this agent's presence
                    double payment = welfareWithoutAgent - othersWelfareInCurrentAllocation;
                    
                    result.setPayment(agent.getId(), Math.max(0, payment));
                    result.setAllocation(agent.getId(), optimalAllocation.getOrDefault(agent.getId(), new HashSet<>()));
                }
                
                return result;
            }
            
            private static Map<String, Set<Object>> findOptimalAllocation(List<Agent> agents, Set<Object> items) {
                // Simplified: greedy allocation based on marginal valuations
                Map<String, Set<Object>> allocation = new HashMap<>();
                Set<Object> remainingItems = new HashSet<>(items);
                
                for (Agent agent : agents) {
                    allocation.put(agent.getId(), new HashSet<>());
                }
                
                while (!remainingItems.isEmpty()) {
                    String bestAgent = null;
                    Object bestItem = null;
                    double bestMarginalValue = 0;
                    
                    for (Object item : remainingItems) {
                        for (Agent agent : agents) {
                            Set<Object> currentBundle = allocation.get(agent.getId());
                            Set<Object> newBundle = new HashSet<>(currentBundle);
                            newBundle.add(item);
                            
                            double marginalValue = agent.getValuation(newBundle) - agent.getValuation(currentBundle);
                            
                            if (marginalValue > bestMarginalValue) {
                                bestMarginalValue = marginalValue;
                                bestAgent = agent.getId();
                                bestItem = item;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (bestAgent != null && bestItem != null) {
                        allocation.get(bestAgent).add(bestItem);
                        remainingItems.remove(bestItem);
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                return allocation;
            }
            
            private static double calculateSocialWelfare(List<Agent> agents, Map<String, Set<Object>> allocation) {
                double totalWelfare = 0;
                
                for (Agent agent : agents) {
                    Set<Object> agentAllocation = allocation.getOrDefault(agent.getId(), new HashSet<>());
                    totalWelfare += agent.getValuation(agentAllocation);
                }
                
                return totalWelfare;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Cooperative Game Theory
    public static class CooperativeGameTheory {
        
        static class CooperativeGame {
            private Map<Set<String>, Double> characteristicFunction;
            private Set<String> players;
            
            public CooperativeGame(Set<String> players) {
                this.players = new HashSet<>(players);
                this.characteristicFunction = new HashMap<>();
                
                // Initialize empty coalition value
                characteristicFunction.put(new HashSet<>(), 0.0);
            }
            
            public void setCoalitionValue(Set<String> coalition, double value) {
                characteristicFunction.put(new HashSet<>(coalition), value);
            }
            
            public double getCoalitionValue(Set<String> coalition) {
                return characteristicFunction.getOrDefault(coalition, 0.0);
            }
            
            public Set<String> getPlayers() { return new HashSet<>(players); }
        }
        
        // Shapley Value calculation
        public static Map<String, Double> calculateShapleyValues(CooperativeGame game) {
            Map<String, Double> shapleyValues = new HashMap<>();
            Set<String> players = game.getPlayers();
            
            for (String player : players) {
                double shapleyValue = 0;
                
                // Consider all possible coalitions not containing the player
                List<Set<String>> coalitionsWithoutPlayer = generateCoalitions(players);
                coalitionsWithoutPlayer.removeIf(coalition -> coalition.contains(player));
                
                for (Set<String> coalition : coalitionsWithoutPlayer) {
                    Set<String> coalitionWithPlayer = new HashSet<>(coalition);
                    coalitionWithPlayer.add(player);
                    
                    double marginalContribution = game.getCoalitionValue(coalitionWithPlayer) - 
                                                game.getCoalitionValue(coalition);
                    
                    // Weight by coalition size
                    int coalitionSize = coalition.size();
                    int totalPlayers = players.size();
                    
                    double weight = factorial(coalitionSize) * factorial(totalPlayers - coalitionSize - 1) 
                                  / (double) factorial(totalPlayers);
                    
                    shapleyValue += weight * marginalContribution;
                }
                
                shapleyValues.put(player, shapleyValue);
            }
            
            return shapleyValues;
        }
        
        // Core calculation
        public static boolean isInCore(CooperativeGame game, Map<String, Double> allocation) {
            Set<String> players = game.getPlayers();
            
            // Check if allocation is feasible
            double totalAllocation = allocation.values().stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).sum();
            double grandCoalitionValue = game.getCoalitionValue(players);
            
            if (Math.abs(totalAllocation - grandCoalitionValue) > 1e-10) {
                return false; // Not feasible
            }
            
            // Check core constraints: no coalition should have incentive to deviate
            List<Set<String>> allCoalitions = generateCoalitions(players);
            
            for (Set<String> coalition : allCoalitions) {
                if (coalition.isEmpty()) continue;
                
                double coalitionAllocation = coalition.stream()
                    .mapToDouble(player -> allocation.getOrDefault(player, 0.0))
                    .sum();
                
                double coalitionValue = game.getCoalitionValue(coalition);
                
                if (coalitionAllocation < coalitionValue - 1e-10) {
                    return false; // Core constraint violated
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private static List<Set<String>> generateCoalitions(Set<String> players) {
            List<Set<String>> coalitions = new ArrayList<>();
            List<String> playerList = new ArrayList<>(players);
            int n = playerList.size();
            
            // Generate all subsets (2^n coalitions)
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
                Set<String> coalition = new HashSet<>();
                
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        coalition.add(playerList.get(j));
                    }
                }
                
                coalitions.add(coalition);
            }
            
            return coalitions;
        }
        
        private static long factorial(int n) {
            if (n <= 1) return 1;
            long result = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                result *= i;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class AdvancedOperatingSystemsAlgorithms {
    
    // Advanced CPU Scheduling Algorithms
    public static class CPUScheduling {
        
        static class Process {
            private int id;
            private int arrivalTime;
            private int burstTime;
            private int priority;
            private int remainingTime;
            private int waitingTime;
            private int turnaroundTime;
            private int responseTime;
            private boolean hasStarted;
            
            public Process(int id, int arrivalTime, int burstTime, int priority) {
                this.id = id;
                this.arrivalTime = arrivalTime;
                this.burstTime = burstTime;
                this.priority = priority;
                this.remainingTime = burstTime;
                this.waitingTime = 0;
                this.turnaroundTime = 0;
                this.responseTime = -1;
                this.hasStarted = false;
            }
            
            // Getters and setters
            public int getId() { return id; }
            public int getArrivalTime() { return arrivalTime; }
            public int getBurstTime() { return burstTime; }
            public int getPriority() { return priority; }
            public int getRemainingTime() { return remainingTime; }
            public void setRemainingTime(int time) { this.remainingTime = time; }
            public int getWaitingTime() { return waitingTime; }
            public void setWaitingTime(int time) { this.waitingTime = time; }
            public int getTurnaroundTime() { return turnaroundTime; }
            public void setTurnaroundTime(int time) { this.turnaroundTime = time; }
            public int getResponseTime() { return responseTime; }
            public void setResponseTime(int time) { this.responseTime = time; }

            public void setStarted(boolean started) { this.hasStarted = started; }
        }
        
        static class SchedulingResult {
            private List<Process> processes;
            private double avgWaitingTime;
            private double avgTurnaroundTime;
            private double avgResponseTime;
            private List<String> executionOrder;
            
            public SchedulingResult(List<Process> processes, List<String> executionOrder) {
                this.processes = new ArrayList<>(processes);
                this.executionOrder = new ArrayList<>(executionOrder);
                calculateAverages();
            }
            
            private void calculateAverages() {
                int n = processes.size();
                double totalWaiting = processes.stream().mapToInt(Process::getWaitingTime).sum();
                double totalTurnaround = processes.stream().mapToInt(Process::getTurnaroundTime).sum();
                double totalResponse = processes.stream().mapToInt(Process::getResponseTime).sum();
                
                avgWaitingTime = totalWaiting / n;
                avgTurnaroundTime = totalTurnaround / n;
                avgResponseTime = totalResponse / n;
            }
            
            public double getAvgWaitingTime() { return avgWaitingTime; }
            public double getAvgTurnaroundTime() { return avgTurnaroundTime; }
            public double getAvgResponseTime() { return avgResponseTime; }
            public List<String> getExecutionOrder() { return new ArrayList<>(executionOrder); }
        }
        
        // Multilevel Feedback Queue Scheduling
        public static SchedulingResult multilevelFeedbackQueue(List<Process> processes, 
                                                              int[] timeQuantums, int levels) {
            List<Process> processList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Process p : processes) {
                processList.add(new Process(p.getId(), p.getArrivalTime(), p.getBurstTime(), p.getPriority()));
            }
            
            List<Queue<Process>> queues = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < levels; i++) {
                queues.add(new LinkedList<>());
            }
            
            List<String> executionOrder = new ArrayList<>();
            int currentTime = 0;
            int processIndex = 0;
            
            // Sort processes by arrival time
            processList.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Process::getArrivalTime));
            
            while (!allProcessesCompleted(processList) || !allQueuesEmpty(queues)) {
                // Add arrived processes to highest priority queue
                while (processIndex < processList.size() && 
                       processList.get(processIndex).getArrivalTime() <= currentTime) {
                    queues.get(0).offer(processList.get(processIndex));
                    processIndex++;
                }
                
                // Find highest priority non-empty queue
                Process currentProcess = null;
                int selectedLevel = -1;
                
                for (int level = 0; level < levels; level++) {
                    if (!queues.get(level).isEmpty()) {
                        currentProcess = queues.get(level).poll();
                        selectedLevel = level;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (currentProcess == null) {
                    currentTime++;
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Set response time if first execution
                if (!currentProcess.hasStarted()) {
                    currentProcess.setResponseTime(currentTime - currentProcess.getArrivalTime());
                    currentProcess.setStarted(true);
                }
                
                // Execute process for time quantum or until completion
                int timeQuantum = (selectedLevel < timeQuantums.length) ? 
                                timeQuantums[selectedLevel] : timeQuantums[timeQuantums.length - 1];
                
                int executionTime = Math.min(timeQuantum, currentProcess.getRemainingTime());
                
                for (int i = 0; i < executionTime; i++) {
                    executionOrder.add("P" + currentProcess.getId());
                    currentTime++;
                    currentProcess.setRemainingTime(currentProcess.getRemainingTime() - 1);
                    
                    // Add any newly arrived processes
                    while (processIndex < processList.size() && 
                           processList.get(processIndex).getArrivalTime() <= currentTime) {
                        queues.get(0).offer(processList.get(processIndex));
                        processIndex++;
                    }
                }
                
                // Process completion or demotion
                if (currentProcess.getRemainingTime() == 0) {
                    currentProcess.setTurnaroundTime(currentTime - currentProcess.getArrivalTime());
                    currentProcess.setWaitingTime(currentProcess.getTurnaroundTime() - currentProcess.getBurstTime());
                } else {
                    // Demote to lower priority queue
                    int nextLevel = Math.min(selectedLevel + 1, levels - 1);
                    queues.get(nextLevel).offer(currentProcess);
                }
            }
            
            return new SchedulingResult(processList, executionOrder);
        }
        
        // Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS) - Linux-inspired
        public static SchedulingResult completelyFairScheduler(List<Process> processes, int timeSlice) {
            List<Process> processList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Process p : processes) {
                processList.add(new Process(p.getId(), p.getArrivalTime(), p.getBurstTime(), p.getPriority()));
            }
            
            // Red-Black Tree simulation using TreeMap
            TreeMap<Double, Process> runQueue = new TreeMap<>();
            Map<Process, Double> vruntime = new HashMap<>();
            
            List<String> executionOrder = new ArrayList<>();
            int currentTime = 0;
            int processIndex = 0;
            
            processList.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Process::getArrivalTime));
            
            while (!allProcessesCompleted(processList) || !runQueue.isEmpty()) {
                // Add arrived processes
                while (processIndex < processList.size() && 
                       processList.get(processIndex).getArrivalTime() <= currentTime) {
                    Process p = processList.get(processIndex);
                    vruntime.put(p, 0.0); // Initialize virtual runtime
                    runQueue.put(0.0, p);
                    processIndex++;
                }
                
                if (runQueue.isEmpty()) {
                    currentTime++;
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Select process with minimum virtual runtime
                Map.Entry<Double, Process> entry = runQueue.firstEntry();
                Process currentProcess = entry.getValue();
                runQueue.remove(entry.getKey());
                
                if (!currentProcess.hasStarted()) {
                    currentProcess.setResponseTime(currentTime - currentProcess.getArrivalTime());
                    currentProcess.setStarted(true);
                }
                
                // Calculate time slice based on process weight (priority)
                int weight = Math.max(1, 10 - currentProcess.getPriority());
                int actualTimeSlice = Math.min(timeSlice * weight / 10, currentProcess.getRemainingTime());
                
                // Execute process
                for (int i = 0; i < actualTimeSlice; i++) {
                    executionOrder.add("P" + currentProcess.getId());
                    currentTime++;
                    currentProcess.setRemainingTime(currentProcess.getRemainingTime() - 1);
                }
                
                // Update virtual runtime
                double newVruntime = vruntime.get(currentProcess) + actualTimeSlice * (1024.0 / weight);
                vruntime.put(currentProcess, newVruntime);
                
                // Re-queue if not completed
                if (currentProcess.getRemainingTime() > 0) {
                    runQueue.put(newVruntime, currentProcess);
                } else {
                    currentProcess.setTurnaroundTime(currentTime - currentProcess.getArrivalTime());
                    currentProcess.setWaitingTime(currentProcess.getTurnaroundTime() - currentProcess.getBurstTime());
                }
            }
            
            return new SchedulingResult(processList, executionOrder);
        }
        
        private static boolean allProcessesCompleted(List<Process> processes) {
            return processes.stream().allMatch(p -> p.getRemainingTime() == 0);
        }
        
        private static boolean allQueuesEmpty(List<Queue<Process>> queues) {
            return queues.stream().allMatch(Queue::isEmpty);
        }
    }
    
    // Advanced Memory Management
    public static class MemoryManagement {
        
        static class MemoryBlock {
            private int startAddress;
            private int size;
            private boolean allocated;

            public int getStartAddress() { return startAddress; }

        }
        
        static class MemoryAllocationResult {
            private boolean success;
            private int startAddress;
            private String algorithm;
            private double fragmentation;
            
            public MemoryAllocationResult(boolean success, int startAddress, String algorithm, double fragmentation) {
                this.success = success;
                this.startAddress = startAddress;
                this.algorithm = algorithm;
                this.fragmentation = fragmentation;
            }

            public String getAlgorithm() { return algorithm; }
            public double getFragmentation() { return fragmentation; }

        // Buddy System Memory Allocation
        public static class BuddySystem {
            private int totalSize;
            private Map<Integer, Set<Integer>> freeBlocks; // size -> set of starting addresses
            private Map<Integer, Integer> allocatedBlocks; // starting address -> size
            
            public BuddySystem(int totalSize) {
                // Total size must be power of 2
                this.totalSize = Integer.highestOneBit(totalSize);
                this.freeBlocks = new HashMap<>();
                this.allocatedBlocks = new HashMap<>();
                
                // Initially, entire memory is one free block
                freeBlocks.put(this.totalSize, new HashSet<>());
                freeBlocks.get(this.totalSize).add(0);
            }
            
            public MemoryAllocationResult allocate(int size, int processId) {
                // Find smallest power of 2 >= size
                int blockSize = Integer.highestOneBit(size);
                if (blockSize < size) blockSize *= 2;
                
                int startAddress = findAndAllocateBlock(blockSize);
                
                if (startAddress != -1) {
                    allocatedBlocks.put(startAddress, blockSize);
                    double fragmentation = calculateFragmentation();
                    return new MemoryAllocationResult(true, startAddress, "Buddy System", fragmentation);
                }
                
                return new MemoryAllocationResult(false, -1, "Buddy System", 0);
            }
            
            private int findAndAllocateBlock(int size) {
                // Find the smallest available block >= size
                for (int blockSize = size; blockSize <= totalSize; blockSize *= 2) {
                    if (freeBlocks.containsKey(blockSize) && !freeBlocks.get(blockSize).isEmpty()) {
                        int address = freeBlocks.get(blockSize).iterator().next();
                        freeBlocks.get(blockSize).remove(address);
                        
                        // Split larger blocks if necessary
                        while (blockSize > size) {
                            blockSize /= 2;
                            int buddyAddress = address + blockSize;
                            
                            freeBlocks.computeIfAbsent(blockSize, k -> new HashSet<>()).add(buddyAddress);
                        }
                        
                        return address;
                    }
                }
                
                return -1; // No suitable block found
            }
            
            public boolean deallocate(int startAddress) {
                if (!allocatedBlocks.containsKey(startAddress)) {
                    return false;
                }
                
                int size = allocatedBlocks.remove(startAddress);
                
                // Try to merge with buddy blocks
                while (size < totalSize) {
                    int buddyAddress = startAddress ^ size; // XOR to find buddy
                    
                    if (freeBlocks.containsKey(size) && freeBlocks.get(size).contains(buddyAddress)) {
                        // Merge with buddy
                        freeBlocks.get(size).remove(buddyAddress);
                        startAddress = Math.min(startAddress, buddyAddress);
                        size *= 2;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                freeBlocks.computeIfAbsent(size, k -> new HashSet<>()).add(startAddress);
                return true;
            }
            
            private double calculateFragmentation() {
                int totalFreeSpace = 0;
                int largestFreeBlock = 0;
                
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Set<Integer>> entry : freeBlocks.entrySet()) {
                    int blockSize = entry.getKey();
                    int count = entry.getValue().size();
                    totalFreeSpace += blockSize * count;
                    
                    if (count > 0) {
                        largestFreeBlock = Math.max(largestFreeBlock, blockSize);
                    }
                }
                
                if (totalFreeSpace == 0) return 0;
                return 1.0 - (double) largestFreeBlock / totalFreeSpace;
            }
        }
        
        // Slab Allocation
        public static class SlabAllocator {
            
            static class Slab {
                private int objectSize;
                private int capacity;
                private BitSet freeObjects;
                private byte[] memory;
                
                public Slab(int objectSize, int capacity) {
                    this.objectSize = objectSize;
                    this.capacity = capacity;
                    this.freeObjects = new BitSet(capacity);
                    this.freeObjects.set(0, capacity); // All objects initially free
                    this.memory = new byte[objectSize * capacity];
                }
                
                public int allocateObject() {
                    int index = freeObjects.nextSetBit(0);
                    if (index != -1) {
                        freeObjects.clear(index);
                        return index * objectSize;
                    }
                    return -1;
                }
                
                public void deallocateObject(int offset) {
                    int index = offset / objectSize;
                    if (index < capacity) {
                        freeObjects.set(index);
                    }
                }
                
                public boolean isEmpty() {
                    return freeObjects.cardinality() == capacity;
                }
                
                public boolean isFull() {
                    return freeObjects.cardinality() == 0;
                }
                
                public int getFreeCount() {
                    return freeObjects.cardinality();
                }
            }
            
            static class Cache {
                private int objectSize;
                private List<Slab> fullSlabs;
                private List<Slab> partialSlabs;
                private List<Slab> emptySlabs;
                private int slabCapacity;
                
                public Cache(int objectSize, int slabCapacity) {
                    this.objectSize = objectSize;
                    this.slabCapacity = slabCapacity;
                    this.fullSlabs = new ArrayList<>();
                    this.partialSlabs = new ArrayList<>();
                    this.emptySlabs = new ArrayList<>();
                }
                
                public int allocateObject() {
                    Slab slab = null;
                    
                    // Try partial slabs first
                    if (!partialSlabs.isEmpty()) {
                        slab = partialSlabs.get(0);
                    } else if (!emptySlabs.isEmpty()) {
                        slab = emptySlabs.remove(0);
                        partialSlabs.add(slab);
                    } else {
                        // Create new slab
                        slab = new Slab(objectSize, slabCapacity);
                        partialSlabs.add(slab);
                    }
                    
                    int offset = slab.allocateObject();
                    
                    // Move slab to appropriate list if state changed
                    if (slab.isFull()) {
                        partialSlabs.remove(slab);
                        fullSlabs.add(slab);
                    }
                    
                    return offset;
                }
                
                public void deallocateObject(int offset) {
                    // Find the slab containing this object
                    Slab targetSlab = null;
                    
                    for (Slab slab : fullSlabs) {
                        if (offset < slab.capacity * objectSize) {
                            targetSlab = slab;
                            fullSlabs.remove(slab);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (targetSlab == null) {
                        for (Slab slab : partialSlabs) {
                            if (offset < slab.capacity * objectSize) {
                                targetSlab = slab;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (targetSlab != null) {
                        targetSlab.deallocateObject(offset);
                        
                        if (targetSlab.isEmpty()) {
                            partialSlabs.remove(targetSlab);
                            emptySlabs.add(targetSlab);
                        } else if (!partialSlabs.contains(targetSlab)) {
                            partialSlabs.add(targetSlab);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                public double getUtilization() {
                    int totalObjects = 0;
                    int usedObjects = 0;
                    
                    for (Slab slab : fullSlabs) {
                        totalObjects += slab.capacity;
                        usedObjects += slab.capacity;
                    }
                    
                    for (Slab slab : partialSlabs) {
                        totalObjects += slab.capacity;
                        usedObjects += (slab.capacity - slab.getFreeCount());
                    }
                    
                    for (Slab slab : emptySlabs) {
                        totalObjects += slab.capacity;
                    }
                    
                    return totalObjects > 0 ? (double) usedObjects / totalObjects : 0;
                }
            }
            
            private Map<Integer, Cache> caches;
            
            public SlabAllocator() {
                this.caches = new HashMap<>();
            }
            
            public MemoryAllocationResult allocate(int size) {
                // Round up to next power of 2 for standard object sizes
                int objectSize = Integer.highestOneBit(size);
                if (objectSize < size) objectSize *= 2;
                
                Cache cache = caches.computeIfAbsent(objectSize, 
                    k -> new Cache(k, 1024 / k)); // Adjust capacity based on object size
                
                int offset = cache.allocateObject();
                
                if (offset != -1) {
                    double utilization = cache.getUtilization();
                    return new MemoryAllocationResult(true, offset, "Slab Allocator", 1.0 - utilization);
                }
                
                return new MemoryAllocationResult(false, -1, "Slab Allocator", 0);
            }
            
            public void deallocate(int size, int offset) {
                int objectSize = Integer.highestOneBit(size);
                if (objectSize < size) objectSize *= 2;
                
                Cache cache = caches.get(objectSize);
                if (cache != null) {
                    cache.deallocateObject(offset);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Deadlock Detection and Prevention
    public static class DeadlockAlgorithms {
        
        static class Resource {
            private int id;
            private int totalInstances;
            private int availableInstances;
            private Set<Integer> allocatedTo; // Process IDs
            
            public Resource(int id, int totalInstances) {
                this.id = id;
                this.totalInstances = totalInstances;
                this.availableInstances = totalInstances;
                this.allocatedTo = new HashSet<>();
            }
            
            public int getId() { return id; }
            public int getTotalInstances() { return totalInstances; }
            public int getAvailableInstances() { return availableInstances; }
            public Set<Integer> getAllocatedTo() { return new HashSet<>(allocatedTo); }
            
            public boolean allocate(int processId, int instances) {
                if (instances <= availableInstances) {
                    availableInstances -= instances;
                    allocatedTo.add(processId);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            
            public void deallocate(int processId, int instances) {
                availableInstances += instances;
                if (availableInstances == totalInstances) {
                    allocatedTo.remove(processId);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Banker's Algorithm for Deadlock Avoidance
        public static class BankersAlgorithm {
            private int numProcesses;
            private int numResources;
            private int[][] allocation;
            private int[][] max;
            private int[] available;
            
            public BankersAlgorithm(int numProcesses, int numResources, 
                                  int[][] allocation, int[][] max, int[] available) {
                this.numProcesses = numProcesses;
                this.numResources = numResources;
                this.allocation = deepCopy(allocation);
                this.max = deepCopy(max);
                this.available = available.clone();
            }
            
            public boolean isSafeState() {
                int[][] need = calculateNeed();
                boolean[] finished = new boolean[numProcesses];
                int[] work = available.clone();
                List<Integer> safeSequence = new ArrayList<>();
                
                while (safeSequence.size() < numProcesses) {
                    boolean found = false;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < numProcesses; i++) {
                        if (!finished[i] && canAllocate(need[i], work)) {
                            // Process i can complete
                            for (int j = 0; j < numResources; j++) {
                                work[j] += allocation[i][j];
                            }
                            finished[i] = true;
                            safeSequence.add(i);
                            found = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (!found) {
                        return false; // No safe sequence exists
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
            
            public boolean requestResources(int processId, int[] request) {
                // Check if request is valid
                for (int i = 0; i < numResources; i++) {
                    if (request[i] > available[i]) {
                        return false; // Not enough resources available
                    }
                }
                
                // Temporarily allocate resources
                for (int i = 0; i < numResources; i++) {
                    available[i] -= request[i];
                    allocation[processId][i] += request[i];
                }
                
                // Check if resulting state is safe
                if (isSafeState()) {
                    return true; // Request granted
                } else {
                    // Rollback allocation
                    for (int i = 0; i < numResources; i++) {
                        available[i] += request[i];
                        allocation[processId][i] -= request[i];
                    }
                    return false; // Request denied
                }
            }
            
            private int[][] calculateNeed() {
                int[][] need = new int[numProcesses][numResources];
                for (int i = 0; i < numProcesses; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < numResources; j++) {
                        need[i][j] = max[i][j] - allocation[i][j];
                    }
                }
                return need;
            }
            
            private boolean canAllocate(int[] need, int[] available) {
                for (int i = 0; i < numResources; i++) {
                    if (need[i] > available[i]) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return true;
            }
            
            private int[][] deepCopy(int[][] matrix) {
                int[][] copy = new int[matrix.length][];
                for (int i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) {
                    copy[i] = matrix[i].clone();
                }
                return copy;
            }
        }
        
        // Wait-for Graph for Deadlock Detection
        public static class WaitForGraph {
            private Map<Integer, Set<Integer>> graph; // process -> set of processes it's waiting for
            
            public WaitForGraph() {
                this.graph = new HashMap<>();
            }
            
            public void addEdge(int from, int to) {
                graph.computeIfAbsent(from, k -> new HashSet<>()).add(to);
            }
            
            public void removeEdge(int from, int to) {
                Set<Integer> edges = graph.get(from);
                if (edges != null) {
                    edges.remove(to);
                    if (edges.isEmpty()) {
                        graph.remove(from);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            public boolean hasDeadlock() {
                Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
                Set<Integer> recursionStack = new HashSet<>();
                
                for (int process : graph.keySet()) {
                    if (!visited.contains(process)) {
                        if (dfsHasCycle(process, visited, recursionStack)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return false;
            }
            
            public List<Integer> findDeadlockedProcesses() {
                Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
                Set<Integer> recursionStack = new HashSet<>();
                List<Integer> deadlockedProcesses = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (int process : graph.keySet()) {
                    if (!visited.contains(process)) {
                        List<Integer> cycle = findCycle(process, visited, recursionStack, new ArrayList<>());
                        if (!cycle.isEmpty()) {
                            deadlockedProcesses.addAll(cycle);
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                return deadlockedProcesses;
            }
            
            private boolean dfsHasCycle(int process, Set<Integer> visited, Set<Integer> recursionStack) {
                visited.add(process);
                recursionStack.add(process);
                
                Set<Integer> neighbors = graph.getOrDefault(process, new HashSet<>());
                for (int neighbor : neighbors) {
                    if (!visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                        if (dfsHasCycle(neighbor, visited, recursionStack)) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    } else if (recursionStack.contains(neighbor)) {
                        return true; // Back edge found - cycle detected
                    }
                }
                
                recursionStack.remove(process);
                return false;
            }
            
            private List<Integer> findCycle(int process, Set<Integer> visited, 
                                          Set<Integer> recursionStack, List<Integer> path) {
                visited.add(process);
                recursionStack.add(process);
                path.add(process);
                
                Set<Integer> neighbors = graph.getOrDefault(process, new HashSet<>());
                for (int neighbor : neighbors) {
                    if (!visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                        List<Integer> cycle = findCycle(neighbor, visited, recursionStack, path);
                        if (!cycle.isEmpty()) {
                            return cycle;
                        }
                    } else if (recursionStack.contains(neighbor)) {
                        // Found cycle - extract cycle from path
                        int cycleStart = path.indexOf(neighbor);
                        return new ArrayList<>(path.subList(cycleStart, path.size()));
                    }
                }
                
                recursionStack.remove(process);
                path.remove(path.size() - 1);
                return new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(n²) for scheduling algorithms, O(log n) for buddy system, O(n³) for Banker's algorithm, **Space**: O(n²)
