```java
public class AdvancedDatabaseAlgorithms {
    
    // B+ Tree Implementation for Database Indexing
    public static class BPlusTree<K extends Comparable<K>, V> {
        
        static class Node<K, V> {
            protected boolean isLeaf;
            protected List<K> keys;
            protected Node<K, V> parent;
            
            public Node(boolean isLeaf) {
                this.isLeaf = isLeaf;
                this.keys = new ArrayList<>();
                this.parent = null;
            }
        }
        
        static class InternalNode<K, V> extends Node<K, V> {
            protected List<Node<K, V>> children;
            
            public InternalNode() {
                super(false);
                this.children = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        static class LeafNode<K, V> extends Node<K, V> {
            protected List<V> values;
            protected LeafNode<K, V> next; // For range queries
            
            public LeafNode() {
                super(true);
                this.values = new ArrayList<>();
                this.next = null;
            }
        }
        
        private Node<K, V> root;
        private int degree; // Maximum number of children per internal node
        private LeafNode<K, V> firstLeaf; // For efficient range scans
        
        public BPlusTree(int degree) {
            this.degree = degree;
            this.root = new LeafNode<>();
            this.firstLeaf = (LeafNode<K, V>) root;
        }
        
        public void insert(K key, V value) {
            LeafNode<K, V> leaf = findLeafNode(key);
            insertIntoLeaf(leaf, key, value);
            
            if (leaf.keys.size() >= degree) {
                splitLeafNode(leaf);
            }
        }
        
        public V search(K key) {
            LeafNode<K, V> leaf = findLeafNode(key);
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(leaf.keys, key);
            
            if (index >= 0) {
                return leaf.values.get(index);
            }
            
            return null;
        }
        
        public List<V> rangeQuery(K startKey, K endKey) {
            List<V> result = new ArrayList<>();
            LeafNode<K, V> current = findLeafNode(startKey);
            
            while (current != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < current.keys.size(); i++) {
                    K key = current.keys.get(i);
                    
                    if (key.compareTo(startKey) >= 0 && key.compareTo(endKey) <= 0) {
                        result.add(current.values.get(i));
                    } else if (key.compareTo(endKey) > 0) {
                        return result;
                    }
                }
                current = current.next;
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        
        private LeafNode<K, V> findLeafNode(K key) {
            Node<K, V> current = root;
            
            while (!current.isLeaf) {
                InternalNode<K, V> internal = (InternalNode<K, V>) current;
                int index = Collections.binarySearch(internal.keys, key);
                
                if (index < 0) {
                    index = -index - 1;
                }
                
                current = internal.children.get(index);
            }
            
            return (LeafNode<K, V>) current;
        }
        
        private void insertIntoLeaf(LeafNode<K, V> leaf, K key, V value) {
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(leaf.keys, key);
            
            if (index >= 0) {
                // Key already exists, update value
                leaf.values.set(index, value);
            } else {
                // Insert new key-value pair
                index = -index - 1;
                leaf.keys.add(index, key);
                leaf.values.add(index, value);
            }
        }
        
        private void splitLeafNode(LeafNode<K, V> leaf) {
            LeafNode<K, V> newLeaf = new LeafNode<>();
            int midPoint = degree / 2;
            
            // Move half of the entries to new leaf
            for (int i = midPoint; i < leaf.keys.size(); i++) {
                newLeaf.keys.add(leaf.keys.get(i));
                newLeaf.values.add(leaf.values.get(i));
            }
            
            // Remove moved entries from original leaf
            leaf.keys.subList(midPoint, leaf.keys.size()).clear();
            leaf.values.subList(midPoint, leaf.values.size()).clear();
            
            // Update leaf pointers
            newLeaf.next = leaf.next;
            leaf.next = newLeaf;
            
            // Promote first key of new leaf to parent
            K promotedKey = newLeaf.keys.get(0);
            insertIntoParent(leaf, promotedKey, newLeaf);
        }
        
        private void insertIntoParent(Node<K, V> left, K key, Node<K, V> right) {
            if (left.parent == null) {
                // Create new root
                InternalNode<K, V> newRoot = new InternalNode<>();
                newRoot.keys.add(key);
                newRoot.children.add(left);
                newRoot.children.add(right);
                
                left.parent = newRoot;
                right.parent = newRoot;
                root = newRoot;
            } else {
                InternalNode<K, V> parent = (InternalNode<K, V>) left.parent;
                int index = Collections.binarySearch(parent.keys, key);
                
                if (index < 0) {
                    index = -index - 1;
                }
                
                parent.keys.add(index, key);
                parent.children.add(index + 1, right);
                right.parent = parent;
                
                if (parent.keys.size() >= degree) {
                    splitInternalNode(parent);
                }
            }
        }
        
        private void splitInternalNode(InternalNode<K, V> node) {
            InternalNode<K, V> newNode = new InternalNode<>();
            int midPoint = degree / 2;
            
            K promotedKey = node.keys.get(midPoint);
            
            // Move keys and children to new node
            for (int i = midPoint + 1; i < node.keys.size(); i++) {
                newNode.keys.add(node.keys.get(i));
            }
            
            for (int i = midPoint + 1; i < node.children.size(); i++) {
                Node<K, V> child = node.children.get(i);
                newNode.children.add(child);
                child.parent = newNode;
            }
            
            // Remove moved entries from original node
            node.keys.subList(midPoint, node.keys.size()).clear();
            node.children.subList(midPoint + 1, node.children.size()).clear();
            
            insertIntoParent(node, promotedKey, newNode);
        }
    }
    
    // Query Optimization using Cost-Based Optimizer
    public static class QueryOptimizer {
        
        static class Table {
            private String name;
            private List<String> columns;
            private Map<String, Integer> columnCardinality;
            private int rowCount;
            private Map<String, Boolean> hasIndex;
            
            public Table(String name, List<String> columns, int rowCount) {
                this.name = name;
                this.columns = new ArrayList<>(columns);
                this.rowCount = rowCount;
                this.columnCardinality = new HashMap<>();
                this.hasIndex = new HashMap<>();
                
                // Initialize default cardinalities
                for (String column : columns) {
                    columnCardinality.put(column, rowCount / 10); // Default selectivity
                    hasIndex.put(column, false);
                }
            }
            
            public String getName() { return name; }
            public List<String> getColumns() { return new ArrayList<>(columns); }
            public int getRowCount() { return rowCount; }
            public int getCardinality(String column) { return columnCardinality.getOrDefault(column, 1); }
            public boolean hasIndex(String column) { return hasIndex.getOrDefault(column, false); }
            
            public void setCardinality(String column, int cardinality) {
                columnCardinality.put(column, cardinality);
            }
            
            public void addIndex(String column) {
                hasIndex.put(column, true);
            }
        }
        
        static class QueryPlan {
            private String operation;
            private List<String> tables;
            private List<String> conditions;
            private double estimatedCost;
            private int estimatedRowCount;
            
            public QueryPlan(String operation) {
                this.operation = operation;
                this.tables = new ArrayList<>();
                this.conditions = new ArrayList<>();
                this.estimatedCost = 0;
                this.estimatedRowCount = 0;
            }
            
            public String getOperation() { return operation; }
            public List<String> getTables() { return new ArrayList<>(tables); }
            public List<String> getConditions() { return new ArrayList<>(conditions); }
            public double getEstimatedCost() { return estimatedCost; }
            public int getEstimatedRowCount() { return estimatedRowCount; }
            
            public void addTable(String table) { tables.add(table); }
            public void addCondition(String condition) { conditions.add(condition); }
            public void setEstimatedCost(double cost) { this.estimatedCost = cost; }
            public void setEstimatedRowCount(int count) { this.estimatedRowCount = count; }
        }
        
        private Map<String, Table> tables;
        
        public QueryOptimizer() {
            this.tables = new HashMap<>();
        }
        
        public void addTable(Table table) {
            tables.put(table.getName(), table);
        }
        
        public QueryPlan optimizeJoin(List<String> tableNames, List<String> joinConditions) {
            if (tableNames.size() == 2) {
                return optimizeTwoTableJoin(tableNames.get(0), tableNames.get(1), joinConditions);
            }
            
            // Dynamic programming approach for multi-table joins
            return optimizeMultiTableJoin(tableNames, joinConditions);
        }
        
        private QueryPlan optimizeTwoTableJoin(String table1, String table2, List<String> conditions) {
            Table t1 = tables.get(table1);
            Table t2 = tables.get(table2);
            
            if (t1 == null || t2 == null) {
                return null;
            }
            
            // Consider different join algorithms
            QueryPlan nestedLoopPlan = createNestedLoopJoinPlan(t1, t2, conditions);
            QueryPlan hashJoinPlan = createHashJoinPlan(t1, t2, conditions);
            QueryPlan sortMergeJoinPlan = createSortMergeJoinPlan(t1, t2, conditions);
            
            // Return plan with minimum cost
            QueryPlan bestPlan = nestedLoopPlan;
            if (hashJoinPlan.getEstimatedCost() < bestPlan.getEstimatedCost()) {
                bestPlan = hashJoinPlan;
            }
            if (sortMergeJoinPlan.getEstimatedCost() < bestPlan.getEstimatedCost()) {
                bestPlan = sortMergeJoinPlan;
            }
            
            return bestPlan;
        }
        
        private QueryPlan createNestedLoopJoinPlan(Table t1, Table t2, List<String> conditions) {
            QueryPlan plan = new QueryPlan("NESTED_LOOP_JOIN");
            plan.addTable(t1.getName());
            plan.addTable(t2.getName());
            
            // Cost: O(|t1| * |t2|)
            double cost = t1.getRowCount() * t2.getRowCount();
            
            // Apply selectivity for join conditions
            double selectivity = calculateSelectivity(conditions, t1, t2);
            int resultRows = (int) (t1.getRowCount() * t2.getRowCount() * selectivity);
            
            plan.setEstimatedCost(cost);
            plan.setEstimatedRowCount(resultRows);
            
            return plan;
        }
        
        private QueryPlan createHashJoinPlan(Table t1, Table t2, List<String> conditions) {
            QueryPlan plan = new QueryPlan("HASH_JOIN");
            plan.addTable(t1.getName());
            plan.addTable(t2.getName());
            
            // Cost: O(|t1| + |t2|) for hash table build and probe
            double cost = t1.getRowCount() + t2.getRowCount();
            
            // Add hash table memory cost
            cost += t1.getRowCount() * 0.1; // Assume smaller table for hash table
            
            double selectivity = calculateSelectivity(conditions, t1, t2);
            int resultRows = (int) (t1.getRowCount() * t2.getRowCount() * selectivity);
            
            plan.setEstimatedCost(cost);
            plan.setEstimatedRowCount(resultRows);
            
            return plan;
        }
        
        private QueryPlan createSortMergeJoinPlan(Table t1, Table t2, List<String> conditions) {
            QueryPlan plan = new QueryPlan("SORT_MERGE_JOIN");
            plan.addTable(t1.getName());
            plan.addTable(t2.getName());
            
            // Cost: O(|t1| log |t1| + |t2| log |t2|) for sorting + O(|t1| + |t2|) for merging
            double cost = t1.getRowCount() * Math.log(t1.getRowCount()) + 
                         t2.getRowCount() * Math.log(t2.getRowCount()) + 
                         t1.getRowCount() + t2.getRowCount();
            
            double selectivity = calculateSelectivity(conditions, t1, t2);
            int resultRows = (int) (t1.getRowCount() * t2.getRowCount() * selectivity);
            
            plan.setEstimatedCost(cost);
            plan.setEstimatedRowCount(resultRows);
            
            return plan;
        }
        
        private QueryPlan optimizeMultiTableJoin(List<String> tableNames, List<String> conditions) {
            // Simplified: use greedy approach based on table sizes
            List<String> remainingTables = new ArrayList<>(tableNames);
            remainingTables.sort((t1, t2) -> Integer.compare(
                tables.get(t1).getRowCount(), 
                tables.get(t2).getRowCount()
            ));
            
            QueryPlan plan = new QueryPlan("MULTI_TABLE_JOIN");
            double totalCost = 0;
            int currentRowCount = tables.get(remainingTables.get(0)).getRowCount();
            
            plan.addTable(remainingTables.get(0));
            
            for (int i = 1; i < remainingTables.size(); i++) {
                String nextTable = remainingTables.get(i);
                Table t = tables.get(nextTable);
                
                // Estimate join cost
                double joinCost = currentRowCount * t.getRowCount();
                totalCost += joinCost;
                
                // Update current row count (simplified selectivity)
                currentRowCount = (int) (currentRowCount * t.getRowCount() * 0.1);
                
                plan.addTable(nextTable);
            }
            
            plan.setEstimatedCost(totalCost);
            plan.setEstimatedRowCount(currentRowCount);
            
            return plan;
        }
        
        private double calculateSelectivity(List<String> conditions, Table t1, Table t2) {
            if (conditions.isEmpty()) {
                return 1.0; // Cartesian product
            }
            
            // Simplified selectivity estimation
            // In practice, this would parse conditions and use column statistics
            return 0.1; // Assume 10% selectivity for joins
        }
    }
    
    // MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control)
    public static class MVCC {
        
        static class VersionedRecord<T> {
            private T value;
            private long version;
            private long createdBy; // Transaction ID that created this version
            private long deletedBy; // Transaction ID that deleted this version (-1 if not deleted)
            
            public VersionedRecord(T value, long version, long createdBy) {
                this.value = value;
                this.version = version;
                this.createdBy = createdBy;
                this.deletedBy = -1;
            }
            
            public T getValue() { return value; }
            public long getVersion() { return version; }
            public long getCreatedBy() { return createdBy; }
            public long getDeletedBy() { return deletedBy; }
            public void setDeletedBy(long transactionId) { this.deletedBy = transactionId; }
            public boolean isDeleted() { return deletedBy != -1; }
        }
        
        static class Transaction {
            private long id;
            private long startTimestamp;
            private TransactionStatus status;
            private Set<String> readSet;
            private Set<String> writeSet;
            
            public Transaction(long id, long startTimestamp) {
                this.id = id;
                this.startTimestamp = startTimestamp;
                this.status = TransactionStatus.ACTIVE;
                this.readSet = new HashSet<>();
                this.writeSet = new HashSet<>();
            }
            
            public long getId() { return id; }
            public long getStartTimestamp() { return startTimestamp; }
            public TransactionStatus getStatus() { return status; }
            public void setStatus(TransactionStatus status) { this.status = status; }
            public Set<String> getReadSet() { return new HashSet<>(readSet); }
            public Set<String> getWriteSet() { return new HashSet<>(writeSet); }
            public void addRead(String key) { readSet.add(key); }
            public void addWrite(String key) { writeSet.add(key); }
        }
        
        enum TransactionStatus {
            ACTIVE, COMMITTED, ABORTED
        }
        
        private Map<String, List<VersionedRecord<Object>>> versionChains;
        private Map<Long, Transaction> activeTransactions;
        private AtomicLong nextTransactionId;
        private AtomicLong globalTimestamp;
        
        public MVCC() {
            this.versionChains = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
            this.activeTransactions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
            this.nextTransactionId = new AtomicLong(1);
            this.globalTimestamp = new AtomicLong(1);
        }
        
        public Transaction beginTransaction() {
            long id = nextTransactionId.getAndIncrement();
            long timestamp = globalTimestamp.get();
            
            Transaction transaction = new Transaction(id, timestamp);
            activeTransactions.put(id, transaction);
            
            return transaction;
        }
        
        public Object read(Transaction transaction, String key) {
            transaction.addRead(key);
            
            List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions = versionChains.get(key);
            if (versions == null) {
                return null;
            }
            
            // Find the latest version visible to this transaction
            for (int i = versions.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                VersionedRecord<Object> record = versions.get(i);
                
                if (isVisible(record, transaction)) {
                    return record.isDeleted() ? null : record.getValue();
                }
            }
            
            return null;
        }
        
        public boolean write(Transaction transaction, String key, Object value) {
            transaction.addWrite(key);
            
            // Check for write-write conflicts
            List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions = versionChains.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>());
            
            synchronized (versions) {
                // Check if there's a newer version created after this transaction started
                for (VersionedRecord<Object> record : versions) {
                    if (record.getCreatedBy() > transaction.getStartTimestamp() && 
                        record.getCreatedBy() != transaction.getId()) {
                        return false; // Write-write conflict
                    }
                }
                
                // Create new version
                long version = globalTimestamp.incrementAndGet();
                VersionedRecord<Object> newRecord = new VersionedRecord<>(value, version, transaction.getId());
                versions.add(newRecord);
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        public boolean delete(Transaction transaction, String key) {
            transaction.addWrite(key);
            
            List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions = versionChains.get(key);
            if (versions == null) {
                return false;
            }
            
            synchronized (versions) {
                // Find the latest visible version and mark it as deleted
                for (int i = versions.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    VersionedRecord<Object> record = versions.get(i);
                    
                    if (isVisible(record, transaction) && !record.isDeleted()) {
                        record.setDeletedBy(transaction.getId());
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        public boolean commit(Transaction transaction) {
            // Validation phase (simplified)
            if (!validateTransaction(transaction)) {
                abort(transaction);
                return false;
            }
            
            // Commit phase
            transaction.setStatus(TransactionStatus.COMMITTED);
            activeTransactions.remove(transaction.getId());
            
            // Cleanup old versions (garbage collection)
            cleanupOldVersions();
            
            return true;
        }
        
        public void abort(Transaction transaction) {
            transaction.setStatus(TransactionStatus.ABORTED);
            
            // Remove versions created by this transaction
            for (String key : transaction.getWriteSet()) {
                List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions = versionChains.get(key);
                if (versions != null) {
                    synchronized (versions) {
                        versions.removeIf(record -> record.getCreatedBy() == transaction.getId());
                        
                        // Restore deleted versions
                        for (VersionedRecord<Object> record : versions) {
                            if (record.getDeletedBy() == transaction.getId()) {
                                record.setDeletedBy(-1);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            activeTransactions.remove(transaction.getId());
        }
        
        private boolean isVisible(VersionedRecord<Object> record, Transaction transaction) {
            // A version is visible if:
            // 1. It was created by this transaction, OR
            // 2. It was created by a committed transaction before this transaction started
            //    AND it wasn't deleted by a committed transaction before this transaction started
            
            if (record.getCreatedBy() == transaction.getId()) {
                return true;
            }
            
            if (record.getCreatedBy() <= transaction.getStartTimestamp()) {
                Transaction creatorTx = activeTransactions.get(record.getCreatedBy());
                
                if (creatorTx == null || creatorTx.getStatus() == TransactionStatus.COMMITTED) {
                    // Check if deleted by a committed transaction
                    if (record.isDeleted()) {
                        if (record.getDeletedBy() <= transaction.getStartTimestamp()) {
                            Transaction deleterTx = activeTransactions.get(record.getDeletedBy());
                            return deleterTx != null && deleterTx.getStatus() != TransactionStatus.COMMITTED;
                        }
                        return record.getDeletedBy() == transaction.getId();
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }
        
        private boolean validateTransaction(Transaction transaction) {
            // Simplified validation: check for read-write conflicts
            for (String key : transaction.getReadSet()) {
                List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions = versionChains.get(key);
                if (versions != null) {
                    for (VersionedRecord<Object> record : versions) {
                        if (record.getCreatedBy() > transaction.getStartTimestamp() && 
                            record.getCreatedBy() != transaction.getId()) {
                            return false; // Read-write conflict
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        private void cleanupOldVersions() {
            long minActiveTimestamp = activeTransactions.values().stream()
                .mapToLong(Transaction::getStartTimestamp)
                .min()
                .orElse(globalTimestamp.get());
            
            for (List<VersionedRecord<Object>> versions : versionChains.values()) {
                synchronized (versions) {
                    versions.removeIf(record -> 
                        record.getVersion() < minActiveTimestamp && 
                        record.getCreatedBy() < minActiveTimestamp);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
**Time**: O(log n) for B+ tree operations, O(n!) for query optimization, O(1) for MVCC operations, **Space**: O(n)
